feature: Clinical Data Exchange
description: The Clinical Data Exchange (CDX) feature allows for the seamless exchange of documents and records between cooperating vaults. *This feature is only available to Early Adopters and is not validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: Clinical Data Exchange ID & Cross-Vault Mapping
description: This feature gives all future clinical documents a CDX ID that Vault uses to track documents that are exchanged between vaults. *This feature is only available to Early Adopters and is not validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: Monitoring Reviewer Comments
description: This feature enhances the reviewing capability on Monitoring Event records for CTMS customers. Once configured, users can navigate to a comment modal by clicking the icon next to related records or trip report questions on a Monitoring Event record. *This feature requires additional Admin configuration.

feature: Homepage Enrollment Status Graph Enhancements
description: The Enrollment Status Graph on both the CRA and Study Manager Homepages now shows data even if First Subject In, Last Subject In, or Last Subject Out dates are unavailable. Lines on the graph do not show if the appropriate data associated with them is unavailable.

feature: Vault Payments: Fee Schedule
description: This feature allows users to create one or more fee schedules for a site that can be associated with multiple fees. The fee schedule is then routed for approval. This feature is available when Vault Payments is enabled. *This feature is only available to Early Adopters and is not validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: Milestone/EDL Creation Job Runs as System
description: This feature enhances the milestone and EDL creation job by running it as System instead of as the user initiating the action. This supports use cases where a user has permissions to activate a site, but should not have access to view the milestones and EDLs created from the

feature: Exclude Correspondence from Bulk Export
description: When the Show Correspondence in Viewer setting is enabled, Admins can now choose whether to include or exclude correspondence documents during bulk submission exports.

feature: Bulk Submission Export Job Enhancements
description: Vault now groups each bulk submission export request by Export ID within the requesting user’s FTP folder, and automatically deletes them from the FTP after 15 days.

feature: Jordan (JO) 1.0 DTD Support
description: Submissions Archive users are now able to import submissions using the new Jordan (JO) 1.0 DTD for eCTD submissions.

feature: Swiss (CH) 1.4 DTD Support
description: Submissions Archive users are now able to import submissions using the latest Swiss (CH) 1.4 DTD for eCTD submissions.

feature: Record-Level Locking for Quality
description: This feature introduces record-level locking for various objects in Quality vaults, preventing users from editing the same record simultaneously.

feature: Quality Teams
description: The Quality Teams feature set allows users to make individual work assignments to individual Change Controls, Audits, CAPAs, or other Quality event related processes. Users define these assignments directly from the record detail page by selecting individual user assignments from a list of users authorized to perform that role on that record.

feature: Vault Quality Station Manager Client Permissions
description: Admins now have the ability to explicitly control which users are allowed to log into the Station Manager mobile application and whether those users are allowed to use a version of the application installed from the public application store. *Station Manager client permissions appear in all Quality vaults and support a future

feature: Vault Configuration Report Enhancements
description: Vault Configuration Reports now support component and settings such as Document & Binder Templates, Default Rule & Override Rules, and Vault Settings. Additional changes include cover page enhancements and user- friendly readability of Document Lifecycle State and Role Security Options as well as Object Lifecycle State Entry Criteria, Entry Actions, and User Actions.

feature: Vault Loader Load Usability Enhancements
description: Usability enhancements for Vault Loader include a new column mapping utility that allows users to map the columns of a CSV file to the available fields of the selected object type, an updated UI, auto- formatting of valid Boolean values to standard Vault format, and lookup of picklist value keys based on labels before the load job is submitted.

feature: Workflow Configuration Version History in Document Workflow Admin
description: Admins can review past workflow configurations from the workflow details page.

feature: Allow Short Circuit in Document Workflow for Non-Cancellable Tasks
description: This enhancement allows Admins to configure document workflows to short circuit without setting the "Allow cancel task" option on short-circuited tasks.

feature: Auto-Start Object Workflow
description: Admins can configure Vault to initiate a workflow through an event action or lifecycle state entry action.

feature: Conditional Overlays
description: Admins can configure conditions, based on document metadata and lifecycle state, that indicate which overlay to apply to a document when downloaded.

feature: Event Actions on Document Lifecycles
description: Admins can configure event actions on document lifecycles that take place automatically when a user creates a new document, creates a new draft of an existing document, or creates a copy of an existing document.

feature: Event Actions on Object Lifecycles
description: Admins can configure automated "entry actions" that occur for an object record when it's created.

feature: Layout Rules
description: Layout Rules use Boolean expressions to

feature: Persist Formula Formatting
description: This feature preserves certain formatting applied by an Admin in Vault formulas, such as next line, spaces, and tabs.

feature: Spark Messaging
description: With Spark, the Vault Java SDK provides QueueService to send notifications to external systems or other vaults. When another vault receives a message, the Vault Java SDK code executes a message process to automate cross vault processes.

feature: Copy Link to Document and Page
description: Users can create and copy a permalink that leads to a document or page, and paste or embed it in another location.

feature: Checklist Design Export to Flattened CSV
description: Admins can configure a user action on a Checklist Design lifecycle state that exports a checklist design and its related records to a flattened CSV.

feature: Formatted Output Tokens for User & Timestamp
description: Admin can configure formatted outputs to display additional tokens on the output representing the Vault user who requested the output.

feature: Formula Support for Picklist Field Default
description: This feature provides the ability to default Picklist type field values using the formula expression builder.

feature: Create Object Records in Non-Initial State
description: Using the Vault API, users can create object records in a state other than the starting state.

feature: Document Type Admin Displays Name
description: In Admin > Configuration > Document Types, Admins can see the name value for document types, subtypes, and classifications rather than just the label value.

feature: Limit for Picklist Items
description: With this release, Vault prevents Admins from adding more than 1,500 items to a single picklist, and Admins can only edit and save existing picklists if the total number of items is 1,500 or fewer. Vault will not modify picklists that already have over 1,500 items.

feature: Enable Asynchronous Binder Export
description: Most vaults already use the Asynchronous Binder Export feature. In this release, Asynchronous Binder Export will be enabled in all vaults. The Binder

feature: HTTP Callout
description: With HTTP Callout, the Vault Java SDK provides HttpService to allow other vaults or external applications to call the Vault REST API or other external APIs.

feature: Salesforce Delegated Auth Supports URLs Without Salesforce Instance Names
description: With this release, Vault fully supports the changes detailed in Salesforce’s Spring '18 critical update of removal of instance names from URLs for Visualforce.

feature: Vault Loader Support for 50k VQL Limit
description: This feature removes the 2,000-character limit for a Where clause and increases the total VQL query limit to 50,000 characters.

feature: Proactive Subject Visit Seeding
description: In 18R3.0 we delivered a feature that populated a Monitoring Event with Subject Visits based on that Subject Visit’s SDV Complete Date. With this feature, we are extending this ability to allow the seeding of Subject Visits that do not have an SDV Complete Date, but do have a Visit Complete Date.

feature: Custom Monitoring Event Milestone Automation
description: This feature allows customers to create custom types of Monitoring Events and a matching custom Milestone Type.

feature: Seeding Follow-Up Items on Monitoring Events
description: This feature allows customers to seed open follow-up items and follow-up items closed since the last Monitoring Event within the current Monitoring Event.

feature: Subject Recruitment Planning
description: This feature allows CTMS customers to plan the number of Subjects that will be screened, enrolled or randomized into a Study on a month-by-month basis. It includes the ability to provide a Start and End Date for each Study, Study Country and Site, and a total number for each Metric. An action, run by the user, takes this information and creates Metrics Over Time records that capture the number of Planned and Actual Subjects per month. Information at the Study Country and Site levels rolls up to the Study and Study Country levels to allow for a more accurate plan of Subject recruitment.

feature: Vault Payments: Fee Schedule Template
description: This feature provides the ability to define a fee schedule template at the Study and Study Country levels.

feature: Automatically Seed Metrics
description: This feature allows a customer to configure an entry action that runs when a Study, Study Country or Site reaches a particular lifecycle state.

feature: Configurable Metric Usage
description: This feature allows customers to choose specific metrics, such as Total Randomized, on a study-by-study basis to ignore throughout the system.

feature: Monitoring Event Object Compliance
description: In support of Monitoring Reviewer Comments, we are adding the ability for customers to control Monitoring Compliance with a field on the Monitoring Event.

feature: Incorporation of Clinical User Tasks into Existing Milestone Features
description: We have extended several milestone- related features to include clinical user tasks in their capabilities. Clinical user tasks are now considered when using Milestone Gating, Milestone Autocompletion, and the Milestone Hover Card.

feature: Clinical EDL Template Refactor
description: This feature will introduce an alternative configuration to support the linkage of milestones and expected documents using a milestone type value on template expected document records.

feature: Person & Organization Migration
description: This feature introduces a series of changes to your Vault Clinical application objects. These changes serve to streamline the process of creating Person, Study Person, and Study Organization object records.

feature: Clinical Version-Aware EDLs
description: This feature gives Clinical Vaults the ability to set document versions for EDL Item matching. This allows users to accurately measure TMF completeness with confidence at any given point in time and to track the linkage of specific EDL Item versions to individual milestones.

feature: New TMF Viewer
description: New TMF Viewer to replace the existing TMF Viewer. It is composed of a window displaying the selected hierarchy structure next to an interactive document list grid. Documents can be filtered with column header filters to more easily navigate to the relevant documents within your TMF. Additionally, prior versions of documents can be accessed from directly within the document list.

feature: Disable Send as Link for Restricted Documents
description: This feature introduces a new Admin setting allowing organizations to limit their users' ability to share restricted (unblinded) documents via Send As Link.

feature: Veeva Clinical Network for CRO to Sponsor Transfer
description: The Clinical Network is a new feature for Clinical Vaults that allows the seamless exchange of documents and records between cooperating vaults.*This feature is not validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: SiteDocs Data Model Changes
description: We have set the System ID field on the standard objects Study Product Role, Study Organization Role, and Study Staff Role to read-only.

feature: Study eBinder Enhancements
description: Changes to the user interface elements and behavior of the eBinder tab. Primary behavior change is that the eBinder no longer displays minor document versions.

feature: Back to Vault from Brand/Medical Portal
description: Users with access to multiple vaults can now access vault from the Portal Selector while working in a Portal.

feature: Compliance Package Generation Improvements: Enforce Documents are in a Steady State Check
description: This feature prevents non-steady state content from being included when users execute the Generate Compliance Package bulk action.

feature: Set Binder Content Version Binding to Steady State Entry Action
description: This feature automatically sets binding rules on binder content to bind to the latest Steady state content.

feature: Prevent State Change When Outstanding Publishing Items Exist
description: Admins can configure a new Publishing Complete entry criteria on Submission object lifecycle states to prevent state changes while outstanding publishing jobs still exist.

feature: Unreferenced Files in Submissions Publishing
description: With this feature, organizations can now include supporting documents not referenced by XMLs, such as working documents, in the published submission output.

feature: Open Content Plan Item from Submissions Archive
description: Admins can configure the Open Content Plan Item action to allow users to open a

feature: XEVMPD Gateway Submission: Supporting Data Model & Configuration
description: This feature adds the configuration components that will allow customers who generate XEVPRM messages within Vault to submit these to the European Medicines Agency (EMA) through the EMA AS2 Gateway. Any configuration will not be active until the XEVMPD Gateway feature is delivered in a future release.

application: RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Action Level Security for Additional Regulatory Actions
description: Admins can now configure Action Level Security from a permission set or within an object lifecycle for additional actions in RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, and RIM Submissions Archive vaults.

application: RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Medical Device Data Model
description: This feature introduces data model changes that support medical devices and in vitro diagnostics. *Data model changes are only visible to a small number of early adopters in 19R2.

feature: Report Level Content Plan for Product Family Reports
description: Customers can use existing Report Level Content Plan functionality to create and publish complex reports such as Pharmacovigilance reports and Investigator Brochures in addition to Clinical and Nonclinical Study Reports.

feature: Content Plan Item Manual Matching on Create Placeholder & Upload Document Actions
description: The Create Placeholder and Upload Document user actions on the Content Plan Item record now immediately match the document or document placeholder to the Content Plan Item and no longer rely on continuous matching. Vault now treats these actions as manual matches.

feature: Show Inactive Records in Content Plan Viewer
description: Vault now automatically hides Inactive records in the Hierarchy Viewer, and users can click "Show Inactive" to toggle between showing and hiding Inactive records.

feature: Content Plan Usability Enhancements
description: This feature provides Content Plan enhancements, including a new Progress Icon formula field on the Content Plan Item object that allows users to visually track a record's progress, as well as the ability to open matched and published documents in a mini-browser window for easy review.

feature: Simplified Import: Dossier Formats
description: Admins can now configure dossier formats and parameters that predefine the application and submission folders for eCTD and Non-eCTD dossiers, and can define how a non-eCTD should display in the Submissions Archive Viewer.

feature: Real-time Correspondence in Viewer
description: Vault now queues correspondence documents and displays changes in the Submissions Archive Viewer as users import or remove submissions or update correspondence documents. This feature also removes the Submissions Archive Correspondence job.

feature: Show eCTD Metadata Mapping on Submission Import
description: Admins now have an option on the Admin > Settings > Application Settings page to show or hide the metadata mapping step when users import eCTD submissions. This feature does not impact users’ ability to set or update metadata through the API.

feature: China (CN) 1.0 XSD Support
description: Submissions Archive users are now able to import and view submissions using the new China (CN) 1.0 XSD for eCTD submissions.

feature: Submission Import from User FTP
description: Submissions Archive users with the FTP: Staging permission can upload dossiers for import from within a Submissions Archive Import folder on the FTP.

feature: Quality Teams: Power Delete Team Memberships Record Action
description: Introduces a record action which can be deployed to Team Enabled Object records which purges all team membership assignments from that record as the Vault system account.

feature: Risk Management in QMS
description: This feature adds in the data model changes for Risk Management in QMS.

feature: Quality Teams: Administration & General Availability
description: Allows for in-UI administration of Quality Teams, and marks the GA release of Quality Teams for QMS customers.

feature: Mandatory Approvers for Document Change Control
description: Approval workflow participants may be automatically assigned by selecting users

feature: QualityOne Station Manager
description: Allows Document Control within QualityOne to be used with the native mobile client so that released and effective documents associated with a device can be viewed using shared device login credentials. *This feature is not validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: QualityOne Training Management
description: Enables training management solution including quizzes in QualityOne. Ensures development of employee skills and professional development. Manages content-related training from Document Control and verifies competency with quizzes. *This feature is not validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: Android Station Manager Enhancements
description: The feature enhances the Vault Station Manager Android sync to reliably run every 15 minutes, even when the app is not actively in use. Additionally, the Station Manager mobile application now always reflects the current state of Station Document records in Vault.

feature: Management of Signing Certificates for SAML & Spark
description: Spark messages sent from Vault as well as SAML Requests sent during SP- initiated SSO are signed with a Vault certificate. All vaults use the same certificate for signing. With this feature, the certificates will be centrally managed in VMC, where they will go through a cycle of use and expiration, whereby a new certificates would be introduced and rolled into production upon expiration. At the same time, a Vault Admin may select and test the newly introduced certificate for Spark message or SAML Request signing before it goes into production.

feature: Object Field Encryption
description: Allows storing of object field values as encrypted in VOF database.

feature: Dataset Configuration Migration Enhancements
description: Support any unique field for object reference lookup in Outbound Migration Packages. Added support for Update and Delete operations.

feature: Vault Compare Enhancements
description: Detail comparison for the following items: Default Rule and Override Rules, Documents & Binder Templates, and Vault Settings.

feature: Dependent Picklists for Objects
description: This feature allows admins to set up dependencies on Picklists Object fields. With dependency, when a controlling field value is selected, a subset of controlled field values is available.

feature: Filtering on Related Object Sections
description: Filtering on Related Object Sections allows admins to filter related object records on other criteria in addition to just object types.

feature: Lifecycle Stages
description: Admins can group document and object lifecycle states into ordered collections of “stages” in order to delineate which steps are complete and which still remain. Vault then visually represents a document or object record’s current stage on the Doc Info page or object record detail page, including color coding to represent whether a stage is completed, in progress, or upcoming. *This feature is not validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: Merge Fields for Excel
description: Allows users to have Vault search within a Microsoft Excel™ (XLSX) source file and replace tokens with values from the document's metadata (document fields).

feature: Multi-Document Workflow: Enhanced Support for Document Fields
description: This feature enables Admin to configure a workflow Content Action step with actions that update a document field using a formula expression. Admin is also able to make the content action conditional based on document field values.

feature: Multi-Document Workflow: Prompt for Fields on Start Step & Task Step
description: Admins can configure workflow Start and Task steps to prompt the workflow initiator or task owner, respectively, for

feature: Date-Based Monitored Subjects & Enrollment Status Logs
description: The "Date-Based" value in the Metric Calculation field will now apply to both Monitored Metrics on Monitoring Events and the creation of Enrollment Status Logs, which are used to populate the Enrollment Status Graph on the CTMS Homepages. This enhancement only impacts customers using the "Date- Based" Metric Calculation.

feature: Subject Recruitment Planning Enhancements
description: This feature enhances the 19R2 Subject Recruitment Planning feature, allowing users to display their planned Metrics Over Time on the CTMS Homepage’s Enrollment Status Graph, plan Metrics Over Time week-by-week instead of month-by-month, and allow tracking of Metrics and Metrics Over Time per Study Arm. *Auto-on in vaults with Subject Recruitment Planning configured.

feature: Surfacing Monitoring Reviewer Comments Resolved By
description: This enhancement to Monitoring Reviewer Comments tracks the user who resolves a review comment and displays the user's name in the Reviewer Comments dialog for easy visibility.

feature: Standard Monitoring Event Approval Complete Date
description: This enhancement adds a new Approval Complete Date field to the Monitoring Event object; Vault sets this value when the Monitoring Event moves to the Final lifecycle state.

feature: Promote Person to User
description: Admins can add a Promote Person to User action on the Person object to more easily create a corresponding User record for that Person record and automatically link the two.

feature: Person & Organization Migration
description: This feature migrates the existing Person object to the Vault Platform Person object, merges the Study Team Assignment object with the Study Person object, and updates the Study Organization object. These changes serve to streamline the process for creating Person, Study Person, and Study Organization object

feature: Quality Teams: Cancel Role-Assigned Task When User is Removed from Role
description: For Quality Teams-governed roles, this feature automatically cancels a task should the user leave the Sharing Settings role while the task is assigned. *Auto-on in vaults using Quality Teams.

feature: QMS Spark Connection: Change Control & Variation Management
description: This feature leverages the Vault Spark framework to connect QMS vaults to Registrations vaults, streamlining the variation process for manufacturing change controls. *This feature is not validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: Copy Custom Fields
description: Vault Training can copy data from a field on a Training Requirement record to the identical, matching field on a Training Assignment record. Admins can set up custom sharing or matching rules on the Training Assignment record based on the copied data to determine record access.

feature: Instructor-Led Training
description: This feature introduces a new Training Requirement type, Classroom Training Requirement, and allows Admins to configure class rosters, schedules, session quizzes, and training materials.

feature: Training Requirement Recurrence Enhancement
description: A new Absolute recurrence option for documents and classroom Training Requirements allows Vault to issue training tasks to Learners on a fixed date.

feature: Data Model Changes for Training Assignment Checklist Lifecycle
description: This feature introduces changes to be consistent with additional entry actions that were added as part of the Instructor- Led Training feature.

feature: Job Logging
description: This feature enhances the log file for the Update Training Assignments job to provide additional detail about what the job did during its run.

feature: Learner Task Page for Document Training Assignments
description: This feature updates Vault Training's Learner task page to support more than one document per Training Requirement and to provide additional information to the Learner.

feature: Multi-Document Training
description: Enhancements to the Vault Training

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Allow Multi-Select on Standard Document Fields
description: When this feature is enabled, Admins can configure certain standard document fields to be multi-select.

feature: Validation Results Archiving
description: Vault now archives validation results from previous publishing activities and adds them as attachments on the Submission or Report Level Content Plan records. *This feature is Auto-on for all RIM Submissions and RIM Submissions Publishing vaults but only impacts vaults currently using the Inline Validation Results feature. Contact Veeva Support to enable Inline Validation Results on your vault.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Submissions Archive, RIM Submissions
feature: Regulatory Buttons & Breadcrumbs
description: New navigation options across various RIM vaults allow users to easily traverse content plans, the Hierarchy Viewer, the Submissions Archive Viewer, and Application and Submission records.

feature: XEVMPD Gateway Submission
description: This feature allows customers who generate XEVPRM messages within Vault to submit these to the European Medicines Agency (EMA) directly through the EMA AS2 Gateway.

feature: Bundle Regulatory Objectives
description: This feature enhances the Vault Registrations bundling capabilities by allowing users to start grouping planned regulatory changes at the regulatory objective level.

feature: Dynamic Labels in Impact Assessment Report Prompt
description: In the Impact Assessment Report start dialog, the options in the drop-downs now display Admin-defined object labels and object field labels to represent customers’ Vault configurations.

feature: Enhancements to Create Registrations Wizard
description: This release provides enhancements to the bulk creation process for registrations to improve the user experience and better support customers with different registration types, such as drug products or medical devices.

feature: Registrations Spark Connection: Change Control & Variation
description: This feature leverages the Vault Spark framework to connect QMS vaults to Registrations vaults, streamlining the

feature: Block Use of System- Managed Name in Validation Rule
description: With this change, Vault prevents Admins from using a system-managed Name field in record validation rules.

feature: Increase Formula Field Limit for Objects
description: This change increases the formula field limit to ten (10) formula fields per object. The previous limit was five (5).

feature: Java SDK Message Catalog: Admin UI
description: With this feature, Admins can use the UI to create and manage the Vault Java SDK message catalog. *This feature may not be validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: Spark Message Processor Label Clarification
description: Throughout the Vault UI, "Message Processor" has been changed to "Spark Message Processor". In Vault Java SDK, the Vault extension "MessageProcessor" will not be renamed.

feature: UI Changes in Object Page Layout Editor
description: When editing an object page layout, the Create Section button is now labeled Add Section and the two options under Add Section (Single Column Detail Form and Two Column Detail Form) have been consolidated into a single item (Detail Form). *This feature is not visible in pre- release vaults but will be Auto-on in the general release.

feature: Spark User Exceptions
description: This feature allows developers building Spark Integrations to track, route, and resolve any exceptions that require the attention of a Business Admin.

feature: Enhanced Delegate Access Experience
description: This feature improves the experience for delegate users.

feature: System Objects Supported in Related Record Audit Trails
description: This feature provides support for system objects within the related record audit trail.

feature: Create Anchors
description: This feature enables users to create anchors on documents directly via a new Create Anchors tool on the annotate toolbar.

feature: Global ID & Link Fields for Object Records
description: This feature introduces two new fields, Global ID and Link, to every object in Vault to uniquely identify object records and support integrations. Vault doesn't audit the addition of these two system fields in the System Audit History.

feature: Include Seconds in Audit Trail Export Timestamp Column
description: This feature adds seconds to audit entry Timestamp columns, which are available when exporting from an individual audit trail or from Admin > Logs.

feature: Multi-Document Workflow: Remove Documents from Envelope
description: A workflow initiator can remove one or more documents from an envelope after a multi-document workflow has started.

feature: Record ID & Object Label Column in Object Audit Exports
description: Object record audit exports now include a Record ID field, and exports to CSV and Text will contain the Object Label field.

feature: Update EDL Item Tracking Fields When Batch Update Is No/Blank
description: Vault now updates the document count and completeness fields on EDL Item records that have the Batch Update field set to “No” to allow users to see accurate EDL Item progress.

feature: Display Object Reference Fields as Links in Reports
description: Object reference fields in reports now appear as links to the objects referenced.

feature: Download Notes to CSV
description: Users can now download annotations from Vault documents as a CSV file.

feature: Global ID & Link Fields for Documents/Versions
description: This feature introduces new fields to uniquely identify a document and a document version.

feature: Improved File Transfer for Vault File Manager
description: Vault File Manager can now download or upload multiple files at once. The client also displays a progress bar for each file being checked out or checked in and allows users to skip files.

feature: Improved Handling for Multiple Action Bookmarks
description: This feature improves Vault’s handling of multi-action bookmarks in PDF source documents to inspect all actions on the bookmark and enable navigation for the first supported action. Additionally, Vault maintains the correct nested bookmark structure as defined in the source PDF.

feature: Pareto Charts
description: Vault dashboards now support Pareto charts. Pareto charts are like standard column charts except that the groups are always ordered from largest to smallest, and they provide a cumulative percentage line.

feature: Task Instructions in Reports
description: This feature allows users to include Task

feature: Remove Deprecated Re- Render Options
description: This feature removes several re-render options which are no longer applicable.

feature: Restrict Adding Users to Active Workflows with SDK- Managed Participants
description: When an object workflow configuration includes the option to use custom actions (created using Vault Java SDK) to define participants, the participant group is no longer available in the Add Participants dialog. This prevents users from manually changing the membership for participant groups defined by custom Vault Java SDK code. *Auto-on in vaults where a configured workflow uses the Record Workflow Action with SDK Managed Participants.

feature: Simple Join Objects Include Lifecycle State Fields
description: Lifecycle fields will no longer convert a simple join section into a complex join section. If an existing complex join has only Lifecycle fields in addition to the System fields, Vault shows the Add button instead of the Create button, and records of the second parent object instead of join records.

feature: Document Workflow: Add Participants to Unselected Optional Tasks
description: Participant groups for optional tasks now appear in the Add Workflow Participants dialog, even if the associated optional task was not assigned when starting the workflow.

feature: Limited Release Sandbox
description: Admins for a General Release vault will be able to create a sandbox on a Limited Release POD. *This feature will not be validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: Vault EDC/CTMS Connection with Spark
description: This feature allows customers using both Vault EDC and Vault CTMS applications to connect those vaults for the purpose of transferring Studies, Study Countries, and Sites from Vault CTMS to Vault EDC and Subjects, Subject Visits, and Visit Definitions from Vault EDC to Vault CTMS using the Vault Spark Messaging framework. *This feature is not validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: Yuzu: Japanese Clinical Trial Notification Generation
description: This feature allows users to generate and manage Japanese CTN on Vault CTMS. *This feature is only available to Early Adopters.

application: CTMS, eTMF, Study Startup, Vault Payments
feature: Streamlined Reuse for Product/Person/Org Documents
description: This feature allows Admins to identify which of their document types are frequently reused, and maintains the Study, Study Country, and Study Site fields for those document types as Persons, Organizations, or Products are added to and removed from studies.

application: CTMS, Study Startup, Vault Payments, eTMF
feature: Study Team Role Field Enhancements
description: This feature allows certain Study Team Role record fields (Name, Description, Monitoring Visit Participant, and Link) to be edited even if the Study Team Role record is referenced by a User Role Setup record.

application: CTMS, eTMF, Study Startup, Vault Payments
feature: Clinical Operations Configuration for Object References in Advanced Search
description: The Object References in Advanced Search feature enables Admins to add object reference fields as filters in the Advanced Search dialog for documents. By default, Clinical Operations vaults include the Study, Study Country, and Site object reference fields as filters in the Advanced Search dialog.

application: CTMS, Study Startup, Vault Payments, eTMF
feature: Clinical Operations Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

application: CTMS, eTMF, Study Startup, Vault Payments
feature: Delay & Batch Autocomplete Job
description: Vault now calculates completeness metrics and autocompletion after a five-

feature: Enhanced Configurability of Standard Fields on Select Medical Inquiry Standard Objects
description: Admins can specify whether the following fields are mandatory: Case Priority, Origination Channel, Request Category, Preferred Response Method, Case Contact, National Provider Identifier (NPI), and Specialty.

feature: MedComms Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: New Shared Field for CLM iOS Native Resolution
description: This feature adds a new shared picklist field, iOS Resolution, to the Multichannel Slide document type to support CRM Native Resolution.

feature: Open Portal Experience from Vault
description: With this feature, users can open the full Portal in the current browser tab. In addition, users with the correct permissions can edit the Portal directly from the Portal Selector drop-down on the Portal Homepage.

feature: Update BEE Editor Support
description: Users will no longer be able to delete folders if they contain files or other folders. Internet Explorer users will no longer be able to use the BEE email template editor to edit email templates in Vault. *This feature may not be validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: Auto Claims Linking: Hierarchical Copy on Claims
description: When making a copy of Claim records, users can now choose to also copy the References and Match Text Variations.

feature: Auto Claims Linking: Match Text Variations
description: This feature allows users to add multiple approved match text variations to each Claim record and enables the Auto Claims Linking feature to find and link each variation to the defined set of references on the Approved Claim.

feature: Auto Claims Linking: Prevent Move & Edit References on Approved Links

feature: Auto-Recall Controlled Copies
description: Customers using Extensible Controlled Copy can configure their vaults to find all associated controlled copies when a document version is superseded or obsolesced, change their lifecycle states, and configure auto-start workflows to initiate a reconciliation process.

feature: Display Mandatory Participants in Workflow Start Dialog
description: The initiator of a Document Change Control (DCC) workflow that includes Mandatory Participants is able to see which groups and users will receive mandatory review/approval tasks in the Start dialog before the workflow is initiated.

feature: Station Manager: Document Categorization
description: This feature allows for the categorization of documents assigned to a Station. Categories are defined and managed in Vault and applied on the mobile application, so operators can pick a category and only browse the documents relevant to their current task. *This feature supports future versions of the Station Manager mobile applications.

feature: Station Manager: Additional Fields on Station Device
description: Station Device records now include three new fields to give Business and IT Admins additional information for their tablets running Station Manager. *Admins must add new fields to the Station Device object page layout. **This feature supports future versions of the Station Manager mobile applications.

feature: External Training Type
description: A new training type allows Learners to complete training on content or topics that occur outside of Vault.

feature: Complete Training Assignment Workflow Visible in Admin
description: The Complete Training Assignment workflow is now visible in Admin. This allows Admins to configure Notifications and Task Reminders for the workflow.

feature: Direct Assignment to Curriculum
description: Direct Assignment now supports issuing a Direct Assignment Training Assignment for a Curriculum.

feature: Manager Access to Training Records
description: This feature adds the ability for a Learner’s manager to have visibility into Learners’ Training Assignment records.

feature: Direct Assignment to Multiple Learners
description: Direct Assignment now supports issuing a Direct Assignment Training Assignment to multiple Learners within a single request. *Auto-on in vaults with the Direct Assignment feature enabled.

feature: Improvements to Learner Task Page
description: This feature enhances the Learner Task Page UI, adding checkmarks for viewed documents, a default landing page, a Learner Task Page presentation for completed Training Assignments, and minor cosmetic improvements.

feature: Training Requirement Object Type Limitation
description: This feature prohibits changing a Training Requirement record's object type after saving the record.

feature: Training Requirement ZIP File Limitation
description: Users cannot add ZIP files to Training Requirement records.

feature: Person Object: Remove User Restrictions When Adding a Learner Role
description: When adding a Learner Role to a Person record, an active User reference is only required if Training Eligibility is set to Eligible. *Auto-on in vaults utilizing the Use Training Eligibility setting.

feature: Australia eCTD XSD 3.1 Publishing & Validation
description: Users in RIM Publishing vaults can now create content plans and generate submissions that are compliant with the AU TGA v3.1 (XSD 3.1) specification. Vault validates these submissions based on the corresponding AU TGA v3.1 Validation Criteria. *This feature is not validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: Switzerland eCTD DTD 1.4 Publishing & Validation
description: Users in RIM Publishing vaults can now create content plans and generate submissions that are compliant with the CH Swissmedic v1.4 (DTD 1.4) specification. Vault validates these

feature: Enable External Users to Bring Forward Anchor Annotations
description: When granted the Annotate and Manage Anchors permissions, users with the External User license type can now bring forward anchor annotations from a previous version of a document to the latest version.

feature: Multi-Pass Reporting: Ladder Scenario
description: Admins can now create multi-pass reports that support more complex data models such as objects with multiple in-bound relationships. Users can also join reports on dates and leverage the new date report type.

feature: Object References in Advanced Search
description: Admins can configure up to five (5) object reference fields to be included as filters in the Advanced Search dialog for documents.

feature: Run Job on Latest Steady State Version
description: This feature enables date-based document jobs to run on the latest Steady state version of a document, even if it is not the absolute latest version.

feature: Deletion Rule Label Updates
description: This feature updates the labels of Deletion Rule drop-down options for both document reference fields and object reference fields.

feature: Expand Time Period for Login Audit Logs
description: Admins can now view and export data from the Login Audit Trail without time restrictions.

feature: Spark Message Delivery Event Handler
description: This new SDK interface allows applications and customers to handle delivery failures of Spark messages. *Auto-on for Outbound Queues implementing MessageDeliveryEventHandler in their Spark Messaging integration.

feature: Formatted Output: List of Attachments
description: Formatted Output users can now include a list of attached files from the targeted record.

feature: Lookup Field on Lifecycle State
description: Vault Admins can now create Lookup- type fields on objects that reference Lifecycle (lifecycle__v) and Lifecycle State (state__v) fields to allow users to view the states of related records.

feature: RBSM: Clinical Risk Assessments
description: This feature allows users to curate a library of selectable risks, create re- usable risk assessment templates, and generate study-specific risk assessments. By tracking impact, probability, and detectability on study-specific risks, along with an overall risk score on the study- specific risk assessment, users can understand specific areas of risk and how this study compares to the risk of other studies.

feature: Yuzu: CTN Enhancements
description: With this release, we’ve made various enhancements to Yuzu: Clinical Trial Notifications including improved error handling for XML validation, format improvements for generated documents, JIS Level 1 and 2 character set validation for CTN data, and a user action to trigger the Change Log job immediately. *This feature is only available to Early Adopters.

description: This feature adds new artifact records to the Vault Clinical Docs Model so that Admins can map certain document types with more granularity.

description: This feature allows users to track the internal processes of Investigator Initiated Studies, including proposal review and approval, study planning and execution, publication tracking, and document tracking.

feature: Pre-Save Field Defaulting
description: This feature improves defaulting behavior for document metadata field values populated by Vault based on values in other fields. Previously, the controlled field did not update until changes were saved. Now, the controlled field values update dynamically to reflect changes to the controlling field in real-time while the user is editing.

feature: Organization Document Reuse Update
description: This feature updates the document reuse functionality to leverage the "Organization" document field rather than the "Contributor's Organization" document field. *Auto-on in vaults with streamlined reuse for organization-level documents configured.

feature: EDL Automation for Study Personnel, Organizations & Products
description: This feature allows for the creation of EDL items from template based on the addition of Person, Organization, and/or Product records to a study, and links them to open milestones based on template configuration. *Available for configuration in vaults with the Clinical EDL Template Refactor and Person & Organization Migration features enabled.

feature: Payments: Generate Payable Items User Action
description: The Generate Payable Items action allows Vault Payments customers to generate payable items by manually evaluating the existing Payable Events against the current approved Fee Schedules for a site.

feature: Rule Set Override
description: This feature allows customers to change the conditions under which the transfer occurs. Users can further constrain the documents and records that are applicable to send or alter the direction in which content is transferred. *This feature may not be validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: Simple TMF Transfer
description: Simple TMF Transfer provides users with the ability to transfer content without requiring large amounts of configuration work. TMF Reference model documents and study data are sent from the CRO vault to the Sponsor vault. *This feature may not be validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: Archive TMF Security
description: This feature enables study team assignments and new document upload for archived studies. Access to the newly available capabilities for archived studies is controlled by the Manage Archive permission.

feature: Archive TMF User Action & Snapshot
description: This feature introduces a user action to archive a study, its documents, and its related records in a single automated job. For documents used across multiple studies, Vault creates a study-specific copy, or snapshot, of the document and archives that copy.

feature: Archive: Snapshot CrossLink Documents
description: This feature ensures that CrossLink documents are protected from further changes when a study is archived. At the moment of archival, Vault automatically creates snapshots of all CrossLink documents to ensure their immutability, while allowing the original CrossLink documents to live on for future use.

feature: Site Connect: Site Packages
description: With this feature, users can create custom regulatory document packages to be sent to Study Sites using SiteVault. SiteVault users will receive documents and document requests. *This feature may not be validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: Milestone Evolution & Standard Metrics
description: This feature introduces industry-standard Global Milestone Types and Global Milestone Offsets to measure key cycle times between milestones. Users can map custom milestone types to these standards, and Vault calculates Cycle Times between completed milestones on a daily basis and recalculates Cycle Times to support historical data. *Available for configuration in vaults with Study Startup.

feature: Site Packages: SiteVault
description: This feature enables site users to receive and respond to regulatory document requests directly in SiteVault when working with Sponsors and CROs who are using Vault Site Connect. *This feature may not be validated in pre- release vaults.

feature: Easy Source Upload
description: This feature dramatically reduces the effort required to get scanned paper source documents ready for monitor

feature: Standard Metrics Fields Now Required
description: With this release, the Global Content Type, Content Creation Currency, and Content Creation Cost fields will be required on all documents. On all existing documents where the Global Content Type, Content Creation Currency, and Content Creation Cost fields are not already populated, these fields will be populated with “Not Specified.” This feature also adds four new currencies: AUD, CHF, CYN, and CAD.

feature: QRM: Process FMEA Assessment Methodology Support
description: This release introduces the ability to model Process FMEA (pFMEA) risk assessments within a customer's vault.

feature: Risk Management: Detectability Support for Qualitative & Quantitative Risk Matrices
description: QMS customers can now implement both Severity x Occurrence style matrices for Quality Risk Management as well as Severity x Occurrence x Detectability matrices within their vaults.

feature: Create Related Records: Effectiveness Checks
description: Vault can now automate the creation of Effectiveness Check records for Quality Events and CAPA Actions.

feature: Enablement Change: QMS to Registrations Spark Connection
description: Customers who wish to enable the QMS to Registrations Spark Connection can now do so without contacting Vault Support to request the feature. This does not automatically enable the feature, but makes the configuration options available to Admins.

feature: Auto-Close Completed MDCCs
description: Customers can now configure their vaults to automatically transition Multi-Document Change Control (MDCC) records to a closed state when all documents in the MDCC have been released or obsolesced.

feature: Copy Content Plan Update
description: In past releases, when users copied a content plan, Vault incorrectly applied source Content Plan Template Constraints to the target content plan. With this release, Vault now ignores the source content plan’s Content Plan Template Constraints when copying a content plan.

feature: Start Multi-Document Workflow from the Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer
description: Users can send up to 100 matched documents on a multi-document workflow directly from the new Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer introduced in 20R1. The documents added to the workflow will respect the filters applied on Content Plan Items and Matched Documents in the viewer. *Auto-on in vaults with the Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer enabled and an active multi-document workflow configured.

feature: Expand Content Plan Section to View Descendant Records in Viewer
description: The Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer now includes an Expand action that allows users to display all descendant Content Plan and Content Plan Item records within the section at once. To show matched documents, users can expand the Content Plan Item records. *Auto-on for users with the All Object Actions: Execute permission on the Content Plan object in vaults with the Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer enabled.

feature: Additional Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer UI Enhancements
description: This release includes minor updates to the Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer UI, including a gray document icon for matched document rows, a banner to display active workflow tasks, and additional document fields to display as Matched Document columns. *Auto-on in vaults with the Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer enabled.

feature: Enablement Change: Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer

feature: Separate SAML SSO Configuration for Login & eSignature
description: Vault now supports a new type of SAML profile, eSignature Profiles, specifically for electronically signing documents and object records via SAML. As part of this feature, we also renamed SAML Profiles to Single Sign-on Profiles.

feature: Document Migration Mode for Vault Loader
description: In Vault Loader, the Object Type Create action for Document Renditions, Document Versions, and Documents, Versions, Roles can now be used without placing the entire vault in Migration Mode.

feature: Inbound Component Dependency Validation
description: This feature provides component dependency validations during the Configuration Migration Package import and deployment process.

feature: Updates to Object Workflow & Lifecycle Formula UI
description: This feature updates the formula editor for object lifecycles and workflows. The formula editor is now consistent with the editor available when configuring objects.

feature: Object & Multi-Document Workflows: Invoke Record Action via a System Action Step
description: This feature enables Admins to configure a System Action workflow step that invokes a Vault Java SDK Record Action as part of an object workflow or a multi- document workflow. When the workflow reaches the System Action step, Vault executes the custom Record Action logic.

feature: Variables for Multi- Document & Object Workflows
description: Multi-document and object workflows support configuration of variables to use with decision steps for branching workflows.

feature: Document Migration Mode API Header
description: A new permission, Document Migration, allows users to include a Document Migration Mode header in bulk document API calls. All documents created or updated within this API call behave as if the vault is in document migration mode. Customers no longer need to enable Migration Mode for the entire vault, which can disrupt auto-matching processes such as EDL and Legal Hold.

feature: Domain Users: Add Vaults in CSV Export
description: This feature adds the list of vaults to which users are assigned in the Domain User CSV export.

feature: Re-establish Vault to Vault Connections
description: Admins can reconnect broken Vault to Vault Spark connections without needing to recreate any interaction-related components.

feature: Spark Integration Rules UI
description: Admins can configure Spark Messaging integration rules in the Vault UI. Previously, integration rule configuration was only available through MDL.

feature: VPK Deployment Order Dependency & Validation
description: This feature introduces a new Validate feature at the Inbound Package level that allows the Admin to determine if an Inbound Package has any dependencies that are blocking the deployment of the package. This feature also adds two new endpoints to the REST API.

feature: Default Search Context
description: When users log in for the first time or navigate to a tab that is not searchable, such as Home or Dashboards, the search box context defaults to search All Documents. Admins can now specify any document or object tab as the default search.

feature: Notification Preferences
description: With this release, Admins can configure four types of notification preferences (Task Notifications, User Mentions, Send as Link, and Shared Views) to help users manage emails coming from Vault. Admins can also set a notification type to Summary to hold messages of this type until the next scheduled email and collate them to send them as a single email.

feature: Improvements for Long Running Jobs
description: In past releases, Vault only cleaned up long-running non-asynchronous jobs that could not complete after 14 days. Now, Vault will clean up these jobs after three (3) days.

feature: Rename Permission for Mobile Applications
description: The label for the Enable App Store Configuration permission is now Enable Direct Installation and includes more accurate help text.

feature: Long-Text Trip Report Question Responses & Comments
description: This feature allows customers to use a long text field for their Trip Report Question responses and comments, allowing for a maximum character length of 32,000 instead of the current 1,500. *Enabling this feature requires a small migration of the data from the current text field to the new long text field.

feature: Displaying Instructions on Trip Report Questions
description: This feature allows Admins to enter instructions for how a user should answer their Trip Report questions. These instructions are visible to users via a clickable icon on the Trip Report Question.

feature: Displaying Required Responses & Comments in Trip Report Questions
description: This feature allows CRAs to easily see which questions require responses on their Trip Report Questions. For multiple- choice questions, Admins can specify which answers require comments. *This feature is auto-on when the Response Required field on a Question record is set to Yes.

feature: Auto-Populate Milestones from Subject Data
description: This feature automates the population of the Actual Finish Date field on first and last subject-related Milestone records at the site level.

feature: Additional Subject Milestones
description: This feature adds New First Subject Out, First Subject Treated, and Last Subject Treated Milestone Types to CTMS vaults.

feature: One-Click Trip Report Question Data Entry
description: This feature improves the entry of Trip Report question responses and comments by allowing CRAs to one-click select multiple-choice responses and one-click type into text response and comment fields.

description: This feature helps customers meet FDA guidelines released in June 2019 by allowing users to automatically generate a new eCTD Compliance Package with Submission Ready Copies of the documents and convert Vault link annotations to relative PDF links. The Compliance Package can then be exported to a Publishing tool to submit to the FDA. Note: The pre-existing Create Compliance Package bulk action will remain, and Admins will need to configure the new Compliance Package functionality. *Validation of core functionality is available with the release of 20R3.

feature: Configurable Standard Metrics
description: This feature makes the Global Content Type, Content Creation Currency, and Content Creation Cost fields not required by default. Configuration options available to other standard fields are now available to Standard Metrics fields.

feature: Standard Metrics Job to Update Global Content Type to Mapped Value
description: This feature allows Vault Owners to run a new asynchronous job called Standard Metrics GCT Mapping Document Update with a new public API. This job will run automatically with the 20R3 release and will update any documents whose Global Content Type is "Not Specified" to a mapped Global Content Type value.

feature: Jordan eCTD DTD 1.1 Publishing & Validation
description: Users in RIM Publishing vaults can now create content plans and generate submissions that are compliant with the JO eCTD v1.1 (DTD 1.1) specification. Vault validates these submissions based on the corresponding JO v1.1 Validation Criteria.

feature: Support Health Canada Validation Profile v5.0
description: RIM Submissions Publishing vaults now support validating Health Canada eCTD submissions using the Health Canada eCTD v5.0 validation rules. *This feature may not be validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: US FDA eCTD Specification v2.4 Support
description: This release updates RIM Publishing vaults to support the new REMS Supplement Submission Type, announced in the US FDA eCTD Specification v2.4. Note that there is no associated DTD update.

feature: Linking to Submissions Archive Content
description: Users in RIM Publishing vaults can now publish Vault link annotations and permalinks that target content within Submissions Archive, allowing for hyperlinks to previously submitted content. *This feature may not be validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: IDMP Phase 2: Algorithms
description: This feature updates the aggregation algorithm that will recurse through RIM Registrations data to compile submission data in new IDMP objects. The full IDMP feature set will be delivered across multiple releases. *Auto-on in vaults with IDMP Phase 1 enabled and configured. **This feature may not be validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: Manage Registered Details Enhancements
description: Enhancements to the Manage Registered Details wizard include: better enforcement of object relationships to prevent bad data; the ability to add additional details for multiple products to the same Investigational Study or Investigational Site registration; and the ability to add and update medical device details in vaults that use Submission object data as the source for the wizard. *This feature may not be validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: Filter Grids & Select All in Manage Registered Details Wizard
description: This feature adds enhancements to the Manage Registered Details wizard UI, including column filters on the grid pages and the ability to select all values in the grid, up to 1,000 records.

feature: Support for Default Values in Field Rules
description: The eTMF & Submissions Spark Connection now supports the inclusion of default values within the integration’s field rules.

feature: Additional Filtering in Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer
description: This feature extends filtering functionality in the Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer to support Date, Object Reference, Picklist, and Lifecycle State fields. *Auto-on in vaults with the Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer enabled.

feature: Save Views in Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer
description: Users can now save and share custom views in the Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer to bookmark current column selections, column order, most filters, and the Show Inactive/Hide Inactive setting. *Auto-on in vaults with the Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer enabled.

description: The Settings page for Station Manager for Android now displays the Station Device record name and the mobile application version.

description: Videos do not play in Station Manager for iOS until the user taps the play button, to provide a consistent user experience regardless of the navigation path to a video.

By default, all configurations with the ADFS / Azure AD Authorization Server Type will be set to ADFS after this release.

feature: Atomic Security for Active Workflow Actions in Objects
description: Admins can now secure the following actions in active object workflows based on lifecycle state and role: Cancel Workflow, Cancel Task, Reassign, Add Participants, and Update Task Due Date.

feature: Managing Sandbox Allowances
description: This feature enables Admins to manage sandbox allowances across all their sandboxes through the UI and the REST API. Admins can manage sandboxes created from the logged-in vault as well as clones created from another sandbox.

feature: Asynchronous Cascade Delete for Checklist Design
description: This feature, when configured, allows users to cascade delete a checklist

feature: Change Issue Type Action
description: Admins can configure the Change Issue Type user action, which changes the object type of an Issue (formerly Protocol Deviation) record. This allows users to promote and demote Issue records to other Issue types.

feature: Seeding Issues on Monitoring Events
description: This feature allows users to seed open Issues (formerly Protocol Deviations) and Issues closed since the last Monitoring Event within the current Monitoring Event. Admins can specify which Issue types seed into Monitoring Events.

feature: CDMS & Clinical Operations Vault Connection: SDV Requiredness
description: The CDMS & Clinical Operations Vault Connection now transfers SDV requiredness on Subject Visit records from EDC vaults to CTMS vaults. This updates any functional transfer utilized in vaults that have previously adopted this feature.

feature: RBSM: Automated Risk Mitigation Actions
description: This feature introduces the ability to define standard Risk Mitigations for potential Risks which are automatically added to Study Risk Assessments. This feature also provides the ability to automatically generate mitigation tasks for users in selected roles to perform for each Study, Study Country, or Site.

feature: Issue Management Enhancements
description: This feature extends the Protocol Deviations object to include full Issue Management capabilities. The Observations issue type, which can be utilized in conjunction with the Change Issue Type action, lets users track preliminary observations and findings in Vault. Admins also have greater flexibility when configuring the requiredness of fields on the Issues (formerly Protocol Deviations) object.

feature: Rule Set-Level Field Defaults
description: This feature allows Admins to create field defaults at the Rule Set-level for Veeva Site Connect and TMF Transfer.

feature: USN Picker
description: Users on Clinical Operations vaults can now search for a site’s Universal Site Number (USN) from within their vault and assign it to an Organization record in their Global Directory. Users can also easily identify “connected” Organizations and Study Sites via a new icon on the object records.

feature: Site User Deprecation
description: This feature removes the Site User License Type and associated legacy collaboration features and user actions from vaults not currently utilizing them. For vaults using this legacy functionality, there will be no change to existing behavior.

feature: Atomic Security for Documents & Clinical Operations
description: The enablement change of the Atomic Security for Document Lifecycles feature to Auto-on in this release removes the Start Workflow permission from the document lifecycle state security matrix, which Vault previously checked when determining which users can perform the Send Document Package action on Study Site records. Users are now required to have a permission set with the Start Workflow permission to perform these actions.

feature: User Profile Accessible for Existing Site Users
description: Site Users can now access their User Profiles in Clinical Operations vaults. If necessary, Admins can disable access via the new View User Profile permission flag in the appropriate permission sets.

feature: Clinical Operations & RIM Vault Connection CrossLink Metadata Sync
description: This feature improves the Clinical Operations & RIM Vault Connection by introducing metadata syncing capabilities across CrossLinked documents. When the fields on a source document are modified, the CrossLink document’s fields are updated in the target Vault to reflect the updates. *Auto-on in vaults with the Clinical Operations & RIM Vault Connection enabled.

feature: Clinical Operations & RIM Vault Connection Document Versioning
description: This feature improves the Clinical Operations & RIM Vault Connection by introducing new versioning behavior for CrossLink documents to keep multiple versions of the same document. *Auto-on in vaults with the Clinical Operations & RIM Vault Connection enabled.

feature: TMF Transfer Archived Documents
description: This feature enables TMF Transfer to send and receive archived documents and records. *This feature may not be validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: Safety Distribution Email Support
description: This enhancement to Veeva Site Connect’s Safety Distribution feature allows Users to email Safety Distribution documents to Study Sites which are not using SiteVault.

feature: Site Connect: Additional Vault Clinical Docs Support
description: This feature adds support to transfer new document types via Veeva Site Connect.

feature: Optional State Change for the Send Document via Clinical Network Action
description: This feature allows customers the option to configure a state change on Veeva Site Connect’s Send Document via Clinical Network action.

feature: Additional Study Sites Visible While Sending Safety Distributions
description: With the Safety Distribution Email Support feature, Site Connect users now see all relevant Study Sites in the Distribute to Sites dialog. Previously, Vault only displayed Study Sites with an active Site Connect Agreement.

feature: Comments for Document Exchange
description: With this feature, Veeva Site Connect users can send and receive comments when exchanging documents and document requests with SiteVault.

feature: Site Connect Enhancements
description: This feature provides a number of enhancements to the Vault Site Connect application, including: support for transferring additional Vault Clinical Docs Artifacts; a new standard Site Rendition rendition type; and hiding the Send Document via Clinical Network action when a document is not related to a Study with an active Site Connect Agreement.

feature: Veeva Site Connect Notifications Send After

feature: eCTD Compliance Package: Relative PDF Links Work in PromoMats
description: Relative PDF links in eCTD Compliance Packages now open in PromoMats, and users no longer need to export a package to open links. *Auto-on in vaults with the eCTD Compliance Package feature enabled.

feature: Quality Teams: Team Role Restrictions & Enhancements
description: This feature introduces the ability to declare, within a team, that a member of a particular role may not also be a member of any other roles, similar to a workflow's participant group role restriction. Additionally, Admins can now create Quality Teams on child objects.

feature: Quality to RIM Vault Connection Update & Resync Enhancements
description: This feature extends the Quality to RIM Vault Connection to allow updates to data in both the Quality QMS vault and the RIM Registrations vault after the initial regulatory Event has been created.

feature: QMS: Product & Supplier Data Model
description: This feature introduces data model changes to improve both the Product hierarchy and the Supplier Quality Management components.

feature: Quality Teams: Team Role Attribute Label Change
description: To support future functionality, the Quality Teams Team Role attribute Constraining Role label has been updated to Constraining Application Role.
