description: Admins can change the time that the Vault Training automation job starts. *This feature may not be validated in pre- release vaults.

feature: Learner Homepage: Resources Section
description: Training Admins can now add and configure a Resources section for the Learner Homepage. *This feature may not be validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: Maximum Attempts for Quizzes
description: With this feature, Learners can retry a training assignment’s quiz a specified number of times. *This feature may not be validated in pre-release vaults.

feature: Updates to Cloning Rules for Vault Training Objects
description: With this release, when a vault is cloned, the following Vault Training objects are not cloned anymore: Learner Role, Curriculum, Training Requirement, Learner Role-Curriculum, and Training Requirement-Curriculum.

feature: Classroom Training Type Mobile Web Support
description: Learners can view Classroom Training Assignments from a mobile browser.

feature: E-Learning Content Mobile Web Support
description: Learners can view and complete e- learning courses, such as SCORM or AICC, from a mobile browser.

feature: External Training Type Mobile Web Support
description: Learners can view and complete External Training Assignments from a mobile browser.

feature: Learner Homepage: Mobile Web Support
description: Learners can view the Learner Homepage from a mobile browser.

feature: Update Training Assignment Due Date Without Sending Task Cancellation Email
description: With this release, when a Training Assignment's Due Date is updated, Vault will no longer send a task cancellation email. Vault will still update the workflow task due date.

feature: Continuous Non-eCTD Structure & TOC Publishing
description: RIM Submissions Publishing vaults can now continuously publish non-eCTD structures, as well as continuously generate and publish a Table of Contents (TOC) as part of a submission.

feature: Publishing Progress Indicator
description: A Publishing Status field displays the current state of submissions publishing

feature: Object & Multi-Document Workflow: Send Notification Based on Roles
description: Vault can now send notifications based on roles in an object or multi-document workflow. Workflow Admins can select one role per notification step.

feature: Object Lifecycle & Workflow: Long Text & Rich Text Fields
description: Admins can now configure Rich Text and Long Text Fields on object lifecycle and object workflow components.

feature: PDF/A Document Rendition
description: In addition to standard PDF viewable document renditions, Vault now supports PDF/A viewable renditions, an ISO- standardized (190005) PDF specialized for the archiving of electronic documents, to comply with widely-adopted ISO standards. This document format provides a reviewable standard and is common in regulatory submissions.

feature: Enhance Compare & Configuration Report to Provide Warnings
description: This feature enhances Compare Reports and Configuration Reports to provide a list of potential component and configuration issues in a separate error log for easier troubleshooting.

feature: Move Spark Queues to the Connection Tab
description: Admins can now access Spark Queues under the Connection tab alongside the other Spark components. This enhancement streamlines UI navigation when creating Spark integrations, and separates Spark Queues from SDK Job Queues.

feature: Rendition Status
description: This feature introduces the Rendition Status page, which allows Admins to view the status of a rendition and troubleshoot rendering issues with source documents.

feature: Spark Integration Rule Support for Object Relationships
description: Spark Integration Rules, which fetch and map data in Vault to Vault integrations, now support object relationships from the source vault, allowing the integration to retrieve data based on the configured relationship from the source vault.

feature: Spark Integration Rules: Allow Modification of Standard Integration Rules
description: Standard Integration Rules can now be delivered as inactive, enabling Admins to turn them on or off as needed. Additionally, Admins can now edit defaults for standard Field Rules.

feature: Spark Integration Rules:
description: This feature allows Admins to easily

feature: Additional Signature Token
description: This feature makes the signee_federated_id__v token available for signatures.

feature: Object Lifecycle & Workflow Expression Enhancement
description: With this feature, expressions in object lifecycle and workflow configurations support additional fields, functions, and operators.

feature: Enablement Change: Atomic Security for Document Lifecycles
description: In past releases, Atomic Security for document lifecycles was only available to customers who requested it from Veeva Support. In this release, Atomic Security for document lifecycles is available for all vaults. The changes mostly impact Admins, but in a few cases, can also impact end users.

feature: Object & Multi-Document Workflow: Timeline View & Task Bar Enhancements
description: Users can now see verdict details in Timeline View for a multi-document workflow. This feature also adds Ad-Hoc Task Instructions in the task bar for both object and multi-document workflows.

feature: Document Owner Can Undo Checkout for All Check Out Types
description: With this release, Document Owners can always perform the Undo Checkout action for all checkout types, as long as they have a document role with the Edit Document permission.

feature: Multi-Document Workflow: Edit Document Fields
description: This feature allows users with appropriate permissions to edit document fields within the multi-document workflow viewer.

feature: Additional Functions in Report Date Filters
description: This feature adds support for the If() function and several logical operators, including = and !=, to report date filters.

feature: Always Display the Document Inbox
description: This feature enhances the Document Inbox to always be available in the Library for users with the Create permission on at least one document type.

feature: Annotate Filters: Enhancements
description: This feature moves annotation filters to the sidebar, adds the Author and Tag filters, and reorganizes and relabels some filters.

feature: Auto Claims Linking: Display Match Text Variation in Info Card
description: Vault now displays the Match Text Variation record ID next to the Claim ID in the footer of Suggested, Approved, and Auto Link annotation info cards when a

feature: Show Document Number in Cart
description: Vault now displays the document number for each document in Cart, which helps to differentiate between documents with similar names. If users start a multi- document workflow from Cart and there is an issue adding documents to the workflow, the warning dialog presents the document numbers that are causing issues.

feature: Template Search Enhancements
description: When creating documents from templates, the field where users select a template is now a type-ahead field, helping users to find templates more easily.

feature: Updated UI for Add Renditions
description: Users can now select the Large Size Asset rendition type in the Add Rendition UI if the selected document type is configured with this rendition type. In addition, this feature updates the Add Rendition dialog, including automatically selecting the rendition type if there is only one available.

feature: CDMS & Clinical Operations Vault Connection: Protocol Deviations
description: This feature allows studies utilizing the standard Protocol Deviations object in Vault CDMS to transfer both manually entered and programmable protocol deviations from Vault EDC to Vault CTMS via the CDMS & Clinical Operations Vault Connection.

feature: Conditional Actions on Trip Report Questions
description: This feature improves the entry of follow up items and issues by allowing CRAs to easily see which Trip Report Question Responses require follow up items and issues. For multiple-choice questions, Admins can specify which answers require users to create or link a related follow up item or issue record.

feature: Add Yuzu Japanese CTN to the Application Settings Page
description: This feature allows Admins to enable and disable the Yuzu Japanese CTN feature from the Application Settings page.

feature: Relabel Question Comment Required Object to Answer with Conditional Requirements
description: The Question Comment Required (question_comment_required__v) object is relabeled to Answer with Conditional Requirements to support the Conditional Actions on Trip Reports feature.

feature: Support for EU Regulatory Agency Issue Notification Tracking
description: This feature adds support for tracking EU Regulatory Notifications on the Issue (pdv__ctms) object. Within an Issue object record, users can specify a Notification Type (Serious Breach, Unexpected Event, and Urgent Safety Measure) and track when the notification should be reported to the EU/EEA Member States. Admins will need to add new fields to the Issue Page Layout in order to fully utilize this feature.

feature: Support for Subject Informed Consent Forms
description: This feature adds support for tracking Subject Informed Consent Forms (ICFs). With the new Subject Informed Consent Form object, users can select a Site Effective Informed Consent Form and a Subject, and then specify the date the Subject signed that ICF in the Signature Date field. A Subject Informed Consent

feature: Site Connect: Additional Vault Clinical Docs Support
description: This feature adds support to transfer new document types via Veeva Site Connect.

feature: Veeva eConsent Transfer with Site Connect
description: With this feature, Site Connect customers will be able to exchange Veeva eConsent documents with SiteVault.

feature: Send Surveys to Non-Users
description: This feature introduces an option to email invitations to complete a Checklist for specific target objects. Non-Vault users can then click on a link in that email to complete the Checklist in Vault.

feature: New Exchangeable Document Types on Connected Studies
description: This feature adds support to transfer the following new document types from a sponsor or CRO’s vault for a Connected Study: * Ancillary Committee Response * Clinical Study Report * Contract * Insurance * Protocol Clarification * Procedure Manual * Protocol Summary of Changes * Protocol Synopsis * Regulatory Authority Response

feature: Digital Delegation Log Updates
description: This feature provides a digital and compliant way to record all of the significant study-related duties that have been delegated to study staff by the principal investigator as part of the Delegation of Authority log. *Only available in vaults with the Extensible SiteVault Permissions feature enabled. This feature may not be validated in pre- release vaults.

feature: Extensible SiteVault Permissions
description: This feature updates how user permissions are managed in SiteVault. To provide additional granularity in user permissions, additional access can be defined at the level of the research organization, site, and study. *This feature may not be validated in pre- release vaults. *This feature is not available in pre-

feature: Commercial Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Material ID
description: This feature adds a Material ID field that is unique to each document that can be used for submission to a health authority. The ID is automatically updated if a second submission is required. This allows customers to upversion documents past steady state, to submit to health authority again with a new unique Material ID.

feature: eCTD Compliance Package 2253 Form Update
description: When generating an eCTD Compliance Package, users can configure Vault to automatically select "Final” on the 2253 Form in Post Marketing Compliance Packages when the Center field is set to CBER - APLB.

feature: Modular Content: Approval Document
description: When working with Content Module objects, users can now generate a document containing key elements of the module and supporting components. This document can then be submitted through a document review process to approve the module for use.

feature: Modular Content: Rich Text Fields
description: With this release, the text fields in Content Module objects use the new Rich Text field type, allowing basic formatting on the text. Existing unformatted text is unaffected and both the plain and rich text are accessible via the API.

feature: PromoMats & RIM Vault Connection
description: This feature introduces part of a PromoMats & RIM Vault Connection for eCTD Submissions, reducing the time it takes to prepare material for submission to the FDA. This includes automating creation of Contact, Submission, Content Plan, and CrossLinks in the RIM vault and creation of Application & Applicant in the PromoMats vault.

feature: Relationship Automation for Quality Objects: Quality
description: Users may establish simple, bi-directional relationships between two records of the

feature: XEVMPD Procedure Number
description: This feature updates the XEVMPD data aggregation algorithm to populate the MRP/DCP/EMA Number from the IDMP Procedure Number field on the Registration record.

feature: Copy Into Content Plans
description: Users working in the Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer can now drag and drop to copy a content plan item or content plan section from one content plan to another.

feature: Extend Content Plan Duplicate Submission Join Detection
description: This feature extends the submission join duplicate detection during the Copy Content Plan action to additionally consider the XML fields on the submission joins.

feature: Asynchronous Content Plan Actions: Locking & Indicator
description: This feature introduces locking that prevents users from initiating an asynchronous Content Plan action when there is a conflicting action already processing on the same Content Plan. The controlled actions include the Content Plan update, Split Content Plan Item, asynchronous state change, and the new Copy into Content Plan. This feature also updates the Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer header to add a status icon to inform users if Vault is processing any of these actions on the current Content Plan.

feature: Collapse Action in Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer
description: This feature adds a new Collapse action for Content Plan records in the Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer to allow users to collapse all descendant Content Plan and Content Plan Item records within a content plan section at once, including matched document rows.

feature: Dynamically Adjust Content Plan Row Height to Fit Text
description: In the Content Plan Hierarchy Viewer, the row height for Content Plan rows now adjusts dynamically to fit text, so that cell text is never cut off vertically when wrapped. Users can no longer adjust row heights manually.

feature: Active Dossier
description: RIM customers with RIM Submissions and Submissions Archive can configure Vault to track and manage documents

feature: Action Menu Button Icon Change
description: This feature updates all action menu buttons from a cog icon to ellipsis icon. The ellipsis icon has become a standard symbol for a menu of actions in modern web applications.

feature: Attachments for Unclassified Documents
description: Documents of the type Unclassified (previously Undefined) now include the Attachments section in the Doc Info pane. Admins can also disable attachments on unclassified documents.

feature: Create Related Record in Record Create Dialog
description: In previous releases, users that wished to create a new record within a related record first had to create a new record if it did not already exist. Users can now create a related record directly in the create record dialog.

feature: Disable Office Online on All Vaults
description: In 21R2, users will no longer be able to check out to Office Online. The preferred technology moving forward is Edit in Office 365 (collaborative authoring). Users can still check in and undo checkout until 21R3, when all Office Online capabilities will be disabled.

feature: Document Inbox Auto-On for All Vaults
description: This feature enables the Document Inbox on all vaults. Additional features introduce ways to control who has access to its abilities, including a way to control exactly which users can create unclassified documents or see the Classify later option when uploading a new document.

feature: Document Workflow on Binders
description: This feature allows users to start a document workflow (formerly multi- document workflow) on binders. Users can start the workflow on a binder itself or on a set of documents that contain binders.

feature: Enable Document Tags on All Vaults
description: This feature enables document tags on all Vaults. Any customers who did not previously have the feature enabled will see a new "Document Tags" item under Document Setup in Admin, as well as the tag__v picklist field on documents.

feature: Infinite Document Scrolling
description: This enhancement eliminates visible tranche navigation on long documents,

feature: Clinical Activities for Investigators
description: This feature adds support for tracking activities related to Investigators in Vault CTMS. With the new Activity object, users can capture details about all actions and interactions performed regarding the selected Investigator.

feature: Expanded CTMS Subject Metrics
description: This feature will add additional metrics to be automatically calculated in Vault CTMS. New metrics will include "Treated", "In Follow Up" and "Lost to Follow Up". This capability will extend to the following features: Metric Calculation, Monitored Metric calculation, Enrollment Status Log calculation, Vault CDMS/ClinOps Connection, Automatic Milestone Population (for First Subject Treated), Seeding Metrics Records, Metrics Not in Use, and Homepage Enrollment Status Graphs.

feature: Support for Resolving Orphaned Monitoring Reviewer Comments
description: This feature allows Admins to configure an entry action on any Monitoring Event lifecycle state that automatically resolves open Review Comments that were deleted from a Monitoring Event. Previously, these ‘orphaned’ records had to be manually resolved by an Admin.

feature: Trip Report Question Branching
description: This feature provides a way to control which Trip Report questions a CRA must populate, depending on their answers to previous questions. For multiple-choice questions, Admins can specify which previous question and answer will allow a later question to be editable.

feature: Yuzu: CTN PMDA XML Update
description: This feature allows Vault CTMS customers to generate Clinical Trial Notification (CTN) documents that meet the requirements provided by Japan's Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency (PMDA) authority.

feature: Displaying Required Trip Report Questions Logic Update
description: This feature will update the logic that highlights required trip report question elements to utilize the new Highlight

feature: Asynchronous Related Object Change State Entry Action
description: Object lifecycles now support a new entry action to change the state of related records asynchronously. This should be only used for objects with a large number of related records. Using this action, there is no limit on the number of related records whose state can be changed.

feature: Checklists: Automation for Aggregate Checklist Updates
description: When a new version of a checklist design is approved, an entry action will automatically create new, approved versions of all approved aggregate checklist designs containing that checklist design.

feature: Document Reference Field Constraints
description: This feature allows Admins to configure reference constraints on document reference fields in objects.

feature: Set Tokens in Instructions
description: Allows workflow Admins to configure tokens in instructions of workflows, and provides no-link tokens for document lists in notifications.

feature: Single Verdict: Any Lifecycle Workflow
description: This feature allows workflow Admins to configure single verdict on any lifecycle workflows. Verdict doesn't get applied to excluded documents.

feature: Start Step Rule: Required Controls
description: Allows Admins to configure Start Step Rules to require a control at the start of the workflow.

feature: Update Task Due Date on Object Date Field Update
description: This feature allows Admins to sync active task due date with object record's date field. When the due date is synced, update task due date action is unavailable.

feature: Workflow Cancellation Actions
description: Admins can configure actions which trigger upon the cancellation of an active workflow. SDK developers can add their own actions as well.

feature: Workflow Cancellation Comment
description: Allows Admins to require a comment when a workflow is cancelled.

feature: Admin Configuration Tab Updates
description: This Admin>Configuration tab has been updated to display a landing page with links to all the configuration pages available to an Admin. Admins can also search for a configuration page and easily

feature: On Behalf Of Auditing Export Enhancements
description: Audit entries that contain on behalf of will now have a new field populated when exported to CSV. The existing User Name column in the export will contain the user on the left side of on behalf of, while a new column On Behalf Of will contain the user on the right side.

feature: Re-Render Previous Rendition Versions
description: With this release, Vault users with the Vault Owner Actions: Re-render permission can re-render the non-current version of a rendition.

feature: Read & Understood Workflows: Restrict Task Completion by Delegate Users
description: Delegated users cannot complete Read & Understood workflow tasks in the new Read & Understood workflows, released in 21R2 General Release.

feature: Distinct Count in Reports
description: This feature allows users to view the total count of distinct records in a grouped report.

feature: Export Binder Notifications: Show Failed Document Exports
description: Updates the Notifications/Email Template to display the number of documents failed during the Export Binder action.

feature: Formula Fields in Multi- Pass Reports
description: This feature allows users to define formula fields in Multi-Pass reports. This release includes support for object and document report types.

feature: HVO Performance Optimization on Related Object Section & Advanced Search
description: To prevent performance issues when filtering high volume objects, this feature introduces a limit of 1,000 records for any search on high volume objects.

feature: Multi-Down Object Reports Support Summary Calculations
description: Adds the ability to calculate averages and sums across numbers, and mins and maxes for dates within a group in multi- down object reports.

feature: Remove Links in Report Exports
description: This feature allows users to remove links in exported reports.

feature: Search Modifiers on Object Tabs
description: This feature makes search modifiers available on object tabs so users can apply picklist and object reference filters directly from the search box and search within a single text field. This feature was only previously available on document tabs.

feature: Substring Matching for
description: The Contains operator available when

feature: Generate Quality Document from Record: Batch Release Process Support
description: Vault Quality customers can now automatically create documents from Formatted Outputs or Document Templates as part of the Lot/Batch release business process.

feature: Generate Quality Document from Record: Support for Documents Based on Document Templates
description: Customers can now use Entry Actions and User Actions to automate the creation and linking of a new document for a specific record based on a document template.

application: QMS, QualityDocs, Station Manager, Surveillance, Training
feature: Quality Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Enable Reference Objects for Quality Suite Vaults
description: Quality customers can now reference Context, Product, Product Variant, Product Family, Organization, and Department, regardless of applications enabled in a Quality Vault.

feature: MDCC: Change Authorization Section
description: A new Change Authorization object can be leveraged to add one or many documents to a DCC for change authorization approval.

feature: Process Navigator: Steady State Only Flag
description: Allow customers to display the latest steady state version of a document when viewed through Process Navigator.

feature: MDCC: Prevent State Changes on Non-Latest Document Versions
description: If a user attempts to perform a state change on a non-latest version of a document managed through a MDCC, it will be blocked and an error shall be displayed to the end user.

feature: Remove Document from Document Change Control Usability Improvements
description: With this enhancement, when a user removes a document from a Document Change Control, all versions of the document are removed.

feature: DCC Banner Utilizes Label of Document Change Control Object
description: The DCC Banner has now been updated to leverage the label of the document change control object.

feature: Process Navigator: Adjustable Hierarchy Limits
description: Allows a customer to increase the maximum number of hierarchies per object type and child process records per parent with Product Management approval.

feature: Station Manager: Picklist Based Categorization Deprecated
description: Configuration options for selecting a picklist to coincide with categorization are no longer available under Station Configurations.

feature: Station Manager App Update Enforcement: Data Model Update
description: Provisions the Days Left to Upgrade (days_left_to_upgrade__v) field on the Station Device object.

feature: Multi-Country Adverse Events Reporting
description: Vault automatically creates Adverse Event Reports once the user finishes the Reportability Assessment based on the Country of Incident, Severity Outcome of the Complaint, the Product involved in the Incident, and Reporting Decision Rules.

feature: VPS: Validation Results Storage
description: Users are able to see all the validation errors for an Adverse Event Report as object records.

feature: Adverse Event Reports for TGA (Australia)
description: This feature allows users to generate Adverse Event Reports for TGA (Australia).

feature: VPS Data Model Changes
description: Adds data model changes to support VPS features in 21R3.

feature: Training Self-Enrollment
description: Learners can browse a catalog of Training Requirements, self-enroll in Training Requirements, and complete those Training Assignments.

feature: Allow Description Field Requiredness on Curriculum & Learner Role Objects
description: For the Description field on Curriculum and Learner objects, the "User must enter a value (required)" setting can now be enabled.

feature: Increased Limit for Training Join Relationships
description: The maximum number of Training Requirements per Curriculum has been increased to 100. The maximum number of Curricula per Learner has been increased to 60.

feature: Rule References Upon Retiring Training Objects
description: Vault now includes the Rule Set Label and Name in the error message when a Training Requirement or Curriculum is retired.

feature: Training Content Set Object is Not Cloned
description: The Training Content Set object is no longer cloned.

feature: Validate Object Type for Imported Training
description: When Training Assignments are imported, the application validates that the Training

feature: Update Copy into Content Plan Error Validation
description: With this release, Copy into Content Plan has been updated to allow users to copy content plans without an associated submission or report level content plan into submission content plans and report level content plans. Previously, an error validation prevented this action.

feature: Process ZIP Import at the Submission Level
description: When enabled by an Admin, this feature provides an ability to import and process all Zip file uploads via the Submissions Archive import as if the file contents were created at the submission level of the application. Unreferenced files at the root of the submission are grouped in the Unreferenced Files folder.

feature: Empty Section Indicator
description: With this release, Submissions Archive can precalculate which eCTD and EAEU submission sections are empty as a result of delete operations. In the Submissions Archive Viewer users will see an icon depicting which sections are empty as a result of delete operations. When Submissions are newly published or imported, the system will recalculate the impacted Applications. The feature is Admin-enabled and cannot be undone.

feature: EAEU Import & Viewing R.022 XML
description: This feature allows customers to import and view EAEU (Eurasian Economic Union) electronic format submissions in the RIM Submissions Archive. EAEU submissions are supported with all current Submission Archive Import methods when the submission’s Dossier Format is set to EAEU.

feature: Dynamic Ordering for Correspondences
description: With this update, Correspondence documents will also be ordered by the Submission record’s Actual Submission Date when Show Correspondence in Viewer and Enable Dynamic Ordering within Submissions Archive Viewer Submissions Archive settings are enabled.

feature: Informational Warnings in Email Notifications for All Import Methods
description: With this release, users receive post submission import email notifications in an updated format, which includes a new

feature: Protected PDFs for 1572s
description: The Protected PDF Renditions feature available in this release can be used to prevent Vault-signed 1572s from being edited once downloaded from SiteVault.

feature: SiteVault Setup Assistant
description: With this feature, SiteVault users can more easily add users to a site, upload their profile documents, and assign them to studies. This feature is only available for SiteVault using the Extensible Permissions security model.

feature: Research Organizations Selectable in the Vault Selector
description: For SiteVaults using the Extensible Permissions security model, all users can select a Research Organization in the Vault Selector. There are some recommended configuration changes associated with this feature.

feature: Scheduled Study Access for External Users
description: For SiteVaults using the Extensible Permissions security model, this feature allows Admins to schedule study access for external users by specifying start and end dates. External users automatically receive and lose access to the study on the start and end dates, respectively.

feature: Create Draft from Original
description: With this feature, SiteVault users will be able to create a draft version of a document using the latest version of the original document that it is based on.

feature: Connected Studies: Exchangeable Organization Profile Document Update
description: With this feature, Central IRB/IEC a Central Lab profile documents will no- longer send to the Sponsor/CRO on Connected Studies. This enhancement prevents Sites from inadvertently sending documents to a Sponsor/CRO that they already have in their Clinical Operations Vault.

feature: Share Non-eConsent Documents with Participants
description: This feature allows SiteVault users to designate certain types of documents for sharing with patients so that the documents are accessible to patients and their signatories through MyVeeva for Patients.

feature: SiteVault Data Model Changes
description: New "Role is External" field on Access Level and Study Role objects. New rich

feature: Monitoring Schedule Planning
description: Monitoring Scheduling allows defining time-based plans for upcoming Monitoring vents. Monitoring Events are initiated by meeting defined milestones and recurring monitoring events can be scheduled based on a defined frequency. An optional Parameter can be defined to support multiple schedules within a study or study country.

feature: RBSM: Critical Data & Processes
description: This feature adds support for tracking Critical Data and Processes for a Study. As part of a Study Risk Assessment, users can define the data points and processes that are critical to study execution and link the records to Study Risks. Admins will need to configure page layouts to fully utilize this feature.

feature: Support to Identify Non- enrolling Sites
description: This feature automatically identifies when a Study Site has no Subjects enrolled when the "No New Subjects" field is checked. This allows users to easily identify and configure processes to inactivate related milestones for sites that did not enroll Subjects. *Auto-on in Vaults where Enable Automated Enrollment Milestones is enabled

application: CTMS, Site Connect, Study Startup, Vault Payments, eTMF
feature: Clinical Operations Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

application: CTMS, Study Startup, Vault Payments, eTMF
feature: Milestone Roll Up Enhancements
description: This feature delivers improvements to Milestone Rollup behavior. When the Milestone Rollups Enhancements setting is enabled and Rollup (Max date) and/or Rollup (Min date) Milestone Dependencies are configured, Vault will reassess roll up dates when a previous milestone date is set to null or a previous milestone is inactivated.

application: CTMS, Study Startup, eTMF, Vault Payments
feature: Restrict Document Study to Single Value
description: This feature introduces a Vault-wide setting that disables certain Clinical functionality and restricts the Study document field to a single value.

application: CTMS, Study Startup, eTMF, Vault Payments
feature: Automate Milestone State Changes: Additional Date Field Triggers
description: This feature introduces additional triggers that fire following the update of a milestone’s planned start, planned finish, and actual start dates, and which updates other milestone date fields, metrics, and/or state without relying on lifecycle actions. This feature is Auto-on in Vaults where the "Automate Milestone State Changes" flag was already enabled. Other Vaults will require configuration.

feature: Site Payment Holdbacks
description: This feature allows Vault Payments to identify fees that require holdbacks. Vault Payments now generates and manages holdback payment tracking and release for payment to study sites.

feature: Site Overhead Calculations
description: Vault Payments can now define whether Fee and Fee Templates should expect the addition of Overhead. If added, Vault Payments will calculate the Total Amount field value with the matching Overhead Percentage.

feature: Subject Payment Tracking Rules
description: This feature allows Vault Payments customers to add additional Payment Rules to their Fees. You can add Subject Status as a required criterion for a Visit or Procedure fee, and use Source Data Verification status as a criterion for a Visit fee.

feature: CDMS/ClinOps: Support for Multiple CDMS Vaults
description: Ability to connect a single CTMS vault to multiple CDMS vaults in the same domain

feature: CDMS/ClinOps: Single Study Refresh
description: Allows Vault Product Support to run a refresh job for a single study. This feature replaces the existing 'full refresh' capability.

feature: TMF Bot: Auto- Classification Enhancements
description: In 21R3 we enabled the TMF Bot for all Vault eTMF customers. This feature includes updates requested from our new- found Clinical AI customers. It includes changing auto-on models to .95 prediction confidence, and excluding Documents with null Pages when auto-training. Auto- on in Vaults with TMF Bot configured.

feature: Clinical Email Ingestion: Relevant Communications
description: This feature leverages platform email ingestion functionality to support inbound email addresses that will create a TMF document from an inbound message and relate it to a Study Communication Log record.

feature: TMF Bot: Bulk Upload Pipeline
description: This feature will extend the TMF Bot capabilities to scenarios where documents are uploaded in bulk to the Document Inbox. This includes: API, Vault Loader and FTP Loader. Auto-on in Vaults with TMF Bot configured.

feature: Transfer CSV Reports for TMF Transfer
description: This feature provides greater visibility into TMF Transfer activity on both the sending and receiving Vaults. Two CSV reports are now attached to each Agreement Transfer record to better show the specific Names and Global IDs of each transferred item.

feature: Milestone Gating for EDL Item Requiredness
description: This feature extends milestone gating support to check that all related EDL items have a requiredness value of “Required” or “Not Required.”

feature: Cancel Site Connect Agreement Invitation
description: This feature allows Site Connect customers to now cancel Pending Site Connect Study Agreements, deactivating the agreement and canceling the workflow task in SiteVault.

feature: Mark Site Connect Document as Rescinded
description: With this feature, Site Connect customers can now take a "Mark Rescinded" user action on documents sent over Site Connect. Taking this action will update the 'Marked Rescinded by Sponsor/CRO' field to "Yes" on the corresponding document in SiteVault.

feature: Site Connect Details User Action
description: Site Connect customers can now access more details regarding a document's distribution to site(s) via a Site Connect Details user action. This action launches a dialog to display tracking information as well as the document's comment history exchanged with a site.

feature: Site Connect: Additional Vault Clinical Docs Support
description: This feature adds support to transfer new document types via Veeva Site Connect.

description: Vault now automatically populates the Related holdback Item field when it generates Payable Items for a Fee that includes Holdbacks.

description: Allows Vault Payments users to automate the creation of Site Fee Definitions from another Study or Site Fee Template.

feature: Display Vault Upgrade Warning

description: A Sandbox Snapshot is a copy of a Sandbox Vault that can store Configuration and optionally Data at a given point of time. Snapshots can be used to create or refresh Sandbox Vaults.

feature: Manage Document Auto Numbering
description: Admins can import a CSV file to update the database tables for document auto-numbering. This tool can also be used to view the current numbers used for all document number formats.

feature: Configuration Report: Atomic Security Enhancement
description: Previously, Vault Configuration Report only included Atomic Security on fields, controls, actions, and relationships if there are overrides. In this release, we have included non-overridden default values as well.

feature: Object Lifecycle Entry Criteria: State of Related Record Rule Can Validate Multiple States
description: Object Lifecycle Entry Criteria validation rules for validating the state of related records now support the includes operator, allowing admins to configure the rule to validate multiple states.

description: The Binder Display Options for Unbound Documents setting allows you to configure how unbound documents display when viewing and exporting documents from binders.In this release, this setting can be enabled through the Admin Settings instead of Veeva Support.

feature: Sort Multi-Select Field Values in Alphabetical Order
description: In this release, the setting to sort multi-select field values in alphabetical order can be configured through the Admin Settings instead of Veeva Support.

feature: Vault Configuration Report: Include all Objects for Metadata Export
description: All objects that are visible in the Admin UI are now visible in the Vault Configuration Report except a select few that are used by the Platform.

feature: Vault Usage & Performance Statistics: User Activation-Deactivation Performance Statistic
description: Introduces two performance statistics: User Activation Count and User Deactivation Count.

feature: Vault Loader Support for MAXROWS & SKIP
description: Vault Loader users can now leverage the MAXROWS and SKIP VQL clauses to page through and retrieve large record sets.

feature: Platform Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Document Templates Limit in Sandbox Cloning
description: Vault no longer includes document templates in Sandboxes when the total size of the document templates exceeds 5GB.

feature: Checklists: Increased Limit for Maximum Answers per Question
description: The limit for Maximum Answers per Question is now increased from 10 to 20.

feature: External Inbound Connections
description: This feature allows Vault Admins and developers to manage external, inbound REST API requests as External Connections in the Vault Admin UI.

feature: Signature Page Generation Enhancements
description: Previously, signature pages were generated only when viewed for the first time or after a new signature was captured in the user’s language. Now, Vault will also generate signature pages when a document enters its steady state in the set document language. Users can regenerate signature pages through a user action once it has been configured.

feature: eSignatures: Object Signature User Title & Delegate Capture
description: Object signatures now capture and store the signing user's title and delegate user information in the signature record.

feature: Advanced Filter Logic for Multi-Pass Reports
description: Allows users to add OR logic between filters on different objects and views in a multi-pass report, making reports more flexible.

feature: Save Link Type Selection as a User Preference
description: When a user creates a link annotation on a document, Vault now pre-selects their most recently selected link type in Vaults where more than one link type is available.

feature: Later Version Available Indicator
description: Document search results will now display a icon indicating when a later version is available to the user via one of their other roles on the document.

feature: Notifications: Add Annotation Replies to Summary Emails
description: Allows Admins to set the email notification preference for annotation replies.

feature: File Size Reduction for Viewable Rendition Downloads
description: Vault optimizes downloaded viewable renditions configured with overlays by removing duplicate fonts, images, and other elements, resulting in a smaller PDF file.

feature: Checklists: Batch Saving Responses
description: The performance of the checklist respondent UI is improved by batch saving the responses instead of saving each response.

feature: Glossary Usability Enhancements
description: Vault now includes the user’s name when recording activity in Glossary Event object records. This feature also enables the Glossary on video documents.

feature: Prevent Re-Render of Documents with Manual Renditions
description: Currently, if a document has a manual rendition and is re-rendered, the manual rendition is replaced with a Vault-generated rendition. Users must now delete the manually uploaded rendition before requesting a new rendition via re-render.

feature: Person Object: Duplicate Person Record Enhancements
description: When users attempt to create a Person record from an object reference field on a document or object record, they can now select an existing record when duplicate records are found.    Users are also now alerted of potential duplicate Person records through the Copy Record action.

feature: Download Source Files using Vault File Manager
description: When downloading source files from Vault, users can now download using Vault File Manager.

feature: Vault Loader Support for Record Migration Mode Update & Upsert
description: Vault Loader users can now leverage Record Migration Mode to update and upsert records to any state while bypassing reference constraints and validation rules.

feature: Notifications: Comma-separated Picklist Values for Notification Template Tokens
description: Minor UI enhancement where tokens in notification templates that resolve to picklist values are now comma-separated.

feature: VFM Resumable Upload & Download for Check Out & Check In
description: If a document check out/in process via Vault File Manager is interrupted, users can resume the process where the interruption occurred.

feature: New Certificate for SAML SSO & Spark Messaging Connection
description: Vault is scheduled to rollover the signing certificate used to sign SAML Single Sign-on requests and Spark messaging connections.  Your IT organization must ensure that the new certificate is configured on your Enterprise Identity Provider system prior to the New Certificate Rollover Event on March 3, 2023 6:00 pm PT.

feature: Jobs: Support DateTimes as Trigger Date
description: With this release, Admins can now leverage DateTime fields as triggers for Date Based Document and Object Operation type Jobs.

feature: Improved Name Search
description: Improves the ranking of search results when matching on document name or record name. This is done by considering any extra unmatched terms in the name when determining the relevance score. For example, searching for "Deviation Review Process" would rank "Deviation Review Process - Europe" below "Deviation Review Process". All of the search terms were found in both documents, but the one with one unmatched term appears lower in the results. This helps exact matches to appear above all other matches.

feature: Improved Rendering Status Reporting
description: Vault now provides more insight into the process and restrictions of creating viewable renditions.

feature: Object Reference Field in Reports Formulas
description: This feature adds support for object reference fields in report formula fields.

feature: Upload Documents UI Enhancements
description: Vault now uses updated icons and typography when uploading documents to clearly indicate to users whether a document uploaded successfully, with warnings, or unsuccessfully.

feature: Vault Loader Support for Picklist as Unique Field for Upsert
description: Vault Loader users can now select picklist fields in the Key Field drop-down when upserting object records.

feature: Object Record Lifecycle User Actions Appear in their Configured Order
description: Object record lifecycle user actions on the object record detail page appear in their configured order.

feature: Country Object: Add Code Field
description: A Code field is now available for the Country object to facilitate easy transfer of Country records in future Vault Connections.

feature: Updated Download Icon for Source File
description: The Download icon for source files has been updated to an icon that is more intuitive for the action that it represents.

feature: Binder Search with Document Numbers
description: Users can now search for document numbers in the "Search Current Binder" search box.

feature: Add a File to a Placeholder via Drag & Drop
description: Users can now add files to placeholders via drag & drop.

feature: Workflow Details on Active Workflows & Timeline
description: For workflows in the Active Workflows home page, the workflow start date and workflow version are now visible. For object workflows, the workflow version is now visible in the workflow timeline on the object record page. This helps workflow owners and administrators understand which version of the configuration is being used for the active workflow.

feature: Workflow Participant Selection Actions Support Search by Email Address
description: Start Step participant controls, the add participant action, and re-assign task action on workflows for documents and objects now support the search of users by entering an email address.

feature: Spanish Stemming Improvements
description: Allows users to search in Spanish without acute accents. Searching for "Guia de documentacion" will match "Guía de documentación". Also provides more flexible matching of plural/singular nouns and past, future, present verbs.

feature: Vault Java SDK Service Account
description: Vault will permanently enable the "Run as Java SDK Service Account" feature, and custom Vault Java SDK code will execute as the new Java SDK Service Account. Vault Admins can no longer disable the setting after the 23R1 release. Audit trails reflect this change, and events will be logged as Java SDK Service Account on behalf of {username}. The Java SDK Service Account user appears in the Users & Groups tab and audit trails and does not count against user licensing. SDK audits will be logged as "java_sdk_service@{domain} on behalf of {user}".

feature: Lookup Field Value Corrections
description: Correction to any outstanding lookup fields that were out of sync with its source field, due to a one-off event in the past that led to lookup inconsistencies.

feature: Lab Test Reopening, Retesting, Canceling & Rejecting
description: Lab Tests can now be reopened after completion to allow for controlled changes, sent through a retesting process as well as cancelled and rejected as needed.

feature: Test Steps for Test Execution
description: Lab Results and Lab Test Inputs can now be grouped into Test Steps. When you complete a Test Step on the Test Execution page, LIMS will validate, calculate, and evaluate the results in that step before proceeding. This feature also includes an update to the collapse/expand control for the procedure document.

feature: Lab Hazards & Special Instructions
description: Adds a Precaution object to capture safety, handling and storage precautions, and a join object to specify multiple precautions for a material and re-use a precaution across many materials.

feature: Reduced Testing Strategies
description: Supports the definition and application of reduced testing strategies for raw materials and finished goods.

feature: Capture Instruments and Consumables in Test Execution
description: Instruments and Consumables usage can now be captured during test execution.

application: LIMS, QMS, QualityDocs, Station Manager, Surveillance, Training, Validation Management
feature: Quality Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Generate Document: Add Users to Document Application Role
description: Generate Document actions have been enhanced to automatically assign users that are associated to selected roles on the record to the same roles on the created document.

feature: 5 Whys Analysis
description: Provides the ability for a Vault user to perform and document a 5 Whys Analysis as a tool to assist in determining the true root cause of a Quality Event or Complaint. For this feature, 5 Whys Analysis will be supported for any standard or custom Quality Event and Complaint object types.

feature: Auto-Create Proposed Audits
description: When an Audit Program record is created, Vault will now provide the ability to automatically create the associated Proposed Audit records based on the Planned Start Date and Planned End Date of the Audit Program as well as the applicable date field on the applicable Organization records, in addition to specific metadata that is configured in the action.

feature: Supplier Change Notifications
description: QMS now supports the ability for customers to send Supplier Change Notifications that originate via an email to a Vault Email Inbox configured with the new Create Supplier Change Notification email processor.

feature: Extend Recurrence Check to Support Custom Object Types on Quality Event
description: Existing Recurrence Check capability in QMS now supports all custom object types on the Quality Event object.

feature: QRM Risk Builder
description: Adds a purpose built interface to make it easier for users to enter risk data into the system.

feature: Standalone MedTech Objects Data Model
description: Modifies the trigger used on Standalone Complaints to allow users to create MedTech Complaints.

feature: QMS <> RIM:  Processing Enhancements
description: Adds a high volume object to track the status of the transaction on the source side of the connection and updates the target side to use job-based processing.

feature: Configurable Document Metadata for Station Manager Apps
description: Station Manager documents can now be configured to display an Admin-selected list of fields.

feature: Certify and Support Station Manager on Android 12 & 13
description: Fully tests and certifies Station Manager for Android devices running Android version 12 and 13.

feature: Audit Trail Behavior Update for the Station Documents
description: This update changes the audit trail behavior of Station Documents and displays the username instead of 'System' or 'System on behalf of <username>' in the User Name field of the Station Document Audit Trail when a document is removed from a Station using the Quality Relationships document information panel.

feature: Support Checklist Versioning for Quizzes
description: The Checklist Versioning feature can now be used with Quizzes.

feature: Tracking Curriculum Completions
description: With this feature, Training automatically calculates the Curriculum Completion % for every Curriculum assigned to a Learner. The automatic calculation happens whenever a Training Assignment is assigned, completed, or canceled.

feature: Complete Training Tasks on Vault Mobile
description: Allows users to complete training tasks from the Vault Mobile app.

feature: Learner Homepage Updates
description: Updates the Learner Homepage in the following ways: 1) Curriculum and Learner Role references are now linked allowing Learners to get to Curriculum Page or Learner Role Page seamlessly. 2) Updated the message a Learner sees if a Training Assignment was opened while it was being processed. 3) Updated the buttons on the Curriculum card. Instead of "View", the button is now "Begin Training". A separate link navigates to the Curriculum detail page.

feature: Enable Vault Training Mobile Interface in All Training Vaults
description: Mobile App and Mobile Web Support are enabled (the "Enable Vault Training Mobile Interface" application setting) on all Training Vaults.

feature: Curriculum Sequencing on Learner Homepage
description: Enables Training Administrators to suggest an order by which curricula should be completed by Learners. Learners are provided with a new grouping option in the Learner Homepage where they may group Training Assignments by Learner Role. Learners can also access a new Learner Role Detail Page, where they get an overview of the selected Learner Role and view all associated curricula.

feature: Prevent Updates to Person Training Eligibility Field if Job is Queued or Running
description: The Training Eligibility field on a Person cannot be modified if the Cancel Training Assignments for Person job is queued or running.

feature: Add Participant Action Available for All Training Workflows
description: The Add Participants action is now available from Workflow Timeline for all Training Assignment workflows. This allows the ability for authorized users to add participants to Evaluation (OJT) and other training assignment workflows in the event that additional users are required to participate in the workflow, without setting up security records.

feature: Tag Reason for Training Assignment Creation
description: Training Assignments created via the training matrix after this release now capture the reason in a new picklist field Creation Reason. The possible values are: Matrix Updates, Document Updates, and Recurrence.

feature: Standalone MedTech CAPA & Nonconformance Objects
description: This feature provisions new standalone objects for Nonconformance and MedTech CAPA processes.

feature: VPS: Reporting Enhancements
description: Adds support for Manufacturer Contact Office for G1 section of eMDR.

feature: eMDR Update: Auto Generate Manufacturer Report Number
description: Automates the Manufacturer Report Number creation for eMDR when the XML file is generated.

feature: Standalone Complaints: VPS Support
description: Adds VPS support (eMDR, EU MIR report types) for the new standalone Complaints object. VPS no longer supports the Quality Event object.

feature: Test Protocol Review
description: Allows executors to view the test protocol narrative content from an execution view of the test script. Users can access the narrative content linked from QualityDocs. Also supports the approval experience whereby all independently reviewed test scripts will be available to defined approvers to review, provide their verdict, and complete their final approval task for the test protocol.

feature: Test Authoring with Requirements Burndown
description: Allow authors of test scripts to easily identify and challenge requirements. Available requirements can be dragged and dropped onto a test step which will update the traceability matrix automatically. Included is the ability to easily search and filter requirements so that they can be linked with test steps based on available attributes such as risk, category, etc. This feature helps to ensure that all necessary requirements are challenged as part of a validation activity while reducing the burden on validation and qualification professionals that manually maintain the trace matrix today.

feature: Improved Gateway Transmission Handling for Out of Order Acknowledgements
description: With this release Vault Publishing now gracefully handles receiving out of order Acknowledgements from Health Authorities following a transmission through the gateway.   *Auto-on in Vaults with gateway submission features enabled. This feature is available with the 23R1.0 B release and is not available in pre-release or limited release Vaults.

feature: User Logs for Gateway Transmissions
description: Vault RIM users are provided with a log file that gives information regarding a submission via the gateway to a Health Authority. The file is added as an Attachment on the Submission record and includes a list of the files that were transmitted and details on any errors that may have occurred.

feature: Support Sequence ID Updates in Continuous Publishing
description: Vault Submissions Publishing will now trigger a continuous publish when the Sequence ID is updated on the Submission record, and Enable Continuous Publishing is enabled. This will update the folder structure without the need to republish all items.

feature: Workgrouping Support for Australia eCTD
description: Vault Submissions Publishing users can add multiple submissions types and subtypes to work-grouping submissions for Australia.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: RIM Email to Vault Processor
description: Vault RIM users can forward emails to a predefined email address to create unclassified documents. Once received, Vault automatically extracts attached documents and creates them in the Document Inbox, including a separate document for the email.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: 23R1 RIM Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Document Merging on Publish
description: To support authoring at a lower level of granularity, Vault merges multiple documents assigned to a single Content Plan Item during Report Level Content Plan publishing or Submission publishing.

feature: Vault Link Annotations: Multiple Target Destination Support
description: Vault Submissions Publishing supports Vault Link Annotations targeting multiple destinations. When multiple destinations are defined, the publishing process determines the destination best suited for the current submission.

feature: FHIR Message Handling in IDMP Viewer
description: The IDMP Viewer displays generated FHIR messages using HL7 FHIR version 4.6.0 to support viewing XML output from the eAF.

feature: Multi-Record Registration Verification
description: The Registration Verification workflow can be reconfigured as a multi-record workflow.

feature: Submission Type Defaulting with Constraint Records
description: Users can select a global term for the Submission Type field in the Bulk Create Activities, Submission, and Regulatory Objectives wizard. The global term value will then be mapped to a corresponding local term by way of constraint records. The resulting Submissions will have the Submission Type field populated by the appropriate local term.

feature: Activity Splitting for Labeling
description: Users can split Activity records to carry forward outstanding Labeling Concepts that have been deferred while allowing the original Activity to be completed.

feature: Registration Type Defaulting with Object Type Mapping
description: The Bulk Create Registrations wizard defaults the appropriate Registration Type value using Admin-configured object type mapping records.

feature: IDMP Data Migration
description: To support IDMP IG V2.1.1, existing data from Registered Site Role records will be migrated to the related registered detail record, and new Authorised Pharmaceutical Form records will be created based on the corresponding Medicinal Product object field.

feature: UPD Data Model Updates
description: The RIM Registrations data model is extended to include Union Product Database (UPD) data points for animal health products, such as species and withdrawal period.

feature: IDMP Data Model Updates
description: The IDMP data aggregation algorithm and source and output data points are updated to support EU IDMP IG V2.1.1. A new Pending Withdrawal state type is also added to allow the algorithm to skip creating output records in the assigned lifecycle state.

feature: EUDAMED UDI XML Generation Updates
description: Vault generates EU UDI Submissions using the EUDAMED XML Schema v2.0.6, which increases the maximum length of the Model and Name for a Basic UDI or EUDAMED DI to 255 characters.

feature: Labeling Automation: Logic Update for Labeling Deviation Trigger
description: This feature modifies how Vault populates fields in labeling records created by a labeling automation trigger: When the trigger runs, Vault sets the Labeling Deviation record's Deviation Review Disposition field to Accepted for Dependent Countries. Once the field is set, the trigger runs again to create corresponding Labeling Deviation and Activity-Labeling Deviation records for any related dependent Activities.

feature: Copy Report Level Content Plan
description: A new system action allows users to create a Content Plan for a Report Level Content Plan by copying from an existing Report Level Content Plan’s Content Plan.

feature: Additional Granularity for Content Plan Template Constraints
description: A new Template Constraint Type picklist and picklist fields are added on Submission, Event, and Constraint. The new field is used in Content Plan Template Constraints functionality to allow for more granularity for excluding and creating Content Plan and Content Plan Item records as inactive based on the additional picklist criteria.

feature: Update Content Plan Study Section
description: A new Update Content Plan Study Section action is available for the Submission Clinical Study and Submission Nonclinical Study objects. Once configured, the action moves valid study sections related to the Submission Clinical Study or Submission Nonclinical Study within the Submission Content Plan to the new location when the Clinical Study Type or Nonclinical Study Type (or Subtype) fields are updated. The action also updates additional fields on the Content Plan and Content Plan Item records in the reparented section, including the Published Output Location, Source Content Plan Template, and Source Content Plan Item Template.

feature: Start Submission Wizard from Regulatory Objective Update
description: The Submission Wizard is enhanced to allow Submission to be optional when initiated from a Regulatory Objective record. This allows relationships to be added directly to the Regulatory Objective only without adding to a Submission in the cases where there is a Regulatory Objective with no associated Submission.

feature: Content Plan and Content Plan Template: Exclude from Auto-Matching
description: This is a data model update only that adds a new Exclude from Auto-Matching field on Content Plan and Content Plan Template. This field is intended to be configured as a conditional entry action in the Content Plan object lifecycle, so that Vault only updates the Match Documents (batch_update__v) field to Yes when Exclude from Auto-Matching is de-selected. This allows organizations to prevent auto-matching of specific Content Plan sections at the template level which are likely not going to auto-match properly.

feature: Increase Limit for Delete Inactive Content Plan Records Job
description: The limit for the Delete Inactive Content Plans job is raised from 5,000 to 50,000 records deleted per job run.

feature: Empty Section Indicator in the New Viewer
description: When a section in the new Submissions Archive Viewer is empty, Vault pre-calculates and displays a specialized styling based on the delete lifecycle operation.

feature: Display Inactive Applications and Submissions in the New Viewer
description: Users can select and view inactive Applications and Submissions in the new Submissions Archive Viewer.

feature: Leaf Source File Path Auto-Correction
description: When an Application folder name is changed, Submissions Archive Admins can initiate a system process to correct previously-imported or published Submission metadata.  *This feature may not be validated in pre-release Vaults.

feature: Save View in the New Submissions Archive Viewer
description: Users can save and share views in the new Submissions Archive Viewer.

feature: Add Submission Fields as Selectable Columns in the New Viewer
description: Users can select, view, and filter on the Submission Lifecycle State and Submission Sequence ID fields as part of the final dossier review process in the new Submissions Archive Viewer.

feature: Submission Based Viewer Filters Automatic Enablement
description: Users are now automatically able to filter by Submission related objects within the new Submissions Archive Viewer. The related legacy Submissions Archive Viewer settings in Admin > Settings > Application Settings are impacted as follows: Enable Submission based Viewer Filter is removed, and Show eCTD Metadata Mapping is removed where Enable Submission based Viewer Filter has been configured.

feature: New Submissions Archive Viewer Automatic Enablement
description: RIM Submissions Archive users are automatically guided to the new Submissions Archive viewer as the default and only RIM Archive viewer supported by Veeva.

feature: Published Document Display Correction in the New Viewer
description: The new Submissions Archive Viewer correctly displays published RIM documents in a steady state.

feature: Support Filtering for XML Section Attributes
description: Users are able to filter on XML section attributes for electronically-formatted submissions in the new Submissions Archive Viewer.

feature: Display Section XML Attributes in the New Viewer
description: The new Submissions Archive Viewer displays section XML attributes for electronically-formatted dossiers.

feature: Enforce Submissions Archive User License
description: RIM Vault users without a Full User license for the Submissions Archive application are blocked from accessing any Submissions Archive functionality, which now includes the new Submissions Archive Viewer.

feature: Active Dossier Loader
description: A new Active Dossier Loader object assists admins with migrating Active Dossier records. When records of this new object are created, for example, by using Vault Loader, Vault creates or updates corresponding Active Dossier Structure, Active Dossier Item, and Active Dossier Item Detail records.

feature: Active Dossier Template Update
description: New records have been added to the Active Dossier Template and RIM Reference Model objects in all RIM Vaults to support 3.2.P.9 Product Interchangeability Equivalence Evidence for ACTD and the granular 3.2.P.2 Pharmaceutical Development components.

feature: Study Training: Vault Connections with Clinical Operations
description: A new standard Vault to Vault connection to automatically send data from a Clinical Operations Vault to a Study Training Vault.

feature: RIM/ClinOps: Support Country to Study Country Document Field Rule Mapping
description: New standard field rules to map Country on RIM to Study Country on Clinical Operations Vaults, and vice versa.  New reference lookup mapping on Clinical to Map Countries between RIM and Clinical Applications.

feature: Vault Connections as System Managed Connections
description: Standard Vault Connections now have their System Managed field enabled by default, meaning they can no longer be referenced in custom Java SDK code.

feature: Quality-RIM: Registered Product Integration for Change Control
description: The Quality to RIM Vault Connection can now transfer Registered Product records between Vaults against which to record change controls.

feature: Subject History
description: We’ve enhanced the handling of transferred Subjects in Clinical Operations Vaults, providing a more consistent and efficient approach to subject management during clinical trials. This update ensures that the transfer of Subjects can be tracked in Vault. Key improvements encompass the creation of Subject History records, a new user action for updating Subject Sites, and the ability to manually create historical records as needed. The creation of Subject History records will be automatically enabled.

feature: Clinical CRM: Automated Clinical Activities
description: Enhances Clinical CRM activity tracking by introducing a job that will automatically create Clinical Activities when Monitoring Event or Study Communication records are created and updated.

feature: Trip Report Question Display Line Breaks
description: The Question column in Trip Report Question Sections will now display question text with line breaks if included in the Question Text (question_text__v) field.

feature: ePRO Survey Report for Monitors
description: This feature provides sponsor users with a report that can be used to monitor ePRO-connected studies in Clinical Operations. From the Study Site or Monitoring Event records, sponsor users can generate and export a ZIP file containing a site's survey responses, survey compliance, audit trail, compliance summary, and SiteVault user access data.

application: CTMS, Site Connect, Study Startup, eTMF
feature: SiteVault Inviter
description: With this feature, Sponsors/CROs will be able to invite Sites to sign up for SiteVault, initiating the process from within Clinical Operations. Within Clinical Operations, customers will be able to track the status of the signup request from delivery through to its completion and will be notified of the Site's Universal Site Number (USN) information.

feature: Editable Study Country Name
description: The Enable Study Country System-Managed Name Field setting can be temporarily disabled from Vault Settings, granting end users the flexibility to manually update the Study Country names as needed.

feature: Display Envelope Tasks in Clinical Operations Homepages
description: Refactors the Clinical Operations homepage task widgets to improve performance and include Envelope  tasks for documents workflows.

feature: Redacted Document Field
description: Provides a Redacted document field to better support sponsor transparency processes.

feature: Enhanced Assigned To Control on Quality Issue
description: Improves the time it takes to load the "Assigned To" users on Quality Issues.

application: CTMS, Study Startup, Vault Payments, eTMF
feature: Study Person Role Constraints
description: Adds support for the restriction of Study Team Role assignments based on Person Type and/or Security Profile.

application: CTMS, Study Startup, Vault Payments, eTMF
feature: Clinical Operations Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Subject Visit Method
description: Incorporates the Visit Method as an additional metadata element on Subject Visit records.

feature: Clinical Operations to CDMS Connection: Enhanced Job Labels
description: Job label now includes information about which connection and integration is impacted.

feature: Clinical Operations to CDMS Connection: Single-Click Navigation to EDC Casebooks
description: Introduces a new standard Casebook Link field (casebook_url__v) that is available on Subject, Visit, Monitored Subject, and Monitored Visit objects in Clinical Operations Vaults. This standard field does not require manual updates to the field formula and links directly to the relevant review page in the CDMS Vault where the casebook is managed.

feature: Clinical Operations to CDMS Connection: Support for Screening Subjects Outside of CDMS
description: Updates the Clinical Operations to CDMS Connection to support Subject handling in Clinical Operations Vaults prior to Subject creation in CDMS. Auto-on in Vaults using the the Clinical Operations to CDMS connection.

feature: Prediction Metrics for Study Metadata Extraction
description: The Prediction Metric records provide a summary of predictions made by a deployed TMF Bot Trained Model to monitor the model’s performance. This feature enhances the current Prediction Metrics to display the Metadata Extraction model's performance data. Auto-on in Vaults with Study Metadata Extraction enabled.

feature: Study Metadata Extraction: Test Model from Production
description: Allows Admins the ability to test a Metadata Extraction model using their Production data from a Sandbox or Pre-release environment, similar to how they can currently train an Auto-classification model. To facilitate this, an action called "Test Model from Production" will be made available, which allows customers to test the model using a training window start date or a CSV file containing a list of document IDs. This feature is auto-on in Vaults with Study Metadata Extraction enabled.

feature: Excluded Classifications for Trained Models
description: Allows Admins to define classifications that will be excluded from trained models of any type. Specified classifications will be omitted from all extraction, training, and testing during model deployment. And, later predictions by the Bot, made as it processes documents, will not be actioned if a document is in or predicted to be in an excluded classification.

feature: Study Metadata Extraction: Bulk Pipeline Support
description: Enhances Study Metadata Extraction to support documents created via the bulk pipeline, such as API or email ingestion. This feature is auto-on in Vaults that have a metadata extraction Trained Model in the deployed state.

feature: TMF Transfer: Match on Country Code
description: When transferring Study Countries, TMF Transfer will use Country records with a matching Code (code__sys) to the Source Vault country. This will reduce the need to map Country records in situations where country names differ between Source and Target Vaults.

feature: TMF Transfer: Match on Site Name
description: TMF Transfer will now search for matching Site records in the Target Vault. Matched Sites will be updated instead of creating a duplicate Site. Sites are considered a match if they have the same name and Study Country as the Source Vault record. If Site records already exist in the Target Vault prior to transfer, this will prevent duplicate Sites from being created and will reduce the need to map Sites.

feature: TMF Viewer UI Enhancements
description: This feature increases the number of columns TMF Viewer can show at once and adds an option to wrap cell text for improved readability.

feature: Site Connect Features Reside in the Digital Trials Platform RIA
description: Site Connect features are documented in the Digital Trials Platform Release Impact Assessment at: https://sites.veevavault.help/gr/release-notes/ria/

feature: Custom Email Senders for Surveys
description: Enhances Feasibility Survey functionality within Study Startup to allow for the flexibility of modifying the email sender address and includes customer branding.

feature: Milestone Workspace
description: Introduces a new app page, accessible from a milestone, where customers can more clearly see the relationship between expected documents and the documents matched to them, and quickly start bulk workflows for each. Also introduces a new system-managed object, Milestone Document, to track the relationship between a milestone and related documents. With this object, it will be possible to associate >1000 milestones to a single document. This feature is auto-on in 23R2, with some configuration required to add the new section to milestone page layouts.

feature: Clinical EDL Template Overrides
description: Reduces EDL templates management and maintenance effort when Country specific rules needs to be applied on Expected documents of any level.

feature: Fee Schedules for Study Organizations
description: Allows users to efficiently manage different Fee Schedules for multiple Payees on the same Site.

feature: Multichannel Events Management Enablement
description: With this release the Multichannel Events Management feature will automatically be enabled for use in Commercial & Medical Vaults that are licensed for the Multichannel App and no longer require support to enable the feature.

feature: PPTX Video Support for CLM Auto-Publishing
description: Allows the Brand team to include embedded videos in presentations delivered to CLM via the Auto-Publish feature.

feature: Bulk Generate eCTD Compliance Package
description: In this release, a new action is available in the ‘Generate Compliance Package’ section when performing a bulk action. Documents are grouped and placed into one or more compliance packages based on application, audience, and compliance package type.

feature: Text Asset Substantiation Lifecycle Entry Criteria
description: This functionality introduces flexibility in selecting what types of Text Asset require a reference and at which point in their lifecycle users must link substantiation.

feature: Controlled Vocabularies for PromoMats
description: Two new objects are available called Controlled Vocabularies and Constraints. When combined with field reference constraints, customers can use these objects to restrict the available options in a dropdown with respect to document or object metadata. This functionality is similar to that of field dependencies but can be applied in workflow task prompts.

feature: AIRs Support for SVG & WebP Files
