description: Merge Fields and Bookmarks (from Microsoft Word) will now render faster.

feature: Default File Size Increased to 500GB
description: The default file size limit for Vault File Manager is now 500 GB, up from 400 GB by default previously. Prior to 23R3, customers could request the limit be increased from 400 GB to 500 GB if necessary, and with this release, we are removing the need for customers to request this increase.

feature: Document Title Displayed in Binder Compact View
description: Users will now be able to see a document’s Title in addition to the Document Name when viewing documents in a binder using the Compact View.

feature: Sticky Create New Reference Record
description: When selecting a related object record in an object reference field, the option to create a new record will now be frozen in the drop-down so that it is always easily accessible. This eliminates the need for a user to scroll through the entire list of available records to get to the Create option. *Auto-on for object reference fields with "Allow create new reference record" option enabled

feature: Workflow Task Options for Update Sharing Settings Actions on Tasks Made Available to Users
description: The Update Sharing Settings Actions in Workflow Task Options on Tasks configured to be made available to users will apply the Task Assignment action rule to the user that accepts a task that was made available to them and to users that were added to the participant group associated with the task. Task Completion and Cancellation action rules will apply to the users & groups in the participant group associated with the task and the user currently assigned to the task.

feature: Email Participants Notification Template Supports Document Workflow Tokens
description: The email notification template for the email participants workflow action now supports the use of multi-document workflow notification template tokens. *Auto-on in Vaults where these tokens have already been added to the Email Participants notification template.

feature: Audit Resync with Source CrossLink Action
description: This feature creates an audit event for the "Resync with Source" action. When "Resync with Source" is clicked on a crosslink document, the message ("Resync with Source" initiated) will show up on the audit trail. *Auto-on in Vaults with CrossLinking enabled.

feature: Vault Object Performance Improvement
description: We’ve improved our Object Framework to support good consistent performance when working with object records on larger vaults.

feature: Create & Reply to Document Comments
description: Users can now view, reply to, and create document comment annotations via the Vault Mobile app.

feature: VeevaID Login Support
description: VeevaID users can now log into the Vault Mobile app to access their Vaults.

feature: Enhanced Document Viewer (Android Only)
description: Viewing documents in the Android Vault Mobile app has been enhanced to now include in- document text search and thumbnail view. This brings feature parity with the Vault Mobile iOS mobile app, which already supports document text search and thumbnails.

feature: Display Notification Count in Vault Selector
description: Users can now view their unseen notification count for all their Vaults in the Vault Selector list on mobile.

feature: Support for Android Tablets and Landscape Mode
description: Vault Mobile can now be downloaded and used on Android tablets. Additionally, the app can be used in landscape mode (horizontally) to accommodate tablet cases (for Android tablets and iPads).

feature: Quality-Clinical Operations: Issue Management Connector
description: This feature introduces a new Quality-Clinical Operations connection that allows a Clinical Vault to send an Issue to a Quality Vault, creating a GCP Deviation in the Vault QMS application for QA to investigate, determine the root cause, and perform corrective / preventative actions

feature: LIMS Spec Data Redesign
description: The LIMS data model has been redesigned from the ground up to focus on a centralized testing structure that can be utilized not just for Batch Release testing, but also in the future for Stability Studies and Environmental Monitoring.  The core of these changes occurred on the design side, where the new Spec Data object is essentially a package of all the information about what Sample Plan will be followed, what Tests will be executed, and which Results from those Tests shall be evaluated against specification Criteria.  The changes in this feature make updates across all existing LIMS functionality, and include new features as well, and are all behind a single support-enabled feature flag.  *This feature may not be validated in pre-release Vaults.

feature: Retest & Resample Parity
description: Included as part of the Spec Data redesign, these are explicit Resampling and Retesting actions that can be configured to be included in User Actions, Entry Actions and Workflows. This functionality was available previously through default Vault functionality.

feature: Create Design Data Copy Action
description: A new Create Design Data Copy action allows design data admin users to copy an entire design data record stack, similar to the Deep Copy platform functionality but with better support for non-child related records, and the automatic selection of latest versions of referenced design data records. It is recommended best practice to always use this action when making copies of design data, and not use the Copy Record platform action.  *Enablement is Configuration if new LIMS data model and app logic are enabled. This feature may not be validated in pre-release Vaults.

feature: Lab Sample & Consumable Labeling
description: Uses LIMS integration framework to send label printing requests to third party label solutions for consumables, samples, tests and assets.  *Enablement is Configuration if new LIMS data model and app logic are enabled. This feature may not be validated in pre-release Vaults.

feature: LIMS Criteria Evaluation
description: Enhanced as part of the Spec Data redesign, Criteria Evaluation records are now created upfront rather than upon result evaluation. These Criteria Evaluation records serve as the definitive source of truth for what must be conformed to for each purpose, indication, and market, in order to determine pass or failure status. Every time a Criteria Evaluation record is evaluated and re-evaluated, a Criteria Evaluation History record captures the changes.  *Auto-on if new LIMS data model and app logic are enabled. This feature may not be validated in pre-release Vaults.

feature: LIMS Version Locking
description: Enhanced as part of the Spec Data redesign, a new Locked property on Sample Plan, Test Definition, and Spec Data helps ensure no unwarranted changes can occur to design data records that are undergoing review or have already been made effective. This property is automatically set to true by some processes such as Change Analysis, but can also be toggled by configured business processes where appropriate.  *Auto-on if new LIMS data model and app logic are enabled. This feature may not be validated in pre-release Vaults.

feature: LIMS Change Analysis
description: A new process for managing interrelated design data records, Change Analysis facilitates the accurate upversioning of your underlying LIMS data. When a new version is created, the Change Analysis process identifies all dependent design data records, allowing you to manage updates to these records all in one place, set a common new effective start date, and approve all the items together.  *Auto-on if new LIMS data model and app logic are enabled. This feature may not be validated in pre-release Vaults.

feature: LIMS Editor Role Assignment
description: Enhanced as part of the Spec Data redesign, there are no longer independent lifecycles or security for child objects of Sample Plan, Test Definition, or Spec Data. Instead, LIMS automatically grants Edit access to those child records depending on whether the user's Role on the parent record includes Edit access. This same security is also applied to the Lab Test, automatically granting Edit access to Inputs and Results if the user's Role has Edit access to the Test.  *Auto-on if new LIMS data model and app logic are enabled. This feature may not be validated in pre-release Vaults.

feature: Support for Manual Completion of Lab Tests for Externally Tested Materials
description: Enhanced as part of the Spec Data redesign, this new user action better supports our Virtual Lab customers who do no enter the result data via the Test Execution interface. After uploading the result data, users can execute this Manual Test Completion action, and LIMS shall automatically perform data validation, calculation, and evaluation for all Results in all Steps of the Test.  *Enablement is Configuration if new LIMS data model and app logic are enabled. This feature may not be validated in pre-release Vaults.

application: LIMS, QMS, QualityDocs, Station Manager, Surveillance, Training, Validation Management
feature: 23R3 Quality Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Standard Data Model for Legacy Archive Data
description: This feature allows migration partners to migrate closed QMS records and associated artifacts from legacy systems into a standard data model.

feature: Quality Team Governor Increases
description: Governances relaxed around maximum supported values relating to Quality Teams.

feature: QRM: Additional Risk Assessment Methodologies
description: This feature introduces support for new Risk Assessment methods: dFMEA (Design FMEA),  uFMEA (Use FMEA), Generic, What - If, HAZOP (Hazard and Operability Analysis),  HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point), Hazard – Harm

feature: Create Related Record Enhancement
description: Enhance the Create Related Record Entry Action for Vault QMS to provide an option to copy attachments from the source record.

feature: Quality Incidents Data Model & Lifecycle
description: Quality Incident records can be created, triaged, and optionally copied into quality events for follow up.

feature: Auditor Profiles & Qualifications
description: This feature allows customers to create an auditor profile and capture key attributes for an auditor, define required qualification criteria for auditor roles, track progress towards role qualification, and the creation  and removal of user role setup records upon qualification or requalification.

feature: Complaint Automated Email Ingestion
description: This feature enables administrators to configure a Vault Email Inbox to process Complaints received via email.   Vault will automatically create a Complaint record when an email is received or associate the email to an existing Complaint record if the email is a reply to an External Notification email that was originally sent from Vault QMS.

feature: Inherit Quality Team from Multiple Source Objects
description: Enables certain standard objects to inherit their quality teams from multiple potential parent objects.  Designed to support the standalone Quality Event data model, this enables a child action, such as CAPA Action, to inherit Quality Team Roles from multiple parent Quality Event objects such Deviations and Lab Investigations.  This feature requires Quality Teams to be configured.

feature: QMS Inbound Email Address Configuration
description: This feature introduces a new configuration screen for QMS system administrators to specify the type of object record created when Vault receives an email to a particular email address (e.g. Complaints or Supplier Change Notifications). System administrators specify whether Vault stores the original email and email attachments on the new complaint or supplier change notification record.

feature: QMS Feature Parity for MedTech Objects
description: This feature enables QMS features such as Recurrence Check, Relationship Automation, External Collaboration, External Notification, Cycle Time Matrix and 5 Why's analysis to Nonconformance and MedTech CAPA process

feature: QRM: Risk Visualization Heatmap
description: This feature adds a capability to generate Heatmap to the Risk Builder functionality. Users can visualize the Risk Assessment in an easy to understand Heatmap.

feature: QRM: Risk Builder Filters
description: Adds the ability to filter the list of risks within a risk assessment using the Risk Builder tool.  *Auto-on in Vaults with the Risk Builder enabled.

feature: Process Navigator: Support for Images
description: This feature allows administrators to add up to 3 image(s) to the Overview section of the Process Navigator detail page.

feature: Process Navigator: Administrator Defined Document Columns
description: This feature allows administrators to define the default columns that display in the Documents grid of the Process Navigator Detail page. This feature also restricts the number of fields that can be configured to display in the Overview section to 15 fields.

feature: Document Page Thumbnail View for iOS Station Manager
description: The iOS version of the Station Manager app will now provide an option to view the pages in a document in a thumbnail view making it easy to navigate through the pages of a document opened in Station Manager.

feature: Improved Document Viewer for Android Station Manager
description: This feature provides an improved Document Viewer for the Android version of Station Manager.

feature: Create Person Records Automatically
description: This feature will automatically manage Person records whenever a User account is updated. When a new User account is created, Vault Training will create a Person record, link the Person and User, and make the Person Eligible. Whenever a User account is inactive, Vault Training will make the Person Ineligible.

feature: Session Location Field in Create Class Dialog
description: For added visibility, this Session Location is now visible to Instructors scheduling a training session in the Create Class dialog.

feature: User Interface Updates for Admin Alerts
description: User Interface updates to Admin Alerts for Quiz, Recurrence, Dynamic Enrollment, and Curriculum Matching.

feature: Add to Calendar Link for Classroom Training
description: The new “Add to Calendar Link” feature populates classroom training event information into Google Calendar or Microsoft Outlook.

feature: Set Quiz Completion Date for External & Evaluation Training Assignments
description: Whenever a Learner passes a quiz for External and Evaluation Training Assignments, the Quiz Completion Date is automatically updated on the Training Assignment.

feature: Imported Training Assignment Handling Update
description: When a Training Requirement is moved to the Retired state, Vault will now cancel any imported Training Assignments (where Creation Source is Import) which are in an open state, such as Assigned.

feature: Documentation Update for EU MIR
description: BRD only: Updates validation documentation for the EU MIR functionality in Vault Product Surveillance.

feature: Reportability Assessment Enhancements
description: Adds new enhancements for Reportability Assessment process, including a standard lifecycle for the Adverse Event Report Validation object, allowing users to create a new VPS: Reportability Assessment object record even if all other records are in Closed or Cancelled state type, and improving processing for Reportability Assessment Effects.

feature: eMDR UI Enhancement: View & Edit fields on AER
description: Allows users to view and edit all the information required for the eMDR submission on the Adverse Event Report page.

feature: VPS: Display Validation Errors in UI
description: This feature displays the health authority validation errors in the UI

feature: eMDR: 23R3 Validation Updates
description: Implements the newest FDA Validations updated by FDA in August 2022. These enhancements will be automatically enabled as part of the VPS Run Validation action for the eMDR, EUMIR and HealthCanada Reports, and do not require any action to take advantage of.

feature: Curriculum Matching: Support Multi-Select Picklist Fields
description: Multi-picklist field types are now supported for the SmartMatch feature.

feature: Workflow Participants Support for Validation Teams
description: Support workflow with Validation Teams enabled to allow workflow initiator to select participants from roles or to use roles as participants.

feature: Additional Prompts for Test Steps
description: This feature will extend support for Additional Prompts in the Test Authoring UI and Execution UI for setup steps and execution steps. Additional Prompts that are part of a script will show all the associated prompts that have been defined by the Test Author. The supported additional prompts will include Text Instruction, Text Response, Number Response with Unit of Measure, and Date/Time Response. A maximum of 15 additional prompts can be defined at a test step. All other behavior existing for Setup and Execution Steps for comments, attachments, discrepancies, verdicts, requirements, and changes will be extended to support additional prompts as well.

feature: Check Minimum Permissions to Access Test Authoring, Test Execution, & Review Protocol UIs
description: Currently, permission checks at the object and field level were not checked prior to opening the Test Authoring, Test Execution, or Review Executed Protocol UIs. In 23R3, the system will now check that the user has the minimum permissions to view information displayed on the Test Authoring, Test Execution, and Review Executed Protocol UIs at both the object and field levels. This also considers new fields and objects introduced with the Additional Prompts for Test Steps introduced in 23R3.  Prior to release night, existing customers will need to review their permission set configurations to ensure that the permission for the base__v object type on the Validation Requirement (val_requirement_svo__v) object is granted. Otherwise, users will receive an error message when attempting to open the Test Authoring, Test Execution, or Review Executed Protocol pages.

feature: RIM/Clinical Operations: Remove Superseded Transfer Flag from Admin UI in RIM
description: The RIM to Clinops Connection: Transfer steady and superseded state document versions feature flag was removed from the RIM Vault UI. The flag is now only available to be turned on via a support request to Veeva.

feature: RIM-PromoMats Content Plan Creation & Document Matching Performance Improvements
description: To improve performance, Submission Content Plans created by the RIM-PromoMats Connection will be created as Inactive by default.  After the documents are auto-matched and locked to the Content Plan, the Content Plan Items with matches and their parent Items will automatically be activated.  Performance for auto-matching of the crosslink documents has also been improved.

feature: New Labeling Document Fields
description: New shared document fields and their associated picklists are added to support RIM best practice for Labeling: Labeling Components Included (field and picklist), Carton or Container Label Type (field and picklist), and Tracked Changes/Redlines.

feature: South Korea eCTD 1.0
description: With this release, RIM Publishing Vaults support the KR FDA v1.0 (DTD 1.0) specification. Users can now create Content Plans and generate Submissions that are compliant with KR v1.0 specification. Vault validates these submissions based on the corresponding KR Validation Criteria Version.

feature: Automated Hyperlinking
description: With this release, Vault Submissions Publishing supports a new way of creating hyperlinks. When authors identify links in MS Word and apply the macro, Vault will now automatically generated the corresponding hyperlinks in the Published documents when the Automated Hyperlinking user action is ran.

feature: Link Evaluator
description: With this release, Vault Submissions Publishing has a new user action from the Content Plan which can be executed to see information on all links and the ability to retarget links where necessary.

feature: Configurable Validation Criteria
description: Vault provides five new validation criteria rules that can be configured to meet the needs of multiple regions for non-eCTDs. The validation criteria rules validate the file path length, file size, folder name length, file name length, and valid characters.

feature: Deprecate FDA Sync Gateway
description: Users will no longer be able to create new Sync Gateway profiles. All customers should be migrating to the async gateway.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Health Authority Meeting Object
description: With this release, a new Health Authority Meeting object is introduced to the standard data model.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: 23R3 RIM Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: RIM Bot: Auto-on in All RIM Vaults
description: With this release the RIM Bot is auto-on in all RIM Vaults. RIM Bot requires at least 1500 steady-state documents to support the creation, training, and deployment of the machine learning model.

feature: EU UDI XML Generation Updates
description: This feature complements the feature UDI Source Data Model Updates for EU and US to change the UDI submission generation process to pull UDI attributes from their new locations.

feature: EU eAF Application Setting Update
description: This feature creates a consolidated admin setting for managing eAF product report generation.  This allows for greater flexibility in configuring reports generated from the Generate eAF Reports action. Additionally, existing settings will be migrated to the new setting.

feature: Use for Registrations Wizard Updates
description: This feature updates Create Registrations and Manage Registered Details to respect the disposition of the 'Use for Registrations' field when creating and / or updating registered details records.

feature: Review & Refine Related Records
description: In this release, we are improving the Create Related Records bulk action by introducing a new Review and Refine step. This step enables users to preview the records that Vault is proposing to create – and in some cases update – based on the Event and a user's selections

feature: UDI Data Model Updates for EU and US
description: With this feature, the source locations for some UDI attributes can be moved to make it easier to migrate the initial set of UDI data as well as make it easier to find and correct source values when validation errors are detected in UDI submissions. Most source data for a Basic UDI-DI will become easily accessible from the Product record that has that device identifier, and most source data for a UDI-DI will become accessible from the Packaging record that has that device identifier.

feature: Submission Date on Submission Country for EU MRP/DCP
description: This feature adds a field to the Submission Country to manage the submission date for non-centrally authorised procedures in the EU.

feature: Drug-Led Combination Product Registration Enhancements for IDMP
description: In accordance with the IDMP device reporting updates introduced in IDMP IG V2.1.1, organizations are obliged to provide additional details for drug-led combination products. To comply with this requirement, Vault Registrations added a checkbox field (Co-Packaged or Integral Device) to the related Product relationship records on the Event, Application, Submission, Regulatory Objective, and Registration. The Create Registrations and Manage Registered Details functionalities take these fields into account and create a new related record when Co-Packaged or Integral Device is set to Yes.

feature: Wizard Support for Full Indication Text & Orphan Designation
description: Vault Registrations has added the Full Indication Text and Regulatory Authorization (Orphan Designation) relationships to the related Indications on the Event, Application, Submission, and Regulatory Objective. When using bulk create and update actions, the Full Indication Text and Regulatory Authorization (Orphan Designation) records are created or updated on the Registration.

feature: Support for Multiple Drug Trade Names with Translations
description: Vault Registrations added fields to the Regulatory Text and Regulatory Text relationship objects to support multiple trade names for Drug Products. Vault Registrations wizards have also been updated to support Regulatory Text Translation relationships.

feature: Support for Certification Bodies in Multiple Markets for Medical Devices Applications
description: The EU Notified Body functionality is now expanded to support Certification Bodies for multiple markets.

feature: UDI Enhanced Support for Device Changes
description: The action to generate UDI data from a registration can now be limited to only include devices impacted by a particular regulatory objective.

feature: Support for EUDAMED XML Schema v2.0.8
description: With this feature, Vault generates EU UDI Submissions using the EUDAMED XML Schema v2.0.8, which now expects a country code of EL for Greece instead of GR.

feature: Submission Wizard Support for Registrations Fields
description: This feature will ensure all fields needed for Registrations are system-managed when the Submission Wizard is enabled.

feature: Respect Use for Content Planning Field in Dispatching Global Content Plans
description: Upon Global Content Plan dispatch, the resulting local Submission Content Plan will not include Content Plan sections if the Submission relationship is is set as Use for Content Planning = No.

feature: Support Additional Fields in Sync Content Plan
description: Additional fields will be compared when synchronizing Content Plans. During the comparison between the Global Content Plan and Submission Content Plans, Vault now includes the Content Plan field Section Owner as well as the following Content Plan Item object fields in the comparison: Expected Steady State Count, Source for Published Document, Publishing Element, Include eSignatures, and Deliverable Owner.

application: RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Generate Active Dossier from Event (Manual Support)
description: This feature adds a new Dispatched picklist entry to the Active Dossier Status picklist to support tracking documents that are ready for use in a submission for a market but not yet submitted. The Active Dossier Editor and Viewer are also made accessible from the Event to support viewing and manual generation of Active Dossier records based on Event and Activity records.

feature: Respect Matched Document Atomic Security in Content Plans
description: When users drag and drop documents from their desktop or the Library, Vault now respects any configured Atomic Security for the Content Plan Item. Additionally, when synchronizing Content Plans, Vault respects any configured Atomic Security for the following actions: Add Document, Remove Document, Lock Version, Exclude Document, and Include Document. When configured, users must be assigned a permission set with the Application permission for EDL Matching, Edit Document Matches.

feature: Suggested Matching
description: This feature introduces a new Match Document Mode to facilitate manually matching documents within the Content Plan Viewer. The new mode provides a context sensitive document picker with default filters based on the Content Plan Item's auto-matching criteria. The Add button from the Match Documents object has been removed as this feature replaces that functionality. The Match Document action in the Content Plan Item's Actions menu has also been renamed to "Auto-Match Documents" to accurately reflect on-demand auto-matching and to eliminate any confusion with Match Document Mode.

feature: Viewer: Collapse All User Action
description: Collapse All user action is available in the Submissions Archive Viewer section nodes where Expand All is shown. The rows collapsed as a result of this action are excluded from the total count, allowing users to further expand other areas.

feature: eSTAR Submission Format Support
description: With 23R3 Submissions Archive users are able to import and view dossiers of eSTAR format. eSTAR submissions are supported with all current Submission Archive Import methods when the submission’s Dossier Format is set to eSTAR.

feature: Viewer: Display Country-Specific Sections
description: With this release, the Submissions Archive Viewer displays country-specific sections based on a combination of the eCTD County Code and Country Code fields.

feature: Map Multiple Document Types to Active Dossier Template
description: Active Dossier records can now be created across multiple document types. Previously, the Active Dossier population process only considered the document type specified on the Active Dossier Template or the associated RIM Reference Model record. Now, the population process also considers the document types set within the RIM Reference Model Mapping records.

feature: Active Dossier Module 1 & Module 2 Support
description: The Active Dossier Template has been extended to add a new 'Common Technical Document (CTD)' Root record as well as a new Module 1 and Module 2. The extended template supports Labeling and Quality documents within Module 1, and Summaries within Module 2. Existing customers using Active Dossier will also see the 'Common Technical Document (CTD)' record as the new Root Active Dossier Structure record.

feature: Active Dossier Consolidated Sections
description: A new 'Active Dossier Template Consolidation' setting has been introduced that is auto-enabled for Vaults with no Active Dossier Item records. When the setting is enabled, Active Dossier Template records are updated to remove all product variant and manufacturer tokens with the exception of 3.2.A.1 Facilities and Equipment, where the product, product variant, and active substance tokens are removed instead. This update to the Active Dossier Template allows Active Dossier Item records to be consolidated under fewer repeating sections. In a future release, Vaults with existing Active Dossier records will be automatically migrated to align with the updated template. Once that occurs, this setting will be removed and Active Dossier Template changes will be mad auto-on.

application: RIM, RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Submission Wizard: Respect Atomic Security for Relationships
description: The Submission Wizard will respect the atomic security for submission and regulatory objective lifecycles when determining the creation of joins when running the wizard. Relationships with insufficient access for the RO and submission lifecycle state will fail to be created.

feature: Create User Automatically
description: Study Training will automatically create a User account in the Study Training Vault if a Study Person has a user account in Vault Clinical.

feature: Invite Sites to Register for VeevaID
description: Site users can log in and complete training using VeevaID, which can be used by clinical research sites to access multiple sponsor systems with a single userid and password.  *This feature may not be validated in pre-release Vaults.

feature: Finalize Matrix Changes When Adding New Training Requirements
description: The Finalize button in the Study Training Matrix builder will now state change newly added Training Requirements

feature: RIM/Clinical: Improved User Exception Message Processing for Document Transfer
description: Inactivate any Document Transfer User Exceptions at the end of every job run. Re-create only a single Active User Exception Message for Document Transfer

feature: RIM/Clinical: Default Study on Clinical CrossLinks based on Product field
description: With this enhancement, the behavior of the RIM-Clinical Connection, will now work as such; - If no Study field is populated on a RIM document to be crosslinked, then the connection will auto-populate the Study field in Vault Clinical Operations based on the Active Lead Agent Product associated with the RIM document.  - If a Study field is populated on a RIM document to be crosslinked, then the connection will respect the Study and populate the crosslinks with the Study from RIM

feature: RIM/Clinical: Superseded Document Transfer Revamp
description: Impact is only to customers who have enabled the RIM FF RIM/Clinical Superseded Document Transfer.   When enabled, customers who have a QueryObjectRule (QOR) on the Inbound Document Integration Rule in RIM, any version that satisfies the QOR beyond the top most Approved version will be transferred. This includes scenarios where the Approved version is filtered out by QOR and only Superseded versions are eligible for transfer.   Additionally, QueryObjectRules that use IN clauses are not supported when this feature flag is enabled.   Removed the RIM Application Feature flag from Vault UI. Any enablement of this flag should be completed through support and requires Approval.

feature: QMS Feature Parity for QMS<>RIM
description: This feature expands the connection to be able to support the standalone Change Control object.  Requires the standalone change control object to be configured.

feature: RIM-Safety: Registered Product for Safety Cases
description: The Safety-RIM Product Connection automatically transfers Product Family, Product, Product Variant, Substance, and Product Registration from RIM to Vault Safety. This automatic transfer from Vault RIM to Vault Safety aligns product and registration data across these application families.

feature: CTMS Transfer
description: Vault-to-Vault transfer of object data and documents in order to populate Sponsor oversight reports and dashboards for fully outsourced studies.

feature: Complex Trials: Subject Milestones
description: When additional Subject Group types are activated, Vault CTMS customers with the "Autopopulate Milestones from Subject Data" will update based on Subject Status Date field data for Subjects with other Subject Group fields populated.

feature: Oversight Issue Tracking for Outsourced Studies
description: Adds new data model to capture information about issues that arise in outsourced studies during vendor oversight activities.

feature: Last Subject Milestones: Lost to Follow-Up Dates Evaluated
description: With this release, Vault CTMS customers with the Autopopulate Milestones from Subject Data will now include the Lost to Follow Up Date when populating the Last Subject Out milestone completion date.

feature: Japanese Clinical Trial Notification Validation Review
description: For Vault CTMS customers with the "Enable Japanese CTN Feature" capability enabled, this feature allows users to proceed with generating a CTN after reviewing validation issues.

application: CTMS, Site Connect, Study Startup, Vault Payments, eTMF
feature: Disable Related Document Requiredness on Quality Issues
description: Allows Admins to update the requiredness of the Related Document field on the Quality Issue object. Enabling this feature will update the field's deletion rule so that the Related Document field is set to blank when a document is deleted.

application: CTMS, Study Startup, Vault Payments, eTMF
feature: Complex Trials: Tracking Country & Site Participation
description: Adds support for the management of master protocols and other complex trials in Clinical Operations. Also allows customers to create a variety of subject groupings that can be used for Milestone tracking, Metrics, and Subject Enrollment tracking.

application: CTMS, Study Startup, Vault Payments, eTMF
feature: Recurring Milestone Schedules
description: Introduces new objects to schedule the recurring creation of milestones at date-based intervals, and automates the creation of milestones based on that schedule.

application: CTMS, Study Startup, Vault Payments, eTMF
feature: Re-trigger EDL Automation
description: Allows Admins to configure a single or bulk action to re-tirgger expected document creation for EDL automation (person, organization, and product expected documents).

application: CTMS, Study Startup, Vault Payments, eTMF
feature: Clinical Operations License Tracking by Application
description: Introduces a new object, Study Site License, in Clinical Operations to track licenses per application: eTMF, CTMS, Payments, and Study Startup. Admins can view license consumption in Vault Settings. Users will see a warning message if consumption is over the licensed amount.

application: CTMS, Study Startup, Vault Payments, eTMF
feature: Email to Vault: Subaddress Case Insensitive
description: Enhances the Clinical Operations email to Vault processors so that when an inbound email is sent, the subaddress that is parsed to set the Study field on the document is processed as all lower case. Previously, the subaddress was parsed as case sensitive.  This feature will additionally update the Email Subaddress field value on Study to lowercase when an edit is made to existing Study records.

application: CTMS, Study Startup, Vault Payments, eTMF
feature: 24R1 Clinical Operations Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality. The data model changes included in this feature also cover the Site Connect application.

feature: Complex Trials: Subject Metrics and Recruitment Planning
description: Metrics calculations now uses the Track Enrollment Metrics field to indicate that Metrics should be created for a Study Arm or other Subject Group. Additionally, the "Create Recruitment Planning" field is used, along with the existence of corresponding milestones for the Subject Group, to generate Metrics Over Time records.

feature: TMF Archive Manage Archive Permission: Validation Documentation Update
description: This is a validation documentation only update to the Archive TMF Security feature released in 20R2. This feature does not introduce any functional changes to the Archive TMF feature.

feature: TMF Standard Document Fields
description: Introduces six standard document fields that can be added to classifications. The fields are accompanied by triggers that will clear or set the values based on certain document action.

feature: Study Country & Site Metadata Extraction
description: Enhances the TMF Bot to extract the Study Country and Site metadata from a document. It works closely with Study Metadata Extraction, and will favor site matches for which a study match was also found. This feature will be auto-on in Vaults that already have a deployed Metadata Extraction trained model. Vaults that do not yet have Metadata Extraction enabled require Support enablement, following which a trained model must be created, tested, and deployed to enable this.

feature: Site Connect Data Model Update on Distribution Task
description: Data model and field updates to the Distribution Task object in preparation for moving the site experience of Site Connect out of SiteVault and into Clinical Operations. This major upgrade is targeted for the second half of 2024.

feature: Additional Vault Clinical Docs Support
description: Adds support to transfer new document types via Veeva Site Connect: IP Treatment Decoding Documentation, IP Re-labeling Documentation, Recruitment Plan, System Account Management, Safety Report Supporting Document

feature: Mark Document Recalled Tracking
description: Allows customers increased visibility into the Mark Document as Recalled action. Customers can now report on which Study Sites the Mark Document as Recalled action has been taken on.

feature: Send Investigator Brochure with Safety Distribution
description: Allows customers to use Site Connect's Safety Distribution functionality to distribute Investigator Brochures to their study sites.

feature: Survey Reminder Notifications
description: Introduces email reminder notifications that can be configured to be sent to a survey respondent reminding them to complete their survey via a user action or a nightly job.

feature: Cycle Time: Omission of Study Part Milestones
description: Updates the Cycle Time job to exclude any milestones that have the arm__v field populated.

feature: Milestone Workspace & EDL Template Scalability Enhancements
description: Standardizes the EDL Template hierarchy expected by the system when using EDL Template Overrides in conjunction with Person, Organization, and Product-specific Expected Documents. Also introduces an endpoint to trigger the bulk generation of missing Milestones Documents, and fixes known issues in the creation of Expected Documents, and the creation and update of Milestone Documents.

feature: Payment Adjustment Override
description: With this feature, customers can identify Payable Items that should not be Adjusted by the Automated Adjustments capability and ignores changes to the Payable Item, Fee, or source Payable Event.

feature: Payments Adjustment Reasons
description: Payments adjustments now populates the Adjustment Reason field for adjustment created by the system.

feature: Improved OCR for Images
description: Improved OCR extraction for Image-based document uploads. This will result in improved text recognition that can be used with other Vault features such as search, annotations, Auto-Linking, and more.

feature: Allow Multi-Select for Standard Audience Field
description: Administrators now have the ability to make the professional_consumer__v document field multi-select. For promotional materials with both consumer and professional selected, the eCTD bulk generate feature will generate a consumer compliance package and will add a note to the comments field of the 2253: “This submission contains materials for both professional and consumer audiences.”

feature: Modular Content: Commercial Module Data Model
description: There have been data model changes to the content module object. New object type Material (commercial__v).

feature: Automated Image Tagging
description: Vault PromoMats now supports automated tagging of uploaded image content. This functionality populates document metadata fields with predefined tags set by an administrator. This feature will support many file formats and leverages the Amazon Recognition Service.

feature: Modular Content: CRM Email Data Model
description: This release will introduce the “CRM Email” Module type. This will allow users to construct personalized emails in the CRM Email Builder. Vault PromoMats will host the email assets that field reps can use in the CRM Email Builder to create personalized emails, within rules set by the business. This feature requires configuration to enable CRM email module types, and other data model changes.

feature: Set State for Previous Email Fragment Versions
description: A new entry action can be configured to automatically set email fragments to a selected state even when they are not the latest version of the email fragment.

feature: eCTD: Annotate Submission Ready References
description: Annotated references and annotated labeling documents that are pulled into eCTD compliance packages can have relevant substantiating content highlighted. Anchors that are relevant to included PDF links are outlined in a red box on submission ready copies.

feature: Commercial Application Settings Optimization
description: User shall be able to easily navigate the PromoMats Application Settings now that it has been optimized by removing flags that are no longer necessary, and aliging setting labels with feature names. Flags required at the launch of a feature may no longer be relevant or are now manageable in configuration.

feature: Best Effort Mapping for Standard Metrics Durations
description: PromoMats will perform best effort mapping for Vaults that do not have any states configured on the Standard Metrics State Mappings configuration page. If a Vault does have at least one state already mapped, PromoMats will make no changes to the mapping configuration.

feature: Commercial Action Layouts
description: User shall be able to copy and customize an inactive standard action layouts for objects and object types that benefit from; elevating pertinant fields, access to fields based on lifecycle state, access to fields based on user profile.

feature: Vault Digital Publishing: AWS Bucket Policy Support
description: Vault Digital Publishing support for the use of Bucket Policies in the configuration of the integration between Vault and the customer's Amazon Web Services S3 Bucket.

feature: Modular Content: CRM Email Builder
description: This release will introduce the “CRM Email” Module type. This will allow users to construct personalized emails in the CRM Email Builder. Vault PromoMats will host the email assets that field reps can use in the CRM Email Builder to create personalized emails, within rules set by the business. This feature requires configuration to enable CRM email module types, and other data model changes.

feature: Claims Linking: Auto-On Auto-Linking
description: When auto-on auto-linking is made available via the Lightbulb icon in the document viewer based on system configuration of document type - suggest links enabled. If User Action and Entry Action for Enhanced Suggest Links were previously configured, the configuration will supersede the system document type configuration.

feature: Modular Content Combinations
description: Vault now allows users to create Combinations for Content Modules. Combinations allow users to group assets within a content module for specific channels, messaging, or personas. When Content Module Combinations are used within CRM Email modules, the combination will behave as a business rule for allowed assets for the CRM email builder.

feature: Claims Linking: Lightbulb Icon for Auto-Linking
description: User shall run Auto-Linking from the document viewer lightbulb icon, Platform Suggest Links has been deprecated for PromoMats Vaults. Users that have configured User Actions for Auto-Linking will have the Lightbulb icon available in the document viewer based on configuration. The lightbulb will not render if Entry Action is configured.

feature: Claims Linking: Language Filter Behavior Change
description: Auto-Linking filtering will make Language optional. If Language is available on a document when Auto-Linking is performed the system will attempt to match to all Text Assets matched with the document's language value but also match to all Text Assets with no language value set.

feature: PromoMats Text Asset Library: Record Limit Increase
description: More than 500 records can exist in the Text Asset Object with the same values in their fields.Maximum for combination Product, Country, Optional Language is 5,000.

feature: Text Assets: Duplicate Record Change
description: Multiple text assets can now exist with the same field values and match text values. However, only 1 Text asset with the same field values and match text value can be in the Approved state to be identified when using Auto-Linking or manual text asset linking.

feature: Portals: Layouts Available in the Portal Library
description: The Portal Library will now support Vault Layouts for viewing content. The following layouts are available in the Portal library; Compact, Thumbnail, Detail and Grid. Grid view will respect the existing Portal library layout available in Vault prior to 24R1. Compact will be the default view for viewing content in the Portal Library.

feature: PromoMats Text Asset Object: Remove Custom Field Limit
description: The Text Asset object no longer has a limited number of custom fields.

feature: Auto-On Auto-Linking: Match Text Variations Maximum
description: As part of the Auto-Linking release all PromoMat Vaults will be allotted the maximum number of match text variations: nine (9).

feature: eCTD: Improved Error Messaging
description: We have made improvements to error handling for eCTD compliance packages that make it faster to support actionable error messages. We also introduced an error message informing users of corrupt submission package renditions when trying to generate eCTD compliance packages. Please note that new notification templates will be used for eCTD compliance package generation after release night.

feature: eCTD: Submission Package Enhancements
description: eCTD Compliance Packages now support submission packages created with the following compression methods: Deflate64, Deflate, and Stored. In addition, documents created from submission package contents are renamed using the same naming convention as other submission ready copies in the binder. Previously, documents created from the submission package were not renamed.

feature: eCTD: Create as System
description: eCTD compliance packages and the documents created within are now generated by the System. Previously, the documents displayed as being generated by the user. This enhancement simplifies the permission requirements for users creating eCTD compliance packages; now, the user only requires Create Binder permissions on the Submission Ready Compliance Package document type and view permissions on the Center object and Promotional Material Document Type object.

feature: Auto-On Multichannel Features: Enable CLM Integration with Auto-Publishing
description: The CLM features are automatically enabled for use in Commercial Vaults that are licensed for Multichannel App.

feature: Auto-On Multichannel Features: Enable Engage Integration
description: Engage Portals features are automatically enabled for use in Commercial Vaults that are licensed for Multichannel App.

feature: eCTD: Update Correspondence Letter on Regenerate
description: For Pre Clearance eCTD compliance packages, the correspondence letter is now automatically regenerated on package regeneration.

feature: Auto-On Multichannel Features: Enable Approved Email
description: Approved Email features are automatically enabled for use in Commercial Vaults that are licensed for Multichannel App. This includes the Auto-Publishing for Email Fragments feature.

feature: RIM-PromoMats Connection Performance Improvements
description: We made performance improvements to the RIM-PromoMats connector so that validation errors on one submission do not block other submissions.

feature: 24R1 Commercial Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Multichannel Performance Improvements
description: Performance enhancements to increase the speed of distributing multichannel content.

feature: Set State for Previous Email Fragment Versions
description: A new entry action can be configured to automatically set email fragments to a selected state even when they are not the latest version of the email fragment.

feature: Vault Digital Publishing: AWS Bucket Policy Support
description: Vault Digital Publishing support for the use of Bucket Policies in the configuration of the integration between Vault and the customer's Amazon Web Services S3 Bucket.

feature: Modular Content: CRM Email Builder
description: This release will introduce the “CRM Email” Module type. This will allow users to construct personalized emails in the CRM Email Builder. Vault PromoMats will host the email assets that field reps can use in the CRM Email Builder to create personalized emails, within rules set by the business. This feature requires configuration to enable CRM email module types, and other data model changes.

feature: Portals: Layouts Available in the Portal Library
description: The Portal Library will now support Vault Layouts for viewing content. The following layouts are available in the Portal library; Compact, Thumbnail, Detail and Grid. Grid view will respect the existing Portal library layout available in Vault prior to 24R1. Compact will be the default view for viewing content in the Portal Library.

feature: Auto-On Multichannel Features: Enable CLM Integration with Auto-Publishing
description: The CLM features are automatically enabled for use in Medical Vaults that are licensed for Multichannel App.

feature: Multichannel Performance Improvements
description: Performance enhancements to increase the speed of distributing multichannel content.

feature: Auto-On Multichannel Features: Enable Engage Integration
description: Engage Portals features are automatically enabled for use in Medical Vaults that are licensed for Multichannel App.

feature: 24R1 Medical Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: CRM Data Sharing: Pull Custom Response Details
description: The CRM Data Sharing feature in MedInquiry has been modified to allow the Case Response to be sent to an email address specified in the Veeva CRM Medical Inquiry record. When fulfilling an inquiry via email, the CRM Data Sharing feature previously only supported sending the Case Response to the email address defined in Vault’s Case Contact record, which is usually synced from Veeva CRM’s Account record.

feature: Medical Provision Action Layouts
description: User shall be able to copy and customize an inactive standard action layouts for objects and object types that benefit from; elevating pertinant fields, access to fields based on lifecycle state, access to fields based on user profile.

feature: Auto-On Multichannel Features: Enable Approved Email
description: Approved Email features are automatically enabled for use in Medical Vaults that are licensed for Multichannel App. This includes the Auto-Publishing for Email Fragments feature.

feature: Modular Content: CRM Email & Combinations Data Model in Vault Medcomms
description: MedComms now supports Modular Content. The use case supported is authoring CRM Email Modules for use with the CRM Email Builder.

feature: MedInquiry OpenData Search: Pull HCP Country & Show Only Local HCPs
description: Allows customers to populate a Country on a Case Contact that is created via the Veeva MedInquiry OpenData Connection. Also allows customers to constrain the HCPs that a user can see to only those in the country in which the user operates.

feature: Automatic Case Contact Creation for Email Ingestion
description: With this feature, a new Case Contact will be created when an email is ingested, if no existing Case Contact exists with the email address from which the email was sent.

feature: Standard Case Owner & Enhanced Escalation for MedInquiry
description: Adds a new Owner field to the Case, Case Request and Event objects that is kept in sync with the owner of the record. The Owner is defaulted to be the current user in the Medical Inquiry UI. Via a workflow, it is also possible to set the value of this Owner field to be the user that completes a Task that has been assigned to them. This makes it easy for users to: 1) Automatically take ownership of records you create in the Medical Inquiry UI, 2) Assign or Reassign a Case, or an individual Case Request or Case Response to another user or group, and 3) View a list of Cases that they own.

feature: Allow Case Response Emails to be Sent Automatically
description: In previous releases, Case Response emails can only be sent via a User Action on the Case Response object lifecycle. This feature allows the "Send Response Package" action to be configured as an Entry Action on the Case Response object lifecycle, as well as a User Action.

feature: Automatically Add Email Attachments onto MedInquiry Object Records
description: An action is added to Vault MedInquiry that allows the attachments from Ingested Emails to be added as object record attachments to the Case Request, Case Response or Event object record.

feature: Allow Case Responses to be Created Automatically
description: This feature adds an action to the Case and Case Request object lifecycle to allow a Case Response record to be automatically created.

feature: Support for Criteria VQL on OpenData Search Case Contact field
description: The MedInquiry OpenData Search feature has been enhanced to support VQL constraints on the Case Contact field.

feature: Outbound Email Domains: Support Multiple Root Domains
description: When leveraging Outbound Email Domains, Admins can create up to three (3) root domains (for example, verteo.com) and five (5) email domains to support scenarios where subsidiary organizations with different email domains exist within one organizational umbrella.

feature: Column Header Filters
description: Users are now able to filter documents and records directly from the column headers in grid view.

feature: Task Filtering Enhancements
description: More easily distinguish Muti Record and Multi Document workflow tasks in the Home tab through new options in the Content Type filter. You can now also filter by object and document fields, and add them as columns.

feature: Notification Categories & Email Preferences
description: Admins can now define how frequently each notification template sends email notifications; every occurrence, summary, or never (meaning they are treated like in-app notifications only). In addition, Admins can now define their own notification categories, and assign a category to their notification templates.

feature: Rename All Tabs to All
description: The default "All Tabs" option in Tab Collections has been relabeled "All", given a global icon, and will now automatically appear at the bottom of the list of collections if additional Tab Collections are configured.

feature: Version Created By & Date Filters
description: When filtering documents you can now filter by Version Created By and Version Created Date. An icon will indicate if the returned results are not the latest version of the document.

feature: Additional Supported Time Zones
description: Vault supports 229 additional time zones according to the latest standards. 7 time zone labels have been updated to conform with the latest standards.

feature: Bulk Rendition Operations
description: Admins will now be able to bulk re-render documents using Vault Loader in the UI or via the API.

feature: Connection Stats
description: Admins can now access daily performance metrics for connections (Vault-to-Vault or external) including messages sent or received, failures, retries, and elapsed time.

feature: Crosslink Settings for Admins
description: Checkboxes to allow Admins to exclude source document overlays and/or source document signature pages on CrossLinks will now be available to Admins by default. In the past, a Support ticket was needed to expose these options.

feature: Enhanced Field Dependency Audits
description: When an Admin makes a change to an existing document field dependency, the System Audit History will now more clearly state what change was made.

feature: Reusable Labels for Document Field Layouts
description: Vault will no longer enforce that Document Field Layout labels be unique. Uniqueness will still be enforced on the name (layout__v).

feature: Enhancements to Query Field Type
description: Field rules now allow using a different SELECT field than the Query field in the field rule.

feature: Non-Consecutive Document IDs
description: Document IDs (generated by Vault) will no longer be sequential numbers. This change is being made to support future functionality. It is not recommended to rely on Document ID for document creation order - customers should leverage Document Number.

feature: File Staging Enhancements for Vault File Manager
description: Users can now create a new folder in File Staging through the use of Vault File Manager's File Staging tab, as well as download documents and folders (individually or in bulk), rather than using a separate File Transfer Protocol Secure (FTPS) client.

feature: Select Anchor Improvements
description: Users can now filter and sort link targets (documents and anchors) in the Select Anchors dialog based on that user's recent selections.

feature: Doc Viewer: Context Menu Usability
description: Users will now be able to select text or areas more easily to perform Context Menu actions, as the default behavior will be Select instead of Grab. Vault will also default to Annotate mode (except when user lacks Annotate permission and no annotations exist), and will maintain annotation tool selection based on a user's last selection. To navigate embedded links when Select is applied, users can hover to invoke a linked tooltip.

feature: Crosslink a Crosslink
description: Vault now supports the ability to CrossLink an existing CrossLink from one Vault to another, within a single domain. *Auto-on in Vaults using CrossLinks

feature: Consolidated Rendition Settings & Profiles
description: Admins will now manage all rendition settings via the Rendition Profiles page in Configuration. The Vault-wide Rendition Settings page (in Admin > Settings) will be deprecated. Additionally, end users will no longer be able to individually adjust the appearance of markup in Word, layouts in Powerpoint, and watermarks in PDFs - this will be controlled by the Rendition Profile.

feature: Support for High-Efficiency Image Rendering
description: Users uploading and managing HEIC and HEIF files will now see these files rendered in the document viewer. Vault also supports Optical Character Recognition (OCR), Overlays, and Signature Pages for these renditions.

feature: Expanded Rendition Type Support in Vault File Manager
description: Vault File Manager now supports all standard rendition types for both download and upload actions. Vault File Manager can now support download and upload of rendition files up to 500GB in size.

feature: My Vaults Card Layout Enhancements
description: Users leveraging the My Vaults page to access multiple Vaults from a single account will now see that the Card layout supports up to 50 Vaults on a single scrollable page. Prior to 24R1, if a user had access to more than 12 Vaults, the My Vaults page would only display 12 Vaults per page. *Auto-on in Vaults with My Vaults enabled

feature: Binder Limits
description: Vault now has clearly documented and enforced limits for Vault Binders to ensure good binder performance. Binders are limited to 50,000 nodes overall, and binders over 10,000 nodes will no longer by able to be versioned or copied.

feature: Document Templates Limit
description: Vault now has clearly documented and enforced limits for Vault Document Templates (both Basic and Controlled Document Templates) to ensure reliable document template performance. There is a limit of 5000 total templates across a Vault, a limit of 500 templates per document hierarchy, and a limit of 50 templates on the Base Document type.

feature: Improved Reporting on Nested Binders
description: When reporting on binders that contain component binders, Vault will now display the component binder as a document within the parent binder.

feature: External Viewer: Improved Multi-Document Navigation
description: When using the External Viewer for multiple documents at once, users will now see several enhancements, including a default expanded sidebar, an updated expand/collapse icon, and resizing of documents when the sidebar is expanded. *Auto-on in Vaults leveraging the External Viewer for multiple documents (i.e. Response Packages in MedInquiry, Approved Email in Medical and PromoMats, and Safety Distribution via SiteConnect).

feature: Improved Error Message for Missing VFM File Security Policy
description: When checking out a document to Vault File Manager (VFM), a clearer error message is shown when VFM attempts to auto-open the file if a user does not have Read access to the VFM File Security Policy object in their permission set.

feature: 24R1 Platform Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Workflow Action Security for Workflow & Task Owners
description: Admins can secure individual workflows and limit the workflow and task actions available for Workflow Owners and Task Owners to help reduce process issues and delays that may be inadvertently caused by users when they take administrative action in a workflow.

feature: Workflow Owner & Task Owner Formula System Variables
description: @WorkflowOwner and @TaskOwner formula system variables provide access to user information such as locale and holiday schedules that can be used in formulas to calculate task due dates based on the working days of each Task Owner. These formula system variables can be accessed in workflow start step rules, update field actions, workflow dates and task due dates.

feature: Formulas for Workflow Dates
description: Workflow dates in the start step and task due dates can now be set using a formula to provide Admins with more flexibility with specifying the dates that drive a business process.

feature: Workflow Initiators Select Task Assignment Type
description: Workflow tasks can now be configured to allow workflow initiators to choose how tasks are assigned for the corresponding participant group so that the workflow initiator can select whether the task is assigned to every user or made available to users within the participant group when the workflow is started.

feature: Start Next Workflow Prompt when a Multi-Record Workflow Ends
description: Business processes configured with multi-record workflows can now be more seamlessly chained together by automatically prompting for the start of the next multi-record workflow when one ends.

feature: Auto-Start Document Workflows
description: Document workflows can now be auto-started through document lifecycle state entry actions so that business process automation can be improved by reducing the need for manual user input

feature: Object Lifecycle Workflow Cancel States
description: Admins can now specify which object lifecycle state an object record automatically moves to when its workflow is cancelled so that the object records do not always revert to the state they were in when the workflow was started.

feature: Document Workflow Task Due Dates Support Document Date Fields
description: Task Due Dates can now be set using document fields, and as part of the due date configuration on the workflow task you can choose whether the due date will automatically update if the document field is updated.

feature: Workflow Cancel States Can Ignore Entry Actions
description: Admins can now configure object and document lifecycle workflow cancel states so that entry actions are not executed on the document or object record when its workflow is cancelled and it moves to the workflow cancel state. This helps ensure that entry actions do not make any unwanted changes to the documents or records when workflows are cancelled.

feature: Advanced Start Workflow
description: Advanced Start Workflow helps eliminate the challenges of finding the right records or documents to start a workflow on by providing a more flexible method to start multi-document or multi-record workflows from any list view regardless of which lifecycle states the records or documents are currently in, how many items are in the list, or if the records or documents are already in active workflows. Advanced Start Workflow gives workflow initiators the ability to refine the selection of documents or records from their originating view and start a workflow from all the available workflows across the different lifecycles and states the records or documents are in.

feature: Reset Saved Task Information
description: Saved workflow task information for field prompts from failed task completion attempts are no longer stored in the workflow task completion dialog when the Task Owner updates the object record or document data directly prior to their next task completion attempt.

feature: Consistent Timeline View for Superseded Documents
description: If a document version is Superseded through a state change or a workflow, the Document Timeline View was making it appear like this occurred on the latest version of the document, which isn't always the case. This has been made more consistent and corrected.

feature: Documentation Update for Checklist Visual Designer
description: BRD only: updated core checklist design capabilities to mention how these can all now be done from the new visual designer.

feature: Pre-default Object Reference
description: Admins can now configure an object field to pre-default if there is only one record available for selection. Required object fields will continue to always pre-default if only one record is available. Pre-defaulting only happens in the record detail page UI.

feature: Action Layouts: Layout Profiles
description: Admins can now configure Layout Profiles and assign them to users. Layout Profile defines what Layouts are available to its assigned users when viewing object records. Layout Profiles are optional and a user can only have one Layout Profile at a time. Without a Layout Profile, users will use the default Layout configured per object. All existing Layouts prior to this release will be set as default.

feature: Action Layouts: Layout Pages
description: Admins can now configure an Object's Layout to include Pages. Pages allow for grouping of sections that users can switch between based on the context and work to be done.

feature: Action Layouts: Additional Improvements
description: Additional improvements to Action Layouts including: Save As New for existing Layouts, Standard Layouts, Custom Layout Limit Increase (from 20 to 50 per Object Type), Multi-Select Drag-and-Drop in the Layout Editor, Filtered Layout Rules, and the ability to Add Base Layouts.

feature: Merge Records API
description: A new API that takes two record IDs from the same object and merges them together so that all inbound object references (including child records) are moved from duplicate to main record. The ability to merge records is controlled in a number of ways, including a new user permission to merge records, and a new option in object configuration to allow its records to be merged.

feature: Help Section/Control
description: Admins can now add help content to a Layout for display on a record detail page. Content can be configured as a dedicated section or a control.

feature: Action Layouts: Record Summary Fields
description: Admins can now configure up to 6 fields by Object or Object Type to always be displayed at the top of a record page as Record Summary Fields.

feature: Support Library Questions in Visual Checklist Designer
description: Admins can now create questions in the new Visual Checklist Designer using questions that have been added to the library. Admins can also now directly add questions to the library from a question created in the Visual Checklist Designer.

feature: Checklist Design Translation
description: Admins can now add and manage translations for each Checklist Design; translations can be provided for the Checklist name, Sections, Questions, and Answers.

feature: Action Layouts: Layout Rules Enhancement
description: Layout Rules are applied to each Layout and any Layout Pages within, but with the introduction of Layout Pages, rules can now be defined to hide or show Layouts and Pages within Layouts. Additionally, a new Layout Selection Rule is available, which allows Admins to define criteria for overriding a default Layout, additional effects (Display as Required and Display as Read Only) have been added, and a new DISPLAYMODE() function has been introduced.

feature: High Volume Object (HVO) Renamed to Raw Object
description: High Volume Objects have been renamed to Raw Objects. As we look to increase the scalability of our Standard Objects, we will begin treating High Volume Objects more like regular database tables, used for storing raw data. Raw Objects will support up to a billion records.

feature: Expression Support for Long & Rich Text Fields
description: Object, Lifecycle and Workflow configuration options that use expressions will now support Long Text and Rich Text field types. This includes areas like Default Values, Validation Rules, Lifecycle Entry Actions, and Workflow Steps. Certain functions like IsBlank() and Left() will also support Long Text and Rich Text field types as inputs.

feature: New Object Audit Fields in CSV Exports & API
description: The object audit API (CSV and JSON) and data exports from the Vault UI (CSV) now include new fields that display the API names for fields, objects, new values, and old values.

feature: Related Record Audit Limits
description: This feature improves the performance of related record audit trails by adding a limit to the number of related objects and modifying the default date range. Users are now able to select up to 10 related objects and the default date range is set to the past month.

feature: Checklists: Increased Character Limit for Answer Text in Answer Library Design
description: The character limit for the Answer Text field on the Answer Library Design object has been increased from 128 to 255 characters. This makes this consistent with the Answer Text field on the Available Answer Design object.

feature: Mobile-Optimized Checklist UI for Respondents
description: Checklist respondents can access checklists from their mobile device’s web browser in a mobile optimized format. This is not supported for QualityOne 'Quality Event Checklists', 'Audit Checklists', or 'Quizzes', nor Quality 'Audit Checklists with Findings'.

feature: Vault Java SDK: Record Triggers Return Correct Fields for New Object Type
description: For more information, see the developer release notes.

feature: Action Layouts: User Interface Enhancements
description: The Record Detail Page interface has been updated to use a more compact user interface for Sections in the left-hand navigation, and a Collapse/Expand option has been added. Additionally, an enhanced Layout Editor will be visible to Admins who manage layouts, allowing for use of new features (such as Pages and Help Sections/Controls) as well as to improve the overall experience of creating and editing layouts.

feature: Add Spaces and Characters to Text with Text() Function
description: Text fields can be formatted using Vault formulas by allowing the Text() function to accept the Text data type and apply simple formatting such as inserting characters or adding spaces.

feature: Enhanced Dashboards Tab
description: Users will now have access to search, filters, custom views, and tags in the Dashboards tab. In addition, users can leverage a sortable tabular layout.

feature: Table Chart
description: This feature allows users to view tabular data and graphs in the same dashboard. Users can choose to present group or row level data in their table.

feature: Union Report Type Enhancement
description: Reports that include a union now support accessing all object fields for any objects that are included in the union. In addition, report views based on a union report type now support formula fields which can be used for joining.

feature: Expand Chart Enhancement
description: Column, Line and Control Charts will now show one data point per dashboard cell, allowing more information to be readily displayed to users based on the size of the dashboard component.

feature: Limit Increases for Reports
description: The maximum number of flash reports a Vault can have has been increased to 400 (from 200) and the maximum number of formula fields a multi-pass report can have has been increased to 10 (from 3).

feature: Report Edit Columns Modal Enhancement
description: Report Edit Column display modal experience has been improved by making it bigger and wrapping the longer field names for better readability. The background color for the selected field has also been improved, and hover-over tool tips are also consistent on both sides of the modal.

feature: Increased Field Limit for User Role Setup Objects
description: Objects of class User Role Setup can now be configured with up to six (6) custom fields for matching.

feature: Vault Loader Document Download Limit Increase to 10,000
description: When exporting document source files and rendition files using Vault Loader, the limit has now been increased from 2,000 files to 10,000 files. This change has been applied to all vaults, and includes no other changes in functionality.

feature: Vault Data Usage Information
description: In Admin > Settings > General Settings, Vault now provides a Data Usage Information section that allows Admins to easily view the size of their Vault based on Object Record Counts and Total Document Version Counts. Admins can also export Object-level record count information to a CSV file.

feature: Scheduled Data Export Support for AWS Bucket Policy
description: Scheduled Data Export will now support AWS Bucket Policy in addition to ACL for AWS S3 Bucket configuration.

feature: Migration Packages Support for Record Migration Mode Update & Upsert
description: Record Migration Mode for update and upsert operations are now supported with Configuration Migration and Test Data Packages.

feature: External URL Reverse IP Lookup Change
description: External URL Jobs are now sent from an IP address associated with Veeva Vault. Customers who are currently allowing listing by domain will need to update their rules to support the *.veevavault.com domains.

feature: Sandbox Allowance Warning
description: For Production Vaults where we have granted customers additional temporary sandboxes on top of their Sandbox limit (often for projects that only need these vaults for a specific period of time), we are updating our terms of use to allow Veeva to delete sandboxes that have surpassed their expiration date, starting in September 2024. After the 24R1 release, this more proactive approach to Sandbox cleanup will be displayed in a message when Admin users access the Sandbox management page, giving everyone the chance to plan around these changes.

feature: Preventing Unintended Document Template Creation
description: If a user performs a Make a Copy action on a template, Vault will no longer copy over the Template Document Type field value. This helps prevent the unnecessary and unintentional creation of new document templates. *Auto-on in Vaults leveraging Controlled Document Templates.

feature: Language Support
description: Vault Mobile now supports all Vault languages, not just English. Users who have a different language set in their profile will now see those translations when using Vault Mobile.

feature: Add Content to Placeholders
description: Users can now scan or upload documents into existing placeholders in Vault, further extending the capabilities for users to be able to contribute content.

feature: Select a File for Upload
description: In addition to scanning a document, users can now also select a file from their device when creating new documents (or uploading content to a placeholder document) via Vault Mobile.

feature: Apply Study Information to New Documents (Clinical Vaults Only)
description: Users in Clinical Operations Vaults now have the option to apply Study, Study Country and Study Site fields on new documents created in Vault Mobile.

feature: Stability Study Management
description: Adds the ability to manage stability studies to the LIMS application.
