feature: Instrument Integration Foundation
description: Implements the foundation for integration with third party data systems using Vault connections and additional objects to capture required integration parameters.

feature: LIMS Change Analysis: Merging via Multi-Record Workflow
description: Adds actions that resolve blockers or allow multiple Change Analysis records to be made effective together via Vault Multi-Record Workflow.

feature: Bulk Sample Printing
description: Creating a custom action to support printing samples in bulk to downstream printing software.

feature: Aggregate Testing
description: Allows for retention of the original Lab Test when retesting and adds new aggregate testing functionality. This includes the Sum, Average, Min, Max, Median, Mode, CountA, StDevP and StDevS calculation functions applied to a selected result from many Lab Tests. These results are collected from all the Lab Tests associated with a separate object, specifically: Lab Sample and Spec Execution.

feature: Modifying Test Inputs
description: Test Input values are now saved immediately upon leaving the cell, and can be modified even after Test Step completion through a sign-off flow very similar to the Result Change flow.

feature: 24R1 Early Adopter Customer Feedback
description: Small enhancements indicated by Vault LIMS early adopter customers.

application: LIMS, QMS, QualityDocs, Station Manager, Surveillance, Training, Validation Management
feature: 24R1 Quality Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Quality Teams Related Object Security
description: Administrators can now secure related objects associated to a Quality Team on a subset of standard objects based on the Quality Team role a user has on the primary process record.  Administrators can specify the role of the Quality Team and the role that users associated to that Quality Team role shall assume on the related object.  Users are added to the related record role dynamically when interacting with the related record.

feature: QRM: Periodic Risk Review
description: Allows organizations to store historical data about a Risk Assessment and its Risks (including risk scores and mitigation actions) in a structured format rather than a PDF.

feature: QRM: Risk Builder: Columns to Display
description: Enables greater flexibility in the way organizations choose to display Assessment Risk columns in Risk Builder.

feature: Enhanced Checklists for Audit Execution
description: Enables Audit Checklists to be created with a Checklist Type picklist value of "Audit Checklist with Findings".  Checklists with this Checklist Type allows Auditor to leverage checklists during audit execution and enable Findings to be created directly in the system while completing an Audit Checklist.

feature: External Notifications Enhancements: Multiple Recipients & Add Document from Library
description: Allows Vault Administrators to configure multiple person fields as recipients of an external notification and whether to allow library documents that reference the object record to be selectable on an external notification record. If the end user can add and remove recipients and documents based on the configuration, they shall be able to add or remove these entities through the Send External Notification dialog.

feature: Duplicate Check: Check Lifecycle State Processing Enhancement
description: Introduces new functionality for QMS Duplicate Check types of Record Checks to specify certain states from which newly identified Duplicates/Similar records should *not* automatically transition into a new state.

feature: Enable Adverse Event Reportability Assessment in QMS
description: Objects supporting Reportability Assessment for Complaints will be available in QMS.

feature: Quality Incidents: Create a Quality Incident from a QR Code
description: Allows for a QR Code or URL to be generated for a Quality Incident Configuration. When the QR Code is scanned or link is clicked, a streamlined intake form shall be displayed once the Vault user authenticates. The intake form is optimized for mobile browsers.

feature: QRM: Recompute Risk Matrix
description: This feature allows users to recalibrate the Risk Matrix and associated Risk records to ensure system-managed Risk Scores are correctly populated.

feature: Related Event App Section
description: Administrators can now add a Related Event App Section to the following objects: Quality Event, Change Control, Complaint, Continuous Improvement, Deviation, Finding, Lab Investigation, or Nonconformance. Once the Related Event App Section has been added, users can create relationships between one or many of the objects mentioned above. Once the user creates a record through the app section, key fields from the related record and related event record shall be displayed in the section in a single grid, providing a better user experience for interacting with the Related Event object.

feature: Standard Action Layout on Deviation Object
description: Two standard layouts shall be provisioned as inactive on the Deviation (deviation__v) object: Sample GMP Deviation Detail Layout (Full View) and Sample GMP Deviation State Layout. Administrators can copy these layouts and then modify them based on their specific business needs and user experience requirements.

feature: Record Check Enhancements: Capture Suggested Terms & UI Enhancements
description: Introduces support for capturing Suggested Terms to be saved whenever Matching Search Terms are utilized as part of a Record Check's configuration.

feature: Duplicate Check: Update Summary Page to Accurately Reflect Lifecycle Transitions
description: The summary page of a Duplicate Check now accurately depicts whether a Complaint record shall be moved to a destination lifecycle state.

feature: QRM: Risk Builder Enhancements
description: This release introduces several new Risk Builder enhancements based on customer feedback. Most notably, users can now assign Mitigation Actions (including CAPA Actions and Change Control) directly from the Risk Builder grid.

feature: 5 Whys Analysis: Support for Dynamic Reference Constraints
description: The 5 Why's Analysis tool now supports dynamic reference constraints as well as the following field data types: Text, Number, Boolean, Date, Object, Rich Text, Long Text, and Lookup fields

feature: Cascade Delete Quality Team Members
description: When a Quality Team-Enabled record is deleted, automatically delete the team member assignments so that the deletion of the Team Enabled record is successful.

feature: Quality Components Configuration Migration Improvements
description: This feature resolves an issue where the "Sibling Check Related Record State Change" entry action cannot be exported via VPK if the action configuration references a lifecycle state on another object lifecycle which has a circular dependency back to the first object. To resolve, a placeholder lifecycle state will be created to allow the deployment to proceed. VPKs will still show as blocked and will require the setting "Allow deployment of blocked steps" to be enabled.

feature: Enable Launching Document Workflows from the Document Change Control
description: This feature allows users to start workflows on documents directly from the Document Change Control (DCC) record via new Documents to be Made Effective and Documents to be Made Obsolete sections. Users will also be able to view the status of the workflows and click on workflow envelope links from the DCC.

feature: Document Change Control: Document Association Governance Limit
description: A governance limit now restricts the number of documents that can be added to a single Document Change Control (DCC) to a maximum total of 100 across all three sections: Change Authorization, Documents to be made Effective and Documents to be Made Obsolete. The limit applies to all Document Change Control records created after the 24R1 release.

feature: Document Page Thumbnail View in Android Station Manager
description: The Android Station Manager application now allows a user to display all pages of a document in a thumbnail view to more easily navigate to the desired page.

feature: Curriculum Completion Outcomes: Grant Additional Permissions
description: Allows an Admin to create rules that update a Learner’s User Role on completion of Curriculum.

feature: My Team Page (Manager Homepage)
description: This new page gives a manager fingertip access to the state of their direct team's training. At a glance, they will understand overall team performance.

feature: Curriculum Prerequisites
description: Allows Training Admins to create Prerequisite Training Rules among curricula indicating which Curricula must be completed before gaining access to another given Curriculum.

feature: Training Requirement Impact Assessment: Copy Training Impact from Document
description: Automatically copies the Training Impact field value from the document to the Training Requirement Impact Assessment (TRIA) record. This allows for TRIA records to be automatically closed based on business processes when Training Impact = No.

feature: Supplemental Materials
description: Allows training admins to add documents as optional supplemental materials on document training requirements.

feature: Assign, Pause, or Cancel Training Assignments Using Learner Role-Person Lifecycle
description: A learner's training is assigned based on the lifecycle state of their Learner Role Person record and cancelled based on the lifecycle state for the Learner Role person record.

feature: Data Model: New Fields & Objects
description: New standard fields on Person, Learner Role, Curriculum, Training Requirement to help drive automation for current and future features.

feature: LearnGxP ContentDirect
description: The LearnGxP Content Direct feature allows the automated delivery of courses and course updates to a Training Vault, for customers subscribed to LearnGxP's library.

feature: Standard Action Layouts for Training Objects
description: Provision standard action layouts for Training Matrix objects to be available for customers to use in their implementations.

feature: Evaluation Training Assignment: Create Checklists for Learners without a Vault User
description: Evaluation Checklists can now be created for Learners without a User reference.

feature: Auto-Manage Persons: Exclude System Users from Auto-Creation
description: The Auto Manage Person feature will exclude Users with a Security Policy of System Managed.

feature: Learner Homepage: User Interface Updates
description: The Begin Training button label on the Learner Homepage's Card View now displays as View Training in the following cases: 1) When an Evaluation Training Assignment is in the In Evaluation or In Evaluation Preparation state, or 2) When an External Training Assignment is in the In Verification state. Additionally, for Classroom Training Assignments where a Learner is not added to a roster and self-registration is not allowed, Classroom Training Assignments were previously hyperlinked in List View, and in the Learner Role and Curriculum pages. These types of Classroom Training Assignments are visible but are no longer hyperlinked.

feature: Training Requirement Prerequisites: User Interface Updates
description: Slight updates to the way Training Requirements Prerequisites are displayed in the Learner UI.

feature: Curriculum Page: User Interface Updates
description: Adds User Interface improvements on the Curriculum Page (from Learner Homepage): 1) Breadcrumb icon. 2) Training Assignments are now hyperlinked on the Curriculum Page. The Begin Training button, which was used to open the Training Assignment from the Curriculum Page, is removed. 3) When a Learner is not part of a class roster and they cannot self-register, then the Training Assignment link is disabled. 4) Self-Enrolled Training Assignments can be Un-enrolled from the Curriculum Page.

feature: Document Training Assignments: Show Additional Document Toolbar Options
description: Full Screen, View Annotations, View Options gestures are available while viewing a document from a Document Training Assignment.

feature: Add to Calendar Link: Training Assignment Link in Calendar Invite
description: The Add To Calendar link now contains a link to the Classroom Training Assignment in the calendar invite.

feature: Training Assignment State Change: Ignore State Of Evaluation Checklist Design
description: When an Evaluation Training Assignment's state is updated (for example, to Canceled), the lifecycle state of the Evaluation Design record is ignored, which allows for successful Training Assignment state change.

feature: Curriculum SmartMatch Renamed to Curriculum Matching
description: Curriculum SmartMatch feature name is updated to Curriculum Matching. Labels were updated in Admin configuration screen, field labels, error messages, and training job log.

feature: Quiz Support for Mobile Web & Mobile App
description: Quizzes can now be completed on mobile browsers.

feature: Training Matrix & Other Limits Updated
description: Training limits have been updated to match usage.

feature: Instructor-Led Training: Improved Error Message when Adding Instructor
description: A friendly message is displayed if the selected Instructor has an inactive User account.

feature: Instructor-Led Training: Auto-Cancel Workflow Tasks when Instructor is Updated
description: Automatically cancels a workflow task for a previous Instructor in the event the instructor has been updated. Before this feature, these workflow tasks were required to be manually cancelled.

feature: Feedback-Based Enhancements
description: A new job is provisioned that processes and consolidates Acknowledgements received from FDA. Also includes mapping enhancements for eMDR.

feature: Regulatory Updates for eMDR
description: This feature adds regulatory updates released by FDA in August 2023. 3500A form is also updated to accommodate the new format.

feature: UI Enhancements for Adverse Event Reporting
description: Adds new fields on AER page layouts to show join object records information (from complaints and other related object records).

feature: Family Validation
description: With 24R1, Vault Validation Management provides a way to group entities together into an entity family. This allows common requirements for the family to be enforced and automatically shared across all entities within the same family and as new entities are added to the family. Additional enhancements include the ability to associate an entity with an asset from the asset object (asset__v) as well as a new Validation Deliverable Entity Version object that allows deliverables to be shared across entities in the same family. Additional fields have been added to the Validation Requirement object (val_requirement_svo__v) that must be enabled on object types as part of adopting this feature in a vault.

feature: Template Requirements
description: In 24R1, Vault Validation Management is introducing templating capabilities for requirements and set of requirements. When enabled, user requirements, functional requirements, and design specifications can be created from a single template requirement record or imported from a set of multiple template requirements.

feature: Printable View for Test Scripts
description: With 24R1, Vault Validation Management will provide a way to generate a printable view of a test script that will include related object records and evidence collected from executors, such as screenshots, that are stored as test step file attachments. When the printable view is initiated from a user action, information about the test script, test steps, related object records such as discrepancies will be included so that it can be printed to a PDF from a browser and shared with an external stakeholder, like an auditor.  A new printable view configuration is available to allow admins to define what printable views are available for configuration on a test script lifecycle state. In an XML template configuration file, admins can configure the order that related object records will appear in the printable view as well as their fields that will display in table, one-column, or two-column formats. Additional configurable options will include a header logo image, header text, footer text, and watermark text that will be displayed at a 45 degree angle. Tokens are available for the header and footer text to include attributes such as the record number (name__v), user name that generated the printable view, and date/time the printable view was created. Free text can be added to the header and footer text.

feature: Standard Action Layouts for Validation Management
description: Provision standard action layouts for all Validation Management objects to be available for customers to use in their implementations.

feature: Re-order & Copy Support for Additional Prompts
description: With 24R1, Vault Validation Management extends support for additional prompts to allow the order of the prompts to be manipulated directly from the test script authoring UI using drag and drop. Setup Steps and Execution Steps that have additional prompts are now also included when the Setup Step or Execution Step is copied.

feature: Improved Inactive Bookmark Handling During PDF Standardization
description: With this release, inactive bookmarks in documents subject to PDF Standardization will inherit the bookmark action of their first child in the tree.

feature: Document Type Definition for RLCP Published Output
description: With this feature, users can define the document type for the published RLCP content, on the Content Plan Item, Content Plan Item Template, or Report Level Content Plan record, allowing for better classification and auto matching within Submissions Content Plans after Publishing RLCP.

feature: Section Level Merge for RLCP
description: Enables users to merge all documents from Content Plan Items within a Content Plan section into a single PDF upon publishing. This feature does not currently support defining a document type for the RLCP Published Output. Any sections merged with Section Merge will be outputted as Submission Ready Document Types.

feature: Link Evaluator Enhancements
description: Enhancements to the Link Evaluator page have been implemented for increased efficiency and user-friendliness. Users can now: 1) Suppress individual links or suppress links in bulk. 2) Retarget or Suppress Links at a submission or application level. 3) Easily view Retargeted links. 4) Revert Retargeted links. 5) Revert Suppress links. 6) UX Enhancements (Back to Content Plan, clearer Link Status values)

feature: Jordan Multiple Application Number Support
description: Users Publishing in JO now have the ability to add overrides or remove overrides for eJDWS Application Number (Application Number) and Application Number (Number) via the edit Submission Administrative Information action from the Submission record.

feature: Disable Auto Reference Leaf for Non-eCTD Submissions
description: Vault Publishing will no longer automatically create Reference Leafs when the same document is matched multiple times in a non-eCTD Submission. Vault Publishing will disable the Reference Leaf functionality for any non-eCTD submissions (where ICH/DTD is not equal to 3.0 or 3.2), allowing the same document to be published multiple times.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Increase RIM Vault Max File Size to 500GB
description: RIM Vaults now support file uploads up to 500GB.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: RIM Standard Action Layouts
description: With this release, standard Action Layouts are provided for the Application, Regulatory Objective, and Submission objects

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: 24R1 RIM Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Vault-Wide PDF Standardization
description: Admins can now configure PDF Standardization as a Vault-wide setting in the Default Rendition Profile. New documents will be standardized on the creation of new versions. Existing documents can be rerendered using Vault Loader.

feature: Single Submission Package Potential Incomplete Export Notification
description: With this feature, Submissions Archive export messaging is updated for clarity in cases where a Submission is set for continuous publishing and the exported dossier package may be incomplete.

feature: Validation Updates for Support for Drug-Led Combination Products
description: In this feature, validation was updated to better support the Drug-Led Combination Product Registration Enhancements for IDMP feature released in 23R3.

feature: Relate Bundled & Split Regulatory Objectives & Submissions to Events
description: With this release, Regulatory Objectives and Submissions that are created by Bundling or Splitting are related to the Event, enhancing end-to-end visibility.

feature: Global-to-Local Site Role Mapping in Bundling
description: When users perform Bundling from an Activity or Regulatory Objective, Vault converts the global Site Role value from the Event-related records to the appropriate local values on the new Regulatory Objective-related records.

feature: Bulk Create & Manage Event Details
description: A new user interface simplifies creation of Event details. This interface is configurable via admin pages. New preview interface allows users to review and refine data prior to creation or manage existing details.

feature: Wizard Support for IDMP Manufacturing Details
description: Adds new fields and wizard support for tracking and implementing changes of Manufacturing details.

feature: RIM Registrations Data Model Updates
description: In this release, we've expanded the Vault RIM data model to better capture product and device details.

feature: EUDAMED XSD Version 2.0.11 Support
description: This feature will update EUDAMED UDI Submission Generation & Validation in alignment with the latest Production update, which uses XSD Version 2.0.11.

feature: Enhancement to Product-Based Activity Scope Levels
description: When Create Related Records is run from an event, and Application relationships are enabled, "Application and Product" and "Country, Application and Product" Activity Scope Levels will be updated to evaluate the products in the Application Product records to determine which activities to create for each impacted application.

feature: Identification of Global Site Role Values That Could Not Be Mapped
description: With this feature, if a global Site Role value from an Event detail cannot be matched to a Site Role value from the local health authority on the new Regulatory Objective and Submission related records, Vault can create the records with a placeholder value to be updated manually later.

feature: Enhanced User Messaging When Bundling Regulatory Objectives
description: When bundling from a regulatory objective, updated messaging will make it clearer to users that the relationships from which they can choose are only the ones from the events of the selected activities.

feature: Enhanced Support for Packaging Shelf Life Field
description: With this feature, the Shelf Life field on the Packaging join objects is now supported by the Registrations wizards when the Submission Wizard is enabled. This field will also continue to be supported without the Submission Wizard.

feature: Generate Active Dossier from Global Content Plan Dispatch
description: This feature supports automatic generation of Active Dossier records upon dispatch of the Global Content Plan based on the documents dispatched. The target Activities’ Local Disposition determines whether Active Dossier records are generated as Dispatched or Pending Current. Generation upon dispatch allows for a more accurate Active Dossier for regulatory use cases outside of the normal submission and approval cycle and provides earlier visibility for dispatched documents. As part of this feature, the Active Dossier Viewer is also updated to display the Dispatched icon for Active Dossier Item Detail records with a Dispatched status and the hovercard is reformatted to display the Event and Activity fields.

feature: Global Content Plan Dispatch Update: Notify Submission Owners Upon Initial Submission Content Plan Creation
description: When the Global Content Plan is dispatched, submission owners on the target application and/or submission are now also notified when the dispatch creates the initial Submission Content Plan. Previously, a notification would only send to submission owners when a comparison with the target submission was generated and ready for review.

feature: Global Content Plan Dispatch by Country
description: This feature allows the Global Content Plan to be dispatched to individual countries. The dispatch dialog will support selection of either Countries, Document Sets (Submission Groupings), or All. When Countries are selected in the dispatch dialog, the dispatch acts on those Countries’ valid Activities.

feature: Support Reattachment of a Global Content Plan to its Event Record
description: This change allows the Global Content Plan that is created for an Event to be reattached to the Event if it is accidentally cleared. Previously, once the Global Content Plan field is cleared from its Event record, the Global Content Plan was no longer able to be re-associated or usable for the Event.

feature: Global Content Plan Synchronization Updates
description: The following enhancements have been made to the Global Content Plan dispatch, Synchronize Content Plan, and Comparison Viewer features: 1) The Comparison Viewer help is updated to state user selections will persist when navigating away without accepting or rejecting within the comparison viewer. 2) There is now validation on whether the dispatching user has permissions to view the matching target Submission Content Plan sections which are dispatched from the Global Content Plan. 3) For a target Submission Content Plan, the Content Plan and Content Plan Items that are created from a dispatch will be in the correct order according to the template by the synchronization. 4) The Comparison Viewer will retain users' preferences on column widths.

feature: Content Plan Creation to Respect DTD/XSD Version
description: This feature introduces two new fields on the Content Plan related objects: XML ICH DTD / XSD Version and XML Regional DTD / XSD Version, along with updates to the Submission Content Plan creation processes to respect the Submission’s XML Version fields. This allows RIM customers to generate a more relevant Submission Content Plan for Content Plan Templates and Content Plan Item Templates that apply to different XML versions. This also allows customers to define records that should only be created for eCTD such as the index, regional, STF, and other XML nodes.

feature: Expand Content Plan to Matched Document Level
description: This feature updates the Content Plan Expand (All) action. Content Plans will now expand to the match document level (up to a maximum of 2000 documents) instead of stopping at the Content Plan Item.

feature: Suggested Matching Enhancements: Reorder, Split, Update Expected Counts, & Bulk Match
description: Provides the ability to reorder matched documents and split a content plan item to create additional content plan items in match document mode. Additionally the system supports the ability to update the expected steady state count and match or unmatch documents in bulk using a select all or deselect all button.

feature: Improve Match Document Mode Performance
description: This feature will increase performance of Match Document Mode, while also restoring document counts and page numbers in the UI.

feature: Embedded Doc Viewer: Select Mode
description: RIM Submission Archive Viewer uses an embedded viewer (/ui/annotate/doc_viewer) and the goal here is to extend or replace that viewer to support the following common actions, in priority order: Bookmarks, Video, Copy Text, Annotations (view, create edit delete), Glossary.

feature: Update Viewer Document Header
description: With this release the Document Viewer header in the Submissions Archive viewer is updated to display the document version and the document lifecycle state.

feature: Leaf Source File Path Display in the Submissions Archive Viewer
description: With this feature RIM Submissions Archive users are able to view and filter the leaf source file path field metadata in the grid.

feature: Sharing Submission Selection in the Viewer
description: Submissions Archive users are now able to share a link to a specific submission selected the viewer.

feature: Active Dossier Update to Support Common Countries
description: Country codes need to be explicitly defined in order for countries to be supported by Active Dossier. The country codes for the Common (EU) and Common (GCC) countries that are used for content planning purposes have been set explicitly to common_eu and common_gcc, respectively. Previously, Common (GCC) was identified by a country code of common and Common (EU) was identified by a blank country code. Admins will need to update the country_code__rim field on the Common Country records for proper Active Dossier support for these countries.

feature: Active Dossier Consolidated Sections (Enablement Update)
description: This feature removes certain product-related tokens from Active Dossier Template records in all RIM Vaults, including Vaults with existing Active Dossier records. These tokens for Product Variant and Manufacturer (and in 3.2.A.1, Product, Product Variant, and Active Substance) were previously responsible for creating repeating duplicative sibling record sections, for example multiple 3.2.S sections for a single Active Substance depending on the Manufacturer information submitted with the Active Substance. Furthermore, Active Dossier Structure and Active Dossier Item records are updated in Vaults with existing Active Dossier records to support the changes to the template: 1) The Section field is updated on Active Dossier Item records accordingly to reparent them under a single consolidated Active Dossier Structure record for the Product, Active Substance, or Manufacturer depending on the template 2) If a single consolidated Active Dossier Structure record does not yet exist for the Product, Active Substance, or Manufacturer, then one is created prior to the reparenting of Active Dossier Item records. 3) No Active Dossier records are deleted, and no updates are made to Active Dossier Item Detail records.  Finally, the Active Dossier Template Consolidation Admin setting will also be removed from all RIM Vaults. Upon completion of the record updates, end-users will see the condensed Active Dossier structure in the Viewer for new and existing Active Dossier records.

feature: Cloning Enabled for RIM Views
description: The RIM View (rim_view__v) object is now set to be cloned when a RIM Vault is cloned. This system managed object stores Saved Views for Content Plans, Active Dossier, and Submissions Archive. This means that RIM Saved Views will be inherited from parent Vaults. Sharing settings and Users/Groups will not be inherited. Vault Owners will have access to the cloned views to share them as needed. Filters on object records that are not cloned in the saved view will not be persisted.

feature: Clinical Trials: Isolate Blinded Product Information
description: This feature lays the foundation for Vault Safety to fully isolate all blinded Product information for Clinical Trial Cases. This feature is currently available to customers only for testing purposes. Contact your Veeva Representative for more information.

feature: Supporting AS2 Connection Adoption
description: With this release, the Safety Gateway includes performance and stability enhancements.

feature: Reporting Rules Configuration for Non-Vault Owners
description: With this release, users with appropriate permissions can now configure Safety Reporting Rules. Previously, this was limited to Vault Owners, regardless of security and permissions.

feature: Japan Periodic Reporting: Post-Market Non-Serious (NUPR)
description: With this release, Vault Safety introduces the Post-Market Non-Serious Unlisted Periodic Report (NUPR) for aggregate reporting to the PMDA.

feature: Validation Query Builder: Inbound Object Reference Expressions
description: With this release, Case validations can be configured using expressions that reference Case data from multiple objects.

feature: Inactivate Product & Study Registrations
description: Vault Safety Admins can now inactivate Product and Study Registrations so the Safety Rule Engine excludes them when determining Case reportability.

feature: Datasheet Expectedness by Age and Sex
description: Expectedness evaluations in Vault Safety now support age range and sex criteria.

feature: Medical-Safety Vault Connection: Adverse Event Reports
description: With this release, potential Adverse Events raised in Vault Medical - MedInquiry can be shared with Vault Safety through a Vault to Vault connection.

feature: Safety Rule Engine Troubleshooting Tool
description: Vault Safety Admins can now diagnose Submission and Distribution Rule issues by using the Safety Rules Troubleshooting tool and the Rule Engine execution log.

feature: Safety Rule Set Configuration Report: Function Families
description: With this release, Vault Safety supports the export of Function Families into the Rule Set Configuration Report.

feature: Lifecycles for Case Assignment Objects
description: Vault Safety introduces default lifecycles for Case Assignment Objects.

feature: Safety Data Validation Exception Handling
description: With this release, Vault Safety extends support for exception handling and troubleshooting tools for custom Safety Data Validations.

feature: Transmission Profiles for FDA E2B(R3) Submissions and Distributions
description: Vault Safety introduces three (3) new Transmission Profiles: CDER Study, CBER Study, and CDER IND Exempt. This feature is a building block for expanding future FDA E2B(R3) capabilities in Vault Safety.

feature: Standard MedDRA Query (SMQ) Hierarchy Update
description: When you import Standard MedDRA Queries (SMQs) into Vault Safety, the system now creates references to MedDRA terms at the Preferred Terms (PT) level.

feature: Create and Export Case and Safety Report Collections
description: Vault Safety introduces Case Collections and the export of multiple E2B and CIOMS I forms at once.

feature: Manage Custom Dose Forms, Routes of Administration, and Units of Measurement
description: Admins can now manage custom dose forms, routes of administration, and units of measurement values within Vault Safety.

feature: Sender-Based Inbound Validations
description: Admins can now assign specific groups of validation criteria (such as ICH E2B(R3)) for individual Transmission Profiles (Business Partners). The system validates imported E2B Transmissions against the specified rules.

feature: QC Checklist Generation
description: Safety will now optimize case Quality Control activities using QC Checklists to guide assessment, track errors and corrections. This includes a rules-based system to determine the appropriate QC Checklist, and sampling rate to allow for randomize selection.

feature: Safety Inbox Loader: Multi-CSV ZIP Data Import for VAERS, KAERS, and Custom Formats
description: Vault Safety Inbox Loader now supports bulk import to Inbox Items from multi-CSV ZIP files.

feature: Update to Seriousness Picklist
description: To support Device and Combination Product Cases, Admins can now update the Seriousness picklist to include “Required Intervention to Prevent Permanent Impairment/Damage (Devices)”.

feature: DSUR and PBRER: Cumulative Tabulations for all IMP, Comparator, Placebo and Blinded Case Study Products
description: With this release, Cases on the DSUR and PBRER cumulative tabulations are counted based on the Study Product Roles (Investigational Medicinal Product, Active Comparator, Placebo) taking into consideration all Study Products, instead of looking at only the primary Product. This feature is Auto-On in Vaults with DSUR and PBRER Investigational Product Causality enabled.

feature: Rule Engine Update for Safety Measure and Research Reports
description: The reporting rule engine now excludes Cases with a Special Report Classification unless specified in the evaluated rule.

feature: Japan: Substance Matching for CPR Generation (Cross Report)
description: Case Product Registration (CPR) generation logic now prioritizes exact Substance matching for investigational Product Registrations, while resorting to partial matching for post-marketed Product Registrations when an exact match isn’t available. Moreover, the system generates CPRs for Compound Products (Cases with multiple Substances) only when the Case Product matches these multiple Substances precisely. This feature is Auto-On in Vaults with PMDA Local Case Processing Automations enabled.

feature: Japan: One Last Time Reporting
description: Vault Safety now supports the evaluation of reportability changes for Japan PMDA Submissions. This feature is Auto-On for customers using Case Product Registration-based Due Date Calculations for Japan.

feature: Non Re-Transmittable Document Classification
description: Case documents can now be classified for exclusion from E2B Transmissions.

feature: MedDRA Browser and Search Improvements
description: With this release, Vault Safety enhances the MedDRA Browser and MedDRA search.

feature: Enablement Update: PMDA Local Reporting Details Generation and Submission Linking
description: With this release, the PMDA Local Reporting Details Generation and Submission Linking feature is Auto-on. This feature was originally introduced in 23R3 with Support-enablement. Although this feature is Auto-on, some components require additional configuration.

feature: Support Device Seriousness on MedWatch 3500A, CIOMS I, and E2B
description: Case form generation now supports the Seriousness value “Required Intervention to Prevent Permanent Impairment/Damage (Devices)”.

feature: Two-Way Relationships Between Multi-Case and Single-Case Files
description: Vault Safety now facilitates a bidirectional relationship between multi-Case files (XML, CSV, and ZIP) and individual single-Case documents.

feature: Product Ranking Suggestions for Imported Inbox Items
description: This release enhances product ranking suggestions for imported Inbox Items from any source (E2B, JSON, Inbox Loader, or Connections).

feature: Combination Product Updates Applied to Case Names
description: Vault Safety Case names now reflect Case Combination Product updates.

feature: Medical History Label Update
description: With this release, Vault Safety updates the label of the deprecated Medical History Text field to “Medical History*”.

feature: Case Compare: Informative Message for Custom Objects with Duplicate Names
description: When Inbox Items are merged to In-flight Cases or promoted to Follow-up Cases, if any Custom objects have duplicate names when unique names are required, the system now displays a clear and informative message on the Case Compare page.

feature: Aggregate Reports: Assessment Result (Override)
description: With this release, DSUR and PBRER Interval Line Listing of Serious Adverse Reaction (SAR) tables and CIOMS II Line Listings display the Assessment Result (Override) value when it’s present, instead of the Assessment Result value.

feature: Product Types Populated in Company Product Browser
description: The Vault Safety Product Browser now shows Product Types for each Product and Product Registration.

feature: External Product Substance Creation Improvements
description: When coding External Products through the WHODrug dictionary, Vault Safety now increases the number of Product Substances that are automatically created. The limit to the number of Product Substances that can be created is 1,500 characters based on the cumulative number of characters across all Product Substance names.

feature: Case Access Group Security: Inbox Items by Country
description: Using Case Access Group Security, Admins can now restrict Inbox Item viewers based on the Inbox Item's primary Reporter Country.

feature: Case Access Group Security: Support for Localization on Inbound Transmissions
description: Vault Safety now supports Case Access Group security for Inbound Transmissions based on the localization of the associated Case or Inbox Item.

feature: Document References on Domestic and Localized Follow-Up Cases
description: When creating Follow-ups to Domestic and Localized Cases, Vault Safety now copies document links from the previous Localized Case version.

feature: Prevent New Info Date Update During Merge to Current
description: When merging Inbox Items to In-flight Cases, the system prevents updates to the Case New Info Date.

feature: Japan: PMDA ICSR Reporting Enhancements
description: With this release, Vault Safety enhances support for Submissions to the PMDA. This feature improves Case Product Registration snapshotting, Localized Case Assessment Due Date calculation, and Expectedness calculation. Additionally, this release updates PMDA E2B(R3) data mapping to support compliant Submissions.

feature: Aggregate Reporting: Combine Tabulations and Authoring
description: This supports integrating Vault Safety's Line Listing and Tabulation generation in Vault SafetyDocs' section-based Aggregate Report authoring model. These enhancements will fully integrate both Safety Management and SafetyDocs applications when it comes to end-to-end authoring of Aggregate Reports. Note: You must be licensed for Vault Safety to use this feature.

feature: Create Inbox Item from Literature Article
description: With this release, Vault SafetyDocs supports sending literature articles directly to the Vault Safety Inbox for ICSR processing.   Note: This feature is not supported in CRO Vaults.

feature: Redacted Document Tracking
description: Vault Safety and Vault SafetyDocs now clearly identify documents where Personally Identifiable Information (PII) data has been redacted and relate them to the unredacted source documents.

feature: 24R1 Safety Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: PSMF: Document Deletion
description: When users delete PSMF Content documents, Vault SafetyDocs can now automatically delete the corresponding PSMF logbooks and logbook entries.

feature: Document Distribution to Partners via Vault Task
description: With this release, PVA documents can be distributed to partners through Vault Tasks.   Note: Partners must have access to the Vault in which the task is assigned.

feature: PVA: Document Distribution via Email
description: Vault SafetyDocs PVA document distribution tracking now includes documents distributed by email.

feature: Multiple Logbook Entries per Major Version of PSMF Documents
description: With this release, Vault SafetyDocs supports creating and displaying up to ten (10) logbook entries for every major version of a PSMF document.

feature: Auto-Translation of Imported Literature Abstracts
description: Vault SafetyDocs can now automatically send for translation non-English literature abstracts that have been imported in bulk. This feature is Auto-On in Vaults with Literature Abstract Auto-Translation enabled.

feature: MedDRA Hierarchical Browser for Product-Event Combinations
description: MedDRA terms for Product-Event Combinations can now be coded at any level of the MedDRA hierarchy.

feature: Aggregate Report Task Creation Enhancements
description: For documents created from aggregate report templates, Vault SafetyDocs now limits document names to fewer than 100 characters.

feature: Update Label of Generate Aggregate Report Section Creation Dialog
description: With this release, Aggregate Report Tasks have been renamed to Aggregate Report Sections.

feature: Exclude Obsolete Documents from the PSMF PDF
description: Vault SafetyDocs now excludes obsolete documents with the PSMF Content or PSMF Generated Document subtypes from the merged PSMF PDF.

feature: Aggregate Reporting: Section Role Assignment
description: Vault SafetyDocs users can now assign and reassign Aggregate Report Sections to other users.

feature: Auto-Create Security Records for Study Country & Site
description: Based on Role Dependencies associated with a Learner Role the system automatically creates URS records for a Learner Role Person who is assigned a study country or study site.

feature: Study Training: Training Matrix Automation
description: Training Administrators can configure which study team roles and curriculum are automatically added to the Training Matrix Builder when they first create the Training Matrix for a study.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Complex Clinical Trials
description: Enhances the Clinical Operations to CDMS Connection to support the introduction of Complex Clinical Trials in Vault CTMS. With Complex Clinical Trials, customers can create a variety of subject groupings (such as arms, cohorts, and sub-studies) that can be used for Milestone, Metrics, and Subject Enrollment tracking.

feature: Clinical Operations-ePRO Connection
description: This feature enables Vault Clinical to transfer Studies, Study Countries, and Study Sites to ePRO.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Subject Visit Method
description: The Clinical Operations to CDMS Connection now supports transfer of Subject Visit Method when the data is available in CDMS.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Serious Adverse Event Reports
description: EDC studies can now transfer safety case data to Vault Safety over a Vault Connection.

feature: LIMS-Quality Connection: Document Exchange
description: Add new connection and integration points between the QualityDocs and LIMS Vaults to support the automated creation of crosslinks when a specified document type reaches a steady state.  Document crosslinks can be sent from QualityDocs to LIMS and also from LIMS to QualityDocs as part of the connection. The connection will support automating steady state document crosslink versioning and metadata updates between both Vaults.

feature: PromoMats-Medical Connection
description: Allows the transfer of steady state documents and their related anchors between Medical Vaults and PromoMats Vaults. For example, medical literature references stored in Medical Vaults can be transferred to PromoMats Vaults to help support claims made in promotional / marketing materials. Upon release, this bi-directional connection will include a default configuration that customers can add to, modify or disable. Configurable elements include Document Types with the PromoMats Medical Connection Document Type Group and Integration Rules (Query Object Rules, Field Rules, and Reference Lookups).

feature: Medical-Safety Connection: Adverse Event Reports
description: With this release, potential Adverse Events raised in Vault Medical - MedInquiry can be shared with Vault Safety through a Vault to Vault connection.

application: PromoMats, RIM Publishing, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: RIM-PromoMats Connection: CrossLink Document Transfer Integration
description: Streamlines the management of documents required for AdPromo Submissions. What is transferred will be configured using the Connection, Integration, and Integration Point. Configurable elements include Document Types with the PromoMats Medical Connection Document Type Group and Integration Rules (Query Object Rules, Field Rules, and Reference Lookups). By default, the integration will only initiate the transfer of Steady State documents once they reach their next Steady State after the feature is configured.

feature: Quality-RIM Connection: Document Exchange
description: Adds a new integration point to the existing connection between the Quality and Regulatory Vaults to support the automated creation of Crosslinks when a document of a specified document type reaches Steady State. Documents can be sent from Quality to Regulatory Vaults or from Regulatory to Quality Vaults.

feature: Quality-RIM Connection: Updated Error Message when Executing UpdateRimChangeDetails Action
description: In previous releases, if the Update RIM Change Details record action was configured as a user action for Impact Assessment records, the action was only visible on a record if the RIM Event ID field Impact Assessment record had a value. In this release, if the Update RIM Change Details record action was configured as a user action for Impact Assessment records, the action will always be visible. If both the Quality Event or Change Control fields (depending on the data model in use) and RIM Event ID field are not populated, then an error message will appear when attempting to run the action.

feature: Safety-RIM Vault Connection: Product Trade Names
description: The Safety-RIM Product Connection now transfers details of associated Product Trade Names from Vault RIM to Vault Safety. This feature is Auto-On in Vaults with the Safety-RIM Connection enabled.

feature: Safety-Clinical Operations Connection: Safety Letters
description: The Safety-ClinOps Connection now supports Safety Letter distribution from Vault Safety to Vault Clinical.

feature: Complex Trials: Additional Metrics
description: Vault CTMS now supports the creation and management of Subject Group specific Metrics and Metrics Over Time records for studies using the Metrics Calculation approach of 'Metrics Only'   Additionally, 'Last Subject' milestones for Subject Groups now support 'No New Subject' identification for Subject Group Study Site records

feature: Clinical Operations-Medical CRM Connection: Specify CRM Account Identifier per Connection
description: This feature allows the CRM Account Identifier field to be specified for each distinct connection to CRM. This supports connecting Vault Clinical Operations to multiple CRM Organizations with different configuration as the CRM field used for matching Accounts and Persons can now be set per connection.

feature: Clinical Operations-Medical CRM Connection: Vault Setting Relabel
description: With this release, the "Enable CRM Connection" setting in Admin Settings is being relabeled to "Enable Global CRM Connection Identifier Mapping" to be more accurate.

feature: Date-based Metrics Calculation: Actual field locked
description: The Actual field on the Metrics object is now locked from editing directly for studies with the Metrics Calculation value of 'Date Based.'  Updates to the Actual field are made via changes to the underlying Subject data.

application: CTMS, Clinical Operations - All, Veeva Clinical Network
feature: CTMS Transfer: Deletion in Source
description: If a previously transferred record was deleted in the Source Vault, CTMS Transfer will now update the Target record to reflect this deletion.

application: CTMS, Site Connect, Study Startup, eTMF
feature: eSignature in Site Connect
description: Sites can complete a standard eSignature workflow to complete Update & Return document actions in Document Exchange.

application: CTMS, Site Connect, Study Startup, Vault Payments, eTMF
feature: 24R2 Clinical Operations Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality. The data model changes included in this feature also cover the Site Connect application.

feature: Recalculate Completeness Metrics Action on Milestone
description: This action allows users to initiate the recalculation of a milestone's completeness metrics. This is recommended to be used in cases where the milestone is already closed but for some reason the completeness metrics are not accurately reflected.

feature: Recurring Milestone Schedule Automate Date Update
description: When a recurring milestone schedule becomes active, this feature will automatically set the "Next Create Date" which will indicate when the next recurring milestone will be created.

application: CTMS, Study Startup, Study Training, Vault Payments, eTMF
feature: Study Person Responsibilities
description: Clinical Operations Vaults now include a set of standard Responsibilities. These Responsibilities can be assigned to Persons for a study.  Study Person Responsibilities support enhanced Study Training capabilities

feature: Repeating Visit Management
description: With this release, Vault CTMS customers can now define Visit Groups and the corresponding repeat information for use in repeating visits, e.g. Treatment Cycles or Follow Up visits.  This information can also be tracked on corresponding Subject Visits and seeded into Monitored Visits  Additionally, Vault Payments customers can specify Fees and Fee Templates for the specific repeat instances allowing for differing payment rates for the individual vists.

feature: eConsent: Send to Site Action
description: With this feature, eConsent will have its own proprietary objects and action for tracking and distributing eConsents to connected study sites. The new "eConsent Send to Sites" action will need to be configured in place of the existing "Send Documents via Clinical Network" action for all document types associated with the Informed Consent Form VCD artifact and Veeva eConsent enabled. All study sites with active Agreements will remain "connected" after the release.   To connect new sites or send eConsents after the release, the new action and related configuration changes are necessary.  The new eConsent Study Site Acceptance and eConsent Send Records will replace Study Invitations, Agreements, and Distribution Tasks and related lifecycles(refer to Connected Study Invitations Deprecated) for all eConsent enabled studies. Entry actions, notifications, user actions and workflow actions created for Agreements and Distribution Tasks will need to reference eConsent Study Site Acceptances and eConsent Send Records respectively.

feature: Simplified Model Training
description: This feature simplifies model training by removing editable advanced model parameters, prediction confidence threshold, minimum documents per document type, and training window start date. Instead, those settings will be standardized in the model training.  It is auto-on and will be visible when admins create and train a new trained model.

feature: TMF Bot Enhanced Prediction Metrics
description: The feature enhances the TMF Bot to calculate Prediction Metrics for Study Country and Site metadata extraction. It also enhances accuracy measurements in Trained Model Performance Metrics and Prediction Metrics to increase the consistency and precision of accuracy measurements.  It is auto-on in Vaults with a deployed Metadata Extraction model.

feature: Metadata Extraction Generally Available
description: This feature removes the requirement for Support enablement Metadata Extraction. Instead, customers will be able to create, test, and deploy Metadata Extraction models in any Clinical Vault.

feature: Country & Site Check in Document QC Step
description: The feature enhances the TMF Bot to add Study Country and Site metadata checks to the document QC step.  It is auto-on in Vaults that have a deployed Metadata Extraction model, and which have configured the TMF Bot QC step as part of a document workflow. In other Vaults, it must be enabled by configuration.

feature: Study Announcements Section for Sites
description: Site Connect customers can post announcements such as news and trial deadlines in Site Connect. Posts will be visible to site users in Site Connect and sent to sites as email notifications once they have been published by the Sponsor/CRO.

feature: Bulk Document Download in Site Connect Site Home
description: Users in Site Connect Site Home will be able to select and download multiple documents within the Document Exchange, Safety Distribution, and End-of-Study Media sections. Bulk downloads are consolidated into a ZIP file containing the documents that were selected for download.

feature: Study Protocol Link
description: An easy accessible "Study Protocol" link is now available to Sites in Site Connect. This link will display the most recent version of the Protocol that was sent to the specific site accessing it.

feature: End-of-Study Media Section for Sites
description: A new section in Site Connect to display End-of-Study-Media documents (e.g. CRFs) that have been sent to the site. Site Users can view and download these documents just like they can in the Document Exchange section.

feature: Study Admin Section for Sites
description: This feature introduces a Study Admin section within Site Connect Site Home. These settings are controlled by Site Users on each Study. Also includes Site ability to add/request additional Site Users for a given Study.

feature: Study Contacts Section for Sites
description: Site Connect customers can now add key names, roles, and contact info and comments for Sponsor/CRO personnel associated to the study, study country, or site. Contact info is sourced from  the Global Directory or entered manually. These Study Contacts are then visible to Site Users in the Study Contacts section of Site Connect Site Home.

feature: Study Information Section for Sites
description: A new section within Site Connect Site Home that that displays a set of standard fields describing the study in a way suited to sites. For example, Study Name, Protocol Title, Masking, Study Phase, and Study Products.

feature: Self-Service Site Access
description: With this feature, Site Users will be able to manage Site Users within Site Connect for their Study Site. Site users can add site users to a study through a self-service site access feature. This includes the ability to remove access. A Sponsor can turn off self-service access at the Vault level. If a Sponsor/CRO turns it off, they will instead receive a task and notification to provide access to the email address that was entered using self-service access.

feature: Add Site Personnel into Site Connect
description: With this feature, the Sponsors/CROs can enable the Site Connect User field on Study Site Persons to give them access to Site Connect and invite them into the Study. Tracking around email invitations and access start/end dates is also provided.

feature: File to SiteVault & Upload from SiteVault in Site Home
description: Sites that have connected their SiteVault in Site Connect Site Home have the ability to File documents to and Upload documents from SiteVault. These actions can also be taken in bulk.

feature: Site-driven Connect to SiteVault
description: Site Users within Site Connect Site Home will have the ability to connect their SiteVault for a given Study using a new "Connect to SiteVault" button. After connecting, they are able to use enhanced functionality such as 'File to SiteVault' and 'Upload from SiteVault' document user actions. Additionally, any site that was using SiteVault on a Connected Study prior to the 24R2 release will automatically be connected after the 24R2 release.

feature: Study Selector in Site Home
description: The Study Selector within Site Connect Site Home allows users to navigate between the different Study Sites they have been added to. The selector also provides search functionality for users with access to many Studies and Study Sites.

feature: Allow Sponsor/CRO to Exchange Documents with SiteVault
description: Connected Sites, those that have connected to SiteVault, can give their Sponsor/CRO permission to exchange documents with SiteVault. Once a Site User enables this permission in the Settings tab of the Study Admin section of Site Home, Sponsor/CRO users with access to Site Home will be able to use the 'File to SiteVault' and 'Upload from SiteVault' user actions.

feature: Site Connect Site Users in Clinical Operations
description: With this feature, the site experience of Site Connect moves into Clinical Operations. Site Users now log in to Clinical Operations complete Document Exchange and Safety Distribution.

feature: Standardized Safety Distribution Email Template
description: With this update, a new standardized email format will be used for Safety Distributions. The Safety Distribution Email Notification (safety_distribution_email__v) will no longer be used. The new standard email format will contain the same details and document links for site recipients to access the safety documents. This update will allow Site personnel to have a consistent experience across all Sponsors/CROs using Site Connect Safety Distribution.

feature: Document Exchange for All Sites
description: With this feature, Site Connect customers can now send documents to all sites. The send to sites document/expected document actions and the Send Site Packages action will now work with all study sites on Studies with Document Exchange in the Connected Study Type field. All Site Connect Site Users will receive email notifications containing document request details and document links that allow them to quickly access the documents that were sent.

feature: eSignatures from SiteVault Viewable in Document Viewer
description: Signature pages for eSigned documents uploaded from SiteVault to Vault Clinical will now be visible in the Vault Clinical document viewer. With this change comes an update to the Site Rendition behavior. The Site Rendition will now be the rendition (Viewable Rendition + eSignature page if present) being sent to the site rather than the rendition received from the Site.

feature: Connected Study Invitations Deprecated
description: Connected Study Invitations/Agreements (cdx_agreement__v) will no longer be used by Site Connect. Existing records will be moved into the Deactivated lifecycle state. Any study site that was previously "Connected" with an Active Connected Study Invitations/Agreement will remain "Connected" after the release. These sites will have a corresponding Site Connect Study Site Settings record in the Active & Connected lifecycle state. Additionally, existing entry actions, user actions, and workflow actions to send Connected Study Invitations will no longer create new agreement records.

feature: Clinical Workflow Context
description: This feature adds ability to view workflows in the Milestone Workspace which have been started on Expected Document Items and Documents from the Milestone Workspace.

feature: Milestone Workspace View Enhancements
description: Enables the option to save views for object data grids in the Milestone Workspace.

feature: Portals: Documents Added to Portal on Behalf of System
description: Users without document field edit permissions can add documents to portal widgets. The edit to the document fields is done as System on behalf of the user. This will be reflected in the Audit Trail.  This change to update document fields as system is intended to improve the management of portals.

feature: Harvesting Claims
description: Extract text and references from document link annotations as well as document metadata from promotional materials to populate Claim records. Qualified harvested Claims will be placed directly into approved state, ready to use for Auto-Linking.

feature: Modular Content: Create a Local Copy
description: Vault PromoMats now supports the ability to create local copies of Content Modules and referenced assets. This functionality allows local affiliates to quickly adapt Content Modules to their local market.

feature: Modular Content HTML Previews: CRM Email Modules
description: It is now possible to generate HTML previews for CRM Email modules in PromoMats. This allows users to preview CRM Email builder content in PromoMats, prior to configuring in CRM.

feature: Commercial Content Taxonomy for Life Sciences
description: Standard document types and subtypes were added to PromoMats Vaults in the inactive state.

feature: Text Asset Reason for Copy
description: Enable user to select a Reason for Copy when copying a Text Asset. Must upload Reason for Copy standard records with provided Vault Loader sheet. Admin can configure Reason for Copy to be required using Page Layout.

feature: eCTD: Change Material State on Submission
description: A new entry action on the Submission Ready Lifecycle can update the state of the eCTD Source to the selected state type. The action will only apply to submission ready copies where the system-managed field Main Promotional Material? field is equal to Yes

feature: Modular Content: Commenting for MLR
description: The modular content UI now supports commenting to enable review and approval of content modules.

feature: Portals: Enhancements to Document Card
description: Enhancements have been made to document cards on the Portals homepage allowing a user to find more information on a document quicker.

feature: Multichannel: New Email Preview Formats
description: With this release, we’re making updates to include more current email formats for you to use when previewing Approved Email content prior to publishing them to field teams. Older email formats and clients will be removed with this update.

feature: Portals: Update to Portal Tab Visibility
description: Prior to this release, if a user had access to the Portals Tab but no portals existed, the tab was hidden. With this release tab visibility will be based solely on the user permissions, meaning they will still see the tab in the instance they have been given access to but no portals exist.

feature: Modular Content: UI Improvements
description: In this enhancement we made some usability improvements to the Modular Content UI, including surfacing the content module details on the user interface.

feature: 24R2 Commercial Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Portals: Documents Added to Portal on Behalf of System
description: Users without document field edit permissions can add documents to portal widgets. The edit to the document fields is done as System on behalf of the user. This will be reflected in the Audit Trail.  This change to update document fields as system is intended to improve the management of portals.

feature: Scientific Communication Platforms
description: The Scientific Communication Platform defines the scientific statements, position, narrative, objectives, and core medical messages for products or therapeutic areas. These serve as the foundation for organising medical communication activities.

feature: Multichannel: New Email Preview Formats
description: With this release, we’re making updates to include more current email formats for you to use when previewing Approved Email content prior to publishing them to field teams. Older email formats and clients will be removed with this update.

feature: Portals: Update to Portal Tab Visibility
description: Prior to this release, if a user had access to the Portals Tab but no portals existed, the tab was hidden. With this release tab visibility will be based solely on the user permissions, meaning they will still see the tab in the instance they have been given access to but no portals exist.

feature: Portals: Enhancements to Document Card
description: Enhancements have been made to document cards on the Portals homepage allowing a user to find more information on a document quicker.

feature: 24R2 Medical Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Telephony Support: Embedded Call Controls
description: This feature enables users to answer inbound phone calls within Vault. Users may speed up the inquiry intake process with a screen pop that redirects them to the Case Intake UI.

feature: Capture Multiple Reactions & Products Under Events
description: New Event Product and Event Reaction objects. If configured as active, E2B(R3) reports will then generate with product and event/reaction information from these new objects.

feature: CC & BCC: Usability Enhancements & Automatically Add Recipients
description: This feature will enhance how CC and BCC recipients are added to Case Response Emails.  There are two parts: •	A new UI component to make adding CC or BCC recipients simpler, without needing to go manually create join objects •	An action to automatically create a CC or BCC.  This could copy in the same person each time, or it could be used to dynamically reference a different person.  This supports an email address in a field, for example one pulled from CRM

feature: MedInquiry Keyword Tracking
description: This feature identifies Keywords from Case Requests in MedInquiry  This yields quantifiable insights that can be used to drive new content creation, based on the requests for medical information they are receiving.  This is difficult to do from today from the unstructured text of the request details.

feature: Respond to Multiple Requests in One Response
description: When HCPs submit medical inquiries, they may ask more than one question and require that the response be sent via email. Instead of sending one email per response, which could amount to many emails, users may now bundle many responses into one fulfillment email. The fulfillment includes links to each individual response.

feature: CRM Data Sharing: Error Handling Enhancements
description: The CRM data sharing integration has been updated to better support error handling and resolution.  New Last Update from CRM and Last Sync to CRM fields have been added to the Case to record the last update time from the Inquiry Pull and Inquiry Push jobs respectively. When there is a partial failure for the Account Pull or Inquiry Pull jobs, now the job status will be "Errors Encountered" and the Last Successful Run Time will not be updated (previously "Success" status and Last Successful Run Time was updated).  For Account Pull, Inquiry Pull, and Inquiry Push jobs running for multiple CRM orgs, a org failure will cause the job to skip the org and continue to the next org (previously an org failure would stop the job).

feature: Follow Up Events Received in Medical
description: When the new Follow Up? field on Event is configured and set to Yes, the standard Copy Record action on the Event will also populate the new Source Case and Source Event fields when creating the copied record. The new Create Event Follow Up action can be configured on the Case and will populate the Follow Up?, Source Case, and Source Event fields when copying the selected Event record.

feature: Static Values for On Behalf Of User
description: This feature ensures that new On Behalf of User values remain static in the Document and Object audit logs even when users change their name.

feature: Improved Search Behavior for Email Suppression List
description: In the Email Suppression List, admins can now search for values in the Name and Suppression Reason columns.

feature: Support for Hyphens in Picklist Entry Values
description: The supported character set for picklist entry values has been expanded to support the use of hyphens.  Post this change the supported character set is as follows:  a-z, 0-9, a single sequential '_' or '-', and cannot begin or end with an '_' or '-'

feature: Hide Inactive Fields from Object Search
description: To provide a consistent experience with document search, inactive fields are no longer available as filters or for text search when searching for object records.

feature: Wildcard Limits in Search
description: Limits searches to 2 wildcards per term and a max of 10 terms can contain a wildcard.

feature: What's New General Release Notification: Mark as Read
description: Users will now be able to mark as read the What's New notification that is displayed with each General Release. Once marked as read, the notification will begin to move down the list as other notifications are received.

feature: Keyboard Shortcuts
description: New keyboard shortcuts have been implemented for List pages, Record Detail Pages, and the Global Header. On any page, you can use the new key combination Ctrl + / to bring up a list of available keyboard shortcuts for the current page.

feature: Data Grid Freeze Line Design Changes
description: When using a grid view (either on an object tab or in the Library), we have enhanced the user experience in a couple of ways: 1) When freezing columns, the line indicating which column is frozen will be gray rather than blue, and 2) When moving columns via drag-and-drop or moving the freeze line, Vault now shows a dotted gray line rather than a dotted blue line.

feature: Improved Color Contrast
description: Several updates have been made to the Vault user interface to enhance color contrast and improve clarity and visibility. These changes aim to provide a more visually distinct and user-friendly experience.

feature: Update Select All & Clear Selected Behavior in Column Header Filters
description: This is a small usability improvement to the way filter values are selected in column header filters. When users are looking up filter values by name, they will see updated options to "Select All", or "Clear Selected".

feature: English Language Default for Help Links
description: Learn More links from Vault now route users with Japanese or Chinese-language Vaults to English-language documentation, where options for translated documentation are visible if available.

feature: Document Logos in Branding Settings
description: Administrators with edit permissions for Branding Settings can upload an image as a primary logo and/or a secondary logo within Document Logos, which will be used in select Vault documents. These options will be used in conjunction with the Print Record feature, and in a future release, these will be able to be leveraged in Overlay and Signature Page templates.

feature: Configuration Migration: Remove Document Type Filter Warning
description: When using Configuration Migration Packages, Admins will no longer receive a warning when the package contains doc types with filters applied (that are not applied to the subtypes or classifications within). When leveraging configuration reports, document fields and picklists will no longer show certain uneditable attributes.

feature: Improved Usability of Rendition Status for Admins
description: Additional fields, including Rendition Profile and Viewable Rendition Type (System Generated or Manual), have been made available to add as columns on the Admin > Operations > Rendition Status page. These columns can be sorted in the grid and all fields are now available as filters.

feature: VeevaID Login Support for Vault File Manager
description: VeevaID users will now be able to login to Vault File Manager to be able to perform typical functions such as check-out, download, and check-in to support document editing.

feature: Allow Fields & Relationships to Be Copied for Large Documents
description: Users can now make copies of documents where the source file is over 4 GB, but Vault will only copy the fields and relationships, and not the large source file.

feature: Apply Filters to Annotation Exports
description: This feature enables users to apply current filters to all annotation export actions including PDF with Annotations, Export Annotations and Download Notes.

feature: Saved Page Rotation
description: After rotating pages in the Document Viewer, users with the appropriate permission can save that rotation, which applies to any user when viewing the document, or downloading the Viewable Rendition.

feature: Send as Link: Limit Number of Recipients
description: When using the Send as Link function, Vault will now limit the number of recipients in a single action to less than 1000. This count is based on the number of recipients across users, groups or external email addresses that are added.

feature: Select Anchor & Permalink Improvements
description: When leveraging the Select or Create Anchor option in the Select Anchors dialog box: the mini-browser that opens will now automatically filter only on Anchors, the Select Targets dialog box (for Permalink annotations) will now include a Recent Targets view, and Vault will also now remember a user's last used view for the Select Targets dialog box.

feature: Filter Annotations By Keyword and New vs Brought-Forward
description: Users can now also filter annotations by keywords, or by whether they are new to this document version or brought forward from a previous version. In addition, there is a new Reset all option to clear all selected filters.

feature: Viewer & Annotations Usability Improvements
description: A number of usability improvements have been added to the doc viewer, including a keyboard shortcut to save annotations (CTRL+Enter / CMD+Enter), a more responsive video player size, a larger default size for mini-browsers, better visual differentiation of Approved versus Auto Link annotations, and more.

feature: Optimized Renditions for PDF Merge Use Cases
description: Vault optimizes downloadable renditions in  Content Plan Section and Content Plan Item Merge, and other features where multiple PDFs are being merged into one. It will now eliminate duplicate fonts, images, and other elements, producing a smaller PDF file.

feature: Standardized Undo Checkout Permissions
description: Permissions required to undo an existing document checkout are updated to be consistent across all checkout types. Users will need to have Edit Document permissions as well as one of the following: Have the Document Owner role, have the All Document Actions permission, or have the Cancel Checkout permission.

feature: Improved OCR for Images
description: Vault’s Optical Character Recognition (OCR) functionality has been improved to better detect text from images, resulting in more recognized text that can be used with other Vault features. This enhancement was previously available in Commercial Vaults and will now be applied to all Vaults.

feature: Improved Directory Upload to File Staging in Vault File Manager
description: When uploading a single directory or multiple directory to File Staging with Vault File Manager, Vault File Manager will now show the upload progress of each file within the directories, allowing users to more easily identify and address errors.

feature: Clearer Reclassification Warning
description: When reclassifying documents that are matched to binders via autofiling, Vault will now display a clearer message to users indicating that the binder relationship may change: “Binder autofiling rules based on a document type may no longer be applied.”

feature: Clearer Error Handling when Reclassifying Documents Under Legal Hold
description: Users will now see a clearer message on why the reclassification is not allowed on a document under Legal Hold: “Cannot reclassify document : Document is associated with one or more approved Legal Holds.” The Reclassify link would only be seen on a document under Legal Hold if the Legal Hold is applied and the page is not refreshed.

feature: Error Message When Adding a Duplicate Document to a Binder Section
