description: Stability Study enhancements: prompting for a name when generating a Lab Study from a Lab Study design, usability improvements for the Study Overview pages, updated logic for reevaluate criteria on time zero Spec Execution records using Results Spec Execution, and additional standard fields on Stability Spec Execution.

feature: Track Previously Completed on Test Steps
description: A lab test step's Complete field switches from True to False when a user makes a change to a result or input. This feature will add a system-populated field to clearly track if the step was previously completed. This feature also includes data migration to set the Previously Completed field on Test Steps in existing LIMS Vaults.

feature: Track Change Analysis Merging
description: This feature allows Admins to block users from merging a change analysis when it has already been merged.

feature: Additional Test Execution User Interface (UI) Enhancements
description: Additional updates to the LIMS test execution UI including enhanced keyboard navigation.

feature: Auto-Generated Default Values for Copied Statements
description: Source Statement automatically populates with value for copied record. Provisioned Reason for Copy with pre-generated list of values via new standard object controlled_vocabulary__sys.

feature: Auto-Populate CRM Slide Notes
description: This feature will automatically populate the CRM Slide Notes field in PromoMats Vaults when using a Power Point (.PPTX) source file as the original document to generate a multi-slide presentation with the Create Presentation feature.

feature: Content Modules UI for CRM Emails
description: Vault Medical now supports an intuitive user interface for building out CRM Email Modules. With this update, users have the ability to comment directly on the content module UI.

feature: 24R3 Medical Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Created From Relationship Type
description: We added a new relationship type called Created From. When copies are created, the original document is captured in Created From. This is similar to the Based On relationship, but the benefit of Created From is you can also add to it via the UI and the API.

feature: Attribute Fulfillment Document Views & Downloads to Case Responses
description: This feature tracks external views and downloads of Fulfillment Documents. Each time a Response Document Link is opened externally and the Fulfillment Documents in it are viewed or downloaded, this will be tracked. There are two primary drivers for the feature: to allow MedInquiry users to see that the recipient has viewed the document that was sent in the response package, and to allow customers to accurately report on views of content externally.

feature: Medical Inquiry Keyword Tracking: Cleanup Job & Reprocess Job
description: This feature enhances the Medical Inquiry Keywords feature by adding two new jobs. The first is a cleanup job that deletes Keywords from Case Requests that are over three years old. The second is a reprocess job that deletes a Keyword from a Case Request if the Keyword Variation record that was used to match to the Case Request has been deleted.

feature: Telephony Support: Conversations
description: When a phone call or live chat is accepted in Vault, users are redirected to the Case Intake UI where Case Contact and Case information is pre-populated with data from the telephony provider. The call or live chat is also logged in Vault and includes a link to the telephony provider's call record.

feature: Enhanced Fulfillment Document Picker
description: An enhanced Fulfillment Document Picker has been added. This shows the Fulfillment Documents in the response package in a more intuitive way, and allows the user to add multiple documents in one go.

feature: Medical Standard Checkbox Defaulting
description: This feature adds defaulting logic to standard fields that were initially provisioned as checkboxes (Yes/No fields with the "Show as checkbox" option enabled). Fields with existing defaulting behavior are not updated by this change, nor are standard Yes/No fields that were later updated to checkboxes.

feature: Limit Number of Fulfillment Documents per Case Response to 100
description: This feature limits the number of fulfillment documents to 100 per Case Response.

feature: Fulfillment Documents on a Case Response Must Be Unique
description: MedInquiry will prevent users from adding duplicate fulfillment documents to a Case Response. They will see an error if they try to do so. In addition, when the Generate Response Package or Generate Preview Response Package action is run, Vault will validate that documents included in the package are unique. If they are not, the action will fail.

feature: Show Previous Cases at Intake
description: In the Medical Inquiry User Interface (during Case intake), once a Case Contact is selected MedInquiry will show the Contact's previous cases, should any exist.

feature: Tag Fulfillment Document Records That Originate From a Standard Response
description: If a Fulfillment Document is automatically added from a Standard Response, the Fulfillment Document will be tagged as a Standard Response Document.

feature: Add Standard Fulfillment Documents Action Does Not Add Duplicate Documents
description: If a document has already been added to a Case Response as a Fulfillment Document, it is not re-added when the Add Standard Response Fulfillment Documents action is run.

feature: Medical Inquiry User Interface: Display Field Updates from Create Record Actions
description: If field updates are defined in the Create Record action of a lifecycle of an object shown in the Medical Inquiry UI, those updates will be reflected in the Medical Inquiry UI on save.

feature: Opt-Out Setting for Future Summary Email Enhancements
description: A checkbox is available on the General Settings page for a 25R1 upgrade that summarizes emails and displays notification fields on the User Profile page. This checkbox is enabled by default to reduce notification frequency and allow users to set email preferences for system notification categories. If disabled, the upgrade will be deferred to 25R2.

feature: Strict Matching Adjustments
description: This feature includes adjustments that slightly loosen the rules of strict matching to return more results for multi-term searches.

feature: Improved Search Results for ID Patterns
description: This feature extends the existing ID pattern matching to all search terms. Any search term that contains a combination of letters, numbers, and punctuation will be searched as a phrase.

feature: Improved Date Field Entry
description: When typing in a date, Vault now understands various date formats, and will automatically convert the date based on the user's locale. All Date and Date/Time fields will display based on the locale for each user and all Vaults. The existing checkbox setting, Format dates and times based on the user’s locale, will be removed from all Vaults.

feature: Email to Vault: Email Size Limit Increase
description: When using Email to Vault functionality, Vault now supports emails up to 40 MB in size, increased from a prior limit of 30 MB.

feature: Archive Notifications After 3 Months
description: Notifications sent from Vault are now archived after 3 months instead of 2 years. This affects the All Notifications page and the Email Notification Status Admin page, where the full notification history can still be exported through a user action.

feature: File Staging Linking
description: Admins will now be able to update a Vault's File Staging server to point to a different Vault without needing to rely on Product Support.

feature: Entry Action: Delete Annotation Comments on Latest Version
description: A new Lifecycle State Entry Action, Delete annotation comments on latest version, is available that will delete comment annotations and document-level comments from the latest version only.

feature: Vault File Manager: File Staging Download Improvements
description: When using Vault File Manager to download content from File Staging, the following enhancements will help reduce potential issues that may occur with longer file paths: a new tooltip on status when file path is too long for Windows, and a shorter download folder name so that there is a reduced risk of running into the Windows file path limit.

feature: Name Support in Vault Loader & Documents APIs
description: This feature updates Vault Loader and Documents APIs to support Name as an input.

feature: Persistent ID for Annotations
description: Vault now automatically creates a unique Persistent ID for all new annotations and existing annotations that are either updated or brought forward after the release. This ID persists across versions when annotations are brought forward. Users will be able to see the ID in the Anchor info card as well as in the Select Anchors dialog box.

feature: Simplified Document Viewer Toolbar
description: The Document Viewer has been simplified and optimized, moving all tools and options to a single-line toolbar. The annotations filter is now directly above the annotations, embedded links are now always clickable, the Notes view and Overlay mode have been deprecated, and the viewer only defaults to annotate mode if there are annotations.

feature: External Viewer: Enable Download Source When No Rendition is Available
description: Users can now download source for documents that do not have a viewable rendition when using the External Viewer, if the document allows source downloading.

feature: Support for XLSM Files in Collaborative Authoring
description: .XLSM files can now be edited with Collaborative Authoring. *Auto-On in Vaults with Collaborative Authoring enabled.

feature: User with Annotate Permission Can Delete Brought Forward Annotations
description: Users with Annotate permission can delete any brought forward annotation except referenced anchors. This is an update to clarify validation documentation only and does not affect Vault behavior.

feature: Linked Documents Usability Improvements
description: With this feature, Vault always deletes Linked Document relationships when the associated link annotations are deleted, and relationship attributes are always displayed in the Linked Documents section.

feature: Migrate Document Usage Object to Raw Object
description: The Document Usage object will be migrated from a standard object to a Raw Object. As a Raw Object, any filters that are applied on Document Usage records will need to be case sensitive, and searching in the Business Admin menu will apply to Name only.

feature: Legal Hold Search Dialog: Updated User Interface
description: The dialog boxes that appear for users when using Apply Legal Hold or Edit Legal Hold will have a slightly updated user interface to be more consistent with other dialog boxes in Vault. * Auto-on in Vaults with Legal Hold enabled.

feature: Always Display Source Vault Name for Crosslink Documents
description: Users will now always see the name of the Source Vault in the CrossLink's metadata, regardless of whether or not they have access to that Vault. *Auto-On in Vaults using CrossLinks.

feature: 24R3 Platform Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Add Annotation ID to Link Target Object
description: The Link Target object now contains a new Annotation ID field to support integrations that create Link Targets. By populating this field, either on creation or update, Vault will automatically set Anchor ID, Anchor Title, Anchor Page, and Reference. This feature primarily impacts Commercial Vaults using Auto-Claims Linking.

feature: Workflow Tasks Prompt for Participants
description: Workflow Tasks can be configured to prompt the Task Owner to add Workflow Participants.

feature: Workflow Uses User Reference Fields as Participants
description: You can now configure workflow participants to automatically populate from a specified user reference field on the object or document (the workflow initiator does not see this workflow participant group upon starting the workflow, making it ideal for auto-start workflows).

feature: Workflow Uses Groups as Participants
description: You can now configure workflow participants to automatically populate from a specified User Group (the workflow initiator does not see this workflow participant group upon starting the workflow, making it ideal for auto-start workflows).

feature: Formula Support in Lifecycle & Workflow Conditions & Entry Criteria Validation
description: Formulas can now be used when defining conditions in workflow action steps, workflow decision steps, lifecycle state entry actions and entry criteria. For entry criteria specifically, a formula can be used as the condition type, and also as the thing being validated itself (which also allows a custom validation message to be defined).

feature: Specific Document Version Fields Supported in Change Related Object Lifecycle State Action
description: The Change Related Object Lifecycle State entry action for document lifecycles now also supports document reference object fields that are configured as "specific version."

feature: Required & Read-only Field in Layout Configuration
description: Admins can indicate a field to be displayed as required or read-only on a Record Details Page layout. The field is only displayed as required or read-only on that specific layout.

feature: Object Type Descriptions
description: Admins can now add descriptions to Object Types during configuration. The descriptions are are visible to Admins only.

feature: Reference Images in Checklist Questions
description: Admins can embed reference images in checklist questions or multiple choice answer options so that checklist respondents can easily view these images while completing a checklist. Reference images can be added to library questions. Admins can also add a translated version of a reference image to support translated checklists.

feature: Attachment Fields
description: Attachment fields let users attach a single file up to 100MB to a field embedded within the object record. Like other object fields, they can be used in Layout Rules, Validation Rules, Formulas, Criteria VQL, and so on. Admins can create up to 15 per object.

feature: Field Subtypes
description: This feature adds new object field subtypes for Text (Time, Email, Link, Phone) and Number (Percent). Field subtypes have a special UI to make data entry easier and have automatic formatting. Formulas can now return time values. When adding fields to objects, the Admin UI has been updated to make field type selection more clear.

feature: Record Migration Mode Enhancements
description: Migration Mode has been simplified to only perform basic checks for migrated data including field type and length. Migrators can also disable standard and custom triggers with a new API header.

feature: User-Person Sync Enhancements
description: When User-to-Person Sync occurs, Vault now creates or edits a Prior Person record, containing the sync-eligible Person field values before the update. Admins can edit sync-eligible fields on Person records associated with Cross-Domain or VeevaID users. However, the Person-to-User Sync never updates User records of Cross-Domain or VeevaID users.

feature: Yes/No Checkbox Field Enhancement
description: Yes/No object fields using the Show as Checkbox option (checkbox fields) can be null. Previously, only True or False was supported. All custom checkbox fields without default values today will be set to False as part of the release. Existing formulas, VQL, sharing rules, reports, and so on should be reviewed. The recommended logic is "equals true" or "does not equal true".

feature: Print Record Enhancements
description: The PDF generated by the Print Record Download as PDF action will now include the Workflow Timeline section and total page count in the footer.

feature: Migrate Vault Component to Raw Object
description: To support the generation of better configuration reports, comparison reports, and VPKs, we have changed Vault Component (vault_component__v) to a Raw object, which results in better performance for operations using this object. Note that Raw objects do not support generic text search, so users must now add filters before adding search terms.

feature: Report Cloning Enhancements
description: This feature improves the Admin experience by leveraging the Name (name__v) values rather than IDs of objects referenced by reports when creating reports through a cloning process, such as creating a new sandbox.

feature: Tab for Individual Dashboard
description: Admins can now set specific dashboards to be standalone tabs in Vault, and manage them the same as any other tab in Vault. A dashboard tab cannot be the user's landing tab.

feature: Picklist Enhancements in Formulas
description: This feature introduces the PicklistValues function which can return picklist values that include a hyphen (-). It also has the ability to return multiple values. Currently, picklists are unable to accept multiple values passed by formulas.

feature: Document Formula Fields Limited to Status & State Type
description: When using the following document formula field functions, only the Document Status and Document State Type fields will be supported for new formula fields: DurationInValue(), NumTimesInValue(), FirstTimeInValue(), LastTimeInValue(), and PreviousValue().

feature: Custom Flash Report Notification
description: Users that schedule flash reports can now customize the email notifications for each flash report, using a combination of free text, HTML tags, and report tokens. If using the Send to users in Group By user field option, users can also choose to not send the flash report to users manually added to the Sharing Settings.

feature: Reduce Dashboard Cache & Display Last Updated Time
description: The Dashboard cache time has been reduced from 36 hours to 12 hours, and Dashboard components now display the last updated time on each chart.

feature: Process Reporting
description: This feature allows customers to report on lifecycle state information directly in reports using new functions available in report formula fields.

feature: Task Exclusion in Multi-pass Workflow Reports
description: When using multi-pass reports that contain Workflow report views, Vault will now only show multiple rows per workflow if a Task column is included in the report or if the multi-pass report type is using a Task column to join views.

feature: Predictable Report Width
description: The report width will now be limited to 100 columns instead of the prior limit of 21,884 characters per row. This significantly improves the report's usability as the report result is not run-time dependent.

feature: Improved Color Contrast in Dashboards
description: The Dashboard interface has been enhanced to improve color contrast, clarity, and visibility. These changes aim to provide a more visually distinct and user-friendly experience.

feature: Enforce Password Validation on Password Reset from Login Screen
description: When entering a new password in the reset password flow initiated from the Vault login page, Vault validates the password and returns an error if non-supported characters are included. A list of supported characters for password is displayed when the validation fails.

feature: Enforce Password Validation on Password Reset from User Profile
description: When a user enters a new password, Vault now validates the password and returns an error if unsupported characters are included. Vault also displays a list of supported characters as part of the error message. This feature is only available in pre-release Vaults for password resets initiated from the User Profile page.

feature: End VeevaID Session With Vault Log Out
description: When VeevaID users choose to log out of Vault, this will now log them out of both Vault and VeevaID.

feature: Vault Time for Jobs
description: Scheduled jobs will now be using Vault's time zone, also known as Vault Time. This reduces confusion and improves consistency by ensuring all background operations are using Vault Time.

feature: Admin About Tab for Vault & Domain Information
description: The Vault and Domain Information sections in the Admin Settings tab (including license, API, and data usage information) are now viewable in a new 'About' tab in Admin.

feature: System Managed Objects Toggle for Data Usage Information
description: The Data Usage Information table (which is now in a new 'About' tab in Admin) now hides system-managed objects by default. Admins can toggle this to display system-managed object information.

feature: Vault Loader Record Migration Mode Enhancements
description: Record Migration Mode has been enhanced with a No Triggers setting to allow Vault Loader users to create and update object records, bypassing all business rules including triggers. Record Migration Mode has also been enhanced to allow users to set all fields on an object, including system fields like ID, Created Date, Created By, Modified Date, and Modified By.

feature: Disable Audit Trail on User Exception Messages & User Exception Items
description: User Exceptions Message and User Exception Items objects are no longer audited for record changes. These objects are used for information purposes to aid in integration management.

feature: Vault Loader CLI Java 17 Support
description: In order to use the latest version of the Vault Loader CLI, developers will need to make sure that Java 17 is available in the environment.

feature: Release Warning on Sandbox Vaults Page
description: With this feature, a UI warning is shown in the Sandbox UI to Vault Admins while a Vault update is under way.

feature: Remove System Audit of Vault Loader Actions
description: Vault Loader events are no longer recorded in System Audit History. The corresponding updates to object records and documents are still being recorded in Object Record Audit History and Document Audit History, respectively.

feature: Scheduled Data Export Maximum Object Limit
description: By default, Scheduled Data Export will have a maximum object limit of 30 on Vaults that are not using SDE. Any existing Vaults with Scheduled Data Export already running will not have this limit.

feature: SDK Profiler: Request Summary
description: This feature allows developers to inspect SDK requests and the total memory and elapsed time used.

feature: Custom WebAPI
description: Customers can create custom API endpoints using Java SDK. Custom APIs accept JSON or form data with a single binary content file and return response status and either JSON or binary content.

feature: Java 17 for Vault Java SDK: Optional Enablement
description: Over the next several releases, Veeva is upgrading the Vault Java SDK to Java 17 to allow developers to take advantage of the upgrades that come with the new version. In addition to new features, Java 17 includes optimizations that can improve performance and efficiency compared to Java 8, allowing for reduced resource usage.  In this release, developers and Admins can optionally enable Java 17 for Vault Java SDK to test their custom code for compatibility with the new Java version.

feature: VQL Date Literals
description: Date literals allow developers to query for data using keywords to represent dates.

feature: Client Credential Support for HttpService
description: This feature allows developers to configure a Client ID and Client Secret for use with Http Callout.

feature: Favorite a Document
description: Users can now select and unselect documents as Favorites within the Vault Mobile app. Additionally, users can access their Favorites view within the Library tab on Vault Mobile.

feature: Site Selector Support (SiteVault)
description: SiteVault users can now view and change their site within the Vault Mobile app. A new site selector list will be available at the top of each mobile tab, which will filter the results to that specific site. This provides a more consistent user experience between the mobile app and the web browser for SiteVault.

feature: Show Timeline View
description: Users can now see the Timeline View for a given document via the Vault Mobile app. This will allow them to see the history of the document, as well as view any outstanding or completed task verdicts if the document is part of a workflow.

feature: Open Binders in Web
description: Users that attempt to access a binder in the Vault Mobile app will now see a link that will directly open the binder in their mobile browser.

feature: Blur Content when App is in Background
description: When a user switches to a different app and Vault Mobile is placed in the device background, the mobile app's content will be blocked when backgrounded to ensure no content is visible until the app has been opened again.

feature: Genealogy for Reporting
description: This feature enables the use of a Report showing all input batches for a batch with any related records that are relevant to the batch disposition process including Dispositions and Quality Events.

feature: Batch Release Role Assignment
description: This feature allows Admins to restrict who is eligible for roles.

feature: Add Documents to Checks
description: When enabled in the Check Requirement of Type Document, users can add a Document to a Check to monitor its state.

feature: Check Object Class Conversion
description: To take advantage of User Task Class, the Disposition Check object batch_disposition_check__v will be converted to batch_disposition_check_task__v.

application: Batch Release, LIMS, QMS, QualityDocs, Station Manager, Surveillance, Training, Validation Management
feature: 24R3 Quality Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Reason for Change
description: This feature introduces a requirement for the user to provide a reason for change for edits made to configured fields within a specific lifecycle state to meet regulatory requirements.

feature: Field Corrective Actions: Business Process Integration & Automations
description: This feature adds several automations to the field corrective actions process, including being able to automatically create Product Return records, send notifications to affected consignees, and collaborate externally on health hazard evaluations.

feature: Field Corrective Actions Data Model
description: This feature adds a new data model to support the Field Corrective Actions process.

feature: Mapping Materials to Products
description: This feature introduces a new object to map material to products.

feature: Recurrence Check: Editable Date & Match Field Prompts
description: This feature provides options on the Quality Record Check that Admins can enable to allow users to modify the default dates and match fields before executing a Recurrence Check.

feature: Email Body Layout Section for Download to PDF Support
description: A specialized Vault QMS section, Email Body, can be added to the Complaint, Complaint Intake, and Supplier Change Notification objects, as well as the Quality Event object for the Complaint, Complaint Email, and Medtech Complaint object types. Adding the Email Body layout section to an object enables the content in the field to be downloaded when the Download to PDF action is executed.

feature: Audit Room
description: This feature adds an audit management tool that utilizes new capabilities and user experience. It is intended for use during a third-party audit and allows customers to manage ongoing requests from an auditor.

feature: Complaints Email Processor Update: Support for Complaint Intake
description: With this feature, an inbound email address can be configured to automatically send or forward emails to a respective Vault in order to automatically create a Complaint Intake object record.

feature: External Collaboration: Supplier Questionnaires
description: This feature will expand External Collaborator functionality to include the ability to assign an external collaborator a task to complete a checklist. As part of the audit process, customers will now be able to request an external collaborator to complete a checklist using an external collaborator license.

feature: Action Paths: Support Change Action Templates
description: This feature enables support for Action Paths in the Change Action Templates.  A new object field control on the Change Action Template allows a user to associate the template action to a desired action step. When the Change Action is created from the template it will show in the appropriate Action Step.

feature: Recurrence Check Data Model Changes
description: This feature includes data model changes only related to the Recurrence Check: Editable Date and Match Field Prompts feature.

feature: Vault QMS Standard Checkbox Defaulting
description: This feature adds defaulting logic to standard fields that were initially provisioned as checkboxes (Yes/No fields with the "Show as checkbox" option enabled). Fields with existing defaulting behavior are not updated by this change, nor are standard Yes/No fields that were later updated to checkboxes.

feature: Download to PDF: Support for Vault QMS Specific Sections & Fields
description: This feature enables specialized Vault QMS layout sections and object fields to be exported when the Download to PDF action is executed. This feature is dependent on the enablement of the Download to PDF action.

feature: Dialog Layout Updates for Recurrence Check
description: This feature corresponds to the Recurrence Check: Editable Date and Match Field Prompts feature and represents the new layouts for Run Record Check dialog, Refresh Results dialog, and the Record Check Result's Match Criteria dialog. The new layouts will be auto-on and apply only to Recurrence Checks (not Duplicate Checks).

feature: External Collaboration: Reassign Task when External Collaborator Changes
description: This feature will allow a user to reassign a task to a new external collaborator elegantly, without impacting the workflow.

feature: Change Action Path Enhancements
description: This feature provides usability improvements associated with viewing, creating, and editing Action Steps for Change Actions.

feature: 24R3 QMS Standard Layout & Data Model Updates
description: With this feature, standard fields, standard layouts, layout rules, component security, and standard objects have been provisioned. Users shall be able to copy and customize inactive standard layouts for use and activate standard fields for use in configuration.

feature: Document Change Control Tokens for Notification Templates
description: There are 3 tokens ($mdccChangeAuthDocsList, $mdccReleaseDocsList, $mdccObsoleteDocsList) that are now available to be used in Notification Templates. These tokens list the documents in the Change Authorization section, Documents to be Made Effective/Released and Documents to be Made Obsolete sections of the Document Change Control respectively.

feature: QualityDocs Standard Checkbox Defaulting
description: This feature adds defaulting logic to standard fields that were initially provisioned as checkboxes (Yes/No fields with the "Show as checkbox" option enabled). Fields with existing defaulting behavior are not updated by this change, nor are standard Yes/No fields that were later updated to checkboxes.

feature: Quality Relationships Panel Enhancements
description: The existing Quality Relationships document information panel will be expanded to include Document Change Requests (DCRs). This allows users to easily view associated DCRs as well as create them from the panel. The existing sections of the panel will also be enhanced to show additional information which can also be searched against in the panel.

feature: Support for Auto-Start Workflows in the Document Change Control
description: Auto-started workflows will now display in the Workflow column of the Documents to be made Effective/Obsolete with Workflows sections of the Document Change Control in addition to manually started workflows.

feature: Process Navigator: Hierarchy Builder UI Enhancements
description: This feature adds minor user interface improvements to the Process Navigator: Hierarchy Builder feature such as styling, icons, text wrapping, spacing, hyperlinks for the root parent processes, and more.

feature: Station Manager Login Improvements (iOS)
description: This feature enhances the login experience on the iOS version of Station Manager.

feature: Prevent Duplicate Documents in Station Manager
description: The system will prevent users from associating duplicate documents (such as the same document and document version) to a Station record.

feature: Mark Training Complete in Bulk
description: This feature allows CRAs or other trusted users to mark multiple Learner completions at the same time.  While this feature may be available in both Study Training and (Quality) Training pre-release Vaults, it will be limited to Study Training Vaults only with the general release on December 6th.

feature: New Standard Responsibility
description: Clinical vaults are adding a new Standard Responsibility that will result in a new Study Training Responsibility being added called "Determine eligibility criteria (inclusion/exclusion)." This will also automatically create a new Clinical Mapping record to Study Training.

feature: Learner Exemption Requests
description: This feature allows a Learner to request an exemption from a Training Assignment.

feature: Instructor-Led Training: Support More Than 100 Learners in Class
description: This feature allows ILT classes to have more than 100 learners. The implementation of this required that we implement app security for classroom training.

feature: My Team Page & My Study Team Page UI Updates
description: Improvements to the Manager Homepage to allow managers to toggle between eligible and ineligible persons. Persons with inactive users will display in the appropriate eligibility tab.

feature: Instructor-Led Training: Maximum Attendees & Waitlisting
description: This feature enables a waitlist for ILT classes. Instructors can specify a maximum capacity for a class. When the capacity is reached, learners can enroll onto a waitlist.

feature: Training Enhancements
description: This feature includes improvements for VeevaID SSO, Instructor-led training features, and other recent features.

feature: Instructor-Led Training Enhancements
description: This feature includes improvements for Instructor-led training features.

feature: Reportability Enhancements: Multiple Decision Trees
description: This feature adds support to add more than one decision tree to determine the reportability of a given Complaint. The system will automatically determine and create the applicable decision tree records based on the Product, Countries Marketed, Reportability Decision Rules, and Decision Tree configuration.

feature: eMDR: Section F
description: This feature adds the capability to submit eMDRs to the FDA as an importer of medical devices.

feature: Require Re-Training User Action
description: This feature adds the ability to assign training for one or more Training Requirements in one or more Learner's Training Matrix.

feature: E-Learning: Support Reporting on Locked Quizzes
description: Vault Training E-Learning will now record when an e-learning course returns a Quiz Locked variable. This is intended to allow customers to run a report on e-Learning courses that are locked because the learner failed the quiz multiple times.

feature: Default Requirement Burndown Filter to Approved Requirements
description: When Authors navigate to the test script authoring page, the requirement burndown panel will now default to only show requirements that are in the approved lifecycle state rather than all lifecycle states. Prior to 24R3, requirements in all lifecycle states would appear in the requirements burndown panel.

feature: Dry Run for Test Scripts
description: This feature provides test script authors with the ability to start dry runs, effectively testing the test script. This will allow selected users to act as the script executor, enabling them to provide feedback and identify scripting issues on the test script which the author can address.

feature: Copy Test Script Enhancements
description: This feature enhances the deep copy test script action to support broader usage of existing test scripts such as regression testing and save as. This allows users to copy a test script to a different deliverable and test protocol.

feature: Copy Test Protocols
description: This feature allows users to copy a Test Protocol with selected test scripts including all child test steps, additional prompts, Co-Authors, and requirements to re-execute, perform regression testing, and save as the existing Test Protocol.

feature: Vault Validation Management Standard Checkbox Defaulting
description: This feature adds defaulting logic to standard fields that were initially provisioned as checkboxes (Yes/No fields with the "Show as checkbox" option enabled). Fields with existing defaulting behavior are not updated by this change, nor are standard Yes/No fields that were later updated to checkboxes.

feature: Admin-Defined List Layouts
description: With the 24R3 release, Admins can predefine list layouts for Requirements, Discrepancies, and Test Step Changes to establish a best practice list for Validation Management users during test authoring, pre-approval, test execution, and post-approval. Existing users can choose to adopt the Admin-defined list layout configuration for the object by navigating to the applicable object data grid and clicking the restore default hyperlink. New users added to the Vault, however, will automatically have the Admin-defined configuration as their starting point.

feature: Requirements Burndown Search Bar
description: Authors will now be able to search for requirement information from the requirement burndown panel with the newly introduced search bar. All fields on the requirement object are searchable from the search bar. When a match is found, only those requirements will appear in the burndown panel combined with any filters that are applied.

feature: Download to PDF: Support for Vault Validation Specific Section & Fields
description: This feature specifies how Validation Application Controls are displayed on a PDF document when the Download to PDF platform action is executed from an object record.

feature: Validation Management: Standard Enhancements
description: In 24R3, the Validation Management application continues to enhance the standard data model and component design. Examples include adding various standard date and cancellation related fields in various objects. In this release, we also put controls in place to prevent Admins from enabling a Dynamic Access Control (DAC) attribute, like custom sharing rules or matching sharing rules, from any Validation Management standard object. Because this change is automatically enabled, all customers must ensure they have not enabled DAC on any standard object (for example, val_requirement_svo__v or val_activity__v) prior to the 24R3 release. We are also introducing a new object type to help organizations manage Configuration Specifications on the Validation Requirement object (val_requirement_svo__v). Customers must, at a minimum, grant Read permissions to this object type for users involved with authoring, executing, or reviewing and approving test scripts when 24R3 is released. We have also introduced a hard limit of 500 test steps per test script which will become effective automatically in the 24R3 release.

feature: Optimize the Loading of Test Step Cards in the Test Authoring UI
description: This feature allows authors to see test step cards in the actual size and eliminates unnecessary scrolling after loading data.

feature: Attachment Display Enhancements for Test Steps
description: In 24R3, we have enhanced how test step attachments display on test step cards. An icon will now display based on the attachment's file type. This change impacts test step cards in the Test Script Execution Interface, Test Script Review Interface, and the Test Protocol Review Interface.

feature: NeeS EAEU Publishing Support
description: With this feature, the system will support publishing EAEU submissions based on EAEU v1.1.0 guidance.

feature: NeeS Canada Validation
description: With this feature, the system will support validating NeeS Canada Submissions based on validation criteria v5.2 from Health Canada.

feature: Publishing EU eCTD v3.1
description: With this feature, the system will support publishing and validating EU dossiers based on EMA guidance version 3.1 and validation version 8.0.

feature: Publishing WHO eCTD Version 1.1
description: With this feature, the system will support publishing and validating WHO PQT dossiers according to the WHO eCTD v1.1 specification.

feature: FDA Sync Gateway Profile Deprecation
description: As part of the move to Async Gateway Profiles for the US FDA, the Sync Gateway profile has been deprecated. This is a follow up to the announcement of the deprecation in 23R3. All customers should use the FDA Async Gateway.

feature: Update Health Canada Rules to Report Warning on Optional Sections
description: Two additional Validation Rules were introduced (G.06 Optional, G.08 Optional) to support Health Canada rule G.06 and G.08. Vault will now report a High validation failure on elements where the attributes are mandatory for the existing G.06 and G.08 rules. Vault will now report as warnings on elements where attributes are not mandatory on rules G.06 Optional and G.08 Optional. If configuration updates are not made to add the new Validation Rules, the existing G.06 and G.08 rules will only report High validation failures for mandatory attributes.

feature: Validation Results Archival Job Update
description: The Validation Results Archive job will now archive records 90 days after the Actual Submission Date (previously 365)

feature: Support Source Document Overlay Resolution
description: When applying overlays to documents, the system will now support using the source document as the source of overlay information or the published document as the source of overlay information.

feature: Publishing Pre-Validation Updates
description: Additional pre-validation messages were added to verify publishing configuration before proceeding to publish. Publishing will fail TOC generation when encountering more than 2500 rows and provide a user-facing exception.

feature: Update Best Practice Validation Rules Logic for Filenames
description: The following regional rules have been updated to more accurately validate filenames across Submissions: CH 15BP3, EU 15BP3, GCC 13, JO 13, TH 15BP3, and TW OBP2.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: RIM Bot Enhancements
description: Improvements to the RIM Bot have been made, including Training Set Optimization, Automated Model Refresh, Multilingual Model, & One-Click Model Retraining. Training Set Optimization caps the number of documents extracted for a single classification when training and testing models. Automated Model Refresh enables and forces on the auto-training job in all RIM Vaults, ensuring that Auto-classification trained models are refreshed with each major release. Multilingual Model support extends RIM Bot support to non-English languages.  One-Click Model Retraining introduces a streamlined one-click path for refreshing a deployed trained model.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: 24R3 RIM Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Vault RIM Standard Checkbox Defaulting
description: This feature adds defaulting logic to standard fields that were initially provisioned as checkboxes (Yes/No fields with the "Show as checkbox" option enabled). Fields with existing defaulting behavior are not updated by this change, nor are standard Yes/No fields that were later updated to checkboxes.

feature: Update Table of Contents Page Numbers When Merging
description: This feature adds support for generating Table of Contents, Table of Tables, and Table of Figures that correctly reference the SCP structure when the Table of Contents Content Plan Item is located in the middle, at the top, or at the bottom of a Submission Content Plan or Report Level Content Plan and the Table of Contents is included in a merged output.

feature: Configurable Procedure Countries for Create Registrations
description: This feature provides the capability to manage Procedure Type countries with Constraints to default countries when creating RIM Registrations in bulk. The Health Authority field set in the constraint will be set for the Registration that uses that Constraint.

feature: Create Related Records: Validation Enhancements
description: This feature updates existing validation when the Create Related Records bulk action is run to be timely, prior to preview data file generation, and dynamic based on Event data. With a wide array of use cases supported, the local data needed to support change management can be propagated quickly and correctly.

feature: Activity Dependency Enhancements
description: This feature will provide the ability to surface labeling-specific Activity dependencies when a labeling impact is identified on a non-labeling Event. We will also allow the specification of dependencies at the level of Applications. This will enable dependencies based on Applications across different markets, within the same market, and within the same Application.

feature: Create Related Records: Support for Enhanced Change Management
description: Create Related Records can now propagate Product Changes from Events to Activities to support more granular management of product-related changes.

feature: 24R3 Registrations Data Model Updates
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Support for Multiple Review Steps in Registration Verification
description: This feature enhances the Registration Verification workflow to support the configuration of additional review tasks.

feature: eAF Report Generation Enhancement
description: When generating electronic Application Form (eAF) Reports from a regulatory objective, any existing reports for the same medicinal product will be replaced to prevent redundant reports from building up over time.

feature: Manage Registered Details Filtering Enhancements
description: The Manage Registered Details wizard will have additional filtering capabilities for text fields to narrow the search for records to facilitate updates. The filters will support searching text values as well as blank (undefined) fields.

feature: Support for Drug-Led Complex Combination Products
description: With this release, the Create Registrations wizard has been enhanced to generate Registered Product records for complex products when Co-Packaged or Integral Device is set to Yes.

feature: GCP Dispatch Validations
description: This feature supports the ability to validate that Global Content Plan (GCP) documents are version-locked and that target Activities and Submissions are in valid lifecycle states when Dispatching GCPs.

feature: Cloning Enabled for Content Plan Item Template Mappings
description: The Content Plan Item Template Mapping (CPITM) object is now set to be cloned when a RIM Vault is cloned. CPITM records will be copied from source to target environment instead of having to be migrated using loader sheets or VPKs.

feature: Auto-Match RLCP Documents into GCP
description: Report Level Content Plans can be associated to Event Clinical Studies and Event Nonclinical Studies when creating a GCP to use that RLCP as a matching criteria for Auto-Matching & Suggested Matching.

feature: Copy Content Plan Action to Respect Use for Content Planning Field
description: The Copy From Content Plan action is enhanced to only copy relationships that are used for Content Planning from the source Submission to the target Submission.

feature: Submissions Archive Viewer: Filter Correspondence by Regulatory Objective
description: Correspondence documents in Submissions Archive Viewer can be filtered by Regulatory Objective(s). A new Correspondence column grouping displays Regulatory Objectives.

feature: EU eCTD v3.1
description: Submissions Archive supports import, viewing, and export of submissions using the EU eCTD v3.1 Document Type Definition (DTD).

feature: ECOWAS eCTD v1.0
description: Submissions Archive supports import, viewing, and export of submissions using the ECOWAS (WA) eCTD v1.0 Document Type Definition (DTD).

feature: WHO eCTD v1.1
description: Submissions Archive supports import, viewing, and export of submissions using the WHO eCTD v1.1 Document Type Definition (DTD).

feature: Import Notification Updates
description: With this release, the Submissions Archive Import Notification has been enhanced to show errors relating to missing required document fields.

feature: Submissions Archive Viewer: Mini-Browser Window Size Increase
description: The Mini-Browser window width is increased. Launching the Mini-Browser simultaneously displays the document's Viewable Rendition and Information panel.

feature: Active Dossier Viewer & Editor Enhancements
description: This feature introduces a new Active Dossier Editor for an improved editing user experience. The Editor is now accessible from the Active Dossier Viewer, and the Edit Active Dossier actions navigate users to the Item Detail layout of the Viewer.   Additional changes to the Viewer include the addition of layouts and a status selector to replace the Show All/Current/Pending toggles. Saved Views in the Editor will also no longer be supported with this release. It is recommended to create these saved views in the Viewer.

feature: Active Dossier Additional Status Tracking
description: This feature adds support for new Active Dossier statuses: Dispatched, Not Submitted; Rejected; Withdrawn; and No Decision. Additionally, a new Approval Type field has been added. A new 'Update Active Dossier' Regulatory Objective entry action is available to configure setting the new statuses and approval type. Finally, Active Dossier records for documents that are dispatched but not submitted are moved into the Dispatched, Not Submitted status instead of cleared.

feature: Active Dossier Translation Handling Update
description: An update has been made to how the Translation Document is set during Active Dossier generation based on the Active Dossier Item Detail's Country and the Vault's Country Language records. If there are multiple valid translations for the country, Vault will set the first instance.

feature: Active Dossier Hovercard Update: Needs Submission
description: The Needs Submission field that was introduced as part of Active Dossier Generation from Global Content Plan dispatch in 24R1 is now surfaced in the hovercard when hovering over an Active Dossier Item Detail in the Active Dossier Viewer. This allows users to see if a document version within Active Dossier still needs to be submitted.

feature: Active Dossier Calculation Update: Narrow Scope of Pending Current Change
description: Active Dossier calculation logic now narrows the scope of records that are moved to pending current status to records that are initially in a Submitted status instead of input records in any status. This will prevent unexpected changes of records in a status other than Submitted to Pending Current during the current calculation.

feature: FDA MedWatch 3500A: August 2024 Version
description: Vault Safety generates the version of the FDA MedWatch 3500A form released in August 2024.

feature: MFDS E2B(R3)
description: Vault Safety supports MFDS E2B(R3) for submission and distribution.

feature: JDrug and WHODrug Cross Reference Tool
description: Vault Safety introduces support for the WHODrug Cross Reference Tool (CRT) Japan and the automatic mapping of WHODrug drug codes to Japanese IDF drug codes for External Product coding.

feature: Global Field Sync to Foreign Localized Case Follow-Ups
description: Admins can now configure their Vault to overwrite all text fields on related Localized Cases with the latest text from the global Cases when Transmissions are created for global follow-up Cases.

feature: Country Specific IMP ICSR Reporting
description: Vault Safety now supports evaluating study product reportability on a country-specific basis.

feature: Configurable PII and E2B Masking for NullFlavor Fields
description: Vault Safety allows Admins to configure exceptions so that NullFlavors are exported and not masked on E2B reports.

feature: EU Convention E2B(R2)
description: Vault Safety supports E2B(R2) using the specifications from the EU Convention in 2012.

feature: Bulk Unblind Studies with Isolate Blinded Product Information
description: Vault Safety now supports bulk unblinding clinical trial Cases for Studies without Study Arms in Vaults with the Isolate Blinded Product Information feature configured.

feature: Vault Expressions: Custom Safety Rule Parameters
description: Vault Safety supports the ability for Admins to configure custom reporting rules using Vault Expressions. Previously, this capability was only supported via Java SDK.

feature: Datasheet Expectedness for Blinded Study Products
description: Vault Safety now supports generating Expectedness records for blinded Study Products on blinded Cases.

feature: Case-Level Reportability Indicator
description: Vault Safety introduces the Case Reportability field, which displays a Case's reportability based on the most recent rule evaluation.

feature: Additional Filters for CIOMS II Aggregate Report
description: The CIOMS II can now be used to generate a variety of reports and includes additional filters.

feature: E2B Readable Renditions
description: Vault Safety allows users to generate a readable rendition of E2B XML files for review.

feature: Multi-Product Selector for Study Products on Cases
description: With this release, Vault Safety supports adding multiple Study Products to Study Cases in one action.

feature: DME Watchlist Update: Immune thrombocytopenic purpura (10074667)
description: With this release, the term "Immune thrombocytopenic purpura (10074667)" on the DME list is updated to reflect the most recent term information from MedDRA, "Immune thombocytopenia (10083842)".

feature: AS2 Connection: Transfer AS2 Connections (Environment Management)
description: Admins can now transfer AS2 Connections between two Vaults owned by the same customer and with the same release and region.

feature: AS2 Connection: Restore AS2 Connections
description: Admins can now restore AS2 Connections deleted during Sandbox refreshes.

feature: MedDRA Bulk Recode Without Case Upversioning
description: Vault Safety can now recode MedDRA terms on closed Cases without creating an upversioned Case. Recoding can be extended to all prior versions of the Case.

feature: Case Copy with Linking
description: Vault Safety now supports creating up to 100 copies of a Case. Case copies include all parent and child records and maintain links to the original Case documents.

feature: Copy Datasheet Expectedness Justification to Case Assessments
description: With this release, Vault Safety supports configuring rationales for adverse event expectedness on Datasheets, which are copied to Case Assessments and Localized Case Assessments.

feature: Import Online Questionnaire Responses to Follow-Up Inbox Items
description: Vault Safety supports the ability for Admins to configure question field mappings to import question responses to Inbox Items when Online Questionnaires are completed.

feature: Duplicate Detection During Case Processing
description: With this release, users can perform duplicate detection during Case processing to compare the current Case record against other Cases and Inbox Items.

feature: Localized Cases: Global Narrative Override on Follow-Ups
description: This feature introduces the Sync Global Narrative to Local Narrative action on Localized Cases, allowing users to override existing Localized Narratives based on related global Case Narratives.

feature: QC Checklist Updates
description: This release enhances Admin configuration of the QC Checklist Generation process.

feature: Licensing Check for MedDRA
description: Vault Safety now supports validation of your company’s MedDRA credentials and license as part of the MedDRA dictionary update process.

feature: Safety Standardization 24R3
description: Vault Safety adds a number of standard components to support major business processes.

feature: Select Registrations on Submissions
description: On aggregate reports, Vault Safety now includes the product registration details from generated submissions.

feature: Case Access Groups on CDMS Subject Information
description: Vault Safety now supports constraining access to CDMS Subject Information by Case Access Group.

feature: Improved FDA One Last Time Reporting
description: Evaluation of One Last Time reporting to the FDA now considers changes to Transmission Profiles when generating subsequent Transmission versions.

feature: Duplicate Inbox Item Linking
description: Vault now links duplicate Inbox Items to their matching records through the new Linked Inbox Item field.

feature: Case Access Group Security: Study Type Update for Inbox Items
description: When assigning Case Access Groups to Inbox Items, Vault Safety now considers the Inbox Item's Study Type when there is no matching Study in the Vault study library.

feature: PMDA Post-Market Reports: Filter by Local Awareness Date
description: PMDA reports can now be filtered by Local Awareness Date.

feature: Automatically Set MedDRA Code When Product Indication is NullFlavor
description: Vault Safety now automatically sets the Name (MedDRA) field to "Drug use for unknown indication (10057097)" when users select a nullFlavor for the Reason Omitted field on Product Indication.

feature: Localized Cases: Domestic Narrative Override on Follow-Ups
description: This feature extends the functionality of the Sync Global Narrative to Local Narrative action on Localized Cases, so users can override existing Localized Narratives based on related domestic Case Narratives. This feature is Auto-on in Vaults with Localized Cases: Global Narrative Override on Follow-ups enabled.

feature: MFDS Regional E2B Fields in E2B Readable Renditions
description: E2B Readable Renditions now supports regional MFDS data elements. This feature is Auto-on in Vaults with E2B Readable Renditions enabled.

feature: Gateway Support for Multiple Transmission Profiles
description: Vault Gateway and AS2 Connection now allow inbound transmissions for gateways with multiple transmission profile assignments.

feature: Latest Study Registration Data on Follow-Up Cases
description: Vault Safety now populates the latest Study Registrations from the study library in the Study Registrations section of follow-up Cases.

feature: Sender-Based Email Inbox Item Pre-Population
description: With this release, Vault Safety can now automatically set the Country and Report Type fields on an Inbox Item based on the sender’s email.

feature: Duplicate E2B XML File Detection
description: With this release, Vault Safety can detect E2B XML files already imported into Inbox Items.

feature: Inbox Item Fields: Report Type & Seriousness
description: In this release, Inbox Items include Report Type and Seriousness fields to support filtering and prioritization for imported Inbox Items.

feature: Update Localized Case Narrative Language Based on Follow-Up Information
description: When promoting Inbox Items as follow-ups to existing Cases, Vault ensures the ISO language of the Narrative document matches the Localization.

feature: Case Version Compare IDs
description: Vault Safety introduces an ID to identify Case child records across Case versions.

feature: Follow-Ups to Domestic Cases from Global Inbox Items
description: With this release, Vault Safety allows users to create follow-ups to domestic Cases from global Inbox Items.

feature: Conditional Age by Decade Expectedness Evaluation Update
description: In Vaults with conditional expectedness by age configured, when evaluating expectedness based on a patient age entered in decades, Vault now evaluates expectedness considering both the upper and lower bounds of decade ranges.

feature: New Application: Vault Safety Signal
description: Safety Signal is a new application in the Vault Safety Suite that integrates with existing safety databases to detect new, unexpected adverse events or changes in existing adverse events to a medicinal product. Safety Signal is available only for early adopters. Validation documents are targeted for 25R1.

feature: New Application: Vault Safety Workbench
description: Safety Workbench is a new application in the Vault Safety Suite for complex reporting and data analysis on high volumes of Vault Safety data. Safety Workbench is available only for early adopters. Validation documents are targeted for 25R1.

feature: Safety Standard Checkbox Defaulting
description: This feature adds defaulting logic to standard fields that were initially provisioned as checkboxes (Yes/No fields with the "Show as checkbox" option enabled). Fields with existing defaulting behavior are not updated by this change, nor are standard Yes/No fields that were later updated to checkboxes.

feature: E2B Generation: Literature Retransmission
description: With this release, during E2B generation Vault can retransmit literature documents attached to Literature Article records. Although this feature is Auto-on, some components require additional configuration.

feature: Auto-Generation of Product Family Product Records
description: Vault Safety now supports automatically generating Product Family-related records when managing the product library.

feature: 24R3 Safety Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: SafetyDocs Standardization 24R3
description: Vault SafetyDocs adds a number of standard components to support major business processes.

feature: Custom Translation Connections for Literature Abstracts
description: This feature introduces support for Literature Abstract translation using custom translation connections.

feature: Pharmacovigilance Agreements Usability Improvements
description: Vault SafetyDocs now displays meaningful values when a PVA object is referenced in an object field rather than the auto-generated name.

feature: Product-Event Disposition Updates
description: This feature includes Product-Event Disposition auto-naming changes. The uniqueness of this object has also been updated to the Reporting Period.

feature: Risk Management Automation
description: In all markets where a Product is registered, Vault SafetyDocs can now generate local Risk Management Plans (RMPs) and Risk Management Measures (RMMs) automatically.

feature: Literature Multi-Product Support
description: SafetyDocs can now support independent verdicts for each product on a literature article.

feature: Open Safety Investigations from Literature Articles
description: With this release, users can open Safety Investigations from identified Literature Articles.

feature: Customize Sender Email Address for PVA Document Distribution
description: Vault SafetyDocs can now be configured to send Vault emails using the customer’s email domain.

feature: Literature Coding to Product Family
description: Literature Articles in Vault SafetyDocs can now be coded to a Product Family, a Product, or both.

feature: Capture Additional Information for Safety Investigations
description: With this release, Safety Investigations include fields for entering descriptions, due dates, and validation and disposition rationales.

feature: Add MedDRA Terms and Queries for Safety Investigation
description: With this release, users can add MedDRA Terms and MedDRA Queries directly to Safety Investigations.

feature: Create Inbox Items from Literature Articles in CRO Vaults
description: Vault SafetyDocs now supports creating Inbox Items for any sponsor from Literature Articles.

feature: Update Notification Template for PSMF Periodic Review
description: PSMF Periodic Review notifications now provide more information about assigned tasks.

feature: Study Training & Vault Training Standard Checkbox Defaulting
description: This feature adds defaulting logic to standard fields that were initially provisioned as checkboxes (Yes/No fields with the "Show as checkbox" option enabled). Fields with existing defaulting behavior are not updated by this change, nor are standard Yes/No fields that were later updated to checkboxes.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Protocol Deviations Link to CDMS
description: Protocol Deviations in CTMS that were created by the Clinical Operations-EDC Connection will contain a link to view the source Protocol Deviation page in EDC.

feature: Safety-Clinical Operations Connection: CRO Support
description: The Safety-Clinical Operations Connection now allows CROs to utilize the connection by supporting the tracking of each study's sponsor organization. This feature also adds a new integration rule and integration point for Study Country data.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: New Fields & Error Messages
description: The Safety-EDC Connection now supports the automatic transfer of additional field values. Additionally, an error message identifies the specific issue when a custom field is missing in Safety Vault.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Send SAE Reporter Details to Safety
description: EDC can now send reporter contact information for an EDC safety case to Vault Safety.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Multiple-EDC Connections on Vault Safety
description: The Safety-EDC Connection now allows a single Safety Vault to connect to multiple EDC Vaults.

application: PromoMats, RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: RIM-PromoMats: Product Data Transfer
description: This feature allows the transfer of Product and Registration data between RIM and PromoMats to have a single source of truth. RIM is the source for most product and Registration data; however, Brand (RIM Regulatory Text) is managed and originates in PromoMats.

feature: Safety-RIM Connection Enhancements
description: The Safety-RIM Connection now supports improved data mapping from RIM to Safety.

feature: RIM-Clinical Operations: EU Special Handling for Clinical Crosslinks
description: When CrossLinking documents from a RIM Vault to a Clinical Operations Vault, if the Country field on the RIM document includes 'European Union', the connection will populate Study Countries on the CrossLink where the Country is mapped to the Jurisdiction 'European Union' via the Jurisdiction Country object.

feature: RIM-Clinical Operations: Update to Clinical Study Field Rules
description: New standard field rules on the Clinical Study integration will transfer data from Clinical Operations to RIM for the fields Study Type, Subtype, and Type of Control.

feature: RIM-Clinical Operations: Enhance Study Defaulting Logic on Clinical Crosslinks
description: If the Study field is blank on the RIM document when attempting to CrossLink to a Clinical Operations Vault, the Connection will default all studies where the Product(s) is a Lead Agent for studies in Clinical Operations. If the RIM document includes a study not transferred from the Clinical Operations Vault (link_sys field is blank), then a User Exception Message will be generated.

feature: Source Data Review (SDR) Tracking
description: This feature introduces a standard means to track Source Data Review (SDR) in Veeva CTMS. A Study Site’s SDR Plan allows for subject data to be selected for source data review and tracked to completion.

feature: Seed Metrics: Error Handling Improvements
description: This features enhances the Seed Metrics action for Study, Study Country, Study Site, and Subject Group to notify users if errors are encountered and handles duplicate metric records.

feature: Seed Metrics: Ignore Transferred Metrics
description: When a Study's Metrics Calculation is set to Transferred Metrics, the Seed Metrics action will not create Metric records.

feature: Daily TMF Transfer
description: This feature automates the daily transfer of steady state TMF Documents from CRO to Sponsor over the course of an active study. TMF documents can also now be included for CTMS Transfer Agreements.

feature: Subject Visits Track Reverted to In Progress Updates
description: With this feature, visit records now track changes from submitted to in progress and updates out of that visit status to enable more granular visit progress tracking.

feature: Populate Procedure Definitions
description: This feature allows easily creating a set of Procedure Definitions in a study, using either an existing study or an eligible Procedure Template

feature: Global Procedure Definitions
description: This feature allows for a Vault-level library of procedures. Tracking procedure use per study will allow for cross-study comparisons and additional insights.

application: CTMS, Site Connect, Study Startup, eTMF
feature: Study Site Addresses
description: This feature allows Sponsors/CROs to capture study site-specific addresses such as IP Shipment addresses, Patient Visit Locations, or IRB/Lab addresses. This new Study Site Address object is a functional replacement of Study Site Locations.

feature: Study Person Security Expired Job
description: This feature introduces a standard daily job that automatically revokes a Study Person's security access once their end date has been reached.

feature: API Support: Global Directory Merge
description: This feature allows merging records via API for standard objects in the Clinical Operations Global Directory: Person, Contact Information, Organization, and Location.

feature: Excluded States for Milestone & EDL Creation
description: This feature enables admins to select specific lifecycle states for Study, Study Country, and Study Site, ensuring that Milestones and EDLs are no longer created for records in those states.

feature: Milestones for Complex Trials
description: This feature provides a method for defining which Milestones within a Study's Milestone Master Set should be created for a Subject Group and provides a mechanism for the creation of these subject group-specific Milestones.

feature: Integrate with ClinicalTrials.gov: API for Submission Protocol & Results
description: This feature includes the ability for Clinical Operations Vaults with Disclosures to connect directly to ClinicalTrials.gov PRS API in order to Submit protocol registrations and results directly from Veeva Disclosures using a Connection object to store configuration.

feature: Support US Results Disclosure
description: This feature extends Disclosures with the ability to enter and submit results data to ClinicalTrials.gov.

feature: Prepopulate Disclosures from Protocol Object
description: This feature streamlines the creation of a disclosure by automatically populating a disclosure with information from the latest protocol.

feature: Self-Evident Corrections
description: The system will automatically create quality issues when changes are made to document metadata when the document is in specific state types. This will allow for metrics to be collected on changes made to documentation without the need for slowing down the process by manually opening the quality issue.

feature: Filter Obsolete on TMF Homepage Unapproved Documents
description: This feature updates the chart the on TMF Homepage to not include Obsolete documents in the Unapproved Docs calculation.

feature: Archival Hardening
description: This feature enhances the current archiving functionality to ensure that all versions of documents are archived when doing snapshots of documents. It also removes the restrictions around preventing archiving for documents under legal hold.

feature: QIs: Auto-Populate Fields from Documents
description: When creating a QI, the system will ensure that the study information from the document is automatically added to the QI, and the Assigned To is defaulted to the Document Owner. The Assigned To can be changed to another user if required.

feature: OpenData Clinical
description: OpenData Clinical is an add-on application for eTMF or CTMS that maintains clean Global Directory data on investigators, sites, and the affiliations between them. Customers select mastered records to use, and can submit Data Change Requests for new or updated records. This feature may not be validated in pre-release Vaults.

feature: Automated Adjustments Excludes Reverted to In Progress Visits
description: With this feature, updates to a Subject Visits record that revert it to In Progress from Submitted do not trigger the automated adjustments behavior.  Visits that are updated to In Progress from Submitted remain valid and are re-evaluated with the subsequent Visit Status field update

feature: Exchange Unblinded Content with Sites
description: This feature allows Sponsor users to exchange unblinded documents with Site users. Site users with Managed Unblinded Content permissions can view and upload unblinded documents from the document exchange tab.

feature: Site Addresses in Site Connect
description: This feature allows Site Users to create and manage Study Site Addresses from Site Connect. Sponsors that configure access to Study Site Addresses can review these addresses and promote them to Locations in their global directory.

feature: Site Connect Hardening
description: This feature focuses on ensuring Site Connect behaves as intended in a number of areas as we continue to grow, including weekly summary emails, Site Connect study invitations, resend actions on Distribution Task and Distribution Task Recipient, public access links (PALs), ignoring inactive records, and hiding archived documents.

feature: Auto-Document Exchange Enhancements
description: Auto-Document Exchange has been updated with the following changes:  - Only documents modified in the last 24 hours will be picked up by the hourly job - Large sets of documents can be sent per day using auto-document exchange (>1,800) - Template Expected Document now includes Auto-Document Exchange fields

feature: Remove Reply To Email Inconsistency
description: The reply to email for document exchange emails will now be "vault-emails@veeva.com" instead of sometimes being the email of the requestor. Site users will no longer be able to reply to any emails and provide an attached document. Prior to this feature only some emails could be replied to, making an inconsistent experience for the site user.

feature: Smart Filing of Profile Documents
description: CV, Med License, and Training Evidence now require only one of their three VCD artifacts to be mapped to classify a document coming from a site user. This restores functionality that was available before Site Connect moved to Clinical Operations.

feature: Autocomplete Approval Milestones
description: This feature enables autocompletion for approval Milestones when the corresponding submission Milestone receives an Actual Finish Date and a Submission Decision of Approved or Approved with Conditions. To leverage this feature, the standard HA & EC/IRB milestone types and Submission Decision picklist values must be used.

feature: Multi-Country and Site IRB & EC Submissions
description: This feature provides the ability to define the countries or sites included in a central submission and automatically tailors the Expected Documents visible within the submission Milestone so that only Expected Documents for related countries and sites are displayed.

feature: Feasibility Licensing
description: With the introduction of Feasibility Licensing, the SSU flag on Site Licenses will be updated to True when both a Site Invitation record and a Site Selected Milestone exist. The SSU flag on Site Licenses will continue to be set to True if there is a Site Greenlight Milestone for the Study Site.

feature: Training Matrix Conversion
description: This feature allows non system-aided training matrices to be automatically updated to system-aided. This allows easy adoption of training matrix automation to reduce the burden of administering training.

feature: Cross-Sponsor GCP Certification Transfers
description: This feature reduces overtraining by allowing GCP training completions to apply to assignments in other Study Training environments.

feature: Updates to Learner Role Dependency
description: User Role Setup records will now appropriately consider 'level' as seen in Clinical Operations. For example, site-level access will also include the appropriate study and study country.

feature: Training Matrix Curriculum Creation Value
description: This feature identifies when a curriculum has been automatically created. A new Creation Source field is populated with a value of System Automation when a Curriculum has been automatically created. This new field is leveraged to display finalized Curriculum on the Training Matrix.

feature: Study Training Enhancements
description: Minor enhancements to Study Training which do not require any configuration changes.

feature: MLR: Similarity Scores
description: PromoMats will calculate a similarity score between two documents in order to help define review tiers, facilitating more efficient review for derivative content.

feature: eCTD: Redline Annotations
description: With this feature, Vault automatically generates redline annotations that are required for pre-clearance FDA submissions.

feature: Communication Objectives
description: Users can gain insight into content strategy execution by using the new Communication Objective object and linking these records to content. Communication objectives can be added to documents, content modules, or claims. When using Claims Auto-Linking, communication objectives used in the claims are automatically associated with the document.

feature: Additional Controlled Vocabularies
description: We provisioned ANSM Classifications and some new Health Authority Submission values to the Controlled Vocabulary object.

feature: PromoMats Portal: Disable Download Option
description: Portal Administrators can now choose to disable the download option for the portal homepage document cards and quicklook. This extra control is intended to promote use of Make a Copy, as the download option requires users to navigate to the Document View.

feature: PromoMats: Support UI Upload Up to 20 GB
description: This feature allows UI Upload up to 20 GB for PromoMats customers.

feature: Preview Content Module Enhancements
description: With this feature, enhancements were made to improve the user flow for reviewing previews for Content Modules.

feature: Enhanced MLR Commenting on Content Modules
