description: To improve the user experience when reviewing content modules, the comments and replies will now be displayed with the most recent comments appearing first

feature: Enable Read & Understood Workflows for PromoMats
description: Read & Understood workflows allow you to assign a document to specific users for review. When users complete their review, they can mark the document as “Read & Understood” and provide an eSignature as proof that they’ve completed the task.

feature: Standard Document Type Descriptions
description: This feature adds descriptions to the material__v, component__v, and reference__v document types. Previously, these document types did not have a description.

feature: eCTD: Additional Error Messages
description: We added error and warning messages for different scenarios in eCTD package generation.

feature: eCTD: Correspondence Letter Name Update
description: The correspondence letter generated for pre-clearance eCTD packages is now named correspondence letter. Previously, the document was named with the document number.

feature: eCTD: Binder Section Naming Update
description: Previously, Vault used the submission_date__v in the binder section names. Now, it uses dissemination_publication_date__v.

feature: Calculation & Instrument Override: Simplified Permission
description: Overriding a Calculation or Instrument result will now require permission to new Actions and will not require the user to have the Test Execution Override role assigned to their account.

feature: Sample Action Job: Queue Next Job Instead of Erroring
description: If the Sample Action job is initiated multiple times, within a Spec Execution record, the subsequent jobs will queue instead of ending in an error. The Job Title will now contain the record ID of the Spec Execution Sample Action or Spec Execution.

feature: Replicate Samples
description: This feature allows a user to create one or more samples from an existing sample. The resultant samples will have the same planned Tests and Criteria Evaluations as the copied sample.

feature: Design Data Portability
description: This feature allows for the movement of a Spec Data, Test Definition, Sample Plan, and descending records from one Vault to another.

feature: Stability Study: Data Export
description: This feature adds the ability to export results from a stability study to Excel or .CSV.

feature: Aggregate: View in Test Execution
description: This feature gives Lab Analysts and Test Reviewers the ability to see aggregate field calculations on the relevant test’s execution screen.

feature: Resample from Backup Sample
description: This feature adds the ability for a user to resample an existing sample with traceability to a backup or reserve sample.

feature: Multiple Test Procedures for a Lab Test
description: This feature allows a user to view multiple documents associated with a Test that is being executed via Test Execution. Users can access the procedure, work instruction, and so on, that is associated with the Test Definition.

feature: Convert Controlling Lookup Fields to Reference Fields
description: This feature modifies the standard data model to address an issue where lookup fields were not updating in time to control other, dependent fields. This includes an error where new Spec Data versions were sometimes referencing old Test Definition versions.

feature: Replicate Tests
description: This feature allows Samples to have multiple tests, of the same Test Definition, to be automatically assigned. Design Data Admin can use the "Number of Replicates" field to define how many tests need to be assigned.

feature: Lab Sample: Release & Stability Object Types
description: This feature adds a standard object type for the Lab Sample object. For the standard object types (Release or Stability) the Lab Sample record is created in the appropriate object type.

feature: Actions to Activate & Inactivate All Sublocations
description: This feature adds new actions to activate and inactivate a Lab Location and all of its sublocations. The Inactivate action will only succeed if there are no object records (such as samples, assets, or consumables) associated with the Lab Location or any of the sublocations.

feature: Make All Print Actions Workflow Actions
description: Print labels will now be available through a workflow (system) action for the following objects: Lab Test, Lab Sample, Lab Location, Consumable, Asset.

feature: Action on Lab Test Definition Result to Create Basic Variables
description: This feature adds a new action on Lab Test Definition Result to create basic variables based on the existing Test Definition Results. The action will only be available on Test Definition Results with Data Entry Method of Calculation.

feature: Lab Sample: Set Mode of Creation & Sample Action
description: When a Lab Sample is created, the Mode of Creation picklist contains the reason for Lab Sample creation (Planned, Planned Aliquot, etc.). Lab Sample will also contain the reference to Spex Sample Action - the sample action that created the Lab Sample.

feature: Populate Latest Test Approval Date on Spec Execution
description: This feature adds an entry action within Lab Test Lifecycle that populates the Latest Test Approval Date (Datetime field) on the related Spec Execution.

feature: Print Label Workflow Actions with Multi-Record Workflow
description: This feature adds the ability for a user to run a multi-record workflow where the Print Label action is configured as a workflow step.

feature: Resample Actions Now Create Planned Aliquot Sample Actions
description: Resample, Resample and Keep, and Resample From Backup actions now create planned aliquot actions if the source sample has aliquots associated with it.

feature: Result Cloning Rules
description: The following LIMS objects are now cloned moving forward: Calculation Constant, Calculation Constant Value, Calculation Constant Value Version, Result Picklist Option, Result Picklist, Unit of Measure

feature: LIMS 25R1 Data Model Standardization
description: Veeva LIMS adds a number of standard components to support evolving needs around major business processes.

feature: LIMS 25R1 Standard Metrics & KPIs
description: This feature introduces standard components to the LIMS data model to support the measurement of operational excellence.

feature: Pulled Lab Sample Must Match Spec Execution Object Type
description: When a Pulled Lab Sample is selected and saved on the Spec Ex Sample Action  record, display an error if the Pulled Lab Sample's standard object type does not match the Sample Action's Spec Execution's standard object type. This check only occurs if the Pulled Lab Sample is using a standard object type, which was introduced in this release.

feature: Standard Actions to Create Variation Input & Variation Results
description: This feature adds standard, inactive actions to create Variation Input and Variation Results.

feature: Change Analysis Check for Invalid Variables
description: This feature introduces a new Change Analysis version verification and completion action for Test Definition to check that calculation syntax does not include invalid variables (for example, due to a cancelled Test Definition).

feature: Allow One Aliquot for Sample & Target Sample Definition Combinations
description: This feature adds Change Analysis validation for Aliquot action: only one combination of Sample Definition and Target Sample Definition can exist for a given Spec Data.

feature: Calculated Result Change Reason: Dependent Value Changed
description: When a test result is changed, and the test result is used in a calculation (e.g. aggregate) that has already been reviewed and requires a change reason for the change, the change reason is set to "Dependent value changed"

feature: Modifying Test Inputs
description: Test Input values are now saved immediately upon leaving the cell, and can be modified even after Test Step completion through a sign-off flow very similar to the Result Change flow.

feature: Sample Result Entry: Support for Multiple Samples
description: This feature adds additional support to the Sample Result Entry UI for entering result values of multiple Samples at one time (such as transcribing results for a Stability Study).

feature: Sample Result Entry: Support for Viewing Attachments
description: This feature adds additional support to the Sample Result Entry UI by allowing Lab Analysts to upload and view transcription documents, such as the CoA or Stability Report from a third party lab, while entering results.

feature: Exception Summary: View Exception Details
description: This feature allows a user to view detailed information for each exception. When the user clicks on an exception icon, the user is able to view more information about that exception.

feature: Prevent Changing Object Types on Spec Execution
description: With this feature, the Specification Execution's object type cannot be changed from Release to Stability or Stability to Release.

feature: Validate Test Definition When Changing Mode of Entry
description: This feature adds validation so that a Test Definition's Mode of Entry is updated to Sample Results Entry; it cannot have Test Steps, Test Inputs, or certain types of calculations.

feature: Cannot Delete Study Timepoint & Action if Timepoint is Initiated
description: With this feature, Study Time and Study Action cannot be deleted if the Lab Study Timepoint is Initiated.

feature: Consumable Record Must be Part of Family
description: Only Consumables that are part of a Consumable family record will be available for selection in the Test Execution interface.

feature: Populate KPI-Related Sample Fields Through Aliquot & Pooling Actions
description: This feature updates existing Aliquot/Pooling logic to populate Datetime fields, such as Delivery Date and Received Date.

feature: Stability: Prevent Non-Stability Spec Data on Non-Initial Timepoints
description: This feature adds validation to prevent non-Stability Spec Data field values for non-initial Study Timepoints.

feature: Test Execution Minor Enhancements
description: This feature adds usability enhancements to the Test Execution User Interface: 1) Action menu displays when hovering an Input row 2) Improved calculation error message for missing cross-test variables

feature: Validate Pulled Lab Samples
description: This feature adds validation to the Pulled Lab Sample field on the Spec Exec Sample Action. Pulled Lab Sample cannot be blank if Generated is True. Pulled Lab Sample's Spec Exec reference must be the same as the Spec Exec's Sample Action.

feature: Auto Match is Always Set to Yes for Spec Data Sample Action
description: This feature simplifies the management of spec data sample action by ensuring that Auto Match is always automatically set to Yes.

feature: Document Viewer: Updated Viewer
description: The Document Viewer was updated to support multiple test documents with a single test. Documents now open in a new tab and loader faster. As part of this update, the document panel (document info, view sharing settings, and so on) is no longer available.

feature: Show Variable Names in Error Messages
description: Error Messages now display the Result Variable name.

feature: Modular Content: HTML Previews for CRM Email Modules
description: This feature allow HTML previews for CRM email modules.

feature: Medical: Support UI Upload Up to 20 GB
description: This feature allows UI Upload up to 20 GB for MedComms customers.

feature: MedComms Portal: Disable Download Option
description: Portal Administrators can now choose to disable the download option for the portal homepage document cards and quicklook. This extra control is intended to promote use of Make a Copy, as the download option requires users to navigate to the Document View.

feature: Auto-On Auto-Linking: Medical
description: Auto-Linking replaces Suggest Links to match statements to documents. It is automatically available via the lightbulb button previously associated with Suggest Links.

feature: Contact Search: HCO & Address Support
description: The Case Contact selection dialog has been redesigned to show the most relevant data users need to search and find Case Contacts during inquiry intake. Users are able to use affiliated organizations, location data like city and zip code/postal code, among other reference data to find the right Case Contact.

feature: Telephony Support: Error Notifications
description: This feature notifies System Admins and Vault Owners of errors that occur when inbound and outbound phone calls or live chat requests fail.

feature: Telephony Support: Click to Dial
description: When users have access to telephony functionality, they are now able to dial phone numbers from the Case and Case Contact pages. When a phone call is initiated, users are redirected to a Phone Response record where they can take notes and provide responses to medical inquiries.

feature: Standard Telephony Integration: Genesys
description: Genesys Cloud is now a standard telephony integration. Users are able to access Genesys Cloud call and chat controls within MedInquiry.

feature: Event Data Model: Support Product Indication, Cause of Death on Event
description: New Indication object and Product-Indication join New Case Cause of Death field on Event object New Indication field on Event Product object

feature: Match Case Contact to the Original Sender for Emails Forwarded to MedInquiry
description: When a member of the medical information team manually forwards an email from the med info inbox into Vault, the original sender (for example, the healthcare provider who sent the medical information request email to the med info inbox) will be populated into the Case Contact field.

feature: Object Type Support for FAQs & Suggested Responses
description: MedInquiry's Suggested Responses identifies a Frequently Asked Question (FAQ) and the relevant Response based on Case Request details. This may be done at intake or at time of fulfillment, but it is restricted to the Base object type. Suggested Responses now supports other object types on Case Requests.

feature: Admin Audit Export Feedback & Limit
description: When exporting object and document audit logs, Vault will query the audit tables for up to 10 minutes. Prior to this, Admins could select a large time range that would eventually time out.

feature: Email to Vault: Option to Always Run As Email Processor User
description: For inbound email addresses that allow Persons or Anyone as a sender, Admins have the option to always use the specified Email Processor User when running the Email Processor even if the sender's email address belongs to a Vault User.

feature: Data Model Documentation
description: The data model documentation is now available from a link within Vault. Users can click the link in Help to access a high level data model diagram, all standard data model objects, and recent data model update documentation.

feature: Email to Vault: Increase Inbound Email Address Limit
description: The limit for inbound email addresses is increased from 50 to 250.

feature: Custom Pages
description: Custom Pages allow developers to write custom UI, hosted in Vault, using the Java SDK and JavaScript.

feature: Role Filter for Objects
description: This feature adds the ability to filter object records by role assignments, including a dynamic Current User option.

feature: Summary Email Enhancements & User-Driven Notifications
description: Non-urgent emails using standard notification templates are included in summary emails, with the default interval changed from 24 hours to 1 hour. Additionally, some notification fields in the User object are now automatically exposed for users to customize email preferences. *This feature is auto-on in 25R1 but can be deferred to 25R2.

feature: Searchable Object Fields Enablement
description: This enables the Searchable Object Fields admin tool on all Vaults. For Vaults where this was previously disabled, we have automatically preserved the object fields most used as document filters to ensure all saved views are unaffected on document tabs. Unused object fields have been removed from the list of available document filters.

feature: User Locale Not Restricted by User Language
description: Users can now set any Locale and Language combination freely. In pre-release Vaults, duplicate Locale names include the Language in parentheses. In General Release, these parentheses are removed when Locale is a field on object records to prevent integration issues, but are maintained in the User Profile and with Domain User creation/updating.

feature: Keyboard Shortcut Hints
description: Actions that have keyboard shortcuts assigned will now show the keyboard shortcut combination in the Actions menu, and also when hovering over actions in the Action Bar. A UI change has been made to the shortcut popup to be more condensed.

feature: Access Vault Information from User Profile Menu
description: A new About this Vault option in the User Profile menu opens a dialog containing information about the Vault such as Vault Name, Vault ID, URL, Version, Applications, Domain, and POD.

feature: Picklist Limit Updates
description: Multi-value picklist fields on a given object record will now be limited to 100 values. The overall limit for number of possible entries has been raised from 1,024 to 2,000 for picklist fields on both object records and documents.

feature: Identifiable Browser Tabs
description: Browser tabs for Vault will now be named in a more meaningful way that makes it easier for users to identify what tabs they have open by naming any Vault tab from most specific to least specific.

feature: Vault Name & Logo Changes
description: Veeva recently updated key Vault application names from Vault [Application] to Veeva [Application]. The upcoming 25R1.0 release will incorporate these changes in the UI (upper banner, login page, and so on).

feature: Enhanced Picklist Administration
description: Several UI updates for picklists have been introduced, including the ability to add and manage picklist values directly from the field using the picklist, the ability to search for values, picklist value pagination, improved reordering, and inline editing capabilities.

feature: Enhanced Formatting Options for Signature Page Templates
description: Admins can now customize page format, adjust the font styling, select text alignment, and add logos when creating Basic Signature/Cover Page templates that will apply to Viewable Renditions upon download. These new options will be based on using an intuitive rich text editor for the Header, Signature Block and Footer.

feature: Auto Bring Forward Annotations
description: Admins can now configure automated Bring Forward Annotations on new version creation for specific document types. The configuration allows opt in for each annotation type: Note, Line, Link, Anchor. This feature also enables bringing forward resolved notes and PromoMats Auto Links.

feature: Enhanced Formatting Options for Overlay Templates
description: Admins can now customize page format, adjust the font styling, select text alignment, and add logos when creating Overlay templates that will apply to Viewable Renditions upon download. These new options will be based on using an intuitive rich text editor for the Header, Signature Block and Footer.

feature: Enhanced Configuration for Collaborative Authoring
description: Setting up Collaborative Authoring no longer requires provisioning the Service Account.

feature: Saved Filters in Create Claim Link Select Target Dialog
description: Vault persists user-defined filter settings in the Create Claim Link's Select Target dialog across documents, browsers, and sessions. Saved preferences are also updated by modifying filters while editing an existing Claim Link's references.

feature: Automatic Mentioning in Collaborative Authoring
description: With this enhancement, Workflow Participants will no longer need to click Edit in Microsoft Office before they can be mentioned in the Microsoft Office documents. *Auto-on in Vaults that have the collaborative authoring workflow actions configured

feature: Consistent Last Modified By & Last Modified Date for Deleting Latest Document Version
description: Today, when deleting the latest version of a document, the Last Modified By value is not updated, while the Last Modified Date is updated. This change will make it such that both values are updated in this scenario.

feature: Document Usage Storage Policy
description: Document Usage object records will be deleted automatically after 36 months. Additionally, any Document Usage records that reference deleted documents will be deleted, even if they are newer than 36 months.

feature: Make a Copy Dialog Indicates That Autonaming is Enabled
description: Vault will no longer prompt users for a new document name when leveraging the Make a Copy function if the document name will be auto-named by the system.

feature: Latest Steady State Document Reference Consistency
description: When a document reference field is set to track the latest steady state of a document, it will always update whenever the document enters a steady state, regardless of whether a new major version is set.

feature: Additional Document Viewer Keyboard Shortcuts
description: The Document Viewer now includes the following additional keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl + + (Ctrl + plus sign) to zoom in, Ctrl + - (Ctrl + minus sign) to zoom out, Ctrl + 0 (Ctrl + zero) to toggle between Fit Width and Fit Height.

feature: 25R1 Platform Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Support for Workflow Task Prompts for Participants
description: Veeva Vault Mobile now supports workflow tasks that prompt task owners to select a workflow participant as part of task completion.

feature: Word Formatted Outputs
description: Admins can now define formatted outputs for object records using Microsoft Word. Vault-specific syntax and tokens can be used in the Word file to control how the data should be outputted, while also managing general formatting in a much easier and user-friendly way. After 25R2, all new formatted outputs must be created using Word, and not Adobe.

feature: Layout Profiles: Save As Action
description: This feature allows you to save an existing Layout Profile as new. This can be done with any source, including custom, standard, and system.

feature: Roll-up Fields
description: Roll-up fields calculate values based on related child records, such as calculated expenses in an expense report. Admins can define up to 25 Roll-up fields on parent objects to derive a value (count, sum, max, or min) from related child records.

feature: Limit Increases for Objects
description: This feature increases the maximum configuration limits for total custom fields, unique fields, long text fields, rich text fields, formula fields, and custom object types.

feature: Ignore Locked Objects During Deep Copy
description: Vault will ignore locked child object records during a deep copy operation, rather than failing the entire operation.

feature: Record List: Flexible First Column
description: Admins and users can now choose any field in the object to be the first column while viewing list of records in areas like object tabs and related object sections. Prior to this feature, the first column position was reserved for the Name field only.

feature: Formulas Support Referencing Multiple Object Levels
description: Vault object formula fields, validation rules and field defaults now support referencing data on records up to three outbound objects away. Object relationships can be traversed using their names, for example, parent__cr.grand_parent__cr.great_grand_parent__cr.name__v.

feature: Support for Additional Fields on Object Types in Formula Expressions
description: This feature makes object type fields accessible in object expressions including API names and default type.

feature: Relationship Constraint Filters for Ladder Multi-Pass Reports
description: Ladder multi-pass reports now support relationship constraint filters, allowing for filtering a primary Report View based on whether there are matching records in a child Report View.

feature: Report PDF Export Enhancement
description: When exporting a report to PDF that contains long text or rich text fields, and the report is set to fit PDF to page, the outputted PDF will now include all text from those fields by overflowing text onto additional pages as needed.

feature: Group By Unique User in Reports
description: When a report is grouped on a User object field, Vault will now ensure that users with the same first name and last name are grouped separately, based on their unique User IDs.

feature: Process Reporting on Documents
description: This feature extends cycle time functions to document report formula fields, allowing customers to report on business processes directly in reports using the same functions introduced for object reports in 24R3.

feature: Skip All Optional Prompts
description: When a report or dashboard contains multiple optional prompts, users will now have an option to skip all prompts.

feature: Allow Editing of Tags in Description Dialog
description: When editing a report’s name and description, users now have the option to apply or modify Tags, in addition to being able to assign Tags from the Reports tab.

feature: Dashboard Prompt Enhancements
description: Dashboard prompts will now be shown as a pop-up dialogs similar to report prompts, and users will be able to hover over prompts to easily identify which charts a prompt is associated with.

feature: Enhanced Report MDL Migration
description: Customers can migrate reports with report filters on reference fields even if the referenced object, user, or document is not in the target Vault. Customers can then create the referenced value on the target Vault after the migration, and the report engine will pick this new value for the next report run.

feature: Additional Delegate Access Validation
description: Additional controls are now available for Delegate Access that can prevent an Admin from delegating access to another user’s account if that action would delegate permissions they themselves do not have.

feature: Standard Configuration Only Security Profile
description: Vaults now include a new standard security profile called Configuration Only to support roles that can manage configuration without access to data and documents.

feature: VeevaID Bounce Support
description: Admins now have increased visibility into VeevaID registration emails that are generated from Vault, including the ability to see if an email was successfully sent and attempt to resend the registration email if needed.

feature: VeevaID SSO Option
description: This feature will allow sponsors to provide an SSO option for VeevaID users. All Site user roles are still required to have a VeevaID for Veeva Applications; however a Sponsor can provide an SSO Option that a VeevaID user can opt to use when logging into their systems.

feature: Change Owner on Unclassified Documents
description: When working with documents in the Document Inbox (unclassified documents) or the Staged Lifecycle, users with Change Owner permission will now be able to replace the Document Owner on documents prior to classifying them.

feature: Add Self-Registered VeevaID Users to Vault
description: When a potential VeevaID user attempts to register for the first time, they will now be presented with any pending invites that they have been sent (provided those invites have not expired). They can then click the link to accept the invite and be added to the Vault(s).

feature: Migration Package Deployment Enhancements
description: With this feature, Migration Package logs appear as a single attachment, with each new log added as a new version. Additionally, the Retrieve Package Deploy Results API  now includes a URL to download a ZIP file containing all data deployment success and failure logs.

feature: Document Migration Mode Support for Document Relationships
description: Document Migration Mode now supports creating Document Relationships using Vault Loader or the API.

feature: Selected Entity Limit for Scheduled Data Exports
description: A new limit (30) on the max number of entities that can be included in Scheduled Data Exports (SDE). This limit will not be enforced on Vaults using SDE today with over 30 entities selected.

feature: Batch Release Plan Variation with Parent Plans
description: Plan Variation for Parent Plans allows customers to manage plans for hundreds and thousands of materials by sharing common Check requirements and varying material specific requirements.

feature: Check for Genealogy Batches
description: This feature adds items for a target batch's genealogy to a Check when enabled by its Check Requirement.

feature: By Exception Genealogy Check
description: This feature excludes items already checked and accepted in a disposition when checking genealogy batches.

feature: Configure Due Date Using Any Batch Date Field
description: This feature adds a new UI control to select the Batch Date or DateTime field that is used to calculate the Disposition and Check Due Dates.

feature: Implement & Evaluate Change Control Implementation Date
description: This feature creates items for Change Controls that were implemented prior to the batch manufacturing date.

feature: Change Control Check for Materials
description: Change Controls are used to manage the process of making changes to Materials in a manufacturing process. These Changes need to be approved before batches can be accepted.

feature: Evaluate Impact Batch field
description: This feature adds a new standard field on the Quality Event - Batch object, Impact Batch?, which determines whether the Disposition Check Item should be closed.

feature: PSUR: Periodic Safety Update Report
description: This feature adds a new process to facilitate MedTech users in the creation and management of Periodic Safety Update Reports (PSURs).

feature: Reason for Change: Support for Custom Objects
description: This feature expands the reason for change feature to support custom objects.

feature: External Collaboration: Reassign Task for New Person
description: This feature is to allow reassign for external collaboration tasks include new persons, that do not have user records associated.

feature: Create Record From Template: Support for Impact Assessments
description: This feature extends the existing Create Record from Template feature to include Impact Assessments. Administrators will now be able to configure approved Impact Assessment Templates that can be used to automatically create records.

feature: Create Related Record: Copy Related Object Data
description: Related Record Configuration is enhanced to include a new section that defines reference records to be copied when the Create Related Record action executes. The action is also now available as a User Action in addition to the existing Entry Action.

feature: External Collaboration: Impact Assessments & Change Actions
description: This feature will expand External Collaborator functionality to include the ability to assign an external collaborator a task to Impact Assessments and Change Actions.

feature: Inspection Readiness: Supporting Records
description: As part of the inspection request fulfillment, this feature allows users to add supporting records to an inspection request for supported objects and display those records to an Inspector through an App Section.

feature: Generate Merged PDF from Record
description: This feature allows users to generate a single PDF file by combining documents from all child records for the APQR and PSUR processes.

feature: Quality Event Suggestions
description: The Quality Suggestions feature offers field value recommendations for up to five fields and three associated related join objects. These suggestions are derived from an analysis of the top 100 similar records. This feature is supported for Complaints, Deviations, and Nonconformances, and their Quality Event object type equivalents.

feature: Execute Root Cause Analysis from Investigation
description: This feature allows a root cause record to be created from within an Investigation. Once the Root Cause is identified, the root cause record is associated to the parent Quality Event that launched the Investigation.

feature: Audit Room: Auto-Assignment
description: This feature expands on the Audit Room feature to provide Auto-Assignment for inspection requests. Auto-Assignment allows the user to auto-assign requests based on the category that is set in the inspection requests.

feature: Audit Room: Inspector Portal
description: This feature expands on the Audit Room feature to provide an Inspector Portal. The Inspector Portal is a UI-focused area for the Inspector to view the Inspection record and the associated Inspection Requests.

feature: Field Actions: Related Event Automation
description: This feature allows users to link Field Action records to other Quality Events in QMS.

feature: QMS: Download to PDF Enhancements
description: This feature supports the export of data contained in Action Steps, Template Process Steps, Reason for Change Audit Trail, and Auditor Qualifications application sections when Download to PDF is executed.

feature: 5 Whys Analysis: Save Button on Why Card
description: A Save button has been added to Why cards for 5 Whys Root Cause Analysis. Clicking outside the Why card will no longer save the record and instead will be replaced with the Save button.

feature: Document Control Homepage
description: This feature provides a role-specific homepage for the Document Control user in Quality. This page can serve as the landing page that provides a comprehensive view into key document control-specific processes. Users can also take certain key actions from this page such as send email reminders to workflow participants who have open tasks.

feature: Quality Relationships Panel: Bi-Directional Document Relationships
description: This feature adds a new Document Relationships section to the Quality Relationships panel where a document user can view both source and target (bi-directional) document relationships. Additionally, users with the appropriate permissions can also Create and Delete the relationships from this panel.

feature: Quality Relationships Panel: Document Change Request Section Enhancements
description: This feature enhances the existing Document Change Request (DCR) section of the Quality Relationships panel to provide additional configurability. Specifically, Vault Admins will be able to enable and disable this section, and the options for Create and Delete Document Change Request (DCR) will be removed.

feature: Process Navigator: User Interface Enhancements
description: This feature enhances the Process Navigator landing page to make the link to the Process Navigator detail page more prominent. Additionally, the user actions available to Process Owners and Admins will be consolidated into an Actions menu.

feature: Automated Station Document Assignment
description: This feature automates the assignment of Planned Station Documents to the Station Manager when the corresponding target documents reach their steady state.

feature: Station Manager: Modernized User Interface
description: This feature modernizes the user interface in the iOS and Android version of Station Manager via styling updates.

feature: Auto-Create Training Requirements
description: This feature adds automatic creation of Vault Document Training Requirements that occurs when the Document enters its Steady State.

feature: VPS: Japan AE Reporting XML
description: This feature will allow users to create XML template for Japan Adverse Event Reporting for our MedTech customers.

feature: VPS: Japan AE Reporting Custom UI
description: This feature will allow users to view and edit all the information needed for Japan Adverse Event Reporting on a single page

feature: VPS: Japan AE Reporting Data Model
description: This feature will provision the data model for Japan Adverse Event Reporting for our MedTech customers.

feature: VPS: Regulatory Updates Enhancements
description: This feature creates Adverse Event Reports for health authorities not yet supported in VPS. It also adds new validation rules based on the latest FDA updates.

feature: Health Canada: Data Mapping Enhancement
description: This feature modifies the A2 Submitter Details data mapping for Health Canada.

feature: Training Requirement Impact Assessment: Admin Alerts
description: This feature adds Admin Alerts that tell the user the impact of their decisions in the Training Requirement Impact Assessment (TRIA).

feature: Reconcile Retraining with TRIA Decisions
description: The Update Training Assignment job now checks for the retraining required decision on Training Requirement Impact Assessment records for a Training Requirement to determine if a Training Assignment is created for a Learner who has a completed Training Assignment for the Training Requirement.

feature: Auto-Manage Person Job Enhancements
description: The Auto-Manage Person job now sets the training eligibility for a person when the User's status changes and copies shared custom field values from User to Person.

feature: Enable Learner to Perform Actions on a Training Assignment
description: Custom Learner actions are now supported from the Learner Homepage’s History tab.

feature: Manager Homepage: Organization View
description: This adds an additional view to the existing My Team page for Managers. When toggled on, this view allows Managers to view training information about both direct and indirect reports.

feature: Training Enhancements
description: This feature includes minor enhancements to Veeva Training which do not require any configuration.

feature: Improved Navigation to Application Pages
description: Veeva Validation Management will now redirect users to the applicable authoring, execution, or review user interface when clicking on a test script record hyperlink from a list view, report, or object reference field.

feature: Template Requirement Refactoring
description: This feature will refactor the existing data model for Template Requirements to provide the same paradigm with other template capabilities, such as Template Test Protocol and Test script.

feature: Test Script Execution Review Comments
description: This feature allows the reviewers and approvers who are reviewing an executed test script in post approval to provide comments on specific steps and prompts, allowing for more specific feedback and commentary when a test script's execution requires re-execution or correction before it can be approved.

feature: Template Test Protocols & Test Scripts
description: This feature allows Template Managers to manage a library of template test protocols and test scripts that can be authored and made available for use by test script authors. Test script authors can then create new test protocols and test scripts from a template.

feature: Quick Create for Requirements & Specifications
description: This feature will streamline how user requirement, functional requirement, design specification, and configuration specification records are created by reducing the number of clicks involved to create a new record.

feature: Test Protocol Execution Review Comments
description: This feature adds support for commenting and collaboration between reviewers and executors during the test protocol review process.

feature: Comment Design Enhancements for Dry Run
description: This feature enhances comments in Dry Run for Test Scripts released in 24R3. Improvements include updated Add/Edit Comment forms, updated Comment  designs, and enhanced comment resolution/rejection behaviors in Authoring. These changes will impact both Dry Run and Authoring interfaces if Dry Run for Test Scripts has been enabled.

feature: Comment Filter Enhancements for Dry Run
description: This feature enhances the state filters to allow for more flexibility when filtering the comment panel and control for Admins to determine what the default filter should be for each interface.  This change impacts both the Dry Run and Authoring interfaces if Dry Run for Test Scripts has been configured and enabled.

feature: Responsive Side Panels for Application Pages
description: This feature updates the behavior for the width of the side panels for Authoring, Executing and Reviewing Test Scripts and Test Protocols. With this enhancement, the width of the side panel will automatically adapt based upon the resolution of the browser.

feature: Ukraine eCTD v1.2
description: This feature adds support for publishing and validating Ukraine eCTD Submissions based on the eCTD v1.2 Guidance

feature: Australia eCTD v3.2
description: This feature adds support for publishing and validating Australia eCTD Submissions based on the eCTD v3.2 Guidance. Users can generate warnings.xml files for submissions when necessary.

feature: Health Canada eCTD Validation Criteria Version 5.3
description: Publishing now supports and validates Health Canada eCTD Submissions based on the eCTD v5.3 Validation Criteria.

feature: Health Canada Non-eCTD Validation Criteria Version 5.3
description: Publishing now supports and validates Health Canada Non-eCTD Submissions based on version 5.3 of the eCTD Validation Criteria.

feature: Extract Health Authority Certificates from Publishing Gateway Profiles
description: US FDA Async ESG and EU EMA ESUB Gateway Profile will contain a new action to Download Certificates. The action will download the following certificates (if uploaded) on Active Gateway Profiles:  - Health Authority Certificate (in .p7b)  - Sponsor Private Certificate (in .pfx) - Sponsor Public Certificate (in .p7b)

feature: New Validation Rules for PDF Bookmarks
description: Validation Rules Rule16.BP8 and Rule16.BP9 have been created to validate PDF documents. The following regions should have the Veeva RIM Validation Criteria ID updated with the new criteria ID: - EU Validation Criteria v8.1 rules 16.BP8 and 16.BP9 - TW ValidationCriteria v1.0 rules P.BP7 and P.BP8

feature: New Validation Rule for Password-Protected ZIP Files
description: A new RIM rule (RuleRim104) has been created to check if ZIP files are password-protected. The RIM104 rule can be added added to any Validation Criteria Version. This rule can be configured on any Validation Criteria Version.

feature: New Validation Rule for Placeholder Files
description: A new RIM rule (RuleRim114) has been created to check for placeholder files in the published output. The rule will report when a file published to submissions archive results in a placeholder and the leaf operation of the CPI is not Delete. This rule can be configured on any Validation Criteria Version.

feature: RIM Publishing Scalability Enhancement
description: This feature adds performance improvements for the initial and continuous publishing framework. A job is no longer displayed for on-demand tasks on the Job Status page.

feature: Remove Control Characters from Published Output Location Upon Publishing
description: This feature removes ASCII control characters (excluding spaces) from the Published Output Location (xlink_href) of an XML file at publishing time. This ensures the folder structure of the published documents is valid if exported or sent via gateway.

feature: Allow Dosage Form Envelope Attribute for ZA Submissions to be Overridden
description: This feature allows for the Dosage Form envelope attribute to be overridden in Update Submission Administrative Information for South Africa eCTD submissions. The overridden value is carried forward to future sequences in the Application. Only one value for Dosage Form can be included in the envelope for ZA submissions.

feature: Activate Validation Results Archival Job on All Vaults
description: The Validation Results Archival Job is made active for all Vaults. The job will only effect customers with a Submissions Publishing license.

feature: Allow Product Name Envelope Attribute for WHO Submissions to be Overridden
description: This feature allows for the Product Name envelope attribute to be overridden in Update Submission Administrative Information for WHO PQT eCTD submissions. The overridden value is carried forward to future sequences in the application.

feature: Updated Validation Rules for Fillable Forms in US Submissions
description: This feature adds validation of fillable forms 2253 and 3674 for US validation rules 5 and 5030. Rules will execute against US forms submitted as fillable. If the form is not fillable, the rule will not execute.

feature: Add User-Facing Exceptions for Common Errors
description: This feature adds additional user-facing failure messages to the Publishing progress indicator for common failure modes.

feature: Increase Table of Contents Max Row Limit
description: This feature increases system generated TOC support to allow for 10k rows in a table of contents.

feature: Use System User to Export Published Submissions for Gateway Transmission
description: When exporting a submission to be sent via gateway, Publishing now exports the submission as the System user, bypassing any user-specific permissions that may result in an incomplete export.

feature: South Africa (ZA) eCTD Version 3.1 Document Matrix Updates
description: Validation rules 4.8.1, 4.8.2, 4.8.3, 4.8.4 have been updated to validate against the latest Document Matrix (version 2.3) Provided SAHPRA.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Data Model to Support eCTD 4.0
description: The data model to track eCTD 4.0 keywords was developed internally in 24R1. This feature will make minor updates to the data model (for example, relabel objects) and enable the data model in customer environments. This feature also includes Publishing data model changes and Registrations wizard support for new eCTD Keyword relationships.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Commitment Extraction
description: This feature provides the ability to extract health authority commitments from Correspondence documents to create Commitment records.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Updates to Health Authority Question Extraction
description: The following updates are made to HAQ Extraction: -The HAQ document panel is converted to 'Health Authority Interactions' -Changes to multi-select fields handling on the document -Question Source Document & Question Source are now editable -Annotations are created as resolved instead of unresolved -The HA Meeting HAQ relationship is auto-populated

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Updates to Commitment & HAQ Relationship Deletion Rules
description: The deletion rules for the parent fields on a number of Commitment & HAQ join relationships have been updated from Prevent Deletion to Cascade Deletion to facilitate easier deletion of HAQs & Commitments. The impacted objects are Commitment Application, Commitment Submission, HA Meeting Commitment, and HA Meeting HAQ.

feature: Bundling & Splitting: Validation Enhancements
description: This feature introduces dynamic validation logic to the Bundling wizards. It also implements several improvements to both Bundling and Splitting wizards, like the ability to choose which relationships are inactivated on the original Regulatory Objective.

feature: Create Related Records: Validation Enhancements
description: This feature provides enhancements to Create Related Records data validation for customers that have enabled the Submission Wizard.

feature: Create Related Records: Support for eCTD 4.0
description: Create Related Records can now propagate Extended eCTD Keywords from Events to Submissions and Regulatory Objectives to support eCTD 4.0 submissions.

feature: Bundling & Splitting: Support for eCTD 4.0
description: The Bundling and Splitting wizards can now propagate Extended eCTD Keywords Submissions and Regulatory Objectives to support eCTD 4.0 submissions.

feature: Enhanced Admin Settings for Medicinal Product Accelerator
description: This feature introduces a new Admin setting allowing users to configure the Medicinal Product Accelerator by Registration type.

feature: IDMP Support for Local Differences in Product Variant Attributes
description: This feature includes data model enhancements to better support the local variations in product variants. Additionally, the IDMP data aggregation algorithm is updated to identify and incorporate the market-specific product variant details in the IDMP submission data set.

feature: Registration Verification Workflow Behavior Harmonization
description: When the Start Registration Data Verification in Atomic Security is set to Hide, the workflow will not be executed for Single or Multi-record Verification and the error message will be in the csv file. This change harmonizes the behavior for the two types of registration verification workflow.

feature: Support EUDAMED UDI Submissions for Master UDI-DI
description: This feature supports UDI submissions to EUDAMED with Master UDI-DIs to support submissions for contact lenses.

feature: Create Event Details: Shelf Life or Condition Filtering Enhancements
description: With this feature, Create Event Details now limits the values users can select for Shelf Life or Condition as well as Storage Condition based on the object type. For example, users will only be able to select Bulk Ingredient shelf life values applicable to the selected Inactive Ingredients.

feature: Splitting Support for Enhanced Change Management
description: The Splitting wizards have been updated to support enhanced change management, which provides the ability to track product changes at a more granular level than an Activity.

feature: Create Related Records: Optional Preview
description: This feature makes the Create Related Records preview optional where enabled. Users will now be able to skip directly to record creation on the last step if they do not want to preview data.

feature: Create Related Records: Support for Application Relationships with Lifecycles
description: In certain scenarios, Create Related Records attempts to activate application relationships that are inactive. Prior to this feature, if the object had a lifecycle, this operation would fail. Now the operation will succeed by transitioning inactive records to the initial lifecycle state.

feature: GCP Dispatch to Respect User-Selected Document Sets
description: The dispatch process is updated to respect the Document Sets the user selects in the dispatch dialog. A new field is added to the Dispatch Message object to track the Document Sets included in the dispatch or comparison. Document Sets tracked on the Dispatch Message are also respected when the user chooses to Regenerate Comparison.

feature: Comparison Viewer Changes Saved Across Users
description: Previously, the Comparison Viewer only stored changes per individual user so that two users could not see each other's selections. Changes synced to the target Content Plan were based on the user who completed the Comparison review. With this feature, review changes are now saved across multiple users to facilitate collaborative review.

application: RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Active Dossier: Product Information & Registrations Tracking
description: This feature introduces new relationships that relate Active Dossier Item Detail with Registration, Product Variant, Manufacturer, & Inactive Ingredient for more granular tracking of these details in Active Dossier. These relationships are auto-created during Active Dossier population & are supported in the Viewer & Editor.

application: RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Active Dossier Generation from Dispatch: Respect Enable Active Dossier Generation
description: Active Dossier Generation from Global Content Plan Dispatch is updated to respect the Enable Active Dossier Generation (enable_active_dossier_generation__v) field on the Application so that Active Dossier records are not created by the dispatch for Applications where the field is set to No.

application: RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Active Dossier Generation from Dispatch: Update to Pending Current Visibility
description: This enhancement sets the country status in the Active Dossier Country Overview with the Dispatched icon for Active Dossier records created in the Pending Current status from a Global Content Plan dispatch. This allows the records to be visible before confirming pending current.

feature: Compare & Merge Submission Content Plans
description: This feature supports the ability to create or update a target SCP by comparing from a source SCP with the ability to select specific sections, exclude matched documents, and review comparison before syncing changes.

feature: Content Plan Creation Support for ASMF/APIMF
description: In order to comply with the differing naming required for ASMF/APIMF Restricted Part (RP) and Applicant/Open Part (AP/OP), a picklist field is added to the Active Substance relationship to allow the user to distinguish whether it is RP or AP/OP. Content Plan creation respects this field and creates the correct CP sections accordingly.

feature: Multi-Record Workflows From Content Plan Viewer
description: This feature adds the ability to initiate bulk workflows on CPs or CPIs directly from the Content Plan Viewer.

feature: Drag & Drop to Reorder Content Plans & Content Plan Items
description: This feature adds the ability to drag and drop Content Plan and Content Plan Items to reorder their position in the CP Viewer. Re-parenting is not supported.

feature: Drag & Drop from Desktop to Content Plan Items With No Document Type
description: Users can now drag and drop to match documents from desktop to a CPI with no Full Document Type. The first step is to classify documents prior to reviewing document metadata. The toast for document upload and match progress is also updated to distinguish when existing documents are matched from library where duplicate content detection is enabled.

feature: Global Content Plan Updates for Region & Country Handling
description: This feature adds the ability to automatically create the Submission Country relationship for the Global Submission's Lead Market to support creation of GCP sections for the Lead Market. Documents-only dispatch logic is updated to include documents that are matched to CPIs created for the Global Submission's Lead Market.

feature: Submissions: Increase Mini-Browser Window Size
description: This feature increases the size of the mini-browser when a document is popped-out in another window to display the full document viewer by default, including the action menu and right rail.

feature: Job Title Update: Submissions Archive Cleanup
description: The always-enabled Submissions Archive Cleanup system-managed job has its Title updated from CLEANUP_SUBMISSION_TEMPORARY_FILES. This is visible to Admins on the Operations > Job Status page.

feature: Singapore (SG) eCTD v1.0
description: Submissions Archive supports importing, viewing, and exporting Singaporean submissions using the SG 1.0 Document Type Definition (DTD) for eCTD submissions.

feature: Australia (AU) eCTD v3.2
description: Submissions Archive supports importing, viewing, and exporting Australian submissions using the AU 3.2 Document Type Definition (DTD) for eCTD submissions.

feature: Ukraine (UA) eCTD v1.2
description: Submissions Archive supports importing, viewing, and exporting Ukrainian submissions using the UA eCTD 1.2 DTD. The UA DTD remains at version 1.0. New imports of UA eCTD 1.0 pilot submissions will display per 1.2 expectations. However, 1.0 pilot submissions imported before this update will continue to display according to the 1.0 specification.

feature: Submissions Archive Viewer: Mini-Browser To Front
description: This feature allows users to bring the Mini-Browser to the forefront when it is obscured by open Vault browser windows or other computer applications by clicking the Mini-Browser pop-out button located anywhere it appears in Submissions Archive Viewer.

feature: Improved Notification for Imports with Long File Names
description: Submissions Archive notifies the user when submission packages contain filenames that exceed the maximum allowed byte length.

feature: Active Dossier Editor Enhancements: Inline Editing, Move & Edit Product Information Fields
description: This feature introduces enhancements to the Active Dossier Editor, including support for inline editing, moving records to a different Active Dossier Structure, and the edit of Product Information fields. A new In Merge field will be auto-added to the Active Dossier Item Detail layout & the Merge Record permission should be configured for move.

feature: Update Active Dossier Translation Document During Population from Submission
description: Active Dossier population from a submission now updates the Translation Document on existing Active Dossier Item Detail (ADID) records based on the submission's documents. Previously, this field was only set when the ADID is first created and not set for existing ADIDs.

feature: Move Saved View Selector in Active Dossier Viewer
description: The location of the Saved View selector in Active Dossier has changed to be next to the Save button in the Active Dossier Viewer header.

feature: Pop-Out Icon Added to Active Dossier Viewer Country Hovercard
description: A pop-out icon has been added to the header of the country hovercard in the Active Dossier Viewer's Country Overview layout. This allows the Active Dossier Item Detail record to be opened in a pop-out window, promoting more direct and easier access to the record.

feature: Active Dossier Country Hovercard to Respect Global Filters
description: The Country hovercard has been enhanced to respect the applied global filters. This allows the proper record to display when there are multiple Active Dossier Item Details for an Active Dossier Item and Country.

feature: Increase Active Dossier Viewer Limit
description: The Active Dossier Viewer limit has been increased for the Item Detail layout from 500 to 2,000 Active Dossier Item Detail rows. There is no change to the limit for the Country Overview layout.

feature: Document Intake Panel
description: Safety improves case intake from unstructured or semi-structured source documents. This feature is available only for early adopters.

feature: Rules Based Narrative Generation
description: With this release, Admins can configure rules for narrative generation.

feature: Case Lifecycle State Change Error Handling
description: This release enhances how Vault handles instances when Case lifecycle state changes cannot complete during Case promotion.

feature: AS2 Connection: Uncompressed Request Setting
description: This feature supports sending uncompressed AS2 messages. Although this feature is Auto-on, some components require additional configuration.

feature: Destination-Specific Case Document Management Improvements
description: This feature introduces more flexibility and control over literature article and attachment inclusion on E2B reports.

feature: Auto-Submit & Localization Transmission Handling
description: Safety can now automatically regenerate Transmission documents for auto-submit email Transmissions, supports standardizing hiding Localized Cases until global approval, and introduces an action for Japan Localized Cases that combines generating Case Product Registrations and related records when evaluating Case reportability.

feature: Validation Query Builder: Expression Engine for Intake Validations
description: This feature introduces the Expression Engine for Sender-Based Inbound Validations for intake validations.

feature: NMPA E2B(R3)
description: Safety supports the generation of the NMPA E2B(R3) for early adopter testing of submissions to the NMPA.

feature: AS2 Connection: ACK on MDN URL Setting
description: Safety now supports AS2 Partners who send ACKs using the same URL as their Message Disposition Notification (MDN).

feature: Email to Inbox Item: Email Attachment Classification
description: This feature introduces configurable handling of email and attachment classifications from PV email inboxes.

feature: Expectedness for Investigational-Marketed Study Products
description: Safety now supports using postmarket datasheets when evaluating expectedness in marketed products involved in clinical trial studies.

feature: Blind Isolation: Simplified Study Product Unblinding
description: In Vaults with the Isolate Blinded Product Information feature configured, this feature introduces an action that creates unblinded records for all blinded Study Products on a Case.

feature: Case Processing Operational Metrics
description: This feature introduces tools, such as quantifying Case processing times and provisioning standard report types, that support operational report and dashboard creation.

feature: Inactivate Products and Studies
description: With this release, Safety will support the ability to deprecate Products in the Product Library and Studies in the Study Library

feature: Extend Company Product Match Verification to All Suspect Products
description: This feature extends product match coding verification on Inbox Items to all suspect Company Products.

feature: Standard Configuration Only Security Profile: Safety Objects
description: This feature introduces the Configuration Only security profile to support roles that can manage configuration without access to data and documents.

feature: PMDA Post-Market Aggregate Report: Consider Product Registrations & Calculate Expectedness
description: With this release, the NUPR Line Listing Form 7-2 tabulation of the PMDA Post-Market Aggregate Report includes expectedness and considers product registrations.

feature: Korea Drug Dictionary  Browser and Search for Korean External Products
description: With this release, Safety will support coding of External Products against the Korean Drug Dictionary for Domestic and Foreign Localized cases.

feature: Online Questionnaires for Follow-Ups Updates
description: This feature enables document generation for manual method follow-up questionnaires from configured document templates and supports translating online questionnaire emails.

feature: Auxiliary Medicinal Product Support
description: The Safety DSUR report now supports Auxiliary Medicinal Products on the Interval Line Listings, Cumulative Tabulations. Additionally, the Safety Rule Engine now supports Auxiliary Medicinal Products for ICSR reporting.

feature: AS2 Connection: ACK Processor
description: Safety now supports uploading AS2 ACKs received from outside of the standard AS2 communication methods and matching them to the corresponding Transmission.

feature: Blind Protect Device Constituent for Unblinded Combination Study Product
description: In Vaults with the Isolate Blinded Product Information feature configured, this feature adds blind protection for open-label device constituents that are part of unblinded Combination Study Products.

feature: Case-Level File Format Validation for Local Destinations
description: This feature enhances Case-level file generation validation of ICH file format conformance for local destinations.

feature: Enhanced One Last Time Reporting for Transmission Output Templates
description: Safety now considers transmissions created from Transmission Output Templates when evaluating One Last Reporting.

feature: PMDA E2B(R3): Substance Validation Criteria Updates
description: This feature introduces Validation Criteria to warn users when fewer than seven (7) characters are exported to the G.k.2.3.r.1 data element of PMDA E2B(R3) files for Case Product Substances related to Case Products with a Japan Product Code Type of J-Drug Code.

feature: Recalculate Due Date Keyboard Shortcut
description: This feature introduces a keyboard shortcut for an action that recalculates the due dates on a Case.

feature: Duplicate Detection Search Updates
description: This feature improves the accuracy of potential matches during duplicate detection.

feature: Updated Cross Reporting Logic for Non-Company Sponsored Studies
description: This feature updates the reporting rule engine logic for non-Company Products and Company Sponsored and non-Company Sponsored Studies.

feature: PMDA MHLW Paper Forms
description: Safety introduces the generation of PMDA MHLW Paper Forms.

feature: Case Follow-Up Compare with Summary
description: This feature updates the Inbox Item to Case Compare page with a summary of new and modified information, clarified filtering, and new visual indicators for special fields.

feature: Case Access Group Security: Country Update for Inbox Items and Cases
description: Safety now prevents users with specific country assignments on their User Access Group Assignment records from seeing Inbox Items and Cases without a Country value.

feature: PMDA: Reportable Case Product Registration Generation Updates
description: This feature updates the Retrieve Reportable Case Product Registrations action to always clear previous Case Product Registrations and generate new Case Product Registrations using the latest data.

feature: Follow-Ups to Domestic Cases from Global Inbox Items: Japan Update
description: This release updates the Follow-Ups to Domestic Cases from Global Inbox Items feature to prevent merging non-PMDA domestic Inbox Items to in-flight or follow-up PMDA domestic Cases.

feature: Regions for Countries
description: This feature introduces standard regions for grouping countries.

feature: Add Product Quality Complaints Event Type to Inbox Item
description: This release supports classifying medical events as Product Quality Complaints (PQCs) on Inbox Items.

feature: Signal Case Series
description: Safety Signal introduces Signal Case Series, which preserves a static list of Case versions and related data sets for signal analysis. Organizations with a Safety Workbench license can analyze this data through Workbench Dashboards.

feature: Schedule Signal Calculations & Alerts
description: This feature automates signal detection on a monthly schedule configured by Admins.

feature: Signal Alert Rule Engine
description: Safety Signal introduces the Signal Alert Rule Engine to identify Statistical Data records that meet predefined thresholds.

feature: Upload to Library
description: This feature introduces uploading Workbench Reports directly to the Vault Library.

feature: Multi-Value Picklists and Updated Filter Logic
description: This release enhances filtering capabilities that support data analysis.

feature: Standardized Workbench Views
description: Safety Workbench adds the capability to build standard views to support business processes.

feature: Workbench PADER for Combination Products
description: Safety Workbench now includes three (3) PADER reports for Cases that include combination products with a malfunctioned device constituent.

feature: Workbench SUSAR Reports
description: Safety Workbench now includes blinded and unblinded SUSAR reports.

feature: Use Registrations from Submissions for Workbench PADERs
description: With this release, Workbench PADERs support generating the Cases Submitted under other NDA’s report and consider Product Registrations when adding Cases to reports.

feature: Workbench Report Sets
description: This feature supports generating and downloading multiple related Workbench Reports in one action and includes the capability to create Workbench Report Set Definitions.

feature: Localization for Dates & Times
description: This feature introduces a standardized approach to handling timezones across ad-hoc and periodic reports.

feature: Workbench Dashboard Tabs
description: This feature introduces tabs and increases the number of supported components on Workbench Dashboards.

feature: Share Filters in Workbench Dashboards
description: Users can now save and share data analysis results from Workbench Dashboards.

feature: PVA Scheduling
description: SafetyDocs can now automatically schedule obligations of any PVAs managed within Vault.

feature: Highlight Literature Abstract Terms
description: This feature introduces the ability to automatically highlight key terms in literature abstracts.

feature: Literature Integration to PubMed
description: SafetyDocs is now integrated directly with PubMed, supporting automated literature searches and article intake.

feature: PSMF Annex H Report Type Standardization
description: This feature updates grouping and filtering Product Registrations on the PSMF Annex H Report Type.

feature: EMA MLM RIS Literature File Support
description: This feature supports the intake of literature references from EMA MLM RIS (European Medicines Agency Medical Literature Monitoring Research Information Systems) files.

feature: Risk Management Enhancements
description: This feature enhances Risk Management capabilities for Local Risk Measures and document management.

feature: Clinical Operations-Veeva Medical CRM: Improved User Exception Message Processing
description: A single User Exception Message (UEM) is created on each Job run per Integration to consolidate all failed Items. Additionally, the Integration's Last Successful Run Time will always update unless a Message Processing Error occurs. The next Job run processes new and updated records, along with previously failed items stored in the most recent UEM.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Visit Filtering
description: This feature enables filtering capabilities when retrieving visits from EDC.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Improved User Exception Message Processing
description: Each pull job processes new, updated, and failed records, skipping successful ones. The Last Run Time updates every run, even with errors, and failed items (Based on User Exceptions) retry until successful, then update the Last Successful Run Time.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Enhanced Review Summaries for EDC Log Events
description: This feature improves the efficiency of subject visit handling in the Clinical Operations-EDC Connection and adds SDV/DMR summaries to log events.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Originating Site
description: This feature enhances subject transfers between sites during a trial. CTMS will retain past visits, procedures, and protocol deviations at the original site while assigning new ones to the new site. It applies to visits, procedures, and deviations created or modified after deployment.

feature: Safety-Clinical Operations Connection: New Integration Field Rule
description: With this release, Safety-Clinical Connection includes a field rule for the Study Type field on the Study object. This rule is inactive in all Vaults.

feature: Safety-Clinical Operations Connection: Update to Send to Vault Clinical Criteria
description: With this release, the Send to Vault Clinical action is visible only when the Patient Content Protection field of the Transmission record contains a value.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Support Custom Mappings to Standard Safety Fields
description: This feature allows EDC Admins to create custom mappings to standard fields in the Safety Case data model.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Unexpected Pregnancy Support
description: The Safety-EDC Connection now supports the transfer of safety cases from more than one study form from EDC to Safety.

feature: LIMS: Initiate Lab Investigation
description: This feature adds the ability for LIMS to initiate a Lab Investigation process in QMS. As the process progresses through completion in QMS, LIMS users are aware of the status.

feature: PromoMats-Medical Connection: Anchor Persistent ID Support
description: Anchors created by the connection in the target Vault have Persistent IDs that match the source Vault's anchor Persistent ID.

feature: Medical-Safety Connection: Support Case Product Indication, Case Cause of Death
description: With this feature, the connection will support Case Product Indication and Case Cause of Death in Safety.

feature: Document Product Registration Check
description: You can now leverage product and registration hierarchies from Veeva RIM to ensure the document has one approved registration for country and any product related document fields using a new formula function. If the registration becomes withdrawn, the document is withdrawn automatically via the Auto Expire Documents (Withdrawn Registrations) job.

feature: Quality-RIM Connection: Enhanced Change Control
description: This feature adds a new connection between Quality and RIM for Change Controls that allows a many-to-many relationship between Change Controls and Manufacturing Events in Regulatory.

feature: Quality-Safety Connection: Transfer PQCs Found in Veeva Safety to Veeva Quality
description: Veeva Safety now supports the automatic transfer of Product Quality Complaints (PQCs) to Veeva Quality. These discovered PQCs are sent via a standard connection with all relevant patient and product information needed for the quality complaint intake process.

feature: RIM-Clinical Operations Connection: CrossLink Creation Update
description: When CrossLink documents are created by the connection, documents are created in a Draft state and then promoted to a Steady state (Approved). If any entry criteria exist on the document's Approved state which aren't met from the data in the source document (for example, the document date is blank), a processing error will occur. Entry criteria should be updated.

feature: RIM-Clinical Operations Connection: Respect Archived Studies on Clinical CrossLinks
description: If the RIM source document includes a clinical study that is in the archived lifecycle state in Veeva Clinical Operations, then the archived study is removed from the Study field when the CrossLink is created.

feature: Study Training Logs Auto-File to eTMF
description: This feature allows Study Training completions to automatically file in eTMF at the end of a study.

feature: Subartifact Support for Create Trip Report System Action
description: Customers can configure the Create Trip Report System Action to include a subartifact value. The subartifact value will be included on the document metadata when the document is generated.

feature: CTMS Licensing: Enrollment Metrics Tracking
description: CTMS Licensing now includes Enrollment Metrics actuals usage when tracking CTMS licenses on the Study Site License objects. The CTMS flag is updated to True for a Study Site when Enrollment Metrics include actual values greater than zero.

feature: Protocol Deviation Categories & Subcategory Transfer Enhancements
description: Users can now select the Other value for the Subcategory field in Outbound Clinical Mappings for CTMS Transfer. Additionally, Vault populates the new Source Category and Source Subcategory text fields on the Issue (pdv__ctms) object with the original values from the source Protocol Deviation when an Admin activates the fields for CTMS Transfer.

feature: Last Subject Milestones: Incomplete Subject Status Dates
description: This feature allows a user to exclude a Subject record with blank status dates from the automated population of the Actual Finish Date field on last subject-related Milestone records at the site level.

feature: Monitored Study Site Addresses
description: Customers can now document Study Site Addresses visited during Monitoring Events through the Monitored Study Site Address object. This object creates a snapshot of the Site Address visited at the time of the visit.

feature: Last Subject Milestones: Preferred End of Treatment Date
description: The Last Subject Treated Milestone is completed with the End of Treatment Date if at least one Subject has an End of Treatment Date. *This feature is Auto-on in Vaults configured for Enable Automated Enrollment Milestones. Other Vaults require configuration.

feature: Last Subject Milestones: Earlier Last Subject Screened Population
description: Checking No New Subjects after screening completion populates the Last Subject Screened Milestone with the latest Screened Date. Last Subject Enrolled, Randomized, and Started Treatment Milestones populate only when all subjects are screen failed or enrolled/randomized. *This feature is Auto-on in Vaults configured for Enable Automated Enrollment Milestones. Other Vaults require configuration.

feature: Recruitment Planning: Consistency & Error Handling Improvements
description: This features enhances the Create Metrics Over Time action for Study, Study Country, Study Site, and Subject Group to notify users if errors are encountered, handle duplicate metric records, and adds minor updates to improve consistency.

feature: CTMS Transfer: Oversight Issues from Sponsor to CRO
description: CTMS Transfer now allows Sponsors to send Oversight Issues and related Milestones, Issues, and Monitoring Events to their CRO partner via a CTMS Transfer Agreement. The Oversight Issues are read-only in the CRO Vault. This feature converts the Oversight Issue-Issue, Oversight Issue-Milestone, and Oversight Issue-Monitoring Event objects to complex joins.

feature: Subject Transfer Support for Seeding Subject Visits on Monitoring Events
description: This feature enhances the Seed Monitored Enrollment and Proactively Seed Monitored Enrollment actions, used in Monitoring Events, to support subject transfer scenarios. With this update, the subject visits seeded into a Monitoring Event are limited to visits at the Subject's current Study Site.

feature: Removed Vault Setting: Prevent User Updates to Date-Based Metric Actual Field
description: The Actual field on the Metrics object is now locked from editing directly for studies with the Metrics Calculation value of 'Date Based’ for all Vaults. The feature is now enabled for Vaults that opted out of the change in 24R2.

feature: Additional Source Text Fields for Transfers
description: This feature adds a new active Source Subartifact text field to the TMF Document type which is be populated by TMF Transfer if the Source document is associated with a Subartifact. Source Milestone Type and Source Monitoring Event Type text fields are also added as Inactive to the Milestone and Monitoring Event objects for use by CTMS Transfer.

feature: Clinical Transfer CDX Enhancements
description: CTMS Transfer now triggers the activation and inactivation of Recurring Milestones in the Sponsor Vault. Additionally, Agreement Transfers which run for more than 24 hours are now automatically terminated and moved to the Completed state.

application: CTMS, OpenData Clinical, Study Startup, eTMF
feature: Available as Study Site Field Added to Organization
description: This feature introduces a new field, "Available as Study Site," on the Organization object. When activated, Vault will ensure that only records with a value of TRUE can be referenced by Study Sites. This control helps ensure proper usage of Global Directory records.

feature: Enable Child Object Security in Clinical Operations
description: This feature enables new platform feature: Child Object Security on select objects in Clinical Operations.
