application: CTMS, Payments, Site Connect, Study Startup, eTMF
feature: Specialized Responsibilities
description: Customers can now create and manage specialized responsibilities to support Responsibility based training of Site Staff. Specialized responsibilities can be created by Admins and must be a child of one of Veeva's standard responsibilities.

application: CTMS, Payments, Site Connect, Study Startup, eTMF
feature: Study Responsibilities
description: Customers can now create and manage Study Responsibilities to support Responsibility based training of Site Staff.

application: CTMS, Payments, Site Connect, Study Startup, eTMF
feature: Enhanced Study Person Responsibility Selection Dialog
description: The responsibility selection dialog for Study Personnel has been updated to list Study Responsibilities. It lists Study Responsibilities and visually groups Specialized Responsibilities under their Standard Responsibility.

feature: Subartifact Support for Create Related Document from Template System Action
description: Customers can configure the Create Related Document from Template System Action to include a subartifact value. The subartifact value is included on the document metadata when the document is generated. This is commonly used for payment letters and Monitoring Event confirmation and follow up letters.

feature: Generate Document from Formatted Output
description: This feature introduces a new action to generate a library document based on a formatted output template. The action can be configured as an entry action or user action on any object lifecycle. Currently, the action does not up-version existing documents and creates a new document every time.

feature: Study Migration Status Bulk Update API
description: An API is now available for enabling bulk updates to Study Migration Mode. Admins and developers can activate or deactivate Migration Mode for multiple studies simultaneously. Historically, this was only done manually in the Vault UI.

application: CTMS, Site Connect, Study Startup, eTMF
feature: New Standard Study Team Roles & Application Roles
description: This feature introduces new standard Study Team Roles & Application Roles for several site-facing roles: Budgets & Contracts, Data Coordinator, Other Non-Investigator, Pharmacist, Regulatory Coordinator, and Research Nurse. These records are delivered as inactive in all Vaults.

feature: Content Defaulting Refactor
description: This feature enhances the UX mainly around document types that will never have unblinding content. First, the system looks at the Masking field on the Study, and if it is Open-Label, the content will be Blinded. Next, if the document type default value does not include Allow Unblinded, the document defaults to Blinded as well.

feature: Selective Ad Hoc Events
description: This feature allows users to select Study Countries and Study Sites for an Ad Hoc Event so that Milestones and Expected Documents are created only for the chosen selections.

feature: Default Contact Information for Sync PI
description: Study Persons created by the Sync PI with Study Person feature now have their Primary Contact Information value defaulted when only one reference record is available and the "Pre-default on non-required field when only one reference record is available" setting is checked for the Primary Contact Information field.

feature: Alphabetize Story Events
description: This feature updates the Ad Hoc Event menu to display Story Events in alphabetical order.

feature: Prevent Re-Defaulting Content Field on Reclassification
description: This feature removes the behavior to re-default the Content field when a user reclassifies or changes the Study, Study Country, or Study Site of a document. The re-defaulting behavior was causing issues by inadvertently moving documents from Blinded to Unblinded and therefore being hidden from normal view.

feature: ClinicalTrials.gov API Two-Way Enhancements
description: This feature enhances the ClinicalTrials.gov PRS API to poll nightly for any updated studies, for whether a study has comments, and then on Vault update a new Registry Tracker object with the retrieved information. Includes the ability to retrieve the comments flag on records, and create notifications when comments are updated. It also includes creating a link to ClinicalTrials.gov portal for the study's comments, and capturing the NCTID.

feature: Posting Documents to ClinicalTrials.gov
description: Disclosures users can now include and submit documents with the XML Generation and API Submission to ClinicalTrials.gov.

feature: Company Website Disclosures Support: Custom Fields & XML
description: This feature provides Disclosures support for customers' company clinical trial websites by supporting XML submission file creation of a custom format which includes configured custom fields.

feature: Check for Updates & Update Disclosure Data
description: Users can now check for CTMS updates between the Disclosures and the latest data in CTMS, and users can review and select changes to update.

feature: Disclosures: Copy Protocol & US Validation Enhancements
description: Disclosures have been enhanced with Copy Entire Protocol functionality and additional US Registration Validations.

feature: Enhancements for Triggering Disclosures
description: Disclosures triggers now include a new Trigger Rule off New Subject Screened Milestone, a Compliance Date that is calculated by Disclosure Rules and applied to the disclosure when generated (unlike Due Date, this cannot be changed), additional prepopulation from new Study and Protocol fields, and a Reason Created Label added to Disclosures when auto generated.

feature: Multilingual Models
description: This feature updates auto-classification and metadata extraction functionality to accept documents in languages other than English.

feature: eTMF License Calculation
description: Calculation of eTMF site licenses is now based on the presence of a document mapped to the TMF Reference Model (excluding CTMS and SSU specific document types).

feature: Investigator Affiliation to Multiple Sites
description: This feature creates multiple Contact Information records in Vault for OpenData Clinical investigators who are affiliated with multiple research sites, and allows customers to select which site affiliation is considered primary for their business purposes.

feature: Parent Site Records
description: This feature delivers parent organization records as part of the OpenData Clinical data set, and updates delivered site records to reference their parent. With this, multiple departments within a large center will be aligned by a clear, simple hierarchy.

feature: Generate Payment Requests Populates Source
description: The value of Sponsor/CRO is now populated in the Payment Source field on Payment Requests when generating a Payment Request using the standard system action. The Payment Source field is only visible in Site Connect by default, but it populates for all Payments customers.

feature: Subartifact Support for Site Packages
description: This feature introduces Subartifact support within document exchange for Site Connect when Subartifacts are configured.

feature: Revoke Site Connect Access
description: This feature enhances the Revoke Access from Study Persons with End Date job to additionally revoke Site Connect access.

feature: Respect Start & End Dates on Responsibilities
description: Sponsors/CROs can now control when Site Connect will stop allowing access to or sending notifications for various capabilities by entering an appropriate start and end date on the relevant Study Person Responsibility.

feature: Document Exchange Responsibility
description: Document notifications are now only sent to study persons with a "Maintain Essential Documents" responsibility, which is defaulted based on the Document Exchange Recipient field on study team role. PI, SubI, CRC, and Reg Coordinator roles have this field checked by default. This responsibility is created for all Site Connect users with the release.

feature: Safety Distribution Responsibility
description: Primary or secondary safety recipients are now determined by the "Assess Safety Notifications (Primary)/(Secondary)" responsibilities, which are defaulted to a study person based on the Primary or Secondary Safety Distribution Recipient field on study team role. The appropriate responsibility is created for existing study persons with the release.

feature: Support VeevaID Email Change
description: Site Connect supports VeevaID email change by ensuring records in Clinical Operations are updated with the appropriate email. This ensures site users continue to have access to the right studies. This feature may not be validated in pre-release Vaults.

feature: Sync Auto-Requests with Automatic Document Exchange
description: This feature enhances automated document exchange from expected documents functionality. Now the system dynamically creates document requests and cancels open requests based on changes to # Expected and All document count. Additionally, Person, Org and Product Expected Documents now apply those values to the site-returned document.

feature: Site Connect Hardening
description: This feature ensures Site Connect functions optimally by filing Provide Original documents to the requested classification, preserving "Completed By/Date" on distributions, maintaining access to approved documents, updating job run times, enabling bulk user management, failing distributions for inactive users, and ensuring large gap packs are email accessible.

feature: Site Connect Vault Clinical Document Updates
description: Vault Clinical Document mappings in Site Connect have been updated. Site Training Material can now be sent to and received from sites. Regulatory Notification of Trial can now be sent to sites. IP Shipment Documentation can now be sent to and received from sites.

feature: USN Sign Up Enhancements
description: Sites are now required to provide their department name and contact information during USN sign up. When their USN sign up is approved or rejected, they will receive a confirmation email.

feature: Completed Survey Notification
description: The system can now automatically file survey responses in the TMF and send a downloadable PDF copy to site survey respondents.

feature: Update Survey Invitation Validation Rule
description: Update the Next Reminder Date cannot be in the past validation rule on Site Survey Invitations and Outreach Target Survey Invitations to ignore records that are inactive or expired, and allow the validation rule to be inactivated.

feature: Electronic CDA
description: Customers can now enable an electronic CDA process directly within Site Feasibility Surveys, including recipient verification and automated CDA document generation. Survey template setup is required to leverage this feature.

feature: Update Survey USN Banner
description: The Site Survey USN banner has more concise instruction text, additional color, and buttons instead of hyperlinks.

feature: Study-Level Expected Documents in Multi-Country & Site Submission
description: This feature enhances Multi-Country and Site Submissions so that Milestones with Select Specific Country and Site enabled can link to Expected Documents at higher levels.

feature: Milestone Study Sites App Section Default Columns
description: Add Study Site to the Milestone Study Sites app section default columns list.

feature: Study Document Audit Trail Export
description: A new action is available on the Study object to allow the user to export the full study document audit log.

feature: Risk-Based Document QC
description: Users can now associate risks with document types and have the system facilitate sampling of documents to QC.

feature: Training Matrix Draft
description: When building a Training Matrix, users can save changes as a draft instead of immediately committing updates.

feature: Study Training Matrix Builder Enhancements
description: The Study Training Matrix Builder is enhanced to automatically filter records by Study, and the section previously labeled "Global" is now called "Study".

feature: OCR for Images in PowerPoint & Word Files
description: Microsoft Office Word and PowerPoint source documents that contain images will undergo for Optical Character Recognition (OCR).

feature: Commercial Content Kernel Updates
description: A new document type is available in the Commercial Content Kernel for Brand Guidelines. Also, the description for the References > Labeling document subtype is updated to include Medication Guides.

feature: Portal: Dynamic Widgets
description: Vault now supports Dynamic Portal Widgets, allowing users to automatically populate Portal widgets with documents using Custom Views from the Vault Library or Portal Library. Unlike static widgets, which require manual curation, dynamic widgets update automatically as documents enter the Vault that match the defined filter criteria.

feature: Claims: Auto-Linking Deduplication
description: Auto-Linking now only provides new links with each run and does not re-suggest previously rejected links.

feature: Text Assets: Product Data Model for Auto-Linking
description: Auto-Linking now includes product family, product form, and product variant when considering text assets to link.

feature: Product Family Generic Name Field Length Increase
description: This feature increases the Generic Name (generic_name__v) field on the Product Family (product_family__v) object to 500 characters. Previously, the maximum length for this field was 100 characters.

feature: eCTD: Empty Required Fields Warning Message
description: A warning message is now displayed to the user when documents in a submission package have required document fields with no value.

feature: PromoMats Notification Templates: Vault Support Updated to Veeva Support
description: This feature replaces the phrase Vault Support with Veeva Support in select Notification Templates email body and notification text.

feature: MLR Bot
description: MLR Bot uses GenAI to execute quality checks on documents; spelling, grammar, red flag phrases, boxed warning, ISI comparison, privacy/unsubscribe link validation. Users can also analyze the document via an AI chat assistant. Customers can use their own LLM or the default LLM chosen by Veeva. This is for early adopters only in 25R2. This feature may not be validated in pre-release Vaults.

feature: System Suitability Testing
description: Organizations can ensure a system (equipment, instrument) is suitable for use before or during sample testing. Test Definitions can have Variations for Quality Control (QC) Sample types, QC Samples can have their own acceptance criteria, workflows can automatically launch for QC samples that don’t meet criteria, and Test Sets can be invalidated.

feature: Test Definition: Operational Criteria
description: This feature allows the definition of Test Set Results (method parameters) for each Test Definition. These results are specific to the entire Test Set and have its own Test Definition Criteria. Set Results are evaluated during test execution and flagged if the result does not meet criteria.

feature: Calculation: Log Function Support
description: This feature adds two new functions when creating formulas/expressions. The ‘log’ function can be specified with any valid base number (ex: base 10) while the ‘ln’ function assumes a base number of ‘e’ for a natural logarithm.

feature: Stability: Pull Window & Pull Compliance
description: This feature supports different early and late pull windows and updates the Review Study Overview UX on both Study Design and Study sides. It also adds Pull Compliance tracking for Lab Samples to monitor if pulls occur within the defined windows.

feature: Quantity Tracking for Stability Studies
description: This feature enables detailed quantity tracking in Stability Studies, including planned, backup, pulled, and disposed quantities. Supports inventory updates across timepoints, storage actions while ensuring data consistency and sync across UI and inventory records.

feature: Stability Timepoint Zero: Use Batch Results
description: This feature allows users to reuse results from a batch release test for the initial timepoint (T0) study results, in order to save time and effort from unnecessary retesting when the T0 criteria can be evaluated using the tests done for the batch’s release process.

feature: Change Analysis Enhancements: View Dependencies
description: Users can now view blockers of a Change Analysis approval when performing a merge of Change Analyses records into an Envelope.

feature: Change Analysis Enhancements: Bulk Update References to Latest Versions
description: Users can now to bulk update all Design Data references to point to their latest version as part of a Change Analysis workflow.

feature: Change Analysis: Re-Merge Change Analysis
description: Users can now add Change Analysis records to an existing Envelope that has previously been merged.

feature: Simplified Aliquot Configuration
description: This feature allows a select sample action to reference to an aliquot sample action. This traceability allows samples to be automatically matched to the appropriate select action for a particular aliquot action.

feature: Stability: Standardization of Unit of Measure
description: At Lab Study initiation, the system now uses a new standard Unit Picklist on the Unit of Measure object instead of the editable Time Stored Units name field to ensure accurate Scheduled Start Date calculation for Study Timepoints. In addition, timepoint ordering has been updated.

feature: Initiate Spec Execution Can Use Spec Data Mapping Records in the Standard Active State
description: When a Spec Execution is created (when a Batch is logged), the Spec Data that is used is based on the Spec Data Mapping that meets the following conditions:  Spec Data Mapping records with a status of Active on a custom lifecycle state (pre-existing), or Spec Data Mapping records with the Standard Active state.

feature: Lab Location Records That Meet Certain Conditions Can Be Deleted
description: Lab Locations and their associated records can now be deleted, provided that they meet all the required conditions: The Lab Location has never been assigned to an Asset, Consumable, or Lab Sample; its parent has never changed after initial creation; and any Lab Location children must also satisfy the required conditions.

feature: Remove Unused Data Model & Components from LIMS Vaults
description: Certain data model and components that are specific to other Quality applications and not used by LIMS have been removed from all LIMS Vaults.

feature: Data Model: Dynamic Access Control Property is No Longer Editable for Spec Data Criteria Set
description: Security on design data objects, which includes Spec Data Criteria Set, is automatic via Application Security and no longer has configurable security.

feature: Do Not Notify Vault Owners on Design Data Portability File Failed to Import
description: If a Design Data Import job ends with Errors Encountered, Vault Owners no longer receive an email indicating that the AsyncOperation did not finish successfully. Vault Owners will still receive an email from the job itself that contains details of the issue.

feature: Support Quality Events & Test Sets in Lab Investigations
description: This feature expands support for the creation of Lab Investigations within the Quality Event object. Lab Investigation requests can also be created from the Test Set for issues found during test execution, improving visibility between QC and QA.

feature: Version History Section for Test Definition-Document Records
description: For a given Test Definition-Document record, the user can see previous versions of the record.

feature: Display Expected Amount & Unit for Inputs
description: This update displays the Expected Amount and Unit for Inputs on the Test Execution screen. Previously, this information was not visible to the end user.

feature: Lab Criteria Evaluation Records Created on Test Creation
description: Previously, Lab Criteria Evaluation records were created when the Spec Execution record was initiated, even though Tests were not created. Now, Lab Criteria Evaluation records are only created when its Tests are created.

feature: Test Set: Enhanced Ways to Search & Select Samples
description: Test Execution and Sample Results Entry now have an updated UI and search and select functionality.

feature: Stability Study Export: Not Expected Result Value Updated
description: For results that are not expected in a stability study, these results are now indicated in the export file using two dashes (--) instead of N/A.

feature: Test Set Contains the Test Definition It Is Associated With
description: When a Test Set is created, the Test Definition is now stamped on the Test Set.

feature: Generate Tests Logic Enhancement or Avoid Duplicates When Generating Tests
description: The system now checks the 'Generated' field value before creating a Test. If it is false, generate tests. If it is true, do not generate tests. This avoids a rare race condition where duplicate tests could be created.

feature: Convert Controlling Lookup Fields to Reference Fields
description: This feature was previously released in 25R1 and added new standard fields to the data model to address an issue where lookup fields were not updated in time to control dependent fields. Previously, this feature needed to be enabled by Veeva Support. As of 25R2, this feature is automatically enabled in all Vaults.

feature: Stability: Study Schedule User Interface Enhancements
description: The Study Schedule UI was updated for Study Design and Study to align the color scheme with rest of LIMS and provide various other UI enhancements, including a dedicated section for Tests, a collapsible left panel, and updated timepoint tooltips. A filter icon, Schedule section, and Storage Counts section have been removed.

feature: Increased Sample Quantity Limit for Test Sets
description: Tests from up to 100 samples can now be added to a Test Set.

feature: All Test Set & Lab Test Result Object Records Updated with New Field Values
description: As part of the System Suitability and Operational Criteria features, object records were automatically updated with new field values. For Test Set, Invalid field set to false. For Lab Test Results, set reference for Step Definition.

feature: Refined Revision Tracking for Results
description: The Revisions field does not change if a failed calculated Result later calculates successfully, or if a manual Result without a value is given one. It does change if a Result changes from valid to invalid, gets a different value, or is manually overridden after calculation.

feature: Scientific Statements: Lifecycle Entry Criteria for Substantiation
description: This feature provides configuration to choose the Statement types that require substantiation before they are made available for use.

feature: Scientific Statements: Harvesting
description: The system extracts text and references from document link annotations as well as document metadata from Medical materials to populate Scientific Statement records. Qualified harvested Statements are placed directly into the Approved state, ready to use for Auto-Linking.

feature: Scientific Statements: Statement Assets
description: This feature helps customers define assets such as graphics, tables, images, and other visual components that support Scientific Statements.

feature: Communication Objectives for Documents
description: Users can gain insight into strategic outcomes by linking Communication Objectives to content. When using Scientific Statement Auto-Linking, communication objectives used in the scientific statement are automatically associated with the document.

feature: Medical Portal: Dynamic Widgets
description: Vault now supports Dynamic Portal Widgets, allowing users to automatically populate Portal widgets with documents using Custom Views from the Vault Library or Portal Library. Unlike static widgets, which require manual curation, dynamic widgets update automatically as documents enter the Vault that match the defined filter criteria.

feature: Scientific Statements: Auto-Linking Deduplication
description: Auto-Linking now only provides new links with each run and does not re-suggest previously rejected links.

feature: Medical Settings & Field Relabeling
description: This enhancement updates several object and Application Settings labels in Veeva Medical.

feature: Medical Notification Templates: Vault Support Updated to Veeva Support
description: This feature replaces the phrase Vault Support with Veeva Support in select Notification Templates email body and notification text.

feature: MedInquiry: Vault CRM HCP Lookup
description: The MedInquiry search experience enables an MI Agent to initiate a search for an HCP against integrated Vault CRM instances. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Incoming Calls & Chats Open in a New Tab
description: When users accept an incoming call or chat, the user is redirected to a new tab where they can begin to log inquiries, adverse events, and product quality complaints.

feature: Automatically Detect Product During Email Intake
description: This feature automatically populates Local Product and Product Family fields on MedInquiry Case Intake based on matching text found within the subject and body of inbound emails.

feature: Standardization of Responses & Interactions
description: In an effort to further standardize MedInquiry, we are provisioning new Case Response object types (Chat and Internal Email), new Case Response fields (Response Content and Interaction Type), a new field on Event Product (Case),  and a Cancelled lifecycle state on Case, Case Request, Case Response, and Event objects.

feature: Object & Document Audit Logs Date Filter Limit
description: This feature introduces a one year limit (365 days) to the date range that Admin object and document audit logs can be filtered by. Admins may still filter for previous years in up to one year chunks.

feature: Email to Vault: Bounce Notifications
description: When configuring Email to Vault functionality, Admins now have an option to allow Vault to immediately notify senders (Users and Persons) if an Email record is created in the Bounced state.

feature: Rename Vault Java SDK Logs to Developer Logs
description: Now that the logs hold information about Action Triggers, the Vault Java SDK Logs section has been renamed to Developer Logs.

feature: Vault User Layout Enhancements
description: The UI for Users (under Users and Groups) now supports all layout features introduced as part of Action Layouts, as well as the Print Record functionality.

feature: Enhanced Picklist Administration: Reorder Large Picklists
description: The Admin UI now supports the reordering of picklists exceeding 200 values. This update introduces reordering and sorting that operates across all pages, effectively removing any prior limitations on the number of items that can be reordered or sorted within the UI.

feature: Flexible Multilingual Search
description: Users can now search all languages, all the time, without the need to specify language preferences and without the performance downsides associated with multilingual search. *Auto-on in Vaults with multi-lingual document handling enabled.

feature: Summary Email Enhancements & User-Driven Notifications
description: Non-urgent, Veeva-owned notification templates are included in summary emails, with default interval changed from 24 hours to 1 hour. Some notification fields in the User object are now also automatically exposed for users to customize email preferences. *This feature applies to Vaults that specifically deferred this feature in 25R1.

feature: Object Reference Field Item Limit
description: There is a limit on the number of records that can be selected in an object reference field. Prior to this change, this limit could have been bypassed when using this component. This change reinforces the limit on this dialog.

feature: Additional Notification Enhancements
description: In-app notifications can now be disabled for Favorite documents if Email Preferences is set to Never. Summary emails also include the Vault name in the Subject for clarity. Four notification templates (bulkstatechangesummary__v, bulkupdatesummary__v, bulkworkflowsummary__v, emailparticipants__v) are set to "Every Occurrence" if they were "Summary."

feature: Allow Document Owner to Delete Annotations
description: Admins can now allow Document Owners to delete eligible annotations authored by other users.

feature: Metadata Clearing on PDF Viewable Renditions
description: A new Rendition Profile setting, Remove document properties from Viewable Rendition, is now available which ensures that all source file metadata (excluding the file name) is removed in the Viewable Rendition's properties.

feature: Include Collaborative Authoring Settings in Sandbox Refreshes
description: When a Vault is refreshed from another Vault with a verified connection using the modern Collaborative Authoring configuration (without the Collaboration User), the Collaborative Authoring configuration is now maintained as part of the refresh.

feature: System Audit Logs: Display Record Labels in Field Dependency Changes
description: When creating or editing a document field dependency set to Controlled by Document Field and the condition references object records, the System Audit History now identify the records by label instead of ID.

feature: Collaborative Authoring Error Log: Expanded Logging
description: The Collaborative Authoring Error Log now includes all errors returned by Microsoft Graph API.

feature: Filter Annotations by Created Date
description: Users can now filter annotations by Created Date using the following filters: In the range, After, or Before.

feature: Disable Manual Bring Forward Annotations Until Document Processing is Complete
description: Vault now disables the Bring Forward Annotations button when OCR is in progress. Once OCR is complete, the button is enabled. Manual Bring Forward Annotations is also disabled when Auto Bring Forward Annotations is in progress.

feature: Bring Forward Annotations: Use Coordinates for Text Placement
description: When bringing forward a text annotation, either manually or automatically, Vault uses the coordinates of the source annotation to improve frequency and accuracy of automatic placement in the target document version. This includes instances where the selected text appears more than once in the page or document.

feature: Disable Suggest Links Until Document Processing is Complete
description: When manually performing Suggest Links on a document, the Suggest Links button is now disabled until Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is complete.

feature: Document Readiness Panel
description: The Document Readiness panel in the Document Viewer display operation statuses related to rendition generation, searchability, and annotations. This panel also displays warnings related to these operations and information on how to address them. Admins can also configure Document Checks as a checklist for additional criteria.

feature: Vault File Manager: Improved Clear Button on Uploads & Downloads Tabs
description: On Vault File Manager's Uploads and Download tabs, the Clear button removes all documents with a Complete, Failed, Corrupted, File Not Found, or Cancelled status. Previously, this option only removed Completed or Cancelled documents.

feature: Document Viewer: Updated Keyboard Shortcuts for Zoom
description: When working in the Document Viewer, the keyboard shortcuts to Zoom In and Zoom Out have been updated to improve usability.

feature: Collaborative Authoring: Automatic Mentioning for Task Reassignment
description: When using Collaborative Authoring workflow actions, Vault now ensures that new task owners are automatically added as an Editor in Microsoft Office when a task is reassigned.

feature: Text Selection & Copy Text Limit Increased to 500 Words
description: When selecting and copying text from a document in the Document Viewer, users can now select and copy up to 500 words. The previous limit was 200 words. The existing limits on Glossary Search remain at 5 words or 256 characters.

feature: Enhanced Duplicate Attachment Detection
description: Vault now prevents the upload of new document and object attachments that share the exact filename of an existing attachment whose MD5 checksum has not yet been calculated. This safeguard ensures file uniqueness and data consistency.

feature: Auto Bring Forward Annotations from Latest Version
description: Auto Bring Forward Annotations now brings forward annotations from the latest version instead of the latest eligible version.

feature: Automatic Mentioning in Collaborative Authoring: Updated Messages in CSV
description: To more accurately reflect the interaction between Vault and Office 365 in the Check Out to Collaborative Authoring workflow action, the messages in the optional CSV notification related to automatic mentioning are updated to reflect that Vault specifically grants Edit permission to the document on SharePoint.

feature: Vault File Manager: Updated Naming for Excel Files
description: Due to a change in Excel's handling of filenames containing square brackets, Vault File Manager now replaces square brackets with parentheses in file names.

feature: Document Viewer: Updated Keyboard Shortcut for Grab
description: The keyboard shortcut used to toggle the document viewer toolbar's Grab button is updated to Ctrl + Shift + P (Windows) and Cmd + Shift + P (MacOS). This avoids unexpected outcomes when using the previous combination of Shift + Space.

feature: 25R2 Platform Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Action Trigger
description: Action Triggers enable Vault Admins to create and execute custom business logic when a Create, Update, or Delete record operation occurs on an object record.

feature: CountIf & CountA for Multi-Item Workflow Conditions
description: CountIf() and CountA() functions have been added, which allow for more complex workflow conditions based on task statuses and field values. Users can now use these functions to count items within a collection that meet specific criteria. This enables users to create dynamic workflows that adapt to changing data and task statuses.

feature: Object Lifecycle Entry Criteria Limit
description: The limit is increased to 20,000 related records for state of related records object lifecycle state entry criteria validation.

feature: Object Reference Field Default
description: This feature provides Admins the ability to use business logic to set the default value for both Parent and Object reference fields. For example, when the Region field is set to North America, the Country field can be defaulted to USA.

feature: Select All for Complex Relationships
description: A new configuration option is available for complex relationship objects that enables users to select all records when relating multiple records at the same time in a related object section. Previously, this option was only available for simple relationship objects.

feature: Copy Record Action Security
description: The Copy Record Object Action now supports action security configuration.

feature: Disable Link Override for Flexible First Column
description: Vault now supports the ability to disable the link override mechanic for Flexible First Column feature. Admins can turn on this feature using Vault Settings. With this feature turned on, if the field already had a link, it will not be replaced when it becomes the first column.

feature: Word Formatted Outputs: Print Attachment Field Images
description: Word Formatted Outputs now support the ability to display an image file from an Attachment Field. This has previously only been supported for image files that are included as record attachments.

feature: Word Formatted Outputs: Support for Traversing Multiple Outbound Object Levels
description: Word Formatted Outputs now support referencing fields for up to three levels of outbound relationships in dot notation (without needing to nest tables) for a single field value.

feature: Label Limit Increases for Layouts
description: Label limits for layouts have been increased to the following: Section Help Content (255 increased to 500), Section Label (40 increased to 150), Page Label (40 increased to 60), and Layout Label (100 increased to 150).

feature: Prevent Creation of New Adobe Formatted Outputs
description: All new formatted output templates now leverage the Word functionality and no new Adobe templates can be created. Existing Adobe templates can continue to be edited. Note: Clinical Operations Vaults can continue to create new Adobe templates after 25R2 as there is additional enhancement coming in a future release to fully support Word templates.

feature: Word Formatted Outputs: Increase Template Page Limit
description: The template file page limit for Word Formatted Outputs has been increased from 10 pages to 20 pages.

feature: Prior Person: Lock Format Mask for Name Fields
description: Admins cannot configure format masks for First Name, Last Name and User Name fields on Prior Person object.

feature: Enhanced Picklist Field Dependency Administration
description: This feature provides an improved admin UI for configuring and maintaining picklist field dependencies, enabling greater flexibility for complex configurations. It resolves critical usability limitations where admins were previously unable to manage dependencies via the UI when dealing with a high volume of picklist combinations.

feature: Checklists: Available Answer Enhancements & Randomization of Question & Answer Order
description: Duplicate copies of Available Answer records are not created for checklists anymore. Response Selected Answer object stores selected multiple-choice answers. Response Ordered Answer object stores multiple-choice answer order. Also, question and answer order can now be randomized on checklist creation.

feature: Checklists: Long Text & Rich Text Support for Comments
description: Checklist respondents can add Response comments in Long Text and Rich Text format.

feature: Related Object Section: Record Limits
description: Vault now limits the total number of join records retrieved in a related object section to a max of 10,000 for simple join relationships. This ensures that Vault still reliably loads record details that may contain a very large number of simple join records (i.e. 1,000,000+) in any given related object section.

feature: Tree Security
description: Admins now have an additional security configuration option that allows for access to be granted to object records based on a defined hierarchical structure. With this structure, users can be granted roles that cascade down through a hierarchy, or have access rolled up through a hierarchy.

feature: Child Object Security
description: When a parent-child relationship exists, a new checkbox is available on the child object's field that references the parent that allows Vault to automatically have access to child records be based on parent record access.

feature: Support for Flash Report Configuration Migration
description: Flash reports can be migrated across environments using Configuration Migration Packages, by including the associated job in the package. If the Runs As user is unavailable in the target Vault, the migrating user is set as the Run As user of the flash report.

feature: Vault Tokens in Expressions
description: Vault now supports using all custom Vault Tokens in formulas, as well as additional standard tokens. These tokens are selectable in the formula editors for object validation rules, layout rules, field defaults, formula fields, workflow and lifecycle formula conditions, and report formula fields.

feature: Support Last Modified By & Created By in Object Formulas
description: The Last Modified By and Created By fields can now be leveraged in formula expressions, like any other User reference field.

feature: Enhanced Document Picklists in Formulas
description: Document picklist fields in formulas now return the picklist data type. This change makes document and object picklists behave consistently in formulas and also improves the use case of comparisons in formulas that use picklists.

feature: Enhanced Contains & Search Operators in Report Filters
description: Users can now filter object text fields in reports using a case-insensitive operator, in addition to the existing case-sensitive operator. Additionally, Long Text and Rich Text fields can now be filtered in reports using a new search operator.

feature: Combined Dashboard Prompts Enhancement
description: When creating a new dashboard or editing the name of an existing dashboard, users now see options to choose how the dashboard combined prompts, based on Prompt Label, Referenced Object, or None.

feature: Merge Cells in Multi-Pass Reports
description: Multi-Pass reports now support merging cells that contain duplicate values with a new setting in Advanced Options: Enable merge cells with same value. With this enabled, report editors can choose which columns should merge cells.

feature: Enhanced Blank Handling in Report Formula Fields
description: When creating formula fields in reports, users are now given the choice to continue treating blanks as blanks, or to handle them as zeroes (0) or empty strings, providing consistency with other Vault formula fields on how blank values are handled.

feature: Include Tags in Report Exports
description: When exporting reports as Formatted Excel and including a cover page, the exported file now contains the Report Tags on the cover page. Additionally, for PDF report exports, the Report Export Cover Page can now be configured to include Report Tags using the ${reportTags} token.

feature: Multi-Pass Matrix Report
description: Report creators can now create matrix reports using Multi-Pass report types.

feature: Document Formula Fields: Deprecation of Non-State Fields
description: Any existing configured document formula fields that do not use document status or state type now return blanks. Existing formula fields that are using document status or state type continue to function as expected.

feature: Security Policy Conversion
description: Admins can now convert a password/SSO user to VeevaID or Cross-domain or vice-versa using the Vault UI or API. This feature may not be validated in pre-release Vaults.

feature: Allow VeevaID Users to Change Email
description: VeevaID users can now change their email, which also changes their username. A User Name field is also added as a sync-eligible field to the Person and Prior Person objects. Vault syncs changes to this shared field between User and Person (and Prior Person during User-to-Person syncing). This feature may not be validated in pre-release Vaults.

feature: Vault Delegation: Usability Enhancements
description: When selecting a delegate from the Home tab, Vault will now only display delegated accounts for the Vault the user is currently in and when returning to their main account, users will now stay in the Vault that they were accessing as a delegate.

feature: Cancel a Job in Queued or Queueing State
description: Admins can now cancel some jobs in the Queued or Queueing states. These jobs can be canceled individually from the Job Status page. Jobs in the Running state cannot be canceled from the Job Status page. All jobs in the Scheduled state can still be canceled from the Job Status page.

feature: Direct Data API: Admin Enablement
description: Direct Data API is now available for customers as a Vault setting.

feature: Jobs: Timeout Statuses
description: To help with troubleshooting jobs, new job status names are introduced for jobs that time out. Queued jobs that time out now have a Timeout status. Running jobs that time out now have a Completed due to Inactivity status.

feature: Enable Inbound & Outbound Package Settings for All Vaults
description: Outbound and Inbound package creation was previously controlled by an Admin setting. This functionality is now enabled by default in all Vaults and the setting has been removed.

feature: Vault Loader Enhancements for Object Record Create, Update, Delete Operations
description: Loader logs for Upsert, Update, and Delete object operations now include the id_param_value when a idParam is provided, and for Upsert operations using a idParam, the log indicates whether the record was created or updated.

feature: Vault Loader: Capture Use of No Triggers
description: Vault Loader now captures use of No Triggers option when a Loader job runs with Migration Mode enabled.

feature: Disposition Archival Design
description: To improve performance, Batch Dispositions in a terminal state for over 24 months are archived with a Disposition PDF attached to the Batch record, and all associated records are deleted.

feature: Change State Configuration
description: This feature configures the Change Control lifecycle states monitored by Batch Dispositions so that changes in any state can be monitored, not just those tied to the Approved state type.

feature: Disposition Dependency
description: This feature manages dependencies between Batch Dispositions so that the closure of one Batch Disposition blocks a disposition decision until other disposition decisions are complete.

feature: Manufacturing Site-Specific Plans
description: This feature allows users to associate Batch Disposition Plans with a manufacturing site so that only those plans can be used with dispositioned batches manufactured at that site.

feature: Monitor Documents Not Batch-Specific
description: This feature includes documents in a Batch Disposition Check that are not batch-specific so that they can be reviewed before users make a disposition decision.

feature: Field Corrective Action Enhancements
description: This feature adds several functional improvements for Field Corrective Actions, including the ability to send tracked Safety Notices as a new type of Product Action, support for configurable Email From addresses, and automation around identifying FCA-Lot records that are not in their completed state.

feature: Reason for Change: Expanded Support for Standard Objects
description: This feature expands the list of supported QMS standard objects for the Reason for Change feature.

feature: Generate Document from Word Formatted Output
description: The Generate Document from Formatted Output action now supports Formatted Output Templates designed in the Microsoft Word (*.docx) file format.

feature: Recurrence Check: Record Check Result Object Control
description: This feature introduces a new object control that Admins can add to the Record Check Result page for Recurrence Checks. This control is designed for customers using editable date and match field prompts in Quality Record Checks.

feature: Recurrence Check: Add Criteria VQL for Related Objects
description: This feature allows Admins to define Criteria VQL on related objects to apply additional filtering rules for refining the match criteria for related objects.

feature: APQR Programs
description: This feature provides a standardized data model set to initiate, plan, and approve APQR programs for a defined period.

feature: QRM: Probability Support for Hazard & Harm Analysis
description: This feature adds Probability of a Hazardous Situation (P1) and Probability of Harm (P2) dimensions to the Risk Matrix to be part of the calculation of overall scoring of risks.

feature: Qualification & Organization History
description: This feature introduces the ability to create a snapshot of data in Organization and Qualification records, which allows users to capture the historical context of an Organization record, when it is approved or reapproved after an update, and a Qualification record, after initial qualification or a requalification.

feature: Duplicate Check Expansion: Complaint Intake, SCN, QI
description: This feature allows Admins to configure Duplicate Checks, replacing the complex manual process of identifying a duplicate Complaint Intake, Supplier Change Notification, or Quality Incident with an intelligent search functionality and user interface that currently exists for Complaints.

feature: Change Related Object Lifecycle State Enhancements & Expansion
description: The QMS Change Related Object Lifecycle State action is updated to support the Quality Event object and its standalone equivalents and support sending notifications to specific roles on the record.

feature: Related Record Configurations: Hide Invalid Target Fields in Field Mappings
description: When users define Field Value Mappings in a new configuration, system-managed fields, lookups, and inactive fields are excluded from the list of selectable source and target fields on the Related Record Configuration page.

feature: QMS Email Processors: Email Thread Detection
description: This feature introduces the Email Thread Detection option for QMS Email Processors, which allows Admins to configure how email threads are detected when an incoming email is processed.

feature: Duplicate Check: Do Not Allow Fields With a Time Subtype as Search Fields
description: This feature adds validation checks to the Qualityrecordcheckrule component to prevent fields with a Time subtype from being configured as a search field.

feature: Quality Teams API Permission Enhancements
description: This feature removes the requirement to have Admin access to the Quality Teams definition in order to use the Quality Teams Bulk Management feature.

feature: Quality Teams: Advanced User Search
description: Advanced user search functionality is added to Team Member fields in the Quality Teams section, allowing users to search using additional filtering criteria.

feature: Recurrence Check Insights: Associate Related Records
description: This feature expands the Recurrence Check Insights functionality so that users can link pre-existing CAPAs, Effectiveness Checks and Investigations from the Recurrence Check Insights page.

feature: QMS Standard Application Enhancements
description: Multiple standard components, such as document types, document fields, document reference fields, objects, and a Related Event standard layout, have been provisioned across QMS.

feature: Supporting Records: Inspector Role
description: The Supporting Records functionality of Audit Room now leverages the Inspector lifecycle application role in all aspects where it previously leveraged the Viewer lifecycle application role.

feature: Reason for Change: Print Record Support
description: This feature provides print record support for the object control related to the Reason for Change object.

feature: 5 Whys Analysis: User Experience Improvements
description: This feature updates the 5 Whys Analysis tool to deliver a more seamless and intuitive experience when you edit and save Why Cards. The fields are unavailable while the card is saving, and a Saved indicator is displayed until a new change is made.

feature: QRM Enhancements: Reorder Risks, Heat Map Ordering
description: This feature allows users to reorder risks in the Risk Builder through drag-and-drop functionality. This feature also improves the readability of generated heat maps by reordering the Y-axis of 2D and 3D heat maps, so that the most critical entries are displayed at the top of the map.

feature: Related Event App Section: User Interface Modifications
description: The Related Event Application section no longer permits partial records to be created and no longer is displayed if users do not have permissions assigned to view any of the records that could be displayed within the section.

feature: Auditor Profile: Delete User Role Setup When Role Qualification Status Is Deleted
description: The User Role Setup record associated with a User now is automatically deleted when the corresponding Auditor Role is removed.

feature: Organization Scalability Improvements
description: This feature optimizes data storage and retrieval for organization records and hierarchies, ensuring efficient performance at scale.

feature: Dynamic Association of Process Navigator Documents
description: This feature dynamically populates the list of documents associated with a given process in Process Navigator, based on matching rules that are configured using document metadata.

feature: Allow Deletion of Documents with Inactive Controlled Copies
description: Documents with associated Controlled Copy Trace records can be deleted, but only when all of the associated records are in an inactive state. When enabled, a setting allows Vault to automatically delete inactive Controlled Copy Trace records when the associated target document is deleted.

feature: Associate Document Change Request & Periodic Review Records During Change Authorization
description: This feature allows linking associated Document Change Request and Periodic Review records with a Document Change Control record during the Change Authorization process.

feature: Prevent Duplicate Documents in Process Navigator
description: Vault displays an error message in Process Navigator and prevents users from adding a duplicate document to a given Process Navigator Hierarchy.

feature: Remove Superseded & Obsolete Documents from the Document Control Homepage
description: The Upcoming Periodic Reviews section of the Document Control Homepage now filters Superseded and Obsolete documents.

feature: Create a separate section for System Managed Document Relationships in the Quality Relationships Panel
description: System-managed document relationships will now display in a separate subsection in a unidirectional manner in the Document Relationships section of the Quality Relationships Panel.

feature: Prevent Selection of Proposed Implementation Date Field in the Past
description: This feature prevents users from selecting a date in the past for the Proposed Implementation Date field on the Document Change Control object.

feature: Add Document Hovercard in the Associated Documents Panel in Process Navigator
description: This feature provides a document hovercard that displays when users hover over a document in the Associated Documents panel of Process Navigator.

feature: Automated Generation of Training Requirement Impact Assessment (TRIA) & Display in Document Change Control (DCC)
description: This feature realigns the Training Requirement Impact Assessment (TRIA)  and Document Change Control (DCC) objects and processes so that the TRIA process can be initiated earlier in a training document's lifecycle and Document Controllers have visibility into the TRIA process.

feature: Android Station Manager: Background Sync Enhancement
description: Syncing with Vault when the Station Manager application is in the background was enhanced to support Android OS version 15.

feature: VeevaID Single Sign-On Support for Study Training
description: The Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection can create User and Person records for Study Training Learners assigned a VeevaID Security Policy configured for Single Sign-On (SSO).

feature: LearnGxP ContentDirect: Learner Homepage Course Images
description: LearnGxP ContentDirect delivery can include accompanying images which are viewable on the Learner Homepage in subscriber Vaults.

feature: Training & Study Training Enhancements
description: This feature enhances Instructor-Led Training (search enhancement), the Quality Relationships panel (adds External and Evaluation Training Requirements), and the Learner Homepage for Veeva Training and Veeva Study Training.

feature: Equivalency Substitute Training Rules
description: This feature allows Training Administrators to create Equivalent Substitute Training Rules indicating that a Primary Training Requirement satisfies or is satisfied by another Primary Training Requirement. Based on these rules, Vault sets Training Assignments to Complete when the Learner completes the equivalent Training Assignment.

feature: Refresher Training
description: Customers can create a separate set of training content which Vault uses as training content when a Training Requirement recurs for a Learner.

feature: Facilitated Training: Training Assignment Completion for Superseded Documents
description: Training Admins can mark an assignment complete via Facilitated Training when a Learner completes training outside of Vault and the related document is already Superseded.

feature: Automatic Completion Credit for Document Participants
description: Training Admins can automatically grant training credit to participants involved in a training document's review and approval process, for example Owners and Approvers.

feature: Delta Training
description: This feature allows customers to create and issue shorter and more focused training on the changes between versions of a procedure, reducing training times and the probability of a Learner clicking Complete Training without reviewing the training.

feature: VPS: Product Master Data Automation
description: This feature introduces the ​Use Regional Product Attributes option, which allows organizations to store country-specific or region-specific product attributes, such as the Brand Name, Common Device Name, and Device Description, as master data, and add the entries to Adverse Event Reports.

feature: VPS: AER Configurability
description: Admins can configure if source data can be changed on Averse Event Reports directly.

feature: VPS: Adverse Event Report Improvements
description: This feature adds enhanced data mapping for eMDR section D9.

feature: VPS: Japan AE Reporting Health Authority Validations
description: This feature introduces automatic field validations for over 50 fields represented in the Japan PMDA-submittable Adverse Event Report.

feature: QMS & VPS: Reportability for Domestic Versus Foreign Incidents
description: This feature adds support for the different durations for how long an organization has to report Incidents that happen in-country versus those that happen out of country.

feature: VPS: Japan AE Reporting Custom UI Enhancements
description: This feature adds new UI elements for Japanese Medical Device Nomenclature (JMDN) codes, such as Health Effect Codes, Device Problem Codes, Component Codes, and Investigation Codes, for Japan PMDA Adverse Event Reports.

feature: VPS: Consolidation of Complaint Details
description: This feature removes the need to have complaints information on two distinct objects: Complaint and Medtech Complaint Details. This will allow users to have a more streamlined experience in capturing all the necessary information onto a single object.

feature: Reference Table Support for Requirements & Specifications
description: This feature allows users to incorporate reference tables into the description of a Validation Requirement/Specification to enhance clarity and efficiency.

feature: Periodic Review for Entities
description: This feature will provide the ability to manage periodic reviews at an entity level.  It will allow one Entity to have multiple periodic reviews planned with different scopes (system review, audit trail review, access control, etc.) and frequencies, as well as allow one periodic review to be associated with multiple entities.

feature: Display Workflow Task Information on Validation Management Interfaces
description: Information about the workflow task assigned to a user is now displayed on each of the Validation Management app pages (Test Authoring, Review Authored Test, Test Execution, Review Executed Test, and Test Protocol Review) for supported standard states. The taskbar mimics the existing taskbar that is shown to users on Vault record pages.

feature: Singapore eCTD 3.2 Publishing & Validation (SG v1.0)
description: The system now supports publishing and validation of Singapore eCTD Submissions per regional XSD version 1.0 and Validation criteria version 1.0.

feature: Taiwan eCTD 3.2 Publishing & Validation (TW v2.0)
description: The system now supports publishing and validation of Taiwan eCTD Submissions per regional XSD version 2.0 and Validation criteria version 2.0.

feature: Support Link Opening Preference in RLCP Publishing
description: When publishing Report Level Content Plans, the system now sets the Open Preference of published links based on the Published Links Opening Setting field specified on the RLCP.

feature: Update PDF Validation Rule to Capture Opening View Settings
description: A new criteria ID is available to capture PDF opening settings in Canada and Australia. Criteria ID RuleB43 applies to Canada Rule B43 and Australia Rule 6.20.

feature: Automatic Deployment of Publishing Validation Rule RIM114
description: Validation rule RuleRim114 is now provisioned on all Submissions Publishing Vaults as a Validation Criteria Record. The rule automatically executes for all Submissions published in Vault.

feature: Render Published Documents on Rendition Bulk Queue
description: Rendering of published documents now uses the Renditions bulk queue for better scaling and reduces the instances of large back-ups in the queue caused by publishing documents during bulk imports.

feature: Prevent Publishing Submissions with Shared Content Plans
description: At publishing time, the system now checks if the Primary Submission of the Root Content Plan is being used in other Submissions. If so, publishing fails and a detailed error message is provided.

feature: Support Additional Tokens for Table of Contents Referencing Section Merged Documents
description: When a Table of Contents targets a section that is being merged using Section Level Merge, the system now resolves the tokens in the Table of Contents instead of always using the Section Merge Published Output Location.

feature: Health Canada REP Version 5.0.0
description: This feature updates Validation Rule I11 for Canada eCTD and Non-eCTD Submissions to validate the correct software version for Human and Vet REP XMLs.

feature: Update US eCTD Valid Values XML
description: When an STF is published in US submissions, the system now includes the valid-values version 6 XML in the util folder.

feature: Update Acceptable File Formats for US eCTD Rule 1255
description: Rule 1255 is updated to accept new file formats under Module 5 for eCTD Submissions to CDER. New acceptable formats include .gpsqlite, .gpproject, and .gpsettings.

feature: Update RIM114 Validation Checks
description: RIM114 is updated with additional checks for placeholder documents, such as if the Source for Published Document is empty, and if the Source for Published Document does not exist as a Rendition Type.

feature: Support Language Attribute in HC eCTD DTD 2.2 Submissions
description: When the Language for Submission field is populated on a Content Plan Item on Module 1, the system uses the two letter language code as a metadata attribute for the leaf.

feature: Populate Merge Document Field on Root Content Plan for Submission Content Plans
description: When using Merge and Publish Content Plan in a Submission Content Plan, the system now populates the Merge Document field on the Root Content Plan.

feature: South Africa (ZA) eCTD 3.2 Publishing: Controlled Vocabulary Regulatory Update
description: Submissions Publishing now supports new values added and existing values revised for the following metadata fields: application-type, evaluation-path, sequence-type, submission-type, and submission-lead. In addition, validation rules regarding document matrix requirements have been updated.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: RIM Bot: Multilingual Model
description: This feature updates the RIM Bot auto-classification functionality to accept documents in languages other than English.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Health Authority Interaction Extraction Updates
description: Extraction of up to 500 words is now supported. Additionally, the Health Authority Interactions document panel has been updated so that the delete icon is only displayed when hovering over the card, and the object dropdown is disabled when extraction of only either HAQ or Commitment is enabled.

feature: Japan eCTD 4.0 Publishing (JP v1.6)
description: Publishing can now generate a submissionunit.xml file in accordance with Japan (PMDA) eCTD 4.0 specifications version 1.6.0. This feature allows customers to create eCTD 4.0 compliant Submissions to be submitted PMDA.

feature: eCTD 4.0 Publishing Core Capabilities
description: Submissions Publishing functionality has been updated to support eCTD 4.0. Publishing supports the ability to Set Document Metadata Update, Update Priority Numbers, perform multi-select lifecycle operations, and define Keyword code & display names. This functionality will be used across various eCTD 4.0 regions as they are supported.

feature: System-Managed Data Made Read-Only
description: System-managed fields that drive the submission structure and display elements in Submissions Archive Viewer on the Submission Metadata object are made read-only. Custom fields remain editable.

feature: Viewing eCTD Lifecycle Histories
description: Submissions Archive Viewer features a completely redesigned UI for reviewing eCTD Lifecycle Histories. This new interface supports ICH eCTD v3.2 and v4.0 XML lifecycle display and is accessible through Historical Lifecycle of Document Action (from a single document) and Cumulative View (for sections containing documents).

feature: Create & Manage Event Details: Support for Change Items & Labeling Concepts
description: With this feature, users can now create Change Items, Event Change Items, and Labeling Concepts from within Create and Manage Event Details. Labeling Concepts can also now be related to Event Change Items.

feature: Create Related Records & Splitting Support for Labeling Concept Validation
description: Create Related Records and Splitting now ensures Labeling Concepts are only added to the appropriate activities based on the Event Change Items to which they are related.

feature: Automated Counts of Total & Completed Events for Change Items
description: To help users understand if a change item has been completed in all markets, Veeva Registrations can now keep track of the total number of Events to which a Change Item is related and the number of those Events which have been completed.

feature: EUDAMED UDI Market Information Updates: UDI Submission Generation
description: With this feature, users can now generate UDI submissions to update market information in EUDAMED. These submissions must be updated manually to EUDAMED. Enhanced support for versions in generated xml will automatically update the versions in xml based on current version for registered device identifier. This feature also includes data model updates to prepare for future support for container package updates for EUDAMED.

feature: IDMP Data Model Updates (IG v2.2)
description: This feature updates IDMP data to support the latest EU IDMP guidance.

feature: Create Event Details: Optional Preview
description: With this feature, users can now decide on the last step of Create Event Details if they want to create records immediately or generate a preview to review. This feature is Auto-on in Vaults configured to use Create and Manage Event Details; other Vaults require configuration.

feature: Population of XML ICH DTD / XSD Version on Submissions Created by Bundling & Splitting
description: When the XML ICH DTD / XSD Version field is populated on an Application, any new Submissions created for that Application will have the same field populated from the Application's field value.

feature: Defaulting Local Differences in Product Variants onto Application Relationships
description: Create Related Records and Bundling now default local differences in product variants (e.g., Active Substance Name and Strength) onto new application relationships based on preferred terms and country-specific exceptions defined for product variants. Auto-on in Vaults with IDMP Support for Local Differences in Product Variant Attributes configured; other Vaults need configuration.

feature: Create Related Records Validation Enhancements for Change Items
description: Create Related Records now ensures packaging-level Change Items are only added to relevant Activities based on market-specific product/packaging information. Validation logic is also enhanced for Activity Change Items via Product Family, Product, and Product Variant. It's Auto-on for Vaults using Change Items; others require configuration.

feature: Impact Assessment Report Prompt Population from Change Items
description: Prompts in impact assessment reports are now populated based on the Products, Product Variants, and Packaging contained in the Change Items related to the selected Event. This feature is Auto-on in Vaults configured to use Change Items; other Vaults require configuration.

feature: UDI Submission Support for Multiple Products with the Same Basic UDI
description: Customers can now include data for multiple products with the same Basic UDI in one EUDAMED UDI submission. Auto-on in Vaults with the "Enable enhanced UDI attribute locations" setting enabled and where Device Identifier naming allows multiple Products per Basic UDI-DI; other Vaults need configuration.

feature: XEVMPD Validation Enhancements
description: This feature updates XEVMPD validation for Authorisation Status to support the latest version of the 3.II guidance.

feature: Dynamic Validation Enhancements
description: This release enhances the "Enable dynamic validation for Create Related Records and Bundling" setting. New validation rules for Related Change Types now control when details are added from an Event to Applications, Regulatory Objectives, and Submissions. This feature is Auto-on in Vaults with the setting enabled; others need configuration.

feature: GCP Dispatch Relationship Matching Logic Excludes Related Change Type
description: GCP sections can be dispatched when a matching relationship is found on the target Submission, even if the Related Change Type field has a different value. When configured to Copy Relationships, the Related Change Type fields is still included while copying source Event relationships to target Submission records,

application: RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Active Dossier Population from GCP Dispatch: Support Dispatch Across Templates
description: Active Dossier generation from Global Content Plan (GCP) dispatch has been updated to support GCP dispatch across templates.

feature: Warning File for Excluded Sections in GCP Dispatch or SCP Compare & Merge
description: A warning file indicates when sections are excluded from the Dispatch GCP and Compare & Merge SCP actions due to a missing relationship on the target Submission record. Additionally for Dispatch GCP, warnings are logged for sections that are excluded when the corresponding target Submission relationship is not used for Content Planning.

feature: Japan eCTD 4.0 Archive & Viewing (JP v1.4, v1.5, v1.6)
description: Submissions Archive supports importing, viewing, and exporting Japanese submissions compliant with JP PMDA Module 1 Implementation Guide versions 1.4, 1.5, and 1.6 for the ICH eCTD 4.0 standard.

feature: eCTD 4.0 Archive & Viewing Core Capabilities
description: Submissions Archive Viewer is enabled for viewing and export needed for ICH eCTD 4.0-based submissions. The actions Historical Lifecycle of Document and Cumulative View (for sections) have new user interface experience that is consistent across ICH eCTD 3.2 and 4.0 standards.

feature: Taiwan eCTD 3.2 Archive & Viewing (TW v2.0)
description: Submissions Archive supports importing, viewing, and exporting Taiwanese submissions according to the TW FDA's eCTD-V-R2 for the ICH eCTD 3.2 standard.

feature: Update FTP Terminology
description: The term "FTP" is updated to "File Staging server" (or "FSS") across relevant UI labels and notifications to better align with standard Veeva terminology. Affected areas include import/export confirmation screens and notification templates. This is a terminology update only, with no change to functionality.

feature: South Africa (ZA) eCTD 3.2 Archive & Viewing: Controlled Vocabulary Regulatory Update
description: Submissions Archive now supports the display of new and updated Controlled Vocabulary values in the Viewable Rendition of the ZA Regional XML.

feature: Active Dossier: Configurable Template Support
description: Configuration support has been added for Active Dossier Templates, including creating, updating, reparenting, and reordering custom templates, plus limited changes to standard ones. Multiple hierarchies are now supported, and new Investigational CTD templates have been provisioned with supporting RIM Reference Models to RIM Vaults.

feature: Disable Archive Path in Active Dossier Population
description: A new configuration option is available for 'Disable Archive Population Path' on the Submission Populate Active Dossier system action. When configured, the system no longer traverses the Submission's Archive to populate Active Dossier. Instead, it traverses the Submission's Content Plan only.

feature: Support Approval Type Field in Active Dossier Loader
description: This feature provides support for the Approval Type field introduced in 24R3 within Active Dossier Loader.

feature: Active Dossier: Dates & Comments Tracking
description: Status dates and comment fields have been added to Active Dossier Item Detail. The Viewer now features improved row sorting, mime-type icon support, as well as multiple global filters. The configured default filter behavior is now honored for Product Family. Permissions enforcement has also been updated.

feature: Active Dossier: Latest for Authoring Tracking
description: Two new fields have been added to Active Dossier to flag the latest internally approved document versions for authoring. These fields auto-populate on Active Dossier records created or updated via Submission, Global Content Plan dispatch, Drag & Drop, and Loader. These fields will not be retroactively set on existing Active Dossier records.

feature: Active Dossier Performance & Scalability Improvements
description: Active Dossier processing has been updated to allow for better scalability & is now surfaced in the Vault Jobs Admin. Document Versions will no longer be synced to Active Dossier records when there are changes. Inactivation of templates will no longer cascade to Active Dossier records. Finally, query optimizations will improve Viewer performance.

feature: Convert EMA E2B(R3) Validations to Vault Expressions
description: With this release, Vault updates EMA validations.

feature: WHODrug Link Korea
description: This feature supports automatic coding of External Products on domestic and foreign localized Korean Cases based on coded WHODrug terms.

feature: Document Intake Highlighter: Product Extraction
description: Admins can now configure automatic identification and extraction of company products from unstructured and semi-structured documents into the Document Intake Highlighter panel.

feature: FDA, NMPA, & EU Regional Fields: Data Model
description: This feature introduces regional fields required for FDA, NMPA, and EU MIR form generation, laying the foundation for future functionality.

feature: Expectedness Reevaluation for Postmarket Follow-Ups
description: This feature enables Admins to configure whether Vault reevaluates expectedness based on follow-up information for postmarket Cases.

feature: Submit to Gateway for Custom E2B Integrations
description: With this release, the Submit to Gateway action supports custom E2B Transmission document integrations.

feature: Early Notification Reports
description: With this release, the reporting rules engine supports automating transmission of early notification (24/48/72 hour) reports to agencies and partners.

feature: European Commission Manufacturer Incident Report (EU MIR) PDF Generation
description: This feature supports the generation of the European Commission Manufacturer Incident Report (EU MIR) in PDF format.

feature: Auto-Ranking Case Adverse Events
description: This feature introduces the automatic ranking of Case Adverse Events based on configurable ranking rules. In addition, the new Overall Case Seriousness field rolls up the most critical seriousness value across all adverse events, regardless of rank.

feature: Centralized Medical Assessment View
description: This feature updates the user interface for viewing and editing medical assessment data.

feature: Previous Case Version Narrative on Follow-Up
description: Admins can configure the Rules Based Narrative Generation feature to only copy the narrative from a previous Case version to the follow-up Case upon promotion instead of also generating a new version.

feature: AS2 Connection: Sponsor Certificate Generation
description: Admins can now create Sponsor certificates within Vault for use with an AS2 Connection.

feature: Agency Units of Measurement Update
description: This feature ensures all relevant Agency Units of Measurement are active.

feature: Case Assessment Expectedness Datasheet Type Identification
description: This feature introduces the Datasheet Type field on Case Assessment Expectedness records.

feature: DSUR: Ability to Include Fatal Adverse Events in Cause of Death Column
description: This feature supports including additional sources of information for the cause of death in the DSUR List of Subjects Who Died tabulation.

feature: Exclude External Products During Assessment Generation
description: This feature supports excluding External Products during assessment generation.

feature: Document Intake Highlighter: User Interface Updates
description: This feature updates the Document Intake Highlighter panel, including its pagination, filters, hovercards, and product classification and recategorization components.

feature: QC Checklists: Post Closure Checklist Log
description: This feature supports generating and attaching CSV log files to Checklist Creation Rules for post-closure QC Case checklists.

feature: AS2 Connection: Deprecate API Name Support for ACK on MDN Setting
description: To determine whether an AS2 Connection accepted the ACK on MDN URL, Vault now references the AS2 Partner Sends ACK on MDN URL setting, instead of the API Name.

feature: AS2 Connection: Deprecate API Name Support for Compression
description: To determine the compression behavior for an AS2 Connection, Vault now references the AS2 Compression Settings, instead of the API Name.

feature: Individual Case Routing Criteria
description: This feature introduces conditional tagging of Cases based on data on the Case or within child records.

feature: Formula Expressions for Online Questionnaire Follow-up Rules
description: This feature supports formula expressions for the follow-up questionnaire rule engine to evaluate Case data for a rule.

feature: Rules Based Narratives: Updates
description: This feature improves Rules Based Narrative Generation, including a new action to copy Narrative Outlines and several new functions to use when defining Statement Formulas.

feature: Generate Case Collections by Case Version
