description: This feature supports generating Case Collections for specific Case versions.

feature: Safety Data Expression Building Blocks
description: This feature introduces Safety Data Expression Building Blocks, reusable Case data evaluation expressions that can be used in multiple Safety Rules.

feature: Online Questionnaires for Manual Correspondence Using Document Templates
description: This feature enables always generating documents for manual method follow-up questionnaires from configured document templates.

feature: Duplicate Search Potential Matches Page Setting
description: This feature introduces the Duplicate Search Potential Matches Safety Page application setting, which lays the foundation for future functionality.

feature: Case Validation for FDA E2B(R3)
description: When generating FDA E2B(R3) files, Vault now validates data at the Case level, in addition to the Transmission level.

feature: LATAM VigiFlow E2B Generation
description: This feature supports the generation and submission of individual case safety reports in the LATAM E2B(R3) format.

feature: E2B: Localized Case Product Dosage Export Update
description: When generating ICH E2B(R3) and EMA E2B(R3) files, Vault now populates the G.k.4.r.8 data element only when Localized Case Product Dosage fields contain values.

feature: PMDA Foreign Localized Case Assessment Generation Update
description: With this release, Vault performs a one-time data sync from global Cases to Japan foreign Localized Cases, which updates Localized Case Assessments and Localized Case Assessment Results.

feature: MedDRA Support for Additional Languages
description: This feature supports nine (9) additional languages for the browsing, searching, and coding of MedDRA terms.

feature: MedDRA Chinese, Japanese, & Korean Language Search Improvements
description: This feature improves search results when searching for medical terms against the Chinese, Japanese, and Korean MedDRA dictionaries.

feature: Increase Generic Name Field Length to 500 Characters
description: This feature increases the Generic Name field on the Product Family object to 500 characters.

feature: FDA E2B(R3) for Clinical Trials: Result of Assessment Update
description: When generating FDA E2B(R3) files for clinical trial study Cases, Vault now exports Assessment Results set to "Related" as "Suspected" and set to "Not Related" as "Not Suspected".

feature: Case Promotion Waiting Page
description: With this release, the Case Promotion page includes progress details and enables users to navigate to the Inbox Item tab without interrupting Case promotion.

feature: DSUR and PBRER: Active Comparator Breakdown
description: The DSUR and PBRER aggregate reports now provide a breakdown of Case counts for each Active Comparator combination.

feature: Simplified Case Product Registration Deletion
description: This feature supports deleting Case Product Registrations on Japan Localized Cases and cascading deletions to associated localized records.

feature: Standard Health Canada Mappings for Safety Inbox Item Processor
description: This feature standardizes field mappings across the Tabular Data Format, Import Field Mappings, and Import Code Mappings for Health Canada.

feature: Automated Acknowledgement of Email to Inbox
description: Vault now automatically sends acknowledgement emails to inform senders about successful email receipt and Inbox Item creation.

feature: MedDRA Dual-Language Coding for Case Processing
description: When coding MedDRA terms on domestic Cases, reported and coded terms now display in both the selected local language and English.

feature: Masked CIOMS I: Parent Route of Administration Update
description: When generating CIOMS I files with dosage information masked, Vault no longer exports "Parent: *****" when no parent dosage information exists.

feature: MFDS E2B(R3): Missing Age Information Masking Update
description: When generating MFDS E2B(R3) files, if Date of Birth, Age at Vaccination, Age, Age Group, and Gestation are blank, Vault exports "MSK" to the D.2.1 data element.

feature: Unified Code for Units of Measure (UCUM): Code Updates
description: This feature corrects and deprecates Unified Code for Units of Measure (UCUM) codes to include only supported codes.

feature: Standardized Lifecycle State Changes
description: This feature aligns the behavior of lifecycle change failures with the rest of Vault.

feature: Export Product Name to Health Canada E2B(R2)
description: When populating the B.4.k.2.1 data element of Health Canada E2B(R2) files, for Study Products and Product Constituents of Combination Products Vault can now export the Name from the Product library. This feature is Auto-on in Vaults with the Use Product Coded for HC E2B(R2) application setting enabled.

feature: Assessment Dechallenge: Data Model
description: This feature updates the Case Assessment object data model to include the Dechallenge and Dechallenge (Override) fields.

feature: Statistical Data and EVDAS eRMR Numeric Fields: Data Model
description: This feature increases the maximum length of the numeric fields on the Statistical Data and EVDAS eRMR objects.

feature: Individual Case Review for Signal Analysis
description: To support signal detection, this feature introduces Individual Case Reviews (ICRs), which can be automatically created based on routing rules and linked to specific Case Products.

feature: Signal Case Series Generation with Scheduled Calculations
description: With this release, scheduled Signal Calculations can now automatically generate Signal Case Series that are configured as part of a calculation.

feature: EBGM Calculations Updated with Case Counts
description: This feature updates standard views used in Empirical Bayes Geometric Mean (EBGM) calculations to use unique Case counts instead of product-event pair counts.

feature: FAERS Case Reconciliation Report
description: This feature introduces a report that identifies FAERS cases that are not in Safety.

feature: VAERS Case Reconciliation Report
description: This feature introduces a report that identifies VAERS cases that are not in Safety.

feature: Multiple Product Families on Safety Investigations
description: This feature supports including multiple Products and Product Families on Safety Investigations.

feature: Filter Workbench Reports and Dashboards by MedDRA Queries
description: Users can now filter Workbench Reports and Dashboards by the terms in any MedDRA query.

feature: Generate Reports from Workbench Report Definitions
description: This feature enables generating new reports directly from a Workbench Report Definition, without requiring a Workbench Report Set.

feature: Use Workbench Report Parameters in SQL
description: Admins may use user-entered values in Workbench View SQL.

feature: Workbench Report Set Scheduling
description: Workbench can now automatically schedule Report Sets to run daily, weekly, or monthly.

feature: Generate Case Collections from a Workbench Case Series
description: This feature enables the generation of a Case Collection from a Case Series.

feature: Ability to Specify Products and Studies in Aggregate Reporting Groups
description: This feature enables specifying Products and Studies on Aggregate Reporting Groups for Workbench aggregate reports.

feature: Workbench PBRER Aggregate Reports
description: Workbench now supports generating multiple Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report (PBRER) components. Although this feature is Auto-on, some components require additional configuration.

feature: Workbench DSUR Aggregate Reports
description: Workbench now supports generating multiple Development Safety Update Report (DSUR) components. Although this feature is Auto-on, some components require additional configuration.

feature: Totals and Sorting for Grouped Data on Workbench Reports
description: This feature enables sorting and adding grand totals to grouped data in Ad Hoc reports without SQL.

feature: Multi-Level Sorting for Workbench Reports and Dashboards
description: This feature introduces sorting by multiple fields for Ad Hoc reports and dashboards.

feature: Document Sensitivity Classification
description: Users can now set a Document Sensitivity value on Workbench Reports and Workbench Report Definitions.

feature: Distribute Workbench Reports Externally
description: This feature supports the automatic generation and distribution of Workbench Report Set documents.

feature: Latest Case Version in Period for Ad-Hoc Reporting & Analytics
description: Vault adds new Case fields that identify when Cases have a later version. This feature maps the New Info Date and Approval Date from the next Case version to its superseded version.

feature: Document State Automation for PVA
description: This feature supports updating documents to your Vault’s steady or superseded state to match the state of their linked PV Agreement.

feature: Automated Distribution of PVA Reports
description: This feature supports automatic distribution of scheduled PVA Vault Report or Workbench Report Set documents.

feature: Literature Inclusion in Aggregate Reports
description: This feature supports an additional verdict on Literature Articles and Literature Article Products.

feature: Literature Article QC Sampling
description: This feature supports conducting randomized quality control (QC) sampling of literature articles.

feature: Multi-Recipient PVA Document Distribution
description: This feature supports distributing PVA Activity documents to multiple users via email or Vault task.

feature: Risk Implementation Strategy Enhancements
description: This feature supports creating local-only Local Risk Measures for regions and updates the Copy to New Version and Create Local Implementations actions to prevent the creation of new Core Implementation Strategy document versions.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: CTMS Visit Definition to Visit Group Relationship
description: The Clinical Operations-EDC Connection and CTMS now show the relationship between visit definitions and visit group definitions to support capabilities like budget planning and scheduling.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Automatic Procedure Definitions Alignment
description: Procedure definitions are now automatically transferred from EDC. Records are matched by study and procedure definition name. If a record already exists in CTMS, a new record is not created. Existing procedure definitions are not updated or deleted. This feature is Auto-on in Vaults configured for transferring procedures. Other Vaults require configuration.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Final CRFs
description: The connection can automatically transfer subject closeout CRF files from EDC to the Clinical Operations Vault. These files can then be sent to sites via SiteConnect.

feature: Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection: Support for Specialized Responsibilities
description: When a Specialized Responsibility is created in Clinical Operations, the Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection uses it to create a corresponding Learner Role in Study Training.

feature: Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection: Multi-Study Document Enhancement
description: When a document is re-used in multiple studies, Study Training creates a unique Training Requirement for each Study.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Configurable Significance Rules
description: Admins can now configure significance rules for Inbox Items imported via the Safety-EDC Connection.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Safety Case Follow-Ups Honor Safety Decisions
description: Vault now tracks changes made to subject-related details so future updates from EDC consider those Safety decisions when generating follow-up Inbox Items.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Enhancements
description: This feature introduces several improvements to the usability of the Safety-EDC Connection, including aligning labels, providing error messages, and, in the rare case and to ensure continuity, ignoring duplicate IDs from EDC.

feature: PromoMats-Medical Connection: Auto Update Anchor Support
description: Connection-created anchors are available on the CrossLinks' Draft state before the CrossLink is moved to Steady State. This enhancement supports the Update Claims Reference Anchors Steady State entry action to ensure text assets using Reference CrossLinks are up to date.

feature: Medical-CRM Connection: Medical Inquiries
description: The connection transfers Medical Inquiries raised in Vault CRM to MedInquiry for fulfillment.

feature: Quality-RIM Connection: Product Data Enhancements
description: This feature enhances the existing Quality-RIM Connection's Product Data feature so that when syncing it records it checks to see where they might already have been created from an external system. If so, it links the records rather than creating a duplicate. The check is done on matching External IDs.

feature: Quality-RIM Connection: Event Auto-Create Per Change Control & Product Family
description: This feature enhances the existing Quality-RIM Connection's Enhanced Change Control feature to automatically create one Event record for each Change Control and Product Family combination.

feature: Quality-Safety Connection: Create Safety Inbox Items from Veeva Quality
description: The standard Quality-Safety connection now supports the ability to create Inbox Items in Safety. These Inbox Items can be a net new adverse event or a follow-up to an existing adverse event case. These Inbox Items transfer all relevant pharma or device information needed by Veeva Safety.

feature: RIM-Clinical Operations Connection: Update to CrossLink Behavior to Respect Sites
description: CrossLinks created in Clinical from RIM now respect site information populated on the RIM source document. If a site is not present in Clinical, a User Exception Message will be generated, unlike before, where the site was ignored. This promotes precise data alignment.

feature: RIM-Clinical Operations Connection: Regulatory Tracking for Clinical Trials
description: This feature enables regulatory tracking data created and managed in RIM to be transferred to Clinical milestones. Important dates and verdicts captured under in-scope clinical trial application types for initial study approval are automatically sent to Clinical.

feature: Safety-Clinical Operations Connection: Enhanced Error Handling
description: For each job run, all failed items are now grouped under a single User Exception Message (UEM) per Integration. The UEM is in the Active status and the Integration's Last Successful Run time (LSRT) is updated unless a Message Processing Error (MPE) occurs. On the next Job run, the job attempts to reprocess failed items.

feature: Seed Metrics via User & Workflow Actions
description: The Seed Metrics action can now be configured as a user action and workflow system action for Study, Study Country, and Study Site.

feature: Monitored Metrics: Evaluate Subject Dates & Actual Visit End Date
description: When the Seed Monitored Metrics and Proactive Seed Monitored Metrics actions are run, the actions evaluate Subject Dates (Subject Status Dates, Visit Date) and the Monitoring Event Actual Visit End Date for seeding of Monitored Subject and Monitored Subject Visit records. This only applies to Studies with Date Based Metrics.

feature: Prevent Recalculate Enrollment Metrics for Transferred Metrics
description: The Recalculate Enrollment Metrics action is blocked from being used on Study's with Metrics Calculation set to Transferred Metrics. The Transferred Metrics calculation is used when an integration or Vault Loader create Metrics records for all levels (study, country, and site) and cannot be recalculated within Vault.

feature: Enrollment Metrics: Consistency & Error Handling Improvements
description: This feature introduces enhancements to the Update Metrics, Update Metrics (Metrics Only), and Recalculate Enrollment Metrics jobs to improve consistency and error handling.  Jobs have new failure notifications, additional job log details, better handling of duplicate Metrics records, and improved consistency.

feature: CTMS Transfer: Improved Object Type Field Handling
description: If a standard field is populated and in-scope for CTMS Transfer, but it is not present on the Target Vault's object type, then the record will successfully transfer without setting the value in this field. This avoids problematic error scenarios when configuration differs between CRO and Sponsor.

feature: Monitoring Event Review Comment Badges
description: When there are open review comments for a Monitoring Event, the section with unresolved comments will show a review comment badge on the section header and navigation pane. This feature enhances the Reviewer experience for Monitoring Events. *This feature is Auto-on in Vaults configured for Monitoring Reviewer Comments. Other Vaults require configuration.

feature: Refine Auto-Populate Last Subject In, Randomized & Started Treatment Milestone Logic
description: Accuracy has been improved for automated Last Subject In, Last Subject Randomized, and Last Subject Started Treatment milestone completion by including additional terminal status as part of the logic. The Actual Finish Date now populates correctly for sites marked with No New Subjects once all subjects have reached a terminal status.

feature: Japan CTN Submission: Data Change Visibility
description: This feature improves preparation for the Create Subsequent CTN action by populating the 'Do Not Copy in Subsequent CTN' field during CTN Generation and also improves the usability of related record changes tracked in CTN Data Change Logs. Additionally, Internal IRB Changes on CTN Data are now tracked with CTN Data Change Logs.

feature: Japanese CTN Generation: Organization Tracking Details
description: With this feature, Japanese CTN (Clinical Trial Notifications) now include support for additional organization types in the INFOSMOINMEDINST section when submitting CTNs. Users can also define Applicant Organization Names for naming the CTN XML file.

feature: Study Product Defaulting for Document Generation
description: This feature enhances the Create Related Document From Template action and Generate CTN Document action to automatically apply study products with the Study Role of Lead Agent to the product document field.

feature: Enrollment Rate Calculation Improvements
description: The Enrollment Rate calculation is improved to use 30.436768 instead of 30 as the average month length to better reflect real time. Additionally, the Enrollment Rate calculate calculation will factor in Last Subject In milestone when the Actual Finish Date is populated.

feature: CTMS Transfer: Milestone Enhancements for Complex Trials & Cycle Times
description: This feature adds 'Study Country Subject Group' and 'Study Site Subject Group' reference fields on the milestone object to the CTMS Transfer Scope. New Milestone Type Picklist values are also now available for Outbound Clinical Mappings.

feature: Clinical Transfer CDX Enhancements
description: When Study Country references an unmapped Country Record, the CDX Issue now displays a more helpful error message. When Study Site references a Study Country that was unable to transfer, the CDX Issue now displays a more helpful error message.

feature: Standard Fields for Study Phase
description: Standard values have been added to the study_phase__v picklist (as inactive) to enable triggers, prepopulation, and rules functionality for Disclosures.

application: CTMS, Disclosures, OpenData Clinical, Payments, Study Startup, eTMF
feature: Clinical Operations Object Redirect URL
description: With this release, a stable URL is created to support reliable navigation to a study site detail page.

application: CTMS, Disclosures, Payments, Site Connect, Study Startup, eTMF
feature: Simplified License Display & Enforcement
description: This feature simplifies the License Information page by removing the legacy "TMF Licenses" section, making the application licensing section the single source of truth. Additionally, Vault no longer blocks the creation of Study Sites when the TMF License limit is reached.

feature: TMF Transfer: Skip Unretrievable Renditions
description: If a viewable rendition is present in the Source Vault for an in-scope document, but it cannot be downloaded by CDX, then transfer the source file of the document and raise a warning.

feature: Complex Trials: Visit & Procedure Tracking
description: This feature populates subject group values on Visit and Procedure records. Payments will now utilize the values on these records for fee criteria. Payments no longer supports Study Element Fees. This update only applies to subject visits and procedures for studies with arms or other subject groups.

feature: Workflow Support for Create Document from Word Formatted Output Templates
description: This feature allows key CTMS, Payments and SSU documents (Confirmation Letters, Follow-up Letters, Trip Reports, Payment Letters, Invoices, Survey Responses) to be created using Formatted Outputs and automatically filed as corresponding TMF Documents.

feature: Optional Subartifact Value for Generate Formatted Action
description: For Vaults where Subartifacts are enabled, when configuring the Generate Document from Formatted Output Object Action, it is no longer required to specify a Subartifact value.

feature: Editable External ID for Study Team Roles
description: Users can now edit the External ID field on Study Team Role and Role Dependency, even while those roles are used by Study Persons with Grant Access set to Yes.

application: CTMS, Site Connect, Study Startup, eTMF
feature: Grant Study Person Access on Start Date
description: The "Revoke Access for Study Persons with End Date" job has been relabeled to "Manage Study Person Access Based on Start and End Dates" and it now checks the "Grant Access to Related Records" or "Site Connect User" box when start date has been reached and "Grant Access on Start Date" is checked. This job will be active in Site Connect vaults.

feature: Create Site Person EDLs
description: A system action is now available that can be incorporated in a site workflow to create Site Person Specific Expected Documents.

feature: Milestone Document Version Backfill Job
description: The Milestone Document object will now track relationships to both previous steady state and latest document versions. A one-time job will create missing Milestone Document records based on what's captured in the Milestone document field. The long term goal is to deprecate the field and replace it with a Milestone Document panel.

feature: Weekday-Adjusted Offsets
description: The system will shift downstream milestone dates to Monday if the calculated date offset falls on a Saturday or Sunday.

feature: Autocomplete Job Refactor
description: The Milestone Autocomplete job now processes milestones independently, so that a single record error no longer prevents an entire batch from processing. Autocomplete metric calculations are also separated from Actual Finish Date population and the final state change to ensure completion metrics are accurate even if the milestone fails to complete.

feature: Migration Tool: Import US Registration XML
description: This feature adds the ability to bring in all existing Registration & Disclosure Records to Vault with matching studies, for studies that closed in a given timeframe and including all in progress studies.

feature: Publish to CDN & Post Disclosure Documents for Company Website Support
description: Vault now uses the Digital Publishing functionality to publish any configured documents on a disclosure to a S3 bucket for hosting, and includes the documents and URLs in the Custom Website XML.

feature: Ability to Import & Store Adverse Events Results Data from XML
description: This feature enables importing a US Results XML file containing Adverse Events when creating or editing a US Results Disclosure.

feature: Disclosures Validation Improvements: US Results
description: In order to support API submission to ClinicalTrials.gov, all possible ClinicalTrials.gov errors must be resolved before the XML generation. Vault will connect to ClinicalTrials.gov PRS Test to validate and retrieve and show the user errors on the page with an on-demand Validate action.

feature: Disclosures: Protocol & US Results Updates
description: For the Protocol object for Disclosures: this feature adds new fields added to Protocol, Eligibility Criteria, and Arms. For US Results Disclosures, this feature adds the ability to copy Outcome Measures, copy Adverse Events, and fill values from the US Registration Disclosure into the US Results Disclosure for Arms and Outcome Measures.

feature: TMF Bot Prediction Metrics Enhancement
description: Prediction metrics will be updated daily and cycled with each release rather than only monthly updates.

feature: Obsolete OpenData Clinical Check for Updates Job
description: When the OpenData Clinical Check for Updates job runs, it will no longer perform any actions as the existing functionality is now handled in a cross-Vault job. The OpenData Clinical Check for Updates job will be deprecated in a future release.

feature: Removed & Excluded OpenData Clinical Records
description: This feature allows users to track and update Investigators or Sites whom Veeva confirms have been removed or excluded from OpenData Clinical.

feature: Create New Record Action from Resolved DCR
description: This feature introduces a new action, on resolved Data Change Requests, to create new Vault Investigators or Sites after they have been added to OpenData Clinical.

feature: Payments: Exclude from Threshold
description: For Vaults using Study Advance functionality, Payment Requests will now auto-generate and include Payable Items where 'Exclude from Threshold' is selected and an advance is outstanding for a Site.

feature: Fee Template Selection
description: Users can now select from a set of approved Fee Schedule Templates when multiple approved Fee Templates exist at a Study.

feature: Payments: Exclude Events with Subject Groups
description: This feature allows Vault to support payments to specific subjects where no Subject Group values are populated.

feature: Bulk Action to Generate Payment Requests
description: This feature provides a new action that can be accessed by users using Vault's Bulk Action capability to initiate Payment Requests across multiple studies, study countries, or study sites with a single request.

feature: Invalid Fees
description: Invalid Fees allows users to specify when a Fee in an approved Fee Schedule should not be evaluated.

feature: Restrict Payment Request to Study Organization
description: Users can now specify on a Study Organization whether they want to group the items with other items for the same Organization.

feature: Fee Base Amount Populates Amount When Blank
description: For customers using the Overhead capabilities in Payments, the Fee Base Amount field now populates the Amount field on Fees when the Amount field is not populated. For consistent user experience, the Amount field is now populated if the Base Amount is populated and the Amount field is blank.

feature: Payment Requests: Additional Lifecycle States
description: With this feature, additional standard Payment Request Lifecycle states are available.

feature: Automate Site Staff Creation
description: When this setting is enabled and sponsor/CRO users are approving Site Staff Change Requests for new site staff, the system will automatically select existing or create new Person and Study Person records for the new site staff member.

feature: Set Site Connect Reply To Email
description: This feature enables defining a reply-to email address via a "Mail To" link available within all document exchange emails sent to site users at the site level. This link, when accessed via the document exchange email, starts a pre-crafted email to the reply-to email address allowing the site to simply upload files and send.

feature: Auto-Distribute Milestone Documents
description: This feature enhances the Automated Document Exchange feature by allowing Sponsor/CROs to block automated document sending and requests until a specific milestone is reached (such as HA approval), thereby enabling them to have greater control over the document exchange process.

feature: Site Connect Hardening
description: This release includes two Site Connect enhancements. We've optimized download speeds for bulk documents, reducing wait times and improving efficiency. The "Last Download Date" now updates only when Site Users download documents from the Site Connect UI.

feature: Site Staff in Site Connect
description: Sites can now track site staff members roles and responsibilities for a study in Site Connect.

feature: Remember Site Staff Roles & Responsibilities
description: When site users add a site staff member to Site Connect, the system remembers what role and responsibilities were selected. The next time that site staff member is added to Site Connect the remembered role and responsibilities will be defaulted as a starting point. These can still be modified if needed.

feature: Copy Responsibilities When Adding Site Staff
description: When a site user in Site Connect is selecting responsibilities for a site staff member, they can select another site staff member in this study to copy the responsibilities from. This can significantly streamline the selection of responsibilities when adding multiple site staff members who need to perform similar tasks.

feature: File to SiteVault Duplicate Document Detection
description: When using the File to SiteVault action, the system checks for exact duplicates in SiteVault and if any are found, the user is warned.

feature: Revise & Return for Study- or Country-Level Documents
description: This feature enhances and simplifies document exchange for Sponsors/CROs by enabling sending study or country-level documents to sites for a Revise and Return task.

feature: Payment Information Enhancements
description: This feature includes Payment-related usability enhancements: Payment info displayed in local currency, payment letter downloaded in PDF format only, new standard lifecycle states for Payment Request objects, and help text on text fields for site user guidance.

feature: Activation of Standard Site-Level Roles
description: In support of sites adding site staff in Site Connect, the following standard Study Team/Application Roles will be enabled in all Site Connect Vaults: Principal Investigator, SubInvestigator, Clinical Research Coordinator, Budgets & Contracts, Data Coordinator, Other Non-Investigator, Pharmacist, Regulatory Coordinator, and Research Nurse.

feature: Improved Safety Acknowledgements
description: Safety acknowledgment has now been improved to ensure existing safety distributions pending acknowledgement can be acknowledged by site staff who were not part of the initial distribution, but have received subsequent distributions.

feature: Site Staff Change Request Configuration Migration
description: To reduce the burden of the "Site Staff in Site Connect" feature, the configuration is now automated for the Site Staff Change Request object in Permission Sets, Lifecycle Roles, and Matching/Custom Sharing Rules based on Study Person security. In addition, a Site Staff Change Request section has been added to Study Site Page Layouts.

feature: Site Home User Interface & Navigation Improvements
description: The Site Profile section now houses Site Staff and Site Addresses tabs. The Study Admin section is relabeled to Site Settings and Study Contacts is now a section. Filtering for a Site in Site Home is now easier for sponsor/CRO users with type ahead search. The Site Address changes dialog and End of Study Media text has minor updates for clarity.

feature: Additional USN Sign Up Enhancements
description: The USN sign up process is enhanced to deliver a better experience for users, including updated instructions and FAQ, persisting sign up information, and defaulting the name and email.

feature: New Milestone Types for Autocomplete Approval
description: New milestone types are available that can leverage the Autocomplete Approval Milestone functionality, which enables autocompletion for approval milestones when the corresponding submission milestone receives an Actual Finish Date and a Submission Decision of Approved or Approved with Conditions.

feature: Bulk Actions for Surveys
description: Survey actions, Send Checklist Based on Contacts, Generate Link, and Inactivate Link, are now available as bulk actions.

feature: Download Referenced Document in Survey
description: Survey respondents can download referenced library documents included in Site and Outreach Surveys.

feature: Key Study & Country Documents Cycle Times
description: New Global Milestone Types and Global Milestone Offsets are added to support cycle times for study and country key document packages. The feature also includes updated labels and descriptions for Health Authority related cycle times.

feature: Update Standard Questions
description: This feature includes updates to existing Veeva Standard Questions and new additions to the Veeva Standard Question library.

feature: TMF Export
description: This feature adds one-click export of all TMF documentation for a study. Options are available for the user to determine what should be included in the export.

feature: Remove Need for Power Delete Permission for Deletion with Reason
description: Users with the permission to execute the Delete Document with Reason action no longer need the Power Delete permission to complete the action.

feature: Create Single SEC Quality Issue When Reclassifying & Using Subartifacts
description: This is an exception to the normal SEC rules whereby if subartifacts are being used, a reclassification of the document will inevitably result in the change of the subartifact as well. Likely this will result in the creation of two SEC QIs (depending on the configuration), and this is unnecessary. Only a single QI is needed.

feature: Study Training Matrix Review
description: With this feature, Study Training Admins can send updated Training Matrix drafts for review to relevant stakeholders.

feature: Add Curriculum Group to Training Matrix Builder
description: This feature allows a user to add new section(s) to the Training Matrix Builder. These sections result in a separate Curriculum being created to house associated Training Requirements.

feature: Multi-Study Document Training Requirement Equivalencies
description: With this feature, Training Requirements which are auto-created through the Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection from the same source document will be considered to be equivalent.

feature: Study Training Enhancements
description: Several enhancements are included in this release to better support Study Training: Blocking Matrix updates when its in the process of being published, specialized responsibilities appropriately grouped, added failure logs for Related record jobs, standard field rule inclusion in person integration point, fixed site license count discrepancies.

feature: Study Training Matrix Draft Highlight
description: When you create a new draft of a Study Training Matrix, changes to the draft are highlighted to provide greater visibility to the changes.

feature: Training Assignment Resolved Lifecycle State
description: This introduces a new lifecycle state on Training Assignment to indicate that the TA is not expected to ever be completed, but it was not assigned by accident, and is not closed.

feature: Brand Team Security Management
description: The management of User Role Setup records and User Role records can now be automated using the Team, Team Assignment, and Team Member objects.

feature: Claims: Commenting for Review & Approval
description: This feature enables commenting to support review and approval of claims in Vault.

feature: Claims: Auto-Link PreLaunch Claims
description: Auto-Linking has been extended to include non-steady state Claims that are assigned to the PreLaunch lifecycle state.

feature: Modular Content: Document Info Panel Enhancements
description: Various user experience improvements have been made to the Modular Content section of the Document Info panel to help streamline the review process of a Material document.

feature: Portal: Shareable Portal Links
description: Users can now share direct links to Portal and individual Portal Widgets, including static, dynamic, and system-generated tabs. Links always reflect the current contents of the widget and respect Vault security, ensuring only authorized users can access.

feature: Modular Content: User Mentions for Commenting
description: To continue improving the user experience when reviewing content modules as well as having feature parity with Claims Commenting, users will have the ability to tag/mention others when creating comments. Additionally, minor UX enhancements will be included as well.

feature: eCTD: Flexible Brand Ordering in Bulk Generate
description: When generating multiple packages, the product__v values on a material no longer have to be in the same order to be grouped in the same compliance package.

feature: Veeva AI: Quick Check Agent Entry Criteria
description: A new entry criteria option is now available that allows users to prevent the document from moving forward if the Quick Check Agent has not yet been run on the document version. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Veeva AI: Quick Agent
description: Quick Check Agent is now implemented as an AI Agent on the new Veeva AI Platform. As part of this change, the AI Chat Assistant is now part of the Vault Platform AI Chat, as a dedicated PromoMats Assistant agent. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults. *This feature is Auto-on in Vaults configured for Veeva AI. Other Vaults require configuration.

feature: Veeva AI: Show Quick Check in the User's Language
description: The Quick Check Agent results now display in the user's language and locale.

feature: Stability Summary Report: Word Formatted Output
description: This feature enables generation of a Stability Study Report in Word or PDF from a Lab Study or Timepoint. The report consolidates results across timepoints, conditions, and orientations, with options to customize content using Vault’s Word Formatted Output capabilities.

feature: Test Execution: Instrument Integration Enhancements
description: In this release, improvements have been made to the experience of using integrated instruments during Test Execution. Users can trigger requests for data from instruments directly from a Result or manage them through a separate integration partner URL.

feature: Design Data Management: Design Data Portability Support Create New Version
description: This feature enhances the Design Data Loader to support automatic up-versioning of design data records.

feature: Design Data Management: Design Data Portability Support Non-Vault Owner
description: Non-Vault Owners can now use Design Data Import/Export.

feature: Design Data Management: Test Definition Builder
description: The process of creating and managing design data records in LIMS has been simplified, making the process faster, visual, and less error-prone. Design data Admins can easily create or update test definitions from a single interface. Design data Admins also get a visual preview of the output, helping catch mistakes early and reducing back-and-forth corrections later.

feature: Test Definition Compare
description: This feature allows Design Data Admins and reviewers to easily see what changes were made across the history of a Test Definition, expediting the review process.

feature: Design Data Management: Spec Data Builder
description: This feature simplifies the process of creating and managing design data records in LIMS, making the process faster, visual, and less error-prone. Design data Admins can now easily create or update spec data from a single interface.

feature: Design Data Management: Design Data Portability Performance Improvements
description: Performance is improved when importing large amounts of design data records.

feature: Picklist Value Inactivation
description: Picklist values for the following picklists can be inactivated: Sample Type, LIMS Criteria Indication, Sampling Point, Collection Type, Core ID Population Choices, Notation, LIMS Precision Type, LIMS Criteria Purpose, Rounding Rule, Evaluate Option.

feature: Prevent Duplicate Documents from Being Added to Test Definitions & Test Sets
description: The same document and version combination cannot be added to the same Test Definition and Test Set.

feature: Sibling Check Related Record State Change Entry Action Available in LIMS
description: "Sibling Check Related Record State Change" Entry Action, which allows the action to execute based on Lifecycle State of sibling records, is now available in LIMS Vaults. Previously, this action was only available in a Quality Vault.

feature: Support for Generate Document from Formatted Output Actions in LIMS
description: LIMS now supports configuring the existing QMS action "Generate Document from Formatted Output" as both a User Action and an Entry Action. Both actions can be added in LIMS vaults and execute without issues.

feature: Add Samples to Empty Test Set
description: Samples' Tests can be added to a new Test Set. Previously, to add a Test to a Test Set, users had to begin a test, which created a test set and added the test to Test Set. Now, when an empty test set is created, users can add tests to a test set from the test set.

feature: Test Definition Document Field Can Be Made Inactive
description: The test_execution_document__v field on Test Definition can be made inactive if the field will no longer be used.

feature: Timepoint Zero Use Batch Results: Sort & Filter Sample & Sample Type
description: This feature adds sorting and filtering capability to the Sample and Sample Type columns of the match selection grid in the popup dialog when selecting Batch Release Tests to use for the Stability Study's initial timepoint.

feature: Automatically Set Amount & Amount Unit on Spec Execution Sample Action
description: Amount and Amount Unit values are now automatically set on Spec Execution Sample Action from the related Spec Data Sample Action.

feature: Warn If Spec Data Not Found During Batch Create
description: When a Batch is created, the user is notified that Spec Data cannot be found for the Batch's Material/Country/Organization. The user can choose to proceed or cancel Batch creation.

feature: Block Reopening Tests on Imported Batches Instead of Blocking Reopening Spec Exes
description: This feature relaxes limitation that blocks reopening a Batch Release Spec Ex with results used in a Timepoint Zero Stability Study. Moving forward, the Batch Release Spec Ex test will be blocked from being reopened unless the Timepoint Zero Stability Study's test is reopened first.

feature: Disallow Updating Batch on Spec Execution After Initiation
description: The batch of a Spec Ex can no longer be updated after the Spec Ex has been initiated.

feature: Disallow Updating Material on Batch After Spec Execution Initiation
description: The material of a batch can no longer be updated after at least one of the batch's related Spec Executions has been initiated.

feature: Lab Sample: Select Sample Action Automatically Set
description: When a Sample is manually set as the Selected Sample field on a Spec Execution Sample Action of type Select, the Spec Execution Sample Action field on the Sample will now automatically reference that Spec Execution Sample Action record. This is already done if AutoMatch is Yes. Now, it's also done if AutoMatch is No.

feature: Merge Evaluated Value Cells Across Timepoints
description: If Study, Test Definition, Result Definition, and Criteria Formula all match for a given Condition/Orientation combination, Vault merges the evaluated value cells across each Timepoint in the report.

feature: Aliquot Actions: Prevent Misconfiguration
description: The following scenarios are prevented when creating an Aliquot Action: The Aliquot Action's Aliquot Sample Definition (target_sample_definition__v) cannot be greater than 0. Select Sample Action that references an Aliquot Action cannot have its Pull Count greater than 1.

feature: Block Users from Updating Object Type of a Runtime Result
description: The Object Type of a Result can no longer be updated.

feature: Test Set: Updated UI for Ordering Samples
description: The drag style is updated for ordering and reordering Samples in a Test Set.

feature: Create Variation Result Action Excludes Certain Result Records
description: The Create Variation Result action now will not show Results with Aggregate Variables or Cross-Test Variables.

feature: Enhanced Validation to Prevent Loops with Calculated Results
description: When a Spec Data is made effective, an additional check is made to ensure that there no loops with calculated results that could prevent a Test from being completed.

feature: Update Expected User Permission for Certain Objects
description: Users are only required to have Read object permission for certain fields in the following Objects: Criteria Evaluation Set, Criteria Evaluation History, Lab Investigation Request, Lab Test. Previously, Edit field permission was required.

feature: Spec Data Object Type Can No Longer Be Changed
description: Once a Spec Data is created in a certain object type, its object type cannot be changed.

feature: Updated Indication Picklist
description: For Test Definition Criteria of type Operational Criteria, the data model is updated to only include 'Alert' as a value for Indication.

feature: Auto-Population of Key Fields for All Stability Lab Samples
description: The fields Study, Study Timepoint, Time Stored, and Time Stored Units are now auto-populated for all Stability Lab Samples, including Initial Timepoints, regardless of Quantity Tracking. Previously, these were only set when Quantity Tracking was enabled.

feature: Communications Platform UI
description: A Scientific Communication Platform app page is now available where users can educate themselves on pharmaceutical product or medical technology characteristics like safety profiles, efficacy, clinical landscape, and more.

feature: Scientific Statements: Auto-Link Reviewed Statements
description: Auto-Linking has been extended to include non-steady state Statements that are assigned to the Reviewed lifecycle state type.

feature: Medical Portal: Shareable Portal Links
description: Users can now share direct links to Portal and individual Portal Widgets, including static, dynamic, and system-generated tabs. Links always reflect the current contents of the widget and respect Vault security, ensuring only authorized users can access.

feature: Medical Content Taxonomy for Life Sciences
description: This feature adds a standard set of document types and subtypes for Medical Content. The new document types and subtypes are provisioned inactive.

feature: Medical Data Model Standardization
description: This feature introduces new standard document fields, document field layouts, picklists, and object fields in Medical.

feature: Pull HCO & Contact Info from OpenData
description: The OpenData HCP import process is enhanced to include affiliated HCO details and contact information.

feature: Ad-Hoc Documents in Response Packages
description: This feature adds an easy way to include files attached to the Case Response object in the response package sent to the HCP.

feature: Send Emails to the Email Found in the Case Response
description: Inquiry response packages are sent to the email address defined in the Case Contact or Response Contact record associated to the Email Response. Either Contact record may have multiple email addresses related to them. This feature allows the user to determine which of those related email addresses the response package should be sent to.

feature: Generate & Attach Case Report to Case Response or Event
description: This feature streamlines the generation and attachment of Case Reports to the Case Response or the Event via a new action, leveraging Word Formatted Output templates.

feature: Only Show Steady State Documents in the Enhanced Fulfillment Document Picker
description: When adding Fulfillment Documents using Enhanced Fulfillment Document Picker, a default filter will apply so that only Steady State documents are shown. Admins in Vaults using the feature may want to remove the steady state constraint from the criteria VQL configured on the Document field of the Fulfillment Document object.

feature: Asynchronous Audit Exports
description: Related record audit exports and Admin audit exports for documents and objects are now asynchronous, and the exports can now run for a longer time.

feature: Notifications Suppressed in Migration Mode
description: To reduce unnecessary notifications, Vault will no longer send notifications if records or documents are created or updated using Vault Loader or the API with Migration Mode enabled.

feature: Outbound Email Domain: Delete Root Domain
description: A root domain can be deleted if it is not yet verified or if there are no Outbound Email Domains that use the root domain.

feature: Label Sets
description: Admins can define alternative labels to be displayed in the Vault UI within a language to support use cases where different groups of users within a given country or region may have different terminology.

feature: Bulk Support for Document Text Export
description: A text parameter has been added to the export documents API. When set to true, .TXT files with the document text will be included in the export for each document. Vault loader extract will also allow extracting the document text.

feature: New Locales
description: Vault now includes over 200 additional Locales to assign to users. A user's assigned Locale determines how dates and numbers are viewed in the Vault user interface.

feature: Email Participants Notification Template Set to Every Occurrence
description: The Email Preferences value of the email_participants__v notification template is set to Every Occurrence if it was previously set to Summary.

feature: Search Truncation Warning Update
description: The truncation warning that appears when a user's search matches the content in over 5,000 documents is now permanently displayed in the search criteria section rather than temporarily displayed as a banner.

feature: Improved Multi-Vault User Experience
description: When users are using different Vaults in different browser tabs/windows, Vault sessions will remain active in all tabs if the user uses the Vault Selector to change Vaults within a tab/window.

feature: Document Relationships Administration Page
description: Admins can now directly configure Document Relationship settings in Admin > Configuration > Document Setup > Document Relationships.

feature: Migration Rendition Reuse for Office & PDFA Files
description: When migrating documents using the file staging server, renditions previously rendered in a lower environment are now reused when migrating to other Vaults.

feature: Provide Additional Fields in Field Dependency Grid & Export
description: To make field dependencies more comprehensible, additional fields are now available for field dependencies in Admin > Configuration > Field Dependencies and the field dependencies Excel export file.

feature: Post-Processing Support for PDFs with Security
description: Vault now renders all PDFs that are not protected from viewing, and applies post-processing (such as overlays, signature pages, and OCR) based on the new "Post processing for PDF files with security" Rendition Profile setting. The legacy "Allow viewing and annotation of protected PDF files" setting is deprecated.  For Vaults with the legacy setting enabled in the Default Rendition Profile, we will auto-enable the new "Post processing for PDF files with security setting" on every Rendition Profile in the Vault.

feature: Enable Move on Brought-Forward Auto Links
description: Users can now move brought-forward Approved Links and Auto-Accepted Links.

feature: Show Lifecycle State on Keyword Link Annotations
description: For keyword link annotations, the lifecycle state is now more visible on the annotation card. Previously, the lifecycle state was visible only on hover.

feature: 25R3 Platform Data Model Changes
description: With every release, we update the data model to better support evolving needs and new feature functionality.

feature: Asynchronous Workflow Tasks
description: Asynchronous Workflow Tasks automatically start a Vault Job and wait for its completion before advancing to the next step. Asynchronous Workflow Tasks are configured using the new workflow job step

feature: Action Trigger Operator Menu Displays All Operators
description: The operator menu now displays the full list of all Vault Formula operators by category and sorts the suggested operators at the top of the list.

feature: Multiple User Reference Fields for Workflow Participant Groups
description: Workflow participant groups that use a user reference field to populate the group now support multiple user reference fields.

feature: Action Triggers Support IsChanged Function
description: Action Triggers now support the IsChanged() function to easily evaluate if fields have been modified so that action triggers are more efficient.

feature: ThisRecord Function Supports Setting Reference Field Value in Action Triggers
description: The CreateRecord() and UpdateRecords() actions within Action Triggers allow the use of the ThisRecord() function when setting a reference field value. This update simplifies the process of linking a newly created record or an updated record to the record that triggered the action.

feature: Latest Document Version Links Available in Document Workflow Notification Template Tokens
description: A new notification template token is now available for multi document workflows that will include the link to the latest version of the document to help users receiving notifications navigate directly to the latest document version. The new token is labeled: Workflow Documents for Latest Version and is available for all envelope object based notification templates.

feature: Hide Inactive Stages in UI
description: Lifecycle stages that are inactive and do not have any states associated with it are automatically hidden from the stages UI on document and record detail pages

feature: Email Available Task Owners in Automated Participant Groups
description: The Available Task Owners option is now available within the Email Participants action for participant groups that are automatically populated from roles, groups, or user reference fields.

feature: Formulas Within Formulas
description: Object formulas can now reference formula fields when configuring formula fields, field default values, and validation rules.

feature: Word Formatted Output: Object & Rowset Limit
description: Word Formatted Output templates now support referencing up to 40 unique object relationships, an increase from the prior limit of 30. Additionally, Word Formatted Outputs now include an overall Rowset() limit of 50. There are no changes to existing limits for Adobe templates.

feature: Label Limit Increases for Attachment & Workflow Timeline Sections
description: Section Help Content and Section Label limits have been increased from 255 to 500 and 40 to 150 characters respectively for Attachment & Workflow Timeline sections.

feature: Word Formatted Output: Field Label Syntax & Additional Tokens
description: Admins can use syntax to print field labels in addition to field values, so that one Word Formatted Output template can be used for different languages. New syntax is also available to display the language and locale of the user.

feature: Detect Duplicate Persons When Editing Records
description: The existing Duplicate Person Detection functionality has been extended to detect duplicates when existing Person records are edited. *This feature is Auto-on in Vaults configured for Duplicate Person Detection. Other Vaults require configuration.

feature: Adaptive Rich Text Editor
description: Rendering rich text editors has been optimized on record detail pages by introducing a lightweight display mode. This mode hides formatting options and displays content only until a user interacts with it. This enhancement will provide noticeable performance gains for Vaults with layouts containing 10 or more rich text fields or sections.

feature: Picklist Field Search Behavior Enhancements
description: When searching in picklist fields on objects, Vault will now treat searches as "starts with" rather than "contains".

feature: Support for All Application Roles in Tree Security
description: Tree Security now supports the assignment of all application roles (System, Standard, & Custom).

feature: Process Monitor
description: The Process Monitor tab is now available. This tab provides dynamic visual process exploration functionality, and enables users to visualize key performance indicators over time in an intuitive and interactive format, without the need to configure reports and dashboards.

feature: Dashboard Charts Drill Down Enhancement
description: Users can now drill down on a data group in a dashboard chart to filter the report to display only the relevant data.

feature: Additional Relative Filters for Dates
description: Reports now support additional relative date filters, such as Previous Week, Current Week, Next Week, Today, Tomorrow, Yesterday, and "is in the last full" (days, weeks, months, years).

feature: Enhanced Merge Cells in Multi-Pass Reports
description: A new option is available to merge cells in multi-pass reports only when the primary object is merged in the report. Merged cells are also now included in flash report emails, PDF exports, and formatted Excel exports.

feature: Support Created By & Last Modified By Fields in Report Formula Fields
description: Users can now add the Created By and Last Modified By fields in report formula fields.

feature: Descriptions & Footers on Dashboard Charts
description: Descriptions and Footers can now be defined on dashboard charts.

feature: Enhanced Standard Matrix Report
description: Standard matrix reports now support the use of formula fields and adding additional columns to display to users when drilling into data.

feature: Support Ladder Multi-Pass Reports in Dashboards
description: Ladder Multi-Pass reports are now available in dashboards.

feature: Search Filters on Non-Primary Objects in Reports
description: Users can now add Search operators to filters for rich text and long text fields on non-primary objects in reports.

feature: Report Export Limit Increase for Excel
description: Reports exported to Excel can now contain a maximum of 250,000 rows, increased from 100,000 rows.

feature: Session Duration by Security Policy
description: Admins can now set the Session Duration per Security Policy. The value is defaulted to the domain-level value, but Admins can now set an override at the Security Policy level. The Session Duration set at the Security Policy level is enforced for all Vaults in a user's domain. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Log In As for Administrators
description: Admins with appropriate permissions are now able to log in as an end-user with a more streamlined Log In As option, leveraging the existing Delegate Access functionality. *This feature is Auto-on for standard Vault Owners and System Administrators in Vaults configured for Delegate Access. Other Vaults require configuration.

feature: Privilege Escalation for Security Policy Conversions
description: Vault will now prevent Admins from using the Convert Security Policy action on Users who have more permissions than the Admin initiating the update. In these cases, the Convert Security Policy option will not display in the Actions menu.

feature: Login Audit History: My Vaults Page
description: For domains that have the My Vaults page enabled, a new login event type is now available when landing on the My Vault page. This feature may not be validated in pre-release Vaults.

feature: Standard User Layout
description: Admins will now be able to leverage a new standard User Layout that takes advantage of Pages and Layout Rules to better organize the layout.

feature: Delegate Access: Vault Owner Group Restriction
description: Admins can now use the "Delegate access allowed only among group members" option on the standard Vault Owners group.

feature: Increase User Role Limits
description: The available limit of User Roles for a single user is increased from 15 to 50.

feature: Site Front Door in VeevaID
description: Site Connect users can see a list of their Studies on the VeevaID website.

feature: VeevaID: Enhanced Multi-Factor Authentication
description: VeevaID users will now be prompted for Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) when logging in from a new country for the first time, or when logging in from two different countries within 4 hours.

feature: Customizable Timeout Period for SDK Jobs
description: Admins can now specify a timeout duration for custom SDK jobs.

feature: Bulk-Cancel Jobs in Queued or Queueing State
description: Admins can now cancel in bulk certain jobs in the Queued or Queueing states.

feature: Scheduled Data Exports: Entity Modification Limits
description: When modifying Scheduled Data Export configurations, the system enforces a strict limit of 30 entities. Modifying the scheduled run time and requesting a full export are allowed as long as the entities are not modified or within limit.

feature: Retaining Sandbox Snapshots Enabled By Default
description: This feature, which allows Vault to provide an option to change the source of a Snapshot when deleting a Sandbox, is now enabled for all Vaults.

feature: Vault Loader Support for Changing Object Type
description: Vault Loader now supports changing Object Types assigned to object records.

feature: Close Disposition Items
description: Users can make decisions and close Disposition Items on the Batch Disposition Execution Page.

feature: Bill of Materials Check
description: Batch Release now checks the Genealogy against the bill of materials (BoM) to ensure they match.

feature: Due Date Handling
description: Admins can configure the Disposition and Check Due Date to use either a Date or Date/Time field.

feature: Genealogy Check Using Bill of Materials
description: Batch Release now creates and uses Bill of Material (BoM) to evaluate quality events related to Materials.

feature: Show My Open Checks
description: A quick filter button has been added for users to view their open checks.

feature: Reassign External Collaborator on Checklists
description: This feature expands the reassign external collaborator feature to include reassigning checklists associated to an external collaborator record.

feature: External Collaboration: Qualification & Organization Questionnaires
description: External collaboration is expanded for Organization and Qualification objects.

feature: Action Path Enhancements: Improved Flexibility & UI
description: Multiple enhancements have been made across Admin configuration, runtime behavior, and end user experience to provide more flexibility when leveraging action paths.

feature: Supplier Risk Assessment
description: Supplier Risk Assessment is a structured process used to identify, analyze, and mitigate potential risks associated with engaging or continuing to use a supplier.

feature: Field Corrective Action: Ingest Reply from External Persons
description: This feature allows the recipient of the External Notification to Reply back to the email and Vault automatically attaches the reply to the corresponding Product Action record.

feature: Record Check & Suggestions: New Configuration Options
description: Recurrence Checks, Duplicate Checks, and Quality Event Suggestions now have additional configuration settings. These new settings offer greater control over how record checks and suggestions are displayed and executed by providing the option to hide similarity scores and exclude alphanumeric values from matching terms.

feature: Enable Auditing for Standard Legacy Migration Objects
description: This feature allows Admins to turn on Auditing for the following standard objects: Legacy System, Legacy Process Record, Legacy Process Artifact, Related Legacy Process Record

feature: Reason for Change: Support for Inline Edits
description: Reason for Change is now supported when governed fields are updated in a list of records. This feature is automatically enabled in Vaults where the Reason for Change feature is already configured. If a Vault does not have any active Reason for Change configurations, this feature does not have any impact.

feature: Audit Room: Nudge Notifications
description: This feature enables users to send notifications to users working on inspection requests directly through the Audit Room functionality. Leveraging preconfigured notification templates, users can ensure timely and consistent communication, improving coordination and response times during inspections.

feature: Record Check & Suggestions: User Interface Enhancements
description: The Record Check dialog now features enhanced clarity for viewing the record check definition. For Vaults allowing override of Suggested Terms, the user interface for Record Checks and Suggestions is improved, enabling users to specify terms to be ignored.

feature: Quality Teams: User Name Hovercard
description: Hovercards are added to Quality Team members' names displaying related user information.

feature: Quality Record Checks with Non-Editable Prompts: Display Exact Match Field Values
description: If Quality Record Check's editable prompts on exact match fields is not enabled, Vault displays read-only exact match field values in the Run Record Check dialog. The values are derived from the record the action is being run on and are limited to Object, Boolean, and Picklist types.

feature: Audit Room: Group Nudge Notification
description: This feature will allow Vault to send a notification to multiple users as a group.

feature: Action Path Enhancements: Only Complete In Progress Action Steps
description: This feature ensures Action Steps are not prematurely completed when the last Change Action is cancelled or deleted by requiring an Action Step to be in the In Progress status to complete it.

feature: Record Suggestion: New Record Suggestion Icon
description: The existing sparkle icon used for the Record Suggestion feature now leverages the lightbulb icon. The lightbulb icon is now displayed instead of the sparkle icon when executing the action and on record layouts.

feature: Action Paths: Add Action Path Validation
description: In Vaults that leverage Action Paths for Change Controls, the Add Action Path action will now validate that the Change Control is not already associated to an existing action path. This can occur if multiple Add Action Paths are configured when creating a record or when a Change Control that is already associated to an Action Path is copied to create a new one. *This feature is Auto-on in Vaults configured for Action Paths. Other Vaults require configuration.

feature: Streamlined Controlled Copy Reconciliation with Barcodes or QR Codes
description: This feature allows users to reconcile printed controlled copies in a streamlined manner using barcodes and QR codes that may be placed on the controlled copy overlay. The printed controlled copies can then be scanned using a scanner on the new Controlled Copies for Reconciliation page where a bulk reconciliation workflow may be initiated.

feature: Ability to Disable the Relationships Panel
description: The Relationships panel can be disabled via a new application setting.

feature: External Collaboration Enhancement
description: External Collaborators collaborating on a Document Review or Document Approval task via the External Collaboration for Documents feature are granted the permission to download the document.

feature: Automated Inactivation of Document Change Request & Periodic Review Records
description: Two new entry actions automatically inactivate associated Document Change Request or Periodic Review records when the target document reaches the lifecycle state where the respective entry action has been configured.

feature: Document Control Homepage: Custom Filters
description: The feature allows document control users to filter the data in each section of the Document Control Homepage.

feature: Process Navigator Enhancements
description: This feature includes several minor Process Navigator enhancements that do not require any additional configuration.

feature: Dynamic Association of Process Navigator Documents Enhancement
description: Process Owners can download a CSV file of the dynamically-matched documents when previewing Document Association Criteria.

feature: Quality Relationships Panel: Document Change Request Section Enhancement
description: The Description of the Document Change Request record is added to the hovercard that displays upon hover of the Document Change Request record in the Quality Relationships Panel.

feature: Station Manager: Tabbed View of Documents
description: This feature allows Station Manager operators to open up to 10 documents in a tabbed view to quickly and easily access multiple documents on the manufacturing floor.

feature: Operating System Information Tracking in Station Device Records
description: The Station Device record now stores the Operating System and Operating System version of the device running the Station Manager iOS or Android app.

feature: Display Latest Steady State Documents on Learner Task Page
description: We are enhancing the Learner Task Page to display information about the training content set associated with a completed Training Assignment and when clicking on a Training Assignment to always display the in use training content set.

feature: Training Homepages: Export Functionality
description: Users can export in CSV format from Training Homepages: Learner Homepage, My Team Page.

feature: My Learning Tab: Announcements
description: The My Learning Tab now lets Vault show up to 10 plain text messages. Admins can choose who sees them by setting conditions based on a user's learner roles or other personal data.

feature: Veeva Training Enhancements
description: This feature includes a grouping of small enhancements to accessibility (color contrast), Instructor-Led Training, Curriculum Outcomes permissions, Substitute Rules, and minor security updates.

feature: Self Enrollment & Direct Assignment: No Due Date Option
description: This feature allows a Training Admin to configure special due date options for Trainings assigned via Direct Assignment or as Self-Enrollment.

feature: TRIA Execution Date Migration
description: Existing Training Requirement Impact Assessment (TRIA) records with a blank Execution Date will be updated to include the date of when the TRIA workflow for that record was last completed.

feature: eMDR: Gateway Certificate Only Authentication
description: Currently, both certificates and user credentials are required to process Acknowledgements from the FDA. With this feature, customers can choose to only authenticate using certificates.

feature: VPS: Previous Report Field Provisioning
description: This feature adds a new field on Adverse Event Report object.

feature: VPS: Adverse Event Report Due Date Calculation Improvements
description: This feature enhances the due date calculation for Adverse Event Reports when new information is received on the complaint.

feature: PMDA: Truncation & Validation Rules Update
description: This feature updates the truncation rules for PMDA.

feature: VPS: Adverse Event Report PDF Text Wrapping
description: This feature optimizes text wrapping to best use the available space in the PDF.

feature: Training Change Request
description: Users can submit requests for changes to the Training Matrix that can be implemented automatically at a specific time, eliminating the need for Training Admins to manually create records.

feature: Reference Instruction Prompt
description: This feature lets authors replace lengthy instructions with a clear visual reference directly in the test, improving clarity, consistency, and reducing errors. Executors get immediate access to critical information. The feature is enabled through configuration.

feature: Optional Entity Versions
description: The user experience has been simplified so that Entity Version is no longer required for all queries and capabilities in Validation Management by discipline. This ability is provided through new layout controls for the Entity, which allow for the management of Requirements (app section) and entity version fields (app control).

feature: In-Scope Requirements & Specifications for Validation Activity
description: This feature lets users define in-scope requirements for a validation activity. RTMs are now auto-updated with correct activity values, and the Challenge Status filter in the Burndown panel is relabeled to “Never Challenged in Entity Version.” The feature is Auto-on but requires configuration to fully use it.

feature: Requirements Entity Version Section Improvements
description: This feature adds improvements to the existing Requirement Entity Version section to rename the Add/Remove actions to Link/Unlink Requirements and provide clearer error messages when Atomic Security configurations block the creation of Requirements or the creation or removal of Requirement Entity Version records.

feature: Enforce the Template Requirement Refactoring
description: The new template requirement logic that was refactored in 25R1 is now enforced on all Vaults.

feature: Tunisia eCTD 3.2 Publishing & Validation (TN v1.1)
description: The system now supports publishing and validating Tunisia eCTD Submissions based on Tunisia specification version 1.1 (DTD v1.1). validation performed against version 1.0 of the Validation Criteria version 1.1.

feature: Japan eCTD 4.0 Validation (JP v1.6.0)
description: The system now supports validating Japan eCTD 4.0 Submissions based on PMDA Validation Criteria v1.6.0.

feature: Bosnia (BA) eCTD 3.2 Publishing & Validation (BA v3.1)
description: The system now supports publishing and validating Bosnia eCTD Submissions based on Bosnia's specification version 1.0 and DTD version 3.1

feature: European Union eCTD 3.2 Validation (EMA v8.2)
description: The system now supports validating EU eCTD Submission based on version 3.1 DTD, specification version 3.1.1 and validation version 8.2.

feature: Auto-Return Bookmarks for Table of Contents
description: When the Publishing Element is set to create return bookmarks, all published documents, published as Viewable Rendition, will automatically get a bookmark that takes you back to the Table of Contents.

feature: Exclude Non-PDF Documents from Link Evaluator
description: Non-PDF Documents will no longer display in Link Evaluator. Previously non-PDF documents would appear with inaccurate link information and no actions could be taken on them.

feature: Add Bookmark Level Column to Edit Table of Contents Page
description: A new column Bookmark Level is added to the Edit Table of Contents page that can be referenced when using the Include Bookmarks to Defined Level action to specify which level of bookmarks should be displayed in a system generated table of contents.

feature: Support Accurate Table of Contents Linking for Multiple CPI Matches
description: The Table of Contents now creates unique links for each instance of a document, even when the same document is matched to multiple items CPIs with unique POLs.

feature: Validation Rule Enhancements
description: General fixes to improved validation have been made across the following regions and rules: EU v8.1 and v8.2 - Rule 11BP2.

feature: Bring Forward Annotations for Keyword Links
description: For keyword links users can now move brought-forward Approved Links and Auto-Accepted Links. Lifecycle State will appear on keyword link annotations

feature: XML Operation Field Respects Default Value for eCTD 4.0 & EAEU Content Plan
description: To align with behavior of CTD Content Plan Template creation the XML Operation field will default to empty if there is no default configured for the XML Operation field.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: HAQ Response Automations
description: This feature introduces new objects and fields, including a new Health Authority Response object, to better support tracking of responses to health authority questions. A new Initiate Response user action and guided flow allows users to initiate the response document and other response activities more efficiently.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: RIM Bot Prediction Metrics Enhancement
description: Prediction metrics will be updated daily and cycled with each release rather than only monthly updates.

feature: Restrict Tokens for Use in Standard Notification Templates
description: Some notification template tokens have been available for use in notification templates where they have not been supported for resolution. This feature restricts the tokens such that they are only available for use in notification templates where they are supported for resolution.

feature: System-Managed Data Made Read-Only
description: System-managed fields that drive the submission structure and display elements in Submissions Archive Viewer on the Submission Metadata object are made read-only. Custom fields remain editable.

feature: Export API: Support for Published Submissions
description: Submissions Archive Export API is extended to support the export of published-in-Vault submissions via the Vault API.

feature: Viewing eCTD 4.0 Keyword Optimization
description: To streamline eCTD 4.0 viewing in Submissions Archive Viewer, Health Authority eCTD Keywords will now appear only on document rows, not sections. This provides essential context at the document level without adding redundant information.

feature: Viewing Sender Defined eCTD 4.0 Keywords on Published Submissions
description: For eCTD 4.0 submissions, the Code System OID for sender-defined keywords on the first submission is blank until the 'Health Authority Received' state. The OID appears on all subsequent submissions and for all Health Authority keywords.

feature: Update Local Regulatory Information
description: When an Event’s scope changes, users can review and update existing local regulatory information, such as Submissions.

feature: Grouping of Change Items
description: Vault groups similar Change Items together based on Product Family, making it easier for users to find, assess, and disposition the changes included in an Event.

feature: EUDAMED Container Packages Submission Generation
description: This feature adds the ability to generate container packages submissions for container package update submissions to EUDAMED.

feature: EUDAMED Acceptance: Data Updates to Support Compliance
