description: Health Authority submission acceptance triggers updates for Registered Device Identifier relationships, which will support additional business rule validation for Market Information and Container Package submissions.

feature: Impact Assessment Enhancements
description: This feature includes enhancements to the impact assessment process: impact assessment and activity creation for a specific set of countries; optional prompts in impact assessment reports.

feature: EUDAMED Market Information Machine-to-Machine & Viewer Support
description: Users can generate, review, and send Market Information submissions for registered devices directly from Vault to EUDAMED using a machine-to-machine (M2M) connection.

feature: EUDAMED Container Packages Machine-to-Machine & Viewer Support
description: Users can generate, review, and send device container package submissions for registered devices directly from Vault to EUDAMED using a machine-to-machine (M2M) connection.

feature: Update to Defaulting Local Differences Logic
description: The defaulting logic introduced in 25R2 to default attributes based on local differences has been updated. The defaulting process now executes before validation matching, instead of after, to correctly match on defaulted attributes. Validation and splitting records based on different combinations of ingredient details have also been updated.

feature: Create GCP from Active Dossier: Baseline from Application Support
description: A new action is introduced to Create Global Content Plans with an option to match current documents from a reference Application, tracked in Active Dossier, as a baseline for the next change event.

feature: Vault Loader, VPK & Bulk Updates for Activity & Content Plan Item Deletion
description: As a prerequisite to delete Activity or Content Plan Item records using Vault Loader, Bulk Action, or VPK, users must first confirm that the Document Set field is blank on all records.

feature: RIM Notification Templates: Email Preference Updates
description: In this release, the Email Preference is updated to Every Occurrence for specific Notification Templates in Submissions Archive and Registrations. This ensures pertinent information is delivered via Vault Notification Emails, instead of in the Vault Summary Email Preference format.

application: RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Extract Proposed Active Dossier Relationships for Registrations & Product Information Tracking
description: A new bulk action can be executed on applications to extract the inferred Active Dossier Item Detail relationship records of existing Active Dossier records for four new relationship objects: ADID Registration, ADID Product Variant, ADID Manufacturer, and ADID Inactive Ingredient.

feature: Improved Document Set Management
description: Users can now create Event-specific Document Set records manually or from templates. Users can track definition, owner, and status, with the option to configure workflows for collaboration. In the Content Plan Viewer, users can reference Document Set information using hovercards, assign Document Sets to Content Plan Items using bulk edit actions, and apply the View by Document Set filter to prepare for dispatch.

feature: Content Plan Viewer: Header Styling Update
description: The CP Viewer header row now has a new gray background and a drop-down to apply the special "View by Activity" filter for GCPs. When used, special filters such as "View by Activity" and "View as Root" have updated styling in the list of applied filters.

feature: Content Plan Viewer: View by Activity Filter for GCP
description: The CP Viewer header has a new drop-down to apply the special "View by Activity" filter for GCPs. When used, special filters such as "View by Activity" and "View as Root" have updated styling in the list of applied filters.

feature: Trigger to Prevent Reparenting Sections Across GCPs
description: GCP sections can no longer be re-parented from one GCP into a different GCP. Note that other reparenting scenarios are still allowed. GCP sections can still be dragged and dropped from one hierarchy into another, with existing limitations (lack of support for Event relationships) and new limitations (lack of support for Document Sets).

feature: Submissions Archive Harmonization for eCTD 4.0 Keywords
description: To ensure an accurate Submissions Archive view, the Harmonization job now supports Sender-Defined Keywords in non-sequential ICH eCTD 4.0 imports. Additionally, Vault now notifies users of unrecognized Sender Keyword Codes from missing submissions to aid troubleshooting.

feature: eCTD 4.0 Viewing: Document Reuse & Document Title Display
description: Submissions Archive Viewer display handles intra-application Document Title Updates for eCTD 4.0 Document Re-use.

feature: Tunisia eCTD 3.2 Archive & Viewing (TN v1.1)
description: Submissions Archive supports importing, viewing, and exporting for Tunisia (TN) eCTD v1.1 based on the ICH eCTD v3.2 standard.

feature: Bosnia and Herzegovina eCTD 3.2 Archive & Viewing (BA v3.1)
description: Submissions Archive supports importing, viewing, and exporting for Bosnia and Herzegovina (BA) eCTD v1.1 based on the ICH eCTD v3.2 standard.

feature: Hide Cumulative View for Japan eCTD 3.2 Submissions
description: Submissions Archive Viewer does not support the Cumulative View user action due to the cumulative XML structure of JP XSD 1.0. The Cumulative View action is hidden from the Actions menu on sections in the Name column.

feature: eCTD Metadata Updates: Document Reuse Optimization
description: For eCTD 4.0 submissions, where documents are reused across multiple applications, document title updates are displayed in Viewer and exported via the eCTD Metadata Updates feature.

feature: Import Notification for Missing Primary Filename
description: Submissions Archive now provides a Warning message when an imported dossier contains one or more files that lack a primary filename (such as .docx). Vault uses the file's extension as the Document Name for the Submissions Archive Document during import, and the 'Import complete with warnings' notification lists each Document Name for user review.

feature: File Name Update for Import Results Attachment
description: In this release, the Submissions Archive Import Results CSV file name is updated to append a system-generated unique identifier at the end of the file name. This update only affects the file name of the Import Results CSV, not the structure or content of the file.

feature: Active Dossier Viewer: Filter by Section
description: A new global filter called Section is available in the Active Dossier viewer and allows users to filter the Active Dossier by sections in the Active Dossier Template.

feature: Active Dossier Support for Clinical Study, Nonclinical Study & Indication
description: This feature adds support for tracking documents associated with a Clinical Study, Indication, and Nonclinical Study in Active Dossier. New Active Dossier Templates & RIM Reference Models are provisioned for tracking CTD modules 4 & 5. Special logic is introduced for tracking published RLCP documents and their source documents.

feature: Active Dossier Hovercard Updates
description: The Active Dossier Country hovercard is updated to display dates and comments. The Registrations and additional Product information hovercards are also updated to reduce noise by removing the column filters and search bar, with an added pop-out icon to allow further search and filter on the related records.

feature: Tag Only Clinical Trial Study Cases as SUSAR
description: Admins can now configure their Vault to tag Case Assessments as SUSAR only when they are associated with a clinical trial study.

feature: Convert FDA VAERS E2B(R3) Validations to Vault Expressions
description: This feature transitions Veeva Safety from JSON-based Case Data Validations to Vault Expression Validations and updates some FDA VAERS E2B(R3) validations.

feature: FDA eMDR Generation & Manufacturing Report Number Automation
description: This feature introduces the generation of FDA eMDR XML files and adds fields and objects for tracking and exporting manufacturing sites and manufacturing report numbers to the FDA eMDR XML and the August 2024 version of the FDA MedWatch 3500A form.

feature: Unknown Formulation Product Selection
description: Veeva Safety now supports the use of Unknown Formulation Products during adverse event intake and processing.

feature: Blinded Cases Rule Evaluation for Agencies
description: The Safety Reporting Rule Engine now supports determining agency reportability for blinded clinical trial Cases.

feature: Patient Content Protection: Mask PII (EU Guidance)
description: This feature introduces a Patient Content Protection parameter to meet requirements for EU GVP Module VI Addendum.

feature: Process Completion Date Population for Inactive Cases
description: When a Case moves into the Inactive lifecycle state, Vault now populates the Process Completion Date with the current date and time.

feature: Combination Product Type Identification
description: This feature adds the Combination Product Type field to the Product object, which identifies when Combination Products include drugs, devices, or both.

feature: Exclude Concomitant Products from Auto-Coding
description: With this release, Veeva Safety can always exclude concomitant drug role products from auto-coding against the Company Product library.

feature: Manage Blind Protection for Case Narratives
description: Admins can now use the Turn off Blind Protection on Narrative setting without first having to enable the Enable Isolation of Blinded Product Information setting.

feature: Inbox Item to Case Compare Page: Option to Ignore All from Specific Origins
description: Admins can now define sender origins that can include a selectable Ignore All option on the Inbox Item to Case Compare page.

feature: Extend Upgrade to Latest Action to Update MedDRA SMQs
description: The Upgrade to Latest action now loads the latest version of Standard MedDRA Queries (SMQs) into a Vault, in addition to upgrading the MedDRA terms.

feature: Auto-Update Related Case Identifiers in Case Relationships
description: Vault can now update Related Case Identifiers following edits to Case Relationship records.

feature: Multi-Case CSV Data Import: Low-Touch Automation Efficiency
description: This features introduces support for more objects, fields, and limits across both tabular data imports and the JSON API.

feature: Rules Based Narratives: 25R3 Updates
description: This feature updates Rules Based Narrative generation with support for the list and LIST operators for any Case child object, provides standard Narrative Outlines, and adds Narrative Text to Case Follow-up Statements following bulk unblind follow-up creation.

feature: Korea Drug Browser Support for Case Drug History
description: This feature introduces Korean Drug Coding on Case Drug History for domestic Cases and foreign Localized Cases reportable to Korea.

feature: Sender-Based Inbound Validation Compatibility
description: Admins can now enable Sender-Based Inbound Validation for inbound sources that also use Automated Case Promotion or Local Intake Auto-Translation for E2B transmissions received via the AS2 Gateway or Vault API.

feature: Allow Case Data Expressions to Reference Inbound Transmissions
description: This feature extends the Case Data - Expression parameter to allow references to Inbound Transmissions for Safety Reporting Rules and Validation Criteria.

feature: Imported Follow Up Information Cases for Migration
description: This feature adds the Imported Follow Up Information object type to the Case object.

feature: Enablement Update: Convert EMA E2B(R3) Validations to Vault Expressions
description: With this release, the Convert EMA E2B(R3) Validations to Vault Expressions feature is Auto-on. This feature was originally introduced in 25R2 with Support-enablement.

feature: Product Alias: Data Model
description: This feature provisions the Alias Type picklist on the Product Alias object.

feature: AS2 Connection / Transmission Profiles Enhancements
description: With this release, Vault no longer creates a corresponding Gateway Profile following creation of an AS2 Gateway-type Transmission Profile, and enables creating an unlimited number of Transmission Profiles for use with AS2 Connections.

feature: Gestation Age at Outcome Control
description: This feature adds the Gestation Age at Outcome control field to the Case object.

feature: Base64 Encoding for Transmission Files
description: Veeva Safety now supports encoding transmission files using Base64 for ICSR Transmissions sent by AS2 Gateway.

feature: Windows-style Line Endings for Transmission Files
description: Veeva Safety now supports Windows-style line endings in transmission files.

feature: CIOMS I (Chinese) Form Generation
description: This feature introduces the generation of the CIOMS I (Chinese) form.

feature: Assessment Dechallenge Calculation
description: This feature introduces Dechallenge calculations on Case Assessments based on the Action Taken on Case Products and the Outcome on Case Adverse Events.

feature: EU MIR 7.3.1: PDF & XML Generation
description: This feature updates the EU MIR PDF form to version 7.3.1 and enables exporting this report in PDF and XML format.

feature: NMPA E2B(R3): Data Model, Mapping, Validation, & Syncing Updates
description: This feature updates the data model, mapping, validation, and syncing of the NMPA E2B(R3) file.

feature: Inbox Item to Case Compare Page: Improved Matching & Highlights
description: This feature updates the matching logic on the Inbox Item to Case Compare page and adds visual indicators on Case records that could be potential matches to new incoming records.

feature: Updated SUSAR Tagging Behavior
description: With this release, Vault tags Cases as SUSAR only when the Report Type is Study.

feature: PMDA: Clear Case Product Registrations for Inactive Products
description: When processing PMDA-reportable Cases, the Retrieve Reportable Case Product Registrations action on Localized Cases now clears out non-reportable Case Product Registrations when the related Products have been inactivated or deprecated.

feature: Transmission: Sent & Completed Dates
description: This feature adds the Transmission Sent Date and Transmission Completed Date fields to the Transmission object.

feature: Document Intake Highlighter: Display Annotations in View Mode
description: The Document Intake Highlighter panel now shows highlighted terms in View mode.

feature: Auto-Code CAS Numbers for Case External Products
description: Following Vault-creation of External Case Product Substance records, Vault now automatically codes Chemical Abstracts Services (CAS) Numbers associated with substances.

feature: Validation Criteria: Added First and Last Admin Date Validations
description: This feature introduces ICH validation criteria for G.k.4.r.4 and G.k.4.r.5 to check that the First Admin Date is not earlier than the Last Admin Date.

feature: Validation Criteria: Add Reason Omitted Requirements for FDA.D.11 & FDA.D.12
description: This feature updates the FDA.D.11-RO validation criteria to require Race (Reason Omitted) if Race is blank and the FDA.D.12-RO validation criteria to require Patient Ethnicity (Reason Omitted) if Patient Ethnicity is blank.

feature: FDA MedWatch 3500A (August 2024 Version): Compounded Product Update
description: This feature adds support for the G.4 Compounded Product field on the FDA MedWatch 3500A (August 2024 version) form.

feature: MFDS E2B(R3): G.k.9.i.2.r.3.KR.1 Export Update
description: When generating MFDS E2B(R3) files for domestic Cases that are not associated with a study, if the Localized Case Assessment Result does not contain a Localized Assessment Result, Vault now exports a value based on the Assessment Result on the Case Assessment Result to the G.k.9.i.2.r.3.KR.1 WHO-UMC Result of Assessment data element.

feature: Non-Current Tag for Japanese MedDRA Coding
description: When coding non-current Japanese MedDRA terms, Veeva Safety now displays a NON-CURRENT tag, along with displaying the coded Japanese term as “-”.

feature: Validation Criteria: Additional FDA.D.9.1 Nullflavors
description: This feature updates the FDA E2B(R3) validation criteria for FDA.D.9.1 to include the following nullFlavors: MSK, ASKU, and NASK.

feature: Validation Criteria: Exclude Treatment Drug Role from FDA.G.K.1-2,3,4
description: This feature updates the following FDA E2B(R3) validation criteria to exclude Treatment Drug Role: FDA.G.K.1-2, FDA.G.K.1-3, and FDA.G.K.1-4.

feature: Validation Criteria: Updated Marketing Definitions for FDA E2B(R3) Validations
description: This feature updates the marketing definitions for FDA E2B(R3) validations and performs the evaluation of the following validation criteria at the Submission level only: FDA.C.5.4-1, FDA.D.9.1, FDA.G.K.1-1, FDA.G.k.12.r.3.r, and FDA.G.K.9.i.2.r.3-1.

feature: Validation Criteria: MFDS.G.k.9.i.2.r.3.KR.1-1,2 Check Global Case Data
description: This feature updates the MFDS validation criteria for WHO-UMC (MFDS.G.k.9.i.2.r.3.KR.1-1 and MFDS.G.k.9.i.2.r.3.KR.1-2) to evaluate global Case data, in addition to Localized Case data.

feature: Validation Criteria: Update ICH G.k.2.2 and H.1 for NMPA Submissions
description: This feature updates NMPA E2B(R3) Submission validation to not evaluate the ICH.G.k.2.2 and ICH.H.1 validation criteria if there are no Localized Cases for the NMPA.

feature: Enhanced Product Browser for Studies with Unspecified Products
description: In Vaults with Faster Case Product Selection enabled, the Product Browser now displays for imported Inbox Items that have a Study with Unspecified Products.

feature: MDN/ACK Transmission Message Attachment Update
description: With this release, for AS2 Gateway ACKs/MDNs sent using UTF-16, Vault now creates the MDN and ACK Transmission Message by populating the content of the XML file in the Body of the Transmission Message.

feature: Enhanced Potential Matches Page for Duplicate Detection
description: This feature introduces a new Potential Matches page with user interface, category match, and comparison table improvements. *This feature is Auto-on in Vaults configured for the Duplicate Search Potential Matches Page. Other Vaults require configuration.

feature: Korean Drug Substance Coding
description: Veeva Safety now codes Korea Ministry of Food and Drug Services (MFDS) Substance IDs and Substance Names on External Localized Case Product Substance records for domestic Cases and foreign Localized Cases reportable to Korea.

feature: PMDA: Clear Non-Reportable Case Product Registrations
description: With this release, when processing PMDA-reportable Cases, the Retrieve Reportable Case Product Registrations action on Localized Cases now removes non-reportable Case Product Registrations if no PMDA-reportable registration exists for the Product.

feature: PMDA Medical Device and Regenerative Medicine Reporting: Data Model
description: This feature provisions the data model to support future PMDA reporting functionality.

feature: Signal Calculations for MedDRA Queries
description: This feature supports running Signal Calculations using standard and custom MedDRA queries.

feature: Listedness from Core Datasheets
description: With this feature, Veeva Signal provides an option to determine Listedness based on Company Core Datasheets (CCDS) from all Products within a Product Family, instead of looking at the Case Assessment field Listedness from Core Datasheets.

feature: Calculations and Statistical Data Creation for FAERS
description: This feature enables running calculations on quarterly FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) adverse event reports.

feature: Subgroups for Calculations: Data Model
description: This feature provisions fields and picklists on the Statistical Data object to support future subgrouping functionality.

feature: Successful Record Creation During Scheduled Calculations
description: During scheduled Signal Calculation runs, if some parts of the data creation fail, Vault now retains successfully created records. By default, this feature is Visible to All Users who have View permissions for the System Processing lifecycle state.

feature: Supplemental Reports for Workbench PADER Aggregate
description: This feature supports the creation of supplemental Workbench PADER aggregate reports.

feature: Clearer Error Handling for SQL
description: The SQL editor on Safety views now displays SQL error messages and includes a downloadable log file for errors when users run Reports or Dashboards.

feature: Clearer Error Handling for Workbench View Configuration Errors
description: In this release, Safety Workbench improves error handling when Admins configure Workbench Views.

feature: Dynamic Views for Ad-Hoc Report Customization
description: This feature allows Admins to configure Dynamic Views, expanding the list of commonly used Safety fields for ad-hoc reporting.

feature: SQL Editor Enhancements
description: This feature introduces syntax highlighting, line numbers, and keyboard shortcuts to the SQL Editor section on Safety views.

feature: Cancel a Running Workbench Report or Dashboard
description: With this feature, users can cancel running Workbench Reports, and Vault automatically cancels Dashboard executions if a user applies new filters or leaves the page.

feature: Workbench DSUR & PBRER Case Completed Filter
description: This feature includes the option to include or exclude open Cases when running Workbench DSUR and PBRER aggregate reports.

feature: Navigate to a Safety Object from Workbench
description: With this feature, Workbench Dashboards and Workbench Report Excel outputs include links to Safety object records.

feature: Export a Workbench Dashboard Component as CSV
description: Users can now export data directly from a Workbench Dashboard Component to a CSV file.

feature: Filter a Workbench Report Using Starts With and Contains Operators
description: Users can now filter reports using the "starts with" and "contains" operators for text fields.

feature: Filter a Workbench Report by Signal Case Series
description: This feature allows users to constrain Workbench Report results to only the Cases within a Signal Case Series.

feature: Generate Reports from Workbench Dashboard Components
description: Users can now create a new Workbench Report, which will run automatically, directly from a Workbench Dashboard Component.

feature: Workbench Dashboard Usability Enhancements
description: This feature adds paging, sorting, and record counts to Workbench Dashboards.

feature: Scheduler Enhancements
description: This feature updates the Scheduler functionality in SafetyDocs and Workbench, including enabling scheduling monthly activities on a specific day of the week or the last day of the month.

feature: Simplified Deletion for Case Products & Adverse Events
description: Following Case Product and Case Adverse Event deletion, Veeva Safety now cascades the deletion to and clear references in related records.

application: Safety, Safety Signal, Safety Workbench, SafetyDocs
feature: Safety Standardization 25R3: Data Model
description: Updated standard layouts and added new standard fields across Safety applications. Standard layouts have been inactivated (for reference only).

application: Safety, Safety Signal, Safety Workbench, SafetyDocs
feature: Safety Coding Tab Collection
description: With this release, Veeva Safety introduces a standard Safety Coding tab collection that includes Dictionaries, Studies, Products, MedDRA, and Watchlists menus.

feature: Product Family Support for PV Agreements
description: This feature supports classifying Pharmacovigilance Agreements (PVAs) by Product Family.

feature: Generate Draft Pharmacovigilance Agreement Documents
description: This feature enables Admins to configure Pharmacovigilance Agreement (PVA) templates with clauses and subclauses and generate draft documents from PVA Outlines.

feature: EU Risk Management Plan Support
description: This feature supports the creation of two types of Core Risk Management Plans (RMPs) and introduces a picklist field for labeling Core RMPs as Company Core RMPs or EU RMPs.

feature: Multi-Agreement Activities
description: This feature supports creating PVA Multi-Agreement Activity records that span multiple Pharmacovigilance Agreements (PVAs).

feature: Clearer Error Handling When Generating PSMF PDFs
description: Veeva SafetyDocs now alerts users if they attempt to generate a PSMF PDF file from a PSMF Binder that contains placeholder generated documents with missing required fields.

feature: Convert HTML Markup in Literature Abstracts
description: This feature converts HTML markup in the Abstract field of Literature Articles imported from external databases to formatted text.

feature: PSMF Link Annotations
description: This feature supports link annotations between documents in a PSMF binder and maintains links when generating PSMF PDFs.

feature: Risk Measure Support for EMA GVP Module XVI Revision 3
description: SafetyDocs now aligns with EMA's updated guidance on categorizing and subcategorizing additional risk minimization measures (aRMMs).

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: CTMS Managed Protocol Deviations
description: With this feature, the Clinical Operations-EDC Connection limits the updates to CTMS managed Protocol Deviation to avoid data in CTMS being overwritten by updates in EDC.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Prevent EDC Study Name Duplicates
description: With this feature, the connection will not update the study label in EDC if the study name is already used by an existing EDC study or study instance. This feature maps to the "Clinical Operations - EDC Connection: Enforcing Unique Study Names" (25R3-074001) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Safety-Clinical Operations Connection: New Integration Field Rule
description: This feature adds a field rule to the Study Design Type field on the Study object in Clinical Operations Vaults.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Linking Parent & Child Case Information
description: On promotion of Inbox Items generated from EDC Casebooks for child subject SAEs, Vault now creates and updates the applicable Pregnancy, Child Information, and Parent Information types of Cases for processing in Safety. This feature maps to the "Safety-EDC Connection: Linking Parent/Child Subject Information & Relevant Cases" (25R3-071009) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Improvements for Mapping, Merging & Error Handling
description: This feature introduces error handling and mapping enhancements to the Safety-EDC Connection.

feature: Clinical Operations-eCOA Connection: End of Study Media
description: This feature enables CrossLink documents to be automatically generated in eTMF based on eCOA end-of-study participant data. Documents are related to the study, study country, and study site record originally transferred from Clinical Operations to eCOA.

feature: Medical-CRM Connection: Metadata Sync Integration
description: This feature enables the distribution of CRM metadata for use with CLM and Events Management over the standard Medical-CRM Veeva connection. The features built as part of this integration will support the new Content Supply Chain. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Medical-Quality Connection: Transfer of Product Quality Complaints from Medical to Quality
description: Veeva Medical now supports the automatic transfer of potential Product Quality Complaints (PQCs) raised in Veeva Medical to Veeva Quality. PQCs are sent via a Vault-to-Vault (V2V) connection with all relevant product, event, and reporter information required for the Quality Complaint Intake process.

feature: Medical-Safety Connection: Performance Enhancements
description: This feature includes enhancements to prevent Event Reaction and Event Product records from being edited when the Event has been transferred to Safety, and to schedule a connection pull when the Last Successful Run Time is modified.

feature: PromoMats-CRM Connection: Product Data Transfer
description: This connection now transfers product-related data from PromoMats to Vault CRM via the standard Vault to Vault connection. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: PromoMats-CRM Connection: Metadata Sync Integration
description: This feature enables the distribution of CRM metadata for use with CLM and Events Management over the standard PromoMats-CRM Veeva connection. The features built as part of this integration will support the new Content Supply Chain. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Quality-Safety Connection: Provision Standard Product Family & Variant Field Rules
description: Standard field rules have been added in order to populate both Product Family and Product Variant on QMS Reported Product created via the integration to Safety.

feature: Quality-RIM Connection: Requires Correction State for Change Item
description: This new Change Item state will be available to regulatory users when assessing Enhanced Change Control Items from QMS. If mistakes are identified in the Change Control or Change Items the state can be selected to notify the QMS team corrections are needed prior to completing the assessment.

feature: Quality-Safety Connection: Follow-Up & Single Intake Creation Logic
description: Single Intake Creation introduces logic to create one complaint intake based on the safety case assessments created. Additional enhancements include follow-up logic marking a Complaint Intake as Follow-Up, relating the Follow-up Intake to prior Complaint Intake & applicable Complaint(s).

feature: Safety-RIM Connection: Transfer All Valid Registrations
description: With this release, the Safety-RIM Connection handles Registration data synchronization failures caused by agency-related validation issues, and transfers all other valid Registrations.

feature: Safety-RIM Connection: Reflect Accurate Deletions in Safety Vaults
description: For Safety records linked to multiple join records in RIM, Vault now clears only the record’s associated fields when the most-recently synched join record is deleted in the RIM Vault.

feature: RIM-Clinical Operations Connection: Updates to Submission Tracking for Clinical Trials
description: Regulatory data entered in RIM will populate a new milestone type in Veeva Clinical Vaults used to track EU CTR Country Approval. *This feature is Auto-on in Vaults configured for Submission Tracking. Other Vaults require configuration.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Improvements for Study Drug Mapping & Significance Criteria
description: This feature updates device and gestation mapping and Inbox Item significance criteria, and adds support for Date and time on the Date of Death field, improved LMP support, and custom field mapping to Reason Omitted fields. This feature maps to the "Safety-EDC Connection: Allow Unknowns & Time for Date of Death" (25R3-079001) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Safety-Clinical Operations Connection: Setting Product in Clinical Operations
description: With this feature, Admins can configure their Vault to populate the Product in Crosslink documents generated in Clinical Operation Vaults based on Safety Letter and Cover Letter distribution data transferred from the Safety Vault.

feature: Safety-Clinical Operations Connection: Match Countries Based on Code
description: When setting a Country of Origin on a Safety Distribution in Clinical Operations, the system can now set the Country based on a matching 2 character country code from Safety.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Auto-Create System Links
description: Site Connect now automatically creates system links for Veeva EDC when EDC is used on a connected study.

feature: RTSM-Clinical Operations Connection: Auto-Create System Links
description: Site Connect now automatically creates system links for Veeva RTSM when RTSM is used on a connected study.

feature: eCOA-Clinical Operations Connection: Auto-Create System Links
description: Site Connect now automatically creates system links for Veeva eCOA when eCOA is used on a connected study.

feature: Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection: Auto-Create System Links
description: Site Connect now automatically creates system links for Veeva Study Training when Study Training is used on a connected study.

feature: Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection: Auto-Add Differentiated Security Profiles
description: This feature allows Sponsors/CROs to define which Security Profiles should be used for which User when they are auto-created in Study Training.

feature: Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection: Auto-Sync Clinical User Status in Study Training
description: This feature enables Clinical User “status” sync to Study Training so there’s a common treatment of Global Directory.

feature: Site Automated Enrollment Milestone Locking
description: This feature locks the Actual Finish Date field on site-level automated enrollment milestones to prevent manual edits when a study is configured for Date-Based Metrics.

feature: Bulk Copy Issue to Multiple Subjects
description: The Bulk Copy Issue action allows users to copy an Issue record to multiple Subjects in bulk.

feature: Recruitment Planning: Additional Metrics Over Time
description: Metric Types now includes the Consented and Started Treatment in the supported Recruitment planning scope.

feature: SDV Status Support for Subject Visits
description: Subject Visits have been updated to include SDV Status and DMR Status details.

feature: UI Enhancements for the Study Enrollment Status Graph
description: The Study Enrollment Status graph on the Study Manager and CRA Homepages now has a Subject Group filter. Additionally, forecasted metrics over time values will now display when they have been captured on a study.

feature: Enhance No Subjects Enrolled Trigger Logic to Include Deleted in CDMS Status
description: The No Subjects Enrolled trigger logic now correctly accounts for the Deleted in CDMS subject status.

feature: Refine Auto-Populate Last Subject Treated, Started Follow-Up, & Out Milestone Logic
description: Accuracy is improved for automated Last Subject Treated, Last Subject Started Follow Up, and Last Subject Out milestone completion by including additional terming status as part of the logic. The Actual Finish Date populates for Sites marked with No New Subject once the Subjects have reached a terminal status.

feature: Efficiencies for SDR Item Creation & Management
description: Vault automatically generates an SDR Item when a Subject Visit is marked Required and an approved SDR Plan exists. Subsequently, marking that SDR Item as complete automatically updates the Subject Visit's review status to Yes.

feature: Activity Enhancements
description: Users can now log Activities with multiple Attendees and referencing multiple studies by logging Discussions.

feature: Subject Group & SDV Status in Monitored Subject Data
description: Monitoring Event Seeding actions have been updated to include Subject Group details and SDV Status. Subject Group details are included on Monitored Subjects and Monitored Subject Visits. SDV Status is included in Monitored Subject Visits.

feature: Updated Seeding Logic for Closed Issues in Monitoring
description: The Seed Issues system action now considers the Date Identified field on Issue records instead of the Created Date when seeding closed Issues.

feature: New Generate Risk Mitigation Actions Per Study Job
description: The Generate Risk Mitigation Actions Per Study job now queues Risk Mitigation Action creation on a Study by Study basis.

feature: New Study Field for Pediatric Studies
description: The Study object now includes the new Pediatric Trial (pediatric_trial__v) field.

feature: Merge Persons Action
description: Vault can now merge duplicate Person records directly from the UI using the Merge Person object action.

application: CTMS, OpenData Clinical, Study Startup, eTMF
feature: Autofill Site Timezones from Global Directory
description: When creating or updating a site record in CTMS, the timezone now automatically populates with the site's location's timezone. This value can be overridden by the user.

feature: Auto-Populate Last PSV Date on Location
description: This feature introduces new automation to populate the last_psv_date__v field on the location__v object based on the completion of a PSV Milestone for a Study Site where the location__v is listed as the primary location. This can be used to streamline or bypass PSV visits for locations that are used for multiple studies.

feature: Apply Template EDL Updates
description: For Vaults with EDL Template Refactor enabled, a new user action is available to update Studies with the latest changes from their Template EDL. This action creates missing EDLs, Expected Documents, and Milestone Items for open Milestones so that studies stay aligned with the current standards.

feature: Remove EDL Automation Setting
description: EDL Automation is now automatically enabled with the EDL Template Refactor setting. As a result, the separate Enable EDL Automation setting has been removed to streamline the settings page and reduce confusion.

feature: Milestone Document Panel
description: A new document panel displays Milestones linked to document versions via the Milestone Document object. The panel provides a more accessible alternative to the Milestone document field, allowing users to search, sort, and filter related Milestones and removing previous relationship limits. Related actions now also use this object.

feature: Hide Pre-EDL Refactor Actions
description: For Vaults with EDL Template Refactor enabled, Admins can now use a setting to hide pre-EDL refactor actions from users. This simplifies the Action menu so that users are only presented with relevant options.

feature: Save Removal Preference for Expected Documents
description: Vault no longer re-adds Expected Documents that were manually removed from a Milestone, so that your Expected Documents remain accurate and you can avoid unnecessary rework. Users can still manually re-add these Expected Documents if needed.

feature: Milestone Dependency Enhancements
description: Vault runs the Update Dependencies workflow when a Finish to Finish Milestone Dependency is created or when the system populates a Previous Milestone Date.

feature: Actual Date Offsets
description: This feature enhances Milestone Date Offsets by supporting the update of Planned Dates of downstream (Next) Milestones when an Actual Start Date or Actual Finish Date is added to an upstream (Previous) Milestone.

feature: EDL Automation Respects Excluded Lifecycle States
description: Expected Documents for Study Persons, Study Products, and Study Organizations are no longer created when the Study, Study Country, or Study Site is in an Excluded Lifecycle State. *This feature is Auto-on in Vaults configured for EDL Automation and Excluded States for Milestone & EDL Creation. Other Vaults require configuration.

feature: EDL Override Update
description: Override Template EDL Items now apply field updates such as Requiredness, # Expected, and Department on every EDL Item with the same match field values, regardless of milestone type. This removes the requirement to specify milestone types on override templates solely to apply field updates.

feature: Disclosures: Flexible Start Timing on Disclosure Rules & Re-order Arms
description: The new Start Date Shift value on Disclosure Rules allow Admin to control how early a Disclosure should be automatically created for Scheduled type Disclosure Rules.  Additionally, new ability to reorder Arms in the US Results Disclosure.

feature: Disclosures: Enhancements to Custom XML Generation
description: Users can now generate Custom XML for documents on the new Company Website Disclosure type, and include language field and rendition URL in Custom XML.

feature: Reviewer Comments on Disclosures
description: Users can now add comments within the Disclosure content for reviewers to view when moving through the Disclosure record.

feature: Disclosures: EU Initial CTA Form with Prepopulation
description: Veeva Disclosures now supports the Ability to support EU CTA - Initial Application Disclosure Type, including prepopulation. This Disclosure Type does not include the Part I Product Section.

feature: Disclosures: EU Notification Forms with Prepopulation
description: Veeva Disclosures now supports the Disclosure Types of Notifications for the EU, such as Recruitment Changes, Serious Breach, and Unexpected Circumstances.

feature: Move CTN Setting to New Disclosures Settings
description: The CTN settings are now located under the new Disclosure section.

feature: Archive Readiness Dashboard
description: The Archival Readiness Page is a section that is added to the Study object to view items that may need to be addressed prior to Study Archive.

feature: Add Signature Page to Document Snapshots
description: When archiving or exporting documents, the Vault now ensures that documents which have a signature page have that signature page included in the archive snapshot.

feature: Delete CrossLink Document After Archival Snapshot
description: When there is only a single study tagged on a CrossLink document, and that study is being archived, after the system takes a snapshot of the CrossLink document to add to the archive, the CrossLink document is deleted.

feature: TMF Transfer: Multi-Study Documents
description: When TMF Transfer encounters a multi-study document in the source Vault, the document is always transferred to the target Vault as a single study document.

feature: OpenData Clinical Prior Values Tracking
description: Read-only records are now created for changes that OpenData Clinical makes to Global Directory records as part of daily updates. Users can set up alerting for OpenData Clinical changes using flash reports to more efficiently monitor and assess the impact of any data updates.

feature: Add Missing Parent from OpenData Clinical Site
description: The OpenData Clinical page for sites now highlights when a site's parent is missing from Vault, and provides a link to quickly create the missing parent organization record.

feature: Site Timezone in OpenData Clinical
description: OpenData Clinical now delivers and controls the timezone for an institution or site based on the primary location. This streamlines management of timezones in the Global Directory and on study sites, which simplifies the setup of EDC connections.

feature: Create Excluded Record from Resolved Data Change Request
description: This feature allows users to create an Investigator or Site that is excluded from OpenData Clinical from the Create Missing Record action on a resolved Data Change Request (DCR).

feature: Allow User Entry for Unavailable OpenData Clinical Email
description: Users can now provide an email address for an Investigator when OpenData Clinical does not have a primary email.

feature: Create Missing Record Action Usability Improvements
description: When the Create Missing Record action is taken from a resolved Data Change Request (DCR) that resulted in a new record added to OpenData Clinical, the OpenData ID of the new record displays and the Save + Create option is not available.

feature: Filter OpenData Clinical Investigators & Sites by OpenData ID
description: If an Investigator or a Site's OpenData ID is known, users can filter on the OpenData ID when searching OpenData Clinical in Vault.

feature: Payments: Tax Tracking
description: Payments now supports tax elements. Additional tax fields are available and the system automatically calculates the amount including tax value when tax is populated.

feature: Standard of Care Tracking
description: This feature allows tracking costs related to Standard of Care.

feature: Fees Support Multiple Subject Groups of the Same Type
description: The Fee Subject Group object manages the relationship of multiple Arms, Cohorts, and other Subject Groups on a Fee. When used, when at least one defined Subject Group matches on the Fee, the Subject Group criteria matches.

feature: Automated Adjustment: Amount Override
description: Users can now specify the change amount of a Payable Item for a specific Fee while also allowing Fee Criteria to still trigger an Adjustment.

feature: Automatic Safety Distributions
description: This feature introduces the ability for Safety Distribution to be automatically generated and distributed to sites by leveraging configurable mappings.

feature: Enhanced Error Handling on Expected Documents Action
description: This enhancement ensures that only Expected Documents that are mapped to Vault Clinical Documents and sendable to the site can be marked for auto-doc exchange.

feature: Generate FDA 1572
description: This feature introduces a forms section within the Document Exchange tab. Using Site Address and Study Person data, the system now populates a Form FDA 1572 within the new forms tab within Site Connect.

feature: Improved Site Home Access for Study Persons with Future Start Date
description: This feature introduces a scheduled state to the Site Home Access object. Any Site Connect User Study Person record with a future start date will have a Site Home Access Record in the scheduled state.

feature: Delete Expired PAL
description: To ensure system data cleanup, this enhancement automatically deletes PAL links that have expired from the system on a nightly basis.

feature: Distributed Sites Attachment
description: This feature enables attachments on the Safety Distribution object and creates an attachment record that displays the specific sites the distribution is being sent to.

feature: Site Home & Document Exchange Navigation
description: This feature introduces a navigation button for sponsor users, allowing for easy movement between the document exchange page/section and the site home page.

feature: Removed Site Connect Document View for Obsolete & Deleted State Types
description: Documents sent to sites that are subsequently moved to a lifecycle state mapped to "Obsolete" or "Deleted" state types will no longer be visible within Site Home.

feature: System Link RTSM Domain & Link Naming
description: To support the new RTSM study domain, all system-generated RTSM links will use the new domain URL. Additionally, all system-created System Links will be named "Veeva" followed by the application name.

feature: Study Site Plan (Data Model Only)
description: This feature introduces the foundational data model required for the Study Site Plan feature, including new objects, object lifecycles, workflows, and notification templates. While this feature only includes data model, it establishes the foundation for the future 26R2 introduction of Study Site Plan.

feature: Roles & Responsibilities Usability Improvements
description: This update adds error messages for duplicate Site Home Access records and removes the visibility of the "Create Study Person Records" action when users do not have permission to create Study Persons. Additionally, when using automate Site Staff creation, the system now defaults to the most used person if duplicate records exist.

feature: Site Home User Interface Improvements
description: This enhancement updates the hover text on recalled documents so that the reason for recall is displayed. Additionally, the Study Contacts grid has had columns reordered and a more clear error message displays when document download fails.

feature: Safety Distribution & Job Logging Improvements
description: This enhancement improves error handling in the safety job log so that errors caused by supporting documents without matching countries are easily identifiable. It also ensures that the Resend action on failed distribution tasks correctly updates distribution task recipients and fails every associated distribution when more than 1000 distributions are created at one time.

feature: Clinical User Ability to Reject Document Action in Site Home Removed
description: This enhancement removes the ability for Clinical Operations users to reject document tasks within the Site Home interface. The "Reject" action is now reserved exclusively for Site users to perform.

feature: Inactive Classification Filtering for Site Packages
description: Inactive classifications no longer appear in the drop-down menus when sending site packages. The system filters these selections to show only active classifications.

feature: Milestone Document Exchange Grid Enhancements
description: This feature enhances the Milestone Document Exchange grid by introducing new columns for Study Country and Study Site to improve filtering and visibility.

feature: Clinical Operations Text Updates for Site Connect
description: Help text within Clinical Operations has been updated so that "Rescind/Rescinded" is replaced with "Recall/Recalled" in all areas of Site Connect.

feature: Failed Safety Distributions Visible in Site Home
description: Failed Safety Distributions are now visible in the Site Home interface. This allows site users to acknowledge safety letters even if the email notification failed to deliver to a primary recipient.

feature: Outreach Target Parity
description: This feature introduces organization reusable questions to Outreach Target (study agnostic) Surveys and a new Outreach Survey Person object to designate a survey respondent or survey sender type.

feature: Milestone Planning View
description: This feature provides a dynamic milestone planning page with a Gantt timeline that supports reviewing and editing the trial's anticipated and actual timeline.

feature: Standard Formatted Output Updates for Site & Outreach Target Surveys
description: The standard formatted outputs for Site Survey Response and Outreach Target Survey Response are updated to include reference to the new rich text comment field.

feature: Custom Email Senders for Completed Survey Notification & Generate New Link
description: With the enablement of Custom Email Senders, the system now supports a From, CC, or BCC email sender for Completed Survey Notifications and when the Generate New Link action is executed on an existing Survey.

feature: Addition of Never Require QC Option for Risk-Based QC
description: Risk-based Document QC has been enhanced to allow document types to be mapped to a 'Never Require QC' risk level which will allow these document types to always skip the QC.

feature: Training Completions Grant Clinical Access
description: When a Study Training user completes their training, Vault automatically grants them Study access in Clinical Operations.

feature: Study Training Matrix Builder: Remove Sections
description: This feature enables the removal of curriculum sections on the Training Matrix Builder. Previously, users were only able to create and edit sections.

feature: Study Training Enhancements
description: This feature includes a grouping of small enhancements to Study Site statuses in Study Training, internal users on the My Study Team Page, Study Training Matrix Builder UI and messaging, and Classroom TA visibility on the Leaner Homepage.

feature: PromoMats: Layout Profile Detail View for CRM Rendition Settings
description: CRM Rendition Settings now uses the newer Layout Profile Detail view in PromoMats Vaults.

feature: PromoMats: Secure Message via Approved Email
description: This feature provides a new Email Template Type, Secure Message Notification Template, and a new document relationship for sending secure messages via Approved Email.

feature: Brand Team Group Management
description: Admins can now automate user-managed group memberships though Brand Team Security.

feature: Claims: Text Asset Auto-Linking by Object Type
description: Admins can now select the Text Asset object types to include in the Auto-Linking process.

feature: Claims: Text Asset Auto-Linking Settings
description: The Auto-Link on Initial Upload feature is expanded to support all document upload scenarios, and allows users the option to configure when to automatically run auto-linking based on Document Lifecycle State.

feature: Claims: Hierarchical Copy
description: Veeva PromoMats now provides users with the option to copy all other child objects when copying a Text Asset record.

feature: Claims and Modular Commenting Enhancements
description: This feature involves various usability enhancements and defect fixes involving the existing Claims and Modular Content commenting functionality.

feature: Provision Standard Component Document Relationship Type
description: A new standard Components Document Relationship type (components__v) can be enabled for PromoMats Vaults.

feature: Claims: Indication Available for Metadata
description: Users can add Indication metadata to both Text Assets and applicable documents. In addition, the existing Harvest Claims feature is extended to include Indication metadata.

feature: Updated Brand & Country Page Layouts
description: The standard Brand and Country page layouts have been updated in PromoMats Vaults.

feature: Claims: New Audience Field
description: A standard Audience (audience__v) field is now available for the Text Asset object, which uses the same picklist as the existing Audience document field to ensure metadata consistency. This allows users to specify the intended audience for each Text Asset record.

feature: Portal Subscriptions
description: Users can now subscribe to a Portal and receive a weekly email digest that highlights the documents added to the Portal within the last seven days and the announcements published within the last week.

feature: Modular Content: Additional Document Info Panel Enhancements
description: To help streamline the review process of a Material document, users now can add Content Module Combinations to the Modular Content section of the Doc Info Panel. Keyboard navigation also is improved for accessing assets with each Content Module.

feature: eCTD: Enhanced Support for Video/Audio Files
description: Veeva PromoMats now supports regenerating eCTD Compliance Packages when an video or audio file has been added to the Compliance Package as a main material.

feature: Error Message Update for Team Assignment URS Records
description: The error message displayed when a user tries to save a Team Assignment URS record without populating any custom fields has been updated to be more accurate.

feature: Custom Terminology & Learning for Quick Check Agent
description: This feature allows you to increase accuracy and reduce noise by teaching the Quick Check Agent your specific terminology directly from the issue menu, along with Claims Library awareness for fewer false positive reports.

feature: Premarket Boxed Warning Detection for Quick Check Agent
description: The Quick Check Agent can now detect and validate Boxed Warnings on documents for a premarket product, even if it does not yet appear in the FDA’s official database.

feature: Smart Page Detection for Boxed Warning Check in Quick Check Agent
description: This feature automatically pinpoints Boxed Warning pages in large documents (20+ pages) to focus visual inspection.

feature: Advanced ISI Extraction & Evaluation for Quick Check Agent
description: Important Safety Information (ISI) statements are now isolated using a dedicated two-step extraction process to ensure accurate evaluation within promotional materials.

feature: Precision Enhancements for the Accessibility Check in Quick Check Agent
description: Users can now run refined checks for Alt Text and paragraph-level Color Contrast to ensure broader accessibility compliance, and a more consolidated list of issues.

feature: General Enhancements for Quick Check Agent & Content Agent
description: This feature provides direct issue annotation for all quick checks, localized explanations, and smarter background routing for chat. It includes architectural upgrades for automated metadata context and dedicated agent permissions.

feature: Enhanced Reviewer Summary & Metadata Check for Content Agent
description: This feature provides an updated document summary action that now incorporates deeper metadata validation alongside standard checks.

feature: Content Agent Is Now More Veeva-Aware
description: The Content Agent has an updated persona, and has deeper structural knowledge of how PromoMats is constructed, helping it to distinguish between the document content and document fields.

feature: New Calculation Scope: All Tests with Same Root Parent
description: This feature expands aggregate and cross-test variable scopes to support all tests with the same root parent. This scope aggregates all test results where there is a common root parent sample based on each sample’s lineage. Additionally, all sample lineage records now have the root parent sample defined.

feature: Result Replicates & Impurity Testing
description: This feature enables a more efficient method of defining and executing of test repetitions, reducing the need for redundant design data. Result Replicates can also be used to support Impurity testing, granting analysts the ability to add ad hoc results when unknown impurities are detected during test execution.

feature: Multi-Stage Testing for Dissolution & Content Uniformity Tests
description: This feature introduces Multi-Stage Testing in Veeva LIMS, automatically guiding additional testing when initial results fail. It supports stage-by-stage workflows for Dissolution and Content Uniformity, handling stage order, cumulative calculations, and progression logic.

feature: Precision Rules for Impurity Testing
description: In support of impurity testing, this feature includes precision rules for dynamic changes in result precision.

feature: Trend Charts: Regression Support for Stability
description: This feature enables lab managers and test reviewers to analyze stability trending, in order to identify regression results that are trending towards an earlier than expected expiration, to proactively prevent product or process failures and recalls before they become specification failures.

feature: Trend Charts
description: This feature introduces embedded statistical process control charts in Veeva LIMS. From a Spec Ex detail page, users can now use control charts, like X and I-MR charts, to compare a batch's test results against previous batch results. The charts identify and highlight the results that are out-of-control (OOC) and out-of-trend (OOT).

feature: Stability Study Data Migration
description: This feature provides a way to easily migrate historical stability timepoints into Veeva LIMS such that it is compatible with core stability functionality.

feature: Certificate of Analysis Field on Spec Execution
description: Users can uncheck the Certificate of Analysis field for the Stability Spec Exec object type on Spec Execution object.

feature: Changes to Material Object
description: The market_country__v, material_sub_type__v, and short_description__v fields have been added to the Material object. The finished_material__v and intermediate_material__v object types have been added as inactive to the Material object.

feature: AVGIF & MAXIF Functions
description: This feature adds AVGIF and MAXIF functions to LIMS calculations.

feature: Deterministic Aliquot Actions
description: This feature enhances the LIMS data model to ensure that the correct Lab Sample is used during the aliquoting process at Run Time.

feature: Test Definition Builder: Allow Documents to Be Selected for Sample Result Entry Test Definitions
description: For Sample Result Entry Test Definitions, one or more documents can be selected for reference in Test Definition Builder.

feature: Design Data Builder: Save Last Page User Was On
description: Design Data Builder remembers the user’s last visited location within a record and automatically returns them to that location when they reopen it.

feature: Test Definition Builder: Respect Default Values
description: Test Definition Builder will display default values, if configured, for fields.

feature: Test Definition Builder: Keyboard Shortcuts & Navigation
description: Various keyboard shortcuts and navigation shortcuts are now available for Test Definition Builder.

feature: Spec Data Builder: Respect Default Values
description: Spec Data Builder will display default values, if configured, for fields.

feature: Spec Data Builder: Export List of Unsupported Setup
description: When opening Spec Data Builder and it has unsupported configuration, the user can now export it to .XLSX format.

feature: Spec Data & Test Definition Builder: Keyboard Navigation & Shortcut Support
description: Various keyboard and navigation shortcuts are now available for Spec Data Builder.

feature: Design Data Builder: Search Capability
description: Users can now search for Inputs/Results within Test Definition Builder and search for Sample Definitions with Spec Data Builder.

feature: Test Definition Compare: Hide Fields Not Applicable to Object Type
description: This feature enhances Test Definition Compare by hiding fields that are not applicable to the Object Type being viewed.

feature: Set Lab Study Owner on Creation from Lab Study Design
description: This feature sets the Owner on the Lab Study to the user who generates it from a study design.

feature: Design Data Builder: Edit Starting Screen Field Values
description: Test Definition and Spec Data Builder now allows the fields from the starting screen to be edited.

feature: Simplified Criteria Definition
description: Admins can now define a simple version of a criteria for the result value type. For example, for a numeric result, Admins can select a minimum and maximum value for the criteria, rather than needing to define it in the format of the advanced criteria formula.

feature: Design Data Builder: View Version History
description: Design Data Admins can view the Version History for Test Definition or Spec Data from Builder.

feature: Test Definition Builder: Mode of Entry Can Be Updated
description: Users can now change the Mode of Entry for a Test Definition to Sample Result Entry if specific conditions are met.

feature: Test Definition Builder: Updates to Calculated Method Parameter Results
description: For Calculated Method Parameter Results, the Target Result now filters out for Basic Variables, and the Cross Test Variable and the Aggregate Variable variable types and the Material constant types are not shown.

feature: Test Definition Builder: Default Basic Variable Name
description: For Basic Variables, the Variable Name is defaulted to the result name in Test Definition Builder.

feature: Spec Data Builder: Sample Plan Can Be Edited If Blank
description: Users can now edit or set the sample plan field from the builder if the sample plan field is blank on the current spec data.

feature: Spec Data Builder: Spec Data Defaulted for Criteria Set
description: When creating a Criteria Set from Spec Data Builder, the Spec Data reference is now automatically set.

feature: Deterministic Aliquot Actions: Create New Version Enhancement
description: The Create New Version action is being enhanced to automatically create and reference Select Actions where needed to make existing Aliquot Actions deterministic.

feature: Test Definition Builder: For Sample Result Entry Variations, Only Allow Valid Setup
description: Admins can no longer configure Integration Results, Inputs, any results on >1 unique step, or any cross test or aggregate variables on a Test Definition Variation of the Sample Results Entry variation type.

feature: Test Definition Builder: Including Results for Sample Result Entry Variations
description: For Sample Results Entry Test Definition Variations, Admins now cannot select results that are not allowed to be included.

feature: Test Definition Builder: For Variation Result Inclusion, Auto-Select Dependent Results
description: When a calculation result is selected to be included as a variation result, the results that the calculation result depend on are automatically selected

feature: Spec Data Builder: Not Applicable Behavior Update
description: Checking Not Applicable now decrements the denominator for Lab Samples Defined.

feature: Material Is a Required Field on Batch
description: Moving forward, Batch records must have a Material referenced to be saved.

feature: Sample Result Entry Display Sample Name
description: In Sample Result Entry, this feature adds the display of the Sample Name when selecting samples, and when entering results for samples, making it easier to identify the samples when selecting and entering results.

feature: Test Definition Builder: Icons
description: The following field types now have icons next to them: the (Result) Data Entry Method, (Criteria) Indication, and (Result) Precision and Precision Type picklists; the (Inputs) Expected Amount + Units and Mode of Entry object reference fields; and the Result) Object Types field.

feature: Test Definition Builder: Operational Results Renamed to Method Parameters
description: Operational Results has been renamed to Method Parameters in Test Definition Builder.

feature: Test Definition Builder: General UI Updates
description: In the Test Definition UI, placeholder text is now displayed for field entries, tooltips appear when users hover over fields, and Not Applicable is hidden for locked Test Definitions.

feature: Test Definition Builder: Inline Field Validation
description: Before saving, the Test Definition Builder shows inline errors if a required field is left blank of if the minimum or maximum is exceeded for text and number field types.

feature: Test Definition Builder: Test Method Field
description: Test Method, a text field, is available in Test Definition Builder.

feature: Spec Data Builder: General UI Updates
description: In the Spec Data Builder UI, the Lab Samples Collected terminology has been updated to Lab Samples Defined, text underneath circles has been updated to Click a sample or group of samples to define actions, and the Order tab for Assign Test does not display if only one SRE Test Definition is selected.

feature: Stability Summary Report: Grouping Logic for Multiple Test Definition Versions
description: This feature updates the Stability Summary Report to group results from Test Definitions with the same Trace ID into a single row, splitting rows only when the Criteria Description differs. For multiple versions, it uses the most recent version’s Test Definition name, Result Definition name, and Criteria Description.

feature: Spec Data Builder: Edit Spec Data Criteria
description: Spec Data Criteria can now be edited without having to go through the Assign Tests dialog.

feature: Spec Data & Test Definition Builder: Enter Key Support
description: All dialogs on the Spec Data builder now perform the primary action on enter. This includes the Delete confirmation dialogs for all Sample Action cards, Not Applicable, and Clear buttons and the Dirty warning dialogs when canceling create/edit of Sample Action cards, clicking Next/Back buttons, or clicking Sample Definitions on the sidebar.

feature: Stability Study CSV Export
description: This feature updates the Stability Study CSV export to output result values and units in separate columns, making it easier for downstream tools to sort, filter, and analyze data without manually separating units from values.

feature: Test Definition Builder: Auto-Scroll to New Result or Input Record
description: When a user creates a new Result or Input record, the record focuses input on the Name field.

feature: Test Execution Limit Update to 50 Tests
description: The Test Execution page is now limited to up to 50 tests.

feature: Criteria Formula Field is Not Required
description: On Spec Data Criteria and Lab Test Definition Criteria, the Criteria Formula UI field is no longer required. Users can leave it blank, opting for entering the new simple mode criteria fields made available in the Simplified Criteria Definition feature.

feature: Medical: Provision Standard Component Document Relationship Type
description: A new standard Components Document Relationship type (components__v) can be enabled for Medical Vaults.

feature: Scientific Statements: Auto-Linking Settings
description: When a qualified document is uploaded to MedComms via the User Interface, Auto-Linking is initiated. Users now have the option to configure when to automatically run Auto-Linking based on Document Lifecycle State.

feature: Scientific Statements: Auto-Linking by Object Type
description: This feature provides users with the ability to select the Scientific Statement object types to include in the Auto-Linking process.

feature: Scientific Statements: Hierarchical Copy
description: Veeva MedComms now provides users with the option to copy all other child objects when copying a Scientific Statement record.

feature: Integration to PubMed
description: Using the new standard PubMed integration, users can now search for, select, and import reference data from PubMed directly into MedComms. Once the relevant literature is selected, Reference records and document placeholders are automatically created to reduce the amount of manual data input required.

feature: Scientific Statements: Indication Available for Metadata
description: Users can now add Indication metadata to Scientific Statements. In addition, the existing Harvest Statements feature is extended to include Indication metadata.

feature: Medical Portal: Subscriptions
description: Users can now subscribe to a Portal and receive a weekly email digest that highlights the documents added to the Portal within the last seven days and the announcements published within the last week.

feature: Scientific Communication Platform: User Interface Task Bar
description: The Scientific Communication Platform (SCP) now displays workflow tasks directly in the SCP UI. This improves the user experience for reviewers by providing the task bar for the Communication Platform record alongside the content that is under review.

feature: Expandable Contact Search Results
description: With the enhanced Search: Case Contact dialog, users can search for Case Contacts using HCO affiliations and address information, and click on a Case Contact to expand a search results row to display additional information. This feature is currently available only to Early Adopters and must be requested via Veeva Product Support.

feature: Contact Search Dialog Sorting
description: With the enhanced Search: Case Contact dialog, users can sort the search results based on relevance, full name, alternate name, and last name, and sort the results in ascending or descending order. This feature is currently available only to Early Adopters and must be requested via Veeva Product Support.

feature: Inbound Email Mapping for Case & Case Request
description: This feature introduces configurable mapping rules that automatically populate fields on Case or Case Request records during email ingestion. It enables Admins to automate data entry and ensure record consistency by mapping incoming email metadata directly to specific object fields.

feature: Phone Number Field Control
description: Enable users to input phone and fax numbers with the appropriate format.

feature: FAQ Quick Search
description: Users can manually search the FAQ library while talking to an HCP, without having to capture the question that was asked. When the relevant FAQ is found, users can provide the associated Standard Response to the HCP. The Request and Response are automatically logged.

feature: Standardization of User Access and Time Metrics on Cases
description: This feature provisions the User Role Setup (Case) object and adds DateTime (Opened, Closed, First Response, Target Close) and Country lookup fields to Case records. It enables Admins to configure granular, geography-based security and ensures consistent time-zone and location data for global teams.

feature: Medical: Layout Profile Detail View for CRM Rendition Settings
description: CRM Rendition Settings now uses the newer Layout Profile Detail view in Medical Vaults.

feature: Medical: Secure Message via Approved Email
description: This feature provides a new Email Template Type, Secure Message Notification Template, and a new document relationship for sending secure messages via Approved Email.

feature: Enhanced Audit Storage
description: Large document and object audit logs may now be stored in files to improve the scalability of the audit trail. Audit logs stored in files remain accessible from the user interface and API. In some scenarios, it may now take longer to retrieve full audit details.

feature: Searchable Object Fields Admin UI Update
description: The Searchable Object Fields page in Vault Admin is updated to improve usability. Users can now add or remove multiple fields before committing. Once all items are modified, the user can select either Commit Changes or Revert Changes.

feature: Picklist Order Type
description: A new attribute on picklists allows Admins to specify how picklist entries are displayed to users. It allows picklist values to be returned in alphabetic order by the picklist value of the user’s language, instead of using the predefined MDL picklist order. This new attribute can be set using MDL or on the picklist itself in Business Admin.

feature: Outbound Email Domain: Send Using Root Domain
description: Admins can now create Outbound Email Domains using root domains even when those domains are already registered in CRM's Approved Email system.

feature: Phone Number Field Search
description: This feature improves how phone number fields are searched. Users can now search for full or local phone numbers with any combination of dashes, white spaces, or parentheses.

feature: Enhanced Multilingual Record Search
description: This feature improves the CJK optimized object search to support all languages.

feature: Excel Copy/Paste
description: This feature allows users to paste multiple values directly from spreadsheet applications, such as Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, into Vault fields that support multiple values.

feature: Streamlined Multi-Vault Navigation
description: Vault names in the Vault Selector and My Vaults page are now hyperlinks that can be right-clicked to leverage the browser's available options for opening in a new tab or window.

feature: New Language Picklist Options
description: This feature adds Mayan dialects and an indigenous Polynesian language to the Document Language picklist for Vaults with multilingual document handling enabled. These languages are for reference only; full language analysis is not supported when searching.

feature: Improved PDF Text Extraction
description: The PDF text extraction process has been updated for improved term accuracy when searching document content.

feature: Pagination, Column & Filter Limits
description: Some limits have been applied to search to guard against potential performance issues. Columns and filters have been limited to 100 and users are not able to paginate past page 100 in results.

feature: Admin Option for Overlays & Signature Pages in Viewable Renditions Download from External Viewer
description: Admins can now enable application of Overlay and Signature Pages on downloads of the Viewable Rendition via the External Viewer. This setting is disabled by default.

feature: Standardized Word Markup
description: Rendition Profiles now support generating renditions with standardized redline markup for Microsoft Word documents, showing tracked changes (such as insertions, deletions, and moves) inline in red. Insertions appear underlined, deletions appear struck through, and comments appear as balloons.

feature: New CrossLink Source Type
description: CrossLinks can now sync the source document’s Source File in addition to the Viewable Rendition.

feature: Doctype Triggers
description: Doctype Triggers are a new Vault Java SDK entry point that allow Vault application developers and Admins to extend Vault document functionality. Triggers execute at the document version level with pre- and post- events for insert, update, and delete actions on document metadata.

feature: Migration Rendition Reuse for PDFs
description: When migrating documents using file staging, existing renditions are now reused when migrating to other Vaults.

feature: Allow Custom Renditions on CrossLink Documents
description: Users can now manually add renditions to CrossLink documents just like they can for any other document, based on the Rendition Types configured for the document type. Renditions are not pulled or synced from the source Vault document.

feature: Remove Limit on Product & Country Document Fields
description: Product and Country document field limits have been raised from 50 to 250, bringing parity with other object reference fields on documents.

feature: OCR Limit Increases
description: Vault OCR limits have been updated to 100 MB for image files, and 500 MB and 1,500 pages for PDF and TIFF files.

feature: Vault File Manager: Exclude Parent Folders When Downloading Folders
description: When downloading folders from Vault File Manager, the folder path now includes only the folder being downloaded and no longer includes parent folders. The initial holding folder for the export from VFM will still be included, and the naming convention for that holding folder has been updated to be shorter as well as part of this change.

feature: Enhanced Field Update Behavior for Document Creation Event Actions
description: For new documents created, validation now occurs after any existing Create Document and Create Copy event actions. This allows documents to be created with empty required fields because the event actions can populate the empty required fields. Before, this was not possible. This change does not apply to the Create Draft event action.

feature: Vault File Manager: Reduce Frequency of Auto-Refresh API Calls
description: Vault File Manager now performs API calls to refresh data every 10 minutes instead of every 30 seconds. A refresh button is available in Vault File Manager for users to manually check for updates more often.

feature: Workflow Activity Log
description: The Workflow Activity Log offers Vault Admins a clear and complete view of how workflows run and make decisions. This new activity log provides a step-by-step record of every action and condition check in a workflow.

feature: Adjustment to Action Trigger Behavior on User Records
description: This feature adjusts the behavior of Action Triggers on the User object to prevent them from firing during internal, system-driven operations. This change standardizes trigger execution with user triggers: https://developer.veevavault.com/sdk/#user-triggers.

feature: View All Workflow Participants
description: This feature provides the ability to view all participants in the workflow and their associated tasks.

feature: Support Created By & Last Modified By in Workflow & Lifecycle Formulas
description: Users can now add Created By and Last Modified By fields in lifecycle and workflow formulas.

feature: Read & Understand Workflows Excluded from Auto-Started Workflow Limit
