description: Read & Understand workflows no longer count toward the maximum limit of ten auto-started workflows per document. This change ensures that document reviews can start automatically regardless of how many other Read & Understand workflow tasks are active on the document.

feature: Document Scanner Improvements for Android Devices
description: Scanning documents on Vault Mobile on Android devices has been improved to provide better quality scan, more consistent page detection, and image clean-up.

feature: Display as Simple for Complex Relationships
description: Admins can now configure complex join related object sections to be displayed as a simple join instead. This allows users to more intuitively navigate to the related record and add & remove records in bulk. This new setting is available for all related object sections based on a complex join object.

feature: Word Formatted Output: Tokens for Object Label, Object Description, Relationship Label & Field Description
description: Word Formatted Output now supports tokens for object label, object description, relationship labels, and field descriptions.

feature: Checklist: Allow Other Participants in Checklist Workflows
description: The Participants Control in the Start step of the checklist’s Accepted and Pending Acceptance workflows now support more configuration options. For the Use roles as participants option, other roles besides Checklist Respondent are now also supported.

feature: Word Formatted Output: Increased Rowset Limit
description: This feature increases the overall Rowset limit for Word Formatted Output templates from 50 to 100.

feature: Object Actions: Available in All Lifecycle States Configurability
description: Admins can now configure an object action’s availability based on the record’s lifecycle state, providing more granular control over the user experience. Previously, object action availability could not be changed after it was configured at creation.

feature: Optimized Record Detail Display
description: This feature optimizes the record detail page experience by prioritizing the most useful expanded section first, then asynchronously rendering the remaining content after the page becomes visible and interactable for users, improving the user's perceived performance.

feature: Identify Blocking References for Object Record Deletion
description: Vault now displays blocking references to users when an attempt to delete an object record fails, helping resolve deletion errors.

feature: Word Formatted Outputs: Display Rich Text Values Using Microsoft Word Font
description: Word Formatted Outputs now display Rich Text fields values using the Microsoft Word template's font instead of displaying the values based on the Vault user interface settings. Displaying the rich text values to match the Vault user interface is still possible using the ;vaultfont modifier.

feature: Checklists: Show Workflow Banner for Available Tasks
description: The Workflow Task banner now appears in checklists if the user did not accept the Available Task yet.

feature: Copy & Paste Table as Plain Text for Rich Text Fields
description: This feature allows users to copy and paste tables as plain text into Rich Text fields in Vault. The converted text uses spaces and newlines to maintain a readable layout, while stripping out table formatting and font styles. All text content and links are preserved.

feature: Process Monitor: Export Records
description: In Process Monitor, users can now export a list of all records or documents in a Process View, or export a list of records or documents for a specific lifecycle state or state transition.

feature: Process Monitor: New Metrics & Chart Options
description: Users can now select new metrics related to volume, cycle time targets, and process consistency. Custom charts now support all available metrics.

feature: Process Monitor: Document Lifecycles
description: Users can now run Process Views on document lifecycles.

feature: Custom Sharing Rules on Reports
description: Admins can now add Custom Sharing Rules to reports to automatically share them with users and groups.

feature: Holiday & Holiday Schedule as Configuration Data
description: Holiday Schedule and Holiday records are now configuration data, ensuring that these records do not count towards sandbox size limits and that these records are copied when sandboxes are created or refreshed.

feature: Workflow Due Date for All Workflow Reports
description: The Workflow Due Date field is now available in all workflow reports. Previously, this was only reportable for legacy document workflows.

feature: Document Version Process Reporting
description: Users can now now apply cycle time functions per document steady state version when using document reports that include previous versions.

feature: Aggregate Functions in Report Formulas
description: Report formula fields now support performing calculations on aggregated data across rows, in addition to performing calculations across columns.

feature: Support for Report Filter Aliases in Multiple Language
description: Users can now add aliases for different languages to report filters. Vault defaults to the base language alias and filter name if there are no language-specific aliases.

feature: Execute Reports with Columns with Field Level Security
description: Vault now automatically hides columns in reports and dashboard charts that a user doesn't have access to due to field-level security, rather than preventing access to the report overall.

feature: Login Audit History: My Vaults Page
description: For domains that have the My Vaults page enabled, a new login event type is now available when a user starts their session on the My Vaults page. Documentation of this feature is included as part of the 26R1 release, though the change was previously deployed to all Vaults shortly after the 25R3 general release.

feature: Improved Search for User Administration
description: When searching users in Vault Users or Domain Users (Admin > Users & Groups), Vault now returns results based on all available fields on the User object, rather than just visible fields.

feature: Create Inactive Users in Migration Mode
description: This feature provides support for creating inactive Vault users attached to inactive domain users leveraging Record Migration Mode.

feature: VeevaID Recent Activity
description: User security has been enhanced by providing a new tab in My Account that allows users to track when and where they logged in.

feature: Create Outbound Package: Allow All Accessible Vaults
description: Vault Admins can now create outbound packages and choose a target for any Vault they have access to. Previously, they could only select Vaults that were directly related to the source.

feature: Bulk Translation Multi-File Import
description: Admins can now use Bulk Translation to upload multiple translation files, and then import them in a single action.

feature: Enhanced Default Values for Field Rules
description: This feature enhances the behavior of Field Rules to support Target Field Lookups when a Field Default value is provided. Specifically, when both a Target Field Lookup and Field Default are populated for a Field Rule, the system now looks up the value using the field specified in the Target Field Lookup.

feature: New Permission to Access Root File Staging Folder
description: A new Access Root Folder application permission is available, which allows access the file staging server's root folder. By default, this permission is enabled in the standard Vault Owner and System Administrator permission sets and any custom permissions sets with All Vault Actions checked.

feature: Reference Lookups Availability in Business Admin
description: This feature removes the ability to manage reference lookups in Business Admin. Vault users typically manage reference lookups from the Connections page in Vault Admin. If any changes were made to the Reference Lookup object configuration, they will be reset.

feature: Vault Loader Support for No Triggers with Document Migration Mode
description: Vault Loader now supports the ability to skip triggers with Document Migration Mode from the Vault user interface, API, and Command Line tool.

feature: Enhanced Reference Lookups
description: Reference Lookups now allow the Lookup to dynamically determine the Target Key based on a user defined criteria. Existing Reference Lookups are not modified.

feature: Direct Data API: Publish Files at Vault Time
description: To better align with where the Vault is located and when data is available, Direct Data API Full and Log files are now published at 01:00 Vault time instead of 01:00 UTC time.

feature: Share Disposition
description: Users can create a link to share documents related to the Disposition for external QPs and other stakeholders. What is shared is specified in the Disposition Plan.

feature: Regulatory Check for Change Controls
description: Batches of Products that are authorized to ship to a market, may require additional HA approval for a Change. This feature monitors these approvals.

feature: Material Qualification Check
description: This new Check will monitor QMS SQM (Supplier Quality Management) records to ensure only approved materials were used to make a batch.

feature: Closing Items with Action Triggers
description: Action Triggers are replacing triggers to allow Admins to configure Vault to automatically close Batch Disposition Items when certain criteria are met for the related records.

feature: Making Market Ship Decision
description: This feature allows users to select the Markets they want to evaluate when making a Market-ship Decisions instead of including all available markets.

feature: Prevent Actions from Copying Roll-Up Fields
description: Rollup fields shall be excluded when initiating new records via the following actions: - Batch Release: Revise Plan and Create Batch/Lot Disposition - APQR: Create Record from Template and Recurring Job record creation - Change Control: Create Record from Template - QRM: Capture Assessment History

feature: New Application: Veeva HACCP
description: HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points) is a new application in the Veeva Quality suite that allows organizations to standardize and maintain safe food production practices and also helps them comply with HARPC (Hazard Analysis and Risk-Based Preventive Controls) requirements under the Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA). This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Organization Scalability Enhancements
description: This feature provides reason for change support on the new objects related to hospital, hospital location, organization location, third party and health authority. This feature also adds new fields to the data model to allow Admins to tag these new objects on standard objects.

feature: Record Check & Record Suggestions: All Search Terms
description: In Vaults configured to allow users to override Suggested Terms as part of running Record Checks, this feature enhances Record Check and Record Suggestions to support all (must match) search terms. It is enabled by a one-way Application Setting.

feature: Prevent Creation of Select Quality Configurations for Inapplicable Components
description: This feature introduces changes in administration of Quality Relationship Automation and Quality Record Checks by hiding locked objects, and in Related Record Configuration by hiding the inactive object types.

feature: Add Collaborate Externally Field to Impact Assessment & Change Action Objects
description: This feature adds a Collaborate Externally Field to Change Action and Impact Assessment objects.

feature: Standalone CAPA
description: This feature allows for Investigations, Root Cause Analysis, and Root Cause records to be associated to a Continuous Improvement record as a Standalone CAPA when the original CAPAs identified to address the original event are ineffective.

feature: Quality Automated Language Translations
description: Automated Language Translations are now available for targeted text fields on Complaint Intake and Complaint records.

feature: Supplier Questionnaires: Follow-Up & Invite Respondents
description: This feature enhances Checklists with dynamic, back-and-forth collaboration. Suppliers can now manage responses involving multiple stakeholders by delegating questions via PAL invitations.

feature: Record History Expansion
description: This feature provides the ability to maintain and visualize historical data related to records over time.

feature: Generate Document from Record: Workflow Job Step
description: A new job step has been added that allows for a document to be generated for an object record through a workflow job step. The workflow waits until the processing of the document is complete, allowing for Admins to manage failures in job creation directly within a workflow.

feature: Reason for Change: Support for Word Formatted Outputs
description: Reason for Change is now supported when designing and generating Word Formatted Outputs.

feature: External Response Collaboration: External Collaborator Control
description: An External Collaboration object control has been added to supported objects and allows a user to select a valid person to collaborate with depending on whether they are associated to an Organization, Organization Location, Hospital, Hospital Location, Health Authority or Third Party.

feature: Change Plan: Required Attribute for Current Due Date Field Is Now Editable
description: The Current Due Date field on the Change Plan object has been modified to allow Admins to specify whether the field is required. Prior to this feature, the field was required and unable to be changed by Admins.

feature: Complaint Intake for MedTech
description: This feature introduces a new MedTech Complaint Intake object type as well as new standard fields on both the Complaint Intake and Reported Product objects.

feature: Reason for Change Enhancements
description: Capturing a Reason for Change is now supported when a user accepts a field suggestion through Recurrence Check Insights or modifies a field value through the Action Steps control. In addition, the Reason for Change capture field does not allow the field to be required and throws an error during configuration and runtime.

feature: Proposed APQR-to-APQR Field Inheritance
description: This feature allows product, country, owning facility, and description field level data coming from a proposed APQR to be added to the APQR, if the APQR template does not have these fields populated.

feature: 5 Whys User Interface Enhancements
description: The 5 Whys Analysis user interface no longer allows a user to edit a Why card if the Root Cause Analysis is in a Completed state type or if Atomic Security on relationships is set to Read for the Root Cause Analysis Item object on the Root Cause Analysis lifecycle.

feature: Related Event Section: Display Gestures Based on User Permissions
description: The Related Event App Section no longer shows Create, Edit, or Delete user gestures if the user does not have the appropriate permissions.

feature: Quality Team Section: Display Minimum & Maximum User Requirements
description: When a user edits the Quality Team section, the user now sees minimum and maximum user requirements to improve usability when managing a Quality Team.

feature: Email Body Section: Display Warning Message When Content Exceeds Character Limit
description: The Email Body field on a Complaint Intake, Supplier Change Notification, Complaint, or Quality Event record now displays a warning message if the content exceeds 32,000 characters when viewed through the UI or Downloaded to PDF.

feature: Supplier Risk Assessment: Multiply Scoring Method
description: This feature expands the scoring method on supplier risk assessment to allow for multiplication.

feature: Download as PDF: Export Audit Trail Entries Associated to Reason for Change Records
description: When the Reason for Change section is exported to a PDF using Download as PDF, the Audit Trail entries associated to those Reason for Change Records are now also exported.

feature: Proposed APQR-to-APQR Date Field Inheritance
description: This feature automatically carries the Data Start Date, Data End Date, and APQR Due Date from the Proposed APQR record to the APQR record

feature: QMS Change Related Object Lifecycle State Action: Allow Download of Failed Records
description: When the QMS Change Related Object Lifecycle action encounters an error transitioning related records to a destination state, users can now download the job log file if they have the appropriate permissions as well as a link to download failed records that failed to transition to the destination lifecycle state.

feature: QRM: Risk Builder Usability Enhancements
description: This feature enhances the user experience of our Risk builder capabilities through various usability enhancements such as smooth scrolling performance when interacting with a large number of records, and redirecting users to the last edited cell on save.

feature: Provision Standard Field on APQR
description: The proposed_apqr__qdm field is now available as a standard in all Vaults.

application: QMS, Veeva AI, Veeva AI for Quality
feature: Complaint Agent & Deviation Agent: Generate Narrative Summary & Ask Questions
description: This feature introduces two new agents that automatically draft narrative summaries for Investigations and CAPA plans. Users can also engage these agents through Veeva AI Chat to ask questions and gain immediate insights into complaints or deviations, and their related records.

feature: External Collaboration: Send Steady State Document to External Collaborator on Workflow Completion
description: This feature sends an email with a secure link to external collaborators, so they can view and download a copy of the steady state document that they collaborated on in QualityDocs after workflow completion.

feature: Regulatory Reference Management Configurations Admin Component
description: This feature provides a configuration option that enables admins to select a custom document field and a custom object used to store a mapping of regulatory references to documents. These can then be used by QualityDocs users to associate regulatory requirements to documents.

feature: External Collaboration: Reassign Tasks
description: This feature enables QualityDocs users to reassign tasks from one group of external collaborators to another.

feature: Support Up to 5 External Collaborators for Document External Collaboration
description: Up to 5 External Collaborator Person records can be selected in a single External Collaboration Document Review or Approval workflow.

feature: Document Change Control: Display Count of Unique Associated Documents
description: The count of unique documents that are associated to the Document Change Control (DCC) record are now displayed in the Add Documents dialog in the Change Authorization, Documents to be made Effective with Workflows, and Documents to be made Obsolete with Workflows sections of the DCC.

feature: Quality Relationships Panel: Document Change Request Enhancement
description: The default order of the fields in the hover card that displays upon hover of a Document Change Request (DCR) record in the Quality Relationships Panel has been updated.

feature: Quality Relationships Panel: Bi-Directional Document Relationships Enhancement
description: The Document Number and Lifecycle State is displayed for each document on the Bi-Directional Document Relationships section of the Quality Relationships panel.

feature: Entry Action Enhancement: Check & Close Multi-Document Change Control
description: The Check and Close Multi-Document Change Control entry action is enhanced to be more robust and to reduce conflicts that may arise from running the Auto-Effectivity and Auto-Obsolescence jobs at the same time.

feature: Station Manager Account Password Expiration Improvements
description: This feature improves the experience for organizations that require periodic expiration of their Station Manager User Account passwords. Station Manager users are proactively notified of an upcoming password expiration and they can continue to access the Station Manager in an offline mode upon password expiration for a defined grace period.

feature: Station Manager Activity Object Enhancements
description: Station Manager Activity records are automatically created as the system to track Station Manager usage and reflected in the audit trail as System on Behalf of.

feature: Update Minimum Supported Android Operating System Version for Station Manager to Android 14
description: Android 14 is now the minimum supported version of Android operating system for Station Manager.

feature: Station Manager Support for iOS 26
description: This feature enhances the Station Manager user interface to support the iOS 26 operating system.

feature: Training Focus Time
description: Vault tracks the amount of time a Learner spends on a Vault Document Training Assignment's learner task page before they complete the task.

feature: Quiz: Support Multiple Choice Drop-Down Questions
description: This feature incorporates support for the multiple-choice drop-down question response format for the Quiz Multiple Choice Question Design object type. This feature is auto-on, but requires additional configuration.

feature: Quiz Scoring Updates
description: Quiz Scoring now supports answers having negative scores, multi-answer questions supporting partial credit, and question score grading with weighting. This feature is auto-on but requires additional configuration.

feature: Wave-Based Curriculum Prerequisites
description: Admins can now define the order in which Learners complete curricula by creating rules within a Learner Role. They can define when curricula are available for Learners to complete by creating curriculum prerequisites that are either completion-based or time-based.

feature: Deep Linking to Training Requirements for Self Enrollment
description: When a Training Requirement is open for Self Enrollment, Training Admins can send Learners a link to the related assignment on their Learner Homepage’s Explore tab.

feature: Generate TRIA on Adding or Removing Document
description: When a Training Admin adds or removes a Training Material from a Training Requirement and populates Admin Alert options, Vault creates a Training Requirement Impact Assessment record with the Admin Alert verdicts and marks the TRIA record as Completed once the requirement is Ready for Use.

feature: Training Enhancements
description: This feature includes a grouping of small enhancements to the Quality Relationships (Training Requirements) Doc Info panel, Class Overview dialog fields, assignment exports from the Learner Homepage, the Training Assignments Assigned? TRIA field validation logic, and Classroom Training Assignment availability.

feature: VPS: UK Adverse Event Reporting
description: This feature allows customers to generate XML for UK (according to GB schema) and submit the Medical Device Adverse Event Report via MORE portal.

feature: VPS: Generate PDF & XML with a Single Action
description: This feature allows users to generate both PDF and XML files with a single user action or entry action.

feature: VPS: EU MIR 7.3.1 Updates
description: EU MIR 7.3.1 version can now be enabled from Admin setting instead of by Veeva support. It also adds additional changes in accordance with latest EU MIR 7.3.1 version (SB-10781).

feature: VPS Data Mapping Enhancements
description: This feature adds mapping enhancements for eMDR: G1. Manufacturing Site Name, B2. Outcomes Attributed to Adverse Event PMDA: Outcome, EU MIR: Classification of Incident.

feature: VPS: eMDR Follow-Up Reporting Enhancement
description: This feature allows users to submit only new information in the follow-up reports to comply with FDA guidance.

feature: VPS: EU MIR Enhancements
description: This feature adds various enhancements to EU MIR form including UI updates, truncation and validation rules enhancements.

feature: VPS: Reportability Assessment Enhancement
description: This feature adds enhancements to reportability assessment process. The system can now automatically close the Reportability Assessment record once all Reportability Assessment Effects are processed.

feature: Curriculum Outcomes: Add Learner Role to Person
description: When a Learner completes a Curriculum the first time, Vault creates a Learner Role-Person record for that Learner Role and Person based on the Curriculum Outcome Rule. This feature is auto-on, but requires additional configuration.

feature: Curriculum Outcomes: Add or Remove User From Groups
description: When a Learner completes a Curriculum the first time, Vault adds or removes the Learner (User) from a Group. This feature is auto-on, but requires additional configuration.

feature: Curriculum Outcomes: Add Application Role Without Permission Set
description: When creating Curriculum Outcome Rules, Training Admins can only select Application Roles without an associated Permission Set. This is an update to the existing Add Application Role functionality.

feature: My Team: Learner Compare & Initiate Changes
description: Managers can use the My Team page to compare Learners to aid in determining training matrix updates. This feature is auto-on, but requires additional configuration.

feature: Training Change Request: Create Matrix Records
description: Vault users with limited and expanded permissions can submit Training Change Requests for creating new training matrix records.

feature: Enable TRIA for All in Quality Vaults
description: The Enable TRIA for all Application Setting is now enabled in all Veeva Training Vaults. This previously-optional setting is also removed from Admin UI.

feature: Validation Team Warning Controls
description: Admins can now disable Validation Team Assignment (VTA) checks by state and field through the creation of Validation Team Warning Control records. This provides control when user fields (Author, Executor, Deliverable Owner, and so on) are checked to verify that the user selected has an active VTA for the associated Entity when records are updated.

feature: Download Step & Discrepancy Attachments For Test Scripts
description: The Download Test Script Attachments action can now be added by Admins to Test Script lifecycle states as an entry or user action. When triggered, it retrieves attachments from the Test Script's Test Steps or Discrepancies, organizes the files, and zips and attaches it to the Test Script.

feature: Template Activities
description: Template Activities are reusable blueprints for validation deliverables. Users can import from a template or copy an existing activity to automatically populate all associated deliverables. This eliminates manual setup, streamlines workflows, and ensures strict consistency across projects.

feature: Bulk Manage Requirements & Specifications
description: Requirement Owners can now download and upload requirements through an Excel template for Entities, Entity Versions, and Activities through the Requirement application sections.

feature: Constraining Roles for Validation Team Assignments
description: Admins can now to restrict Validation Team Roles by adding a Constraining role. When adding a Validation Team member to a Validation Entity, the system filters the user selection list based on the predefined role constraints, ensuring only authorized users can be assigned to specific team roles.

feature: Test Comment Deletion Enhancements
description: The Delete Test Script Post-Approval Comments action can now be added by Admins to Test Script lifecycle states as an entry or user action. When triggered, the action deletes Post-Approval Comments and their replies. The existing Delete Dry Run Results action has been extended to better handle the removal of replies from Dry Run Comments.

feature: Standard Fields Updates for Validation Management
description: External IDs are added to relevant Validation Management objects to better enable data migrations. Other field additions are also included, such as Original Due Date on Activity and Deliverable and Original Date/Time Completed for Test Steps.

feature: Application Interface Side Panel Improvements
description: Authors, Executors and Reviewers using Test Script interfaces (Author Test, Execute Test, Review Test, and so on) can now collapse and expand the side panel allowing them to focus on steps. Further optimizations for the width of the side panel to better support more browser resolutions is also included.

feature: Test Step Change: Full Attachment Names
description: Executors can now see the full attachment file names captured in the original and new values fields on the Test Step Change record upon completing a Test Step Change for attachments, removing the previous truncation of 20 characters which was applied to the file names.

feature: South Korea Validation Updates
description: RIM Publishing now supports updates to MFDS (South Korea) validation rules for Validation Criteria version 1.0.

feature: EAEU Validation
description: RIM Publishing now supports validation for EAEU submissions for Validation Criteria v1.1.0.

feature: US eCTD 4.0 Publishing & Validation v1.8
description: Veeva Publishing now supports publishing and validating US eCTD 4.0 Submissions based on FDA guidance version 1.8. Support includes forwards compatibility for lifecycle operations, and validation criteria.

feature: China eCTD 3.2 (NMPA) Specification 1.1
description: RIM Publishing now supports publishing and validating China eCTD Submissions based on China specification version 1.1 (DTD v1.1) and Validation Criteria version 1.1.

feature: US eCTD 3.2 Validation Criteria 4.5
description: FDA released version 4.5 of eCTD 3.2 Validation Criteria. The new version updates six existing rules and adds one new rule.

feature: Singapore eCTD 3.2 (HSA) Specification 1.1
description: RIM Publishing now supports publishing and validating Singapore eCTD Submissions based on HSA specification version 1.1 (DTD v1.0) and Validation Criteria version 1.1. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Auto-Suppress Weblinks & Mailto Links on Published Documents
description: Users can now enable a Yes/No field that automatically suppress all weblinks and mailto links on a published document per Content Plan Item.

feature: Support CrossLink Source Type & Renditions on CrossLink for Publishing Source
description: RIM Publishing now supports publishing documents based on the selection on the SOPD field with respect to CrossLinks matched to the Content Plan Item where the source of the CrossLink may be the source document or a rendition.

feature: Link Evaluator Enhancements
description: This feature improves usability of Link Evaluator to streamline link management workflows. Users can now filter, sort, and customize columns for better data visibility. The tool supports bulk retargeting to apply changes to multiple links at once. The system remembers user settings (such as applied filters and column order) on page refresh.

feature: eCTD 4.0 Updates
description: This feature introduces eCTD 4.0 usability updates with respect to support for unreferenced-files, specifically Cover Letters, generation and management of Table of Content documents, and automatically handling sequence IDs to align with eCTD 4.0 numbering format.

feature: Unified RIM Validation Logic for Submission & RLCP Publishing
description: RIM Publishing now includes centralized System Validation Rules for both the Submission Publishing System Validation Rules and RLCP Publishing System Validation Rules, which are region agnostic.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Correspondence Email Processor
description: This feature introduces a new dedicated email processor for specialized intake of HA correspondence documents. In addition to uploading a document for the email and each of its attachments, the new processor classifies the documents and automatically initiates a workflow for processing.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Updates to Styling of Initiate Response Guided Flow
description: The styling on Initiate Response pages has been updated to align with other RIM features and wizards. Users are taken through a paginated flow that has consistent styling and look and feel with other processes in RIM with respect to the page header, navigation pane, and page description.

feature: Streamlined Import with Automated eCTD Data Population
description: For new eCTD imports, Vault now automatically populates key information from the imported XML file, such as Sequence ID and Application UUID. This feature supports all currently supported eCTD versions, reduces manual data entry, and prevents edits to the Sequence ID after import to ensure data integrity.

feature: EUDAMED Submission Security
description: Customers can control which users are permitted to submit data directly to EUDAMED through the gateway after review is complete.

feature: Product Management Service (PMS) Data in IDMP Viewer
description: This feature extends the IDMP Viewer functionality to allow for the comparison of Vault data against external IDMP data sources, including PMS and FHIR messages generated as a part of the eAF process.

feature: Assess Local Activities
description: Regulatory strategists can now more efficiently assess activities and their activity change items.

feature: Manufacturer Data Management Enhancements
description: Veeva Registrations supports the management of manufacturer and manufacturing business operation data required for IDMP.

feature: Support for Product Management Service (PMS) Data Submission
description: Product Management Service (PMS) submission functionality is now released for general use.

feature: EUDAMED Submission Generation: Max Object Limit Enforcement
description: EUDAMED submissions are now generated with a maximum of 40 Device Identifiers to comply with EUDAMED Production limits.

feature: EUDAMED XSD Version 3.0.25 Support
description: EUDAMED UDI Submission generation is updated to comply with XSD version 3.0.25 which is currently used in Production.

feature: EUDAMED XSD Version 3.0.28 Support
description: EUDAMED UDI Submission generation is updated to comply with XSD version 3.0.28, including updated Acknowledgement response format support.

feature: Product Management Service (PMS) Submission for Pack Size Details
description: This feature is an enhancement to PMS data submission, which extends the functionality to also support the submission of Pack Size details.

feature: Update Local Regulatory Information: Limit to Activities
description: Users can define which Activities should be in scope for updates when running the Update Local Regulatory Information from an Event.

feature: Impact Assessment Report Auto-Split Prompts
description: This feature supports automatically splitting prompts in the Impact Assessment Reports where there are more than 100 values based on a given Event detail value. This allows Med Tech Vaults with larger volumes of products and packaging to get around the existing limits.

feature: High-Volume Product Registration Support
description: The Create Registrations and Manage Registered Details actions now better support products with high volumes of registered details, such as MedTech and generics.

feature: Support for Defaulting Event in Impact Assessment Report Prompt
description: Impact Assessment Reports configured with an Activity > Event prompt and In operator now support automatically defaulting the Event in the Impact Assessment Report Options dialog.

feature: Create Event Details Support for Event Product & Event Indication Fields
description: Create & Manage Event Details (CMED) is updated to improve the handling of Event relationship fields, namely the Event Product field on Event Inactive Ingredient & the Event Indication field on Event Clinical Study. These fields are now appropriately populated based on whether the detail is for Registrations or Content Planning.

feature: Updates to Styling of Registrations Wizards & Pages
description: Updates have been made to the styling of various Registrations actions and pages to provide consistency across Veeva RIM.

feature: Update to Select All Within Create Related Records Wizard
description: When using Select All selection within relationship grids in the Create Related Records wizard, it now selects across all pages instead of the current page only.

feature: GCP Dispatch to Follow-Up Submissions
description: Global Content Plans can now be dispatched to follow-up Submissions to support health authority questions responses and rolling submissions.

feature: Create GCP from AD: Clinical & Nonclinical Study & Indication Support
description: The Create Global Content Plan from Active Dossier action now supports mapping of documents related to Clinical Study and Nonclinical Study sections.

application: RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Active Dossier: Filter by ADID Relationships
description: For Vaults using the Product Information and Registration Tracking feature, Active Dossier records can now be filtered by Active Dossier Item Detail relationship records for Registration, Product Variant, Manufacturer, and Inactive Ingredient.

application: RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Active Dossier: Provide Reason When Editing ADID Relationships
description: As part of the AD Registrations & Product Information Tracking feature, the user is now prompted to enter a Reason for Change when an ADID relationship field is updated in AD Editor.

feature: Match Document Mode Pinned Filters
description: Users can now apply global filters while using Match Document Mode, and the filters are preserved when traversing from CPI to CPI. Global filters are applied in addition to CPI default filters.

feature: Content Plan Viewer Enhancements
description: This feature provides a set of usability enhancements intended to make existing Content Plan functionality more intuitive to use within the CP Viewer.

feature: MedTech: Default Filters for Product & Product Variants
description: Users can now apply default filters for Medical Devices while using Match Document Mode based on the existence of Submission Product relationships.

feature: Advanced Start Support for Multi-Record Object Workflows in Content Plan Viewer
description: When initiating a Multi-Record Object Workflow from the Content Plan Viewer, an Advanced Start option is now available to refine in-scope records.

feature: eCTD 4.0 Archive & Viewing: Document Reuse Recurrence Handling
description: For eCTD 4.0 submissions, Vault now reconciles Document Titles across all instances of Document reuse. This ensures consistent title display in the Submissions Archive Viewer while maintaining point-in-time accuracy. During import, Vault now also provides a warnings file to identify missing referenced documents.

feature: United States eCTD 4.0 Archive & Viewing (US 1.7, 1.8)
description: Submissions Archive supports importing, viewing, and exporting United States submissions compliant with US FDA Module 1 Implementation Guide versions 1.7 and 1.8 for the ICH eCTD 4.0 standard. US 4.0 submissions are viewable alongside US 3.2 submission via Forward Compatibility. US Grouped Submissions are not supported in this release.

feature: EAEU R.022 Archive & Viewing (v1.1.0)
description: Submissions Archive supports importing, viewing, and exporting EAEU submissions using the EAEU R.022 1.1.0 XSD format.

feature: Taiwan eCTD 3.2 Archive & Viewing (TW v2.1)
description: Submissions Archive supports importing, viewing, and exporting Taiwanese submissions according to the TW FDA's eCTD-V-R2.1 for the ICH eCTD 3.2 standard.

feature: China eCTD 3.2 Archive & Viewing (CN v1.1)
description: Submissions Archive supports importing, viewing, and exporting Chinese eCTD submissions according to the NMPA's eCTD v1.1 specifications.

feature: Submissions Archive Harmonization for eCTD 4.0 Keywords Optimization
description: The Submissions Archive Harmonization job is now optimized for handling Suspended Context of Uses for ICH eCTD 4.0 submissions imported non-sequentially.

feature: Active Dossier: Processing Status & Issues Tracking
description: This feature introduces an indicator for status tracking of Active Dossier processing and the ability to view skipped records, errors, and warnings encountered during processing for better troubleshooting.

feature: Active Dossier: Standard Template for Medical Devices
description: Two new Active Dossier templates for tracking In Vitro Diagnostic and non-In Vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices (MedTech) are introduced. The templates are based off of the International Medical Device Regulators Forum (IMDRF) template.

feature: Active Dossier: Update Global Records from Local Submission
description: A new checkbox in Active Dossier Viewer filters the Active Dossier to display only records with an Event. Active Dossier population from Submission lifecycles the existing dispatched records, ignoring metadata matching, supporting continuity for globally managed documents in Active Dossier.

feature: Active Dossier: Replaced Status
description: A new Active Dossier status of Replaced has been introduced to track cases where a document is replaced by another a document before it reaches Current in the market.

feature: New Fields in Active Dossier Viewer
description: Active Dossier Viewer now includes six additional fields to assist with tracking and filtering records: Created By, Created Date, Modified By, Modified Date, Active Dossier Item, and Active Dossier Item Detail.

feature: Transmission Reason Defaulting for Migrated Cases
description: Admins can now configure their Vault to default the Transmission Reason to Initial when a Submission or Distribution is generated for a Case with no previous Transmissions that is a follow-up to a migrated case.

feature: ICH E2D Additional Study Types
description: This feature supports additional Study Type values based on the latest ICH E2D(R1) guidelines.

feature: Japan Postmarket Device & Regenerative Reporting
description: This feature introduces the generation of PMDA postmarket medical device and regenerative medicine files in PDF and XML format and adds fields for tracking and exporting required information on the files.

feature: Device Case Assessments & ICSR Transmissions
description: This feature enhances the Rule Engine to evaluate reporting requirements for each individual device constituent of a Case Product.

feature: FDA E2B(R3) Standard Reporting Rule Version 4
description: This feature updates the standard FDA ICSR Reporting Rule Set to add Investigational to Investigational reporting scenarios for FDA E2B(R3) cross reporting.

feature: Individual Case Routing Criteria Expression Requirements
description: When saving Individual Case Routing Criteria record, Vault now requires the Expression field to be populated and to start with VS_LET.

feature: Deferred Domestic Processing: Localized Event Reported in Native Language
description: This feature allows populating values on the Localized Case to the E.i.1.1a (Event Reported in Native Language) and E.i.1.1b (Localization Language) data elements when generating E2B files for  domestic Cases.

feature: Secure DTD for EMA E2B(R3)
description: This feature supports using secure HTTPS-based links for regulatory submissions.

feature: External Assessments for Clinical Trial Cases
description: This feature introduces a sub-setting so Admins can configure their Vault to continue generating assessments for External Products on clinical trial study Cases, while excluding them on postmarket Cases.

feature: WHODrug Global Chinese Browser
description: This feature supports External Product coding using the WHODrug Global Chinese dictionary.

feature: WHODrug External Product Auto-Coding
description: This feature supports auto-coding External Products based on the WHODrug dictionary.

feature: Study Aliases
description: This feature introduces configurable Study Number Aliases for automated Study matching for structured intake sources.

feature: Document Follow-Up Questionnaires
description: This feature extends follow-up questionnaire rule setup and trackable email to questionnaire document templates in your Vault Library.

feature: Case Approval Due Date
description: This feature introduces the Approval Due Date field on Cases so Admins can configure global case due dates for specific reporting destinations.

feature: Improvements to Import to Inbox Item
description: This feature introduces the Localization and Localization based Mapping on Import picklists on the Tabular Data Format and Transmission Profile objects, which allows Admins to specify how Vault handles incoming data.

feature: Rules Based Narratives: Updates
description: This feature updates Rules Based Narratives so Admins can reference inbound transmission data, Statement Formula conditions support field references from Case documents, a new optional parameter provides fallback text logic, Case Product Dosage records are ordered by First Administration Date, and the Narrative Preview field updates even when Cases are locked by another user.

feature: MedDRA Bulk Recode for Administrative Maintenance
description: This feature introduces a bulk recoding action that identifies and replaces non-current MedDRA terms on Datasheets, Watchlists, and MedDRA Queries.

feature: Transmission Document Generation Status
description: This feature introduces the Transmission Document Status field on the Transmission object.

feature: Code Relevant Products
description: This feature introduces the Product Use Type field on the Product object.

feature: FDA E2B(R3): Primary Study Selection for Cross Reporting
description: Admins can designate the primary study registration for FDA E2B(R3) submissions.

feature: Case Product Device Code Import for Tabular Data Format
description: Multi-case tabular data import now supports Case Product Device Codes.

feature: FDA eMDR Automated Site Report Numbering
description: With this feature, Vault generates Site Report Number names to include the current year.

feature: PMDA: Multiple Marketing Authorization Holder Automation
description: This feature automates the population of Japan Case Product Registrations for each Marketing Authorization Holder (MAH) based on Registration Holder/Applicant values on Product Registrations. Although this feature is Auto-on, some components may require additional configuration.

feature: MHRA MIR (XML)
description: This feature introduces the generation of MHRA MIR XML files.

feature: Follow-up Case Compare: Always Promote Non-Displayed Data
description: This feature resolves a known limitation with Case promotion. During merge to an in-flight Case or promotion to a follow-up Case, Vault now includes data in fields that are not displayed on the Case Compare Followup page.

feature: EU MIR 7.3.1: Export Updates
description: This feature adds fields and updates data mapping to support compliant EU MIR form generation. Although this feature is Auto-on, some components may require additional configuration.

feature: Follow-up Case Compare: Narrative Selection
description: This feature resolves a previous limitation of rules based narratives by introducing document versioning behaviors based on the selection of the Narrative Preview checkbox on the Inbox Item to Case Compare page.

feature: Company Product Browser Search & Filter
description: This feature updates the Product Browser with additional filtering and search features. In addition, the browser displays only Products with a Product Use Type that is blank or Company Product.

feature: Duplicate Detection Results Log & Usability Improvements
description: With this feature, Vault creates a CSV log of all potential matches and attaches it to the applicable Inbox Item and Case. This feature also includes loading indicators as well as improved navigation.

feature: Download as PDF
description: This feature enables downloading object pages as PDF files.

feature: Validation Criteria: Inactivate EMA.D.1-2
description: This feature inactivates the EMA.D.1-2 validation criteria previously used for EMA submissions.

feature: LATAM E2B(R3) Relabeled to Vigiflow E2B(R3)
description: This feature relabels the LATAM E2B(R3) file to Vigiflow E2B(R3). There are no changes to document export or data mapping.

feature: Validation Criteria: Qualification Required When Reporter Is Primary
description: This feature adds the FDA.C.2.r.4 validation criteria, which requires a valid Qualification for primary Reporters on generated FDA E2B(R3) files.

feature: Validation Criteria: Assessments Require Products & Adverse Events (G.k.9.i.1)
description: This feature adds the ICH. G.k.9.i.1 validation criteria, which requires Case Product and Case Adverse Event references on Case Assessments.

feature: NMPA Validation Criteria Updates
description: This feature updates the criteria used to validate NMPA E2B(R3) files.

feature: Automatic Validation Status Recovery
description: With this release, Vault now clears the status of Validation Results records if running Evaluate Regulatory Conformance resolves all validation issues.

feature: E2B Readable Rendition: Adverse Event & Causality Organization
description: This feature improves E2B readable renditions by incorporating G.k.9.i and adverse event references within each product-specific G.k block, and embeds adverse event references within their corresponding product sections.

feature: Medical Assessment: Flexible Rank Columns
description: This feature allows users to reorder the Product Rank and Event Rank columns within the Medical Assessment section on the Case layouts.

feature: Follow-up Case Compare: Alphabetical Sorting for Manual Match Selector
description: This feature improves the Inbox Item to Case Compare page by sorting all picklist entries within the manual match selector in alphabetical order within their respective category sections.

feature: Display Non-Current MedDRA-J Term
description: Veeva Safety now displays non-current Japanese MedDRA Terms along with a recode badge.

feature: Company Product Match Verification for Deprecated Product Registrations
description: During Advanced Product Coding Verification, if the matched Product Registration is deprecated, Vault considers the Product Match Confidence to be an Unlikely Match.

feature: Always Open Multilingual MedDRA Browser in English
description: This feature introduces a setting that allows users to always display the multilingual MedDRA Browser in English.

feature: Duplicate Detection Subject Matching for Clinical Trial Cases
description: This feature introduces a Subject Matches section to group Inbox Items and Cases when duplicate detection is performed for Clinical Trial Study Types using the enhanced Potential Matches page.

feature: Product Quality Complaint Assessments
description: This feature introduces single assessment generation for Product Quality Complaints (PQCs). Although this feature is Auto-on, some components may require additional configuration.

feature: Auto-Generate Domestic Localized Parent Information
description: This feature introduces automatic domestic Localized Parent Information generation whenever parental information is manually added to a related global Case.

feature: WHODrug IDMP MPID Coding
description: This feature supports IDMP MPID data within the WHODrug dictionary.

feature: NMPA: Snapshot Recoded Products
description: With this release, Vault re-maps NMPA-specific data whenever a Case Product is replaced or re-coded.

feature: PMDA MHLW Paper Form: Export Sender's Organization
description: This feature supports exporting the Organization of the User associated with the Sender (User) to Transmissions using PMDA MHLW Paper Forms.

feature: PMDA: Updating Assessments Following Global Approval
description: Veeva Safety now allows assessment changes on Japan domestic Cases to roll up to the global Case, regardless of the global Case’s lifecycle state.

feature: FDA E2B(R3): IND Aggregate Reports
description: This feature introduces the FDA Report Type field. In addition, when generating FDA E2B(R3) files, Vault references the FDA Report Type to map the required placeholder strings to the file.

feature: Document Intake Highlighter: Usability Updates
description: This feature enhances data visibility within the Document Intake Highlighter panel.

feature: Product Family Substances Sync Action
description: This feature introduces an action that propagates all Substances in a Product Family to every Product within the family group.

feature: Field Access Updates for Potential Matches Page
description: With this feature, Vault displays the Reporter Qualification during Potential Matches review. Also, in Vaults configured with Case Access Group Security and with PHI and PII masking on the Potential Matches page, user Case Access Group permissions will be evaluated to provide appropriate PII access to fields on the enhanced Potential Matches page.

feature: Vigiflow E2B(R3): Date Formatting
description: With this release, Vault converts date-based TermID Versions into the MMMddyyyy format for Vigiflow E2B(R3) exports.

feature: Case Version Compare: Improved Record Matching
description: This feature adds standard record-matching logic to the Case Version Compare page, which previously relied on only Link and Compare ID when comparing child records across Case versions.

feature: Case Promotion: Reportability Calculation
description: This feature ensures that assessment generation is fully complete before Vault calculates reportability and deadlines.

feature: PMDA: Unexpected Adverse Event Justification
description: This feature supports populating Expectedness Justifications on Japan Localized Case Assessments even when Case Adverse Events are Unexpected due to Serious Exclusions.

feature: NMPA E2B(R3): Export Updates
description: This feature updates data mapping to the E.i.4 and G.k.CN.4 data elements on NMPA E2B(R3) files.

feature: Multi-Source Signal Data Consolidation
description: This feature consolidates data from Safety and external sources, like FAERS and EVDAS, into one Statistical Data record.

feature: Subgrouping for Targeted Analysis
description: This feature enables running calculations and case counts on data grouped by custom combinations of user-defined dimensions within Product Families.

feature: Calculations & Statistical Data Creation for VAERS
description: With this release, users can run calculations and execute statistical scores against VAERS data.

feature: Information Component Calculation for Signal Detection
description: This feature introduces the Information Component (IC) and IC-Bayes algorithms, along with IC025 and IC005 credibility intervals and the ability to select priors for signal detection. Although this feature is Auto-on, some components require additional configuration.

feature: Clearer Error Handling for EBGM Calculations
description: When EBGM score is unavailable or unreliable, the calculation now completes and a descriptive message is displayed in the Signal Calculation Run preview and on the Statistical Data record.

feature: Ad Hoc Calculations Results Expiry
description: This feature introduces expiring ad hoc calculation results seven days after the calculation run, which also removes the Preview and Create Data actions for the calculation. Existing calculation run results will expire seven days after the version upgrade.

feature: Signal Case Series Dashboard Refresh
description: When opening a Signal Case Series in a Workbench Dashboard from a Statistical Data record, users must now apply filters before any data is displayed in the dashboard.

feature: Statistical Data Handling Based on MedDRA Version
description: This feature introduces a priority order when mapping a reaction event to the MedDRA dictionary on data creation from calculation results.

feature: Clearer Error Messaging for Configuration
description: This feature introduces descriptive error messages for common configuration issues.

feature: Add Product Families to Aggregate Reporting Groups: Data Model
description: This feature introduces a join between Product-Family and Aggregate Report Group (ARG) to support Signal Calculation functionality.

feature: Signal Calculations for Product Family Combinations
description: This feature enables signal calculations at the Aggregate Reporting Group (ARG) level to support Signal Calculations and Signal Case Series generation across Product Families.

feature: Workbench PADER Simplified Registration Number Filtering
description: Workbench PADER will include cases with the specified registration number, instead of just matching to the the single registration record included in the filter. Multiple registration records can have the same registration number.

feature: Migrated Follow-Up Cases for Aggregate Reports
description: Veeva Safety Workbench aggregate reports, including PADER, DSUR, and PBRER, now support migrated historical cases.

feature: Combined Excel Export for Report Sets
description: This feature exports all reports in a report set into a combined Excel workbook.

feature: View Parameter Enhancements for Complex Reporting
description: This feature introduces optional parameters, combined date range parameters, and Excel tokens for embedding parameter values in templates.

feature: Reusable Report Sets
description: This feature supports generating a report set and running multiple related reports simultaneously from a predefined report set definition.

feature: Default Report Styling Template
description: This feature allows Admins to create a global corporate style template to reports.

feature: Import Case Series
description: This feature allows a user to create and import a Report Case Series from a CSV file.

feature: Report Filter Operator: Not In
description: This feature introduces the "not in" filter operator for reports for Object and Picklist field types.

feature: Workbench Report Status
description: This feature introduces a running status on Workbench Reports.

feature: Infinite Scroll on Dashboard Data
description: This feature introduces the Infinite Scroll option on Workbench Dashboard Components for viewing large datasets.

feature: Instant SQL Preview for Views
description: This feature allows Admins to preview SQL changes without finalizing view columns.

feature: Calendar Date Report Filters
description: This feature introduces calendar filters to reports.

feature: Reusable Excel Templates
description: This feature supports using an Excel template across different Workbench Reports with similar safety views.

application: Safety, Safety Signal, Safety Workbench, SafetyDocs
feature: 26R1 Safety Suite Standardization
description: This release includes a number of standardizations across the Safety Suite, which include standard views for Signal, standard layouts for SafetyDocs, relabeled fields, and user-facing error messages for Signal.

feature: PVA: Defer Contact Entry
description: This feature supports creating PVA Obligations before sponsor or partner contact information is known.

feature: PSMF: Display Document Title in PDF Table of Contents
description: This feature enables displaying document Titles in the table of contents of PSMF PDFs.

feature: PVA: Event Based Activities
description: This feature introduces automated activity creation for monitored obligation events.

feature: Automated Inbound PVA Activity Email Processing
description: This feature automates the receipt and processing of inbound Pharmacovigilance Agreement (PVA) obligation activities and their related documents from partners.

feature: Support Multiple Reviewers During PSMF Periodic Review
description: This feature supports multiple reviewers for PSMF periodic reviews.

feature: PSMF Logbook Governance
description: Admins can now restrict PSMF Logbook Entry editing and can require PSMF Logbook Entry before a PSMF document can move to the next lifecycle state.

feature: PSMF Binder Periodic Reviews
description: Admins can now configure periodic reviews for PSMF Binders.

feature: Literature Integration to PubMed Enhancements
description: This feature updates Literature Integration to PubMed with weekly and monthly literature article search jobs, populating the URL on Literature Articles sourced from PubMed, and adds Search Term field warnings to Literature Search Terms.

feature: Increase PSMF Logbook Record Limit
description: Veeva SafetyDocs now supports up to 50 PSMF Logbook Entries per major version of a PSMF document.

feature: Terminate PVA Documents Action
description: With this feature, on the PV Agreement object the Make Agreement Documents Superseded action has been replaced by the Make Agreement Documents Terminated action.

feature: Clearer Error Handling When Generating PSMF PDFs
description: This feature introduces clearer error messaging for the Generate PSMF PDF action.

feature: Added Standard First Day of the Month Schedule
description: With this release, Veeva SafetyDocs now supports scheduled activities consistently recurring on the first day of the month.

feature: PVA: MAA Document Required for Distribution
description: Veeva SafetyDocs now requires a document when creating a PVA MAA Document for Distribution.

feature: Prevent Risk Measure Duplication on Local Implementation Strategies
description: This feature prevents the duplication of Risk Measures when the Create Local Implementations action is executed multiple times.

feature: Veeva AI for Safety: Intake Agent
description: In Vaults using Veeva AI for Safety, this feature introduces the Intake Agent, which processes structured and unstructured files to detect Adverse Event Reports (AERs) and generate Inbox Items.

feature: Veeva AI for Safety: Narrative Agent
description: In Vaults using Veeva AI for Safety, this feature introduces the Narrative Agent, which proofreads and rewrites rules-based narratives based on your Vault's configuration.

feature: Automatic Inbox Item Creation for Adverse Event Report Documents
description: This feature introduces automatic Inbox Item creation following upload of a Case > Source > Adverse Event Report document type to the Library.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Identify Programmatic Protocol Deviations
description: Protocol Deviations created in EDC through a Rule Definition are now identified as a Programmatic protocol deviation when created in CTMS through the connection.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Visit Review Progress Indication
description: This feature indicates whether SDV and DRM are in progress for Subject Visits, alongside existing statuses for SDV and DMR requiredness and completeness. This feature maps to the "Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Partial SDV and DMR Reflects as In Progress in CTMS" (26R1-07G005) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Editable Connection Details
description: Users can now edit default names and descriptions (among other details) for EDC connections, replacing numbered ones with clear names like "Connection to Sponsor A's EDC". This significantly improves organization and clarity within the Vault, helping users quickly identify each connection's purpose.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Flexible Visit Definitions
description: This feature helps CTMS and Payments users create their visit definitions early in their Clinical Vault by matching them on name when the study is connected, making it optional to manually link those records using private keys and IDs.

feature: Safety-Clinical Operations Connection: Inactivate Integration Record
description: This feature inactivates the legacy Study Registration Integration record and removes all associated code references.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Handling Child Details in Pregnancy Cases
description: This feature allows for the pregnancy case child details to be enterable in EDC after the birth of the child(ren) and transfer the child details to Safety as a follow-up to the original pregnancy case. This feature maps to the "Safety-EDC Connection: New Standard Safety Fields & Configuration Restrictions" (26R1-07N015) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Improvements & Additional Mapping Support
description: When transferring data through the Safety-EDC Connection, Dechallenge data from EDC now updates the Dechallenge Override field on Case Assessments, ConMed and study drug details are now sent from EDC, and more pregnancy data is mapped from EDC to Inbox Items and Cases. This feature maps to the "Safety-EDC Connection: New Standard Safety Fields & Configuration Restrictions" (26R1-07N015) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Handling Product Indication
description: When transferring data through the Safety-EDC Connection, Vault now allows Product Indication information to be included and creates Case Assessment records for each. This feature maps to the "Safety-EDC Connection: New Standard Safety Fields & Configuration Restrictions" (26R1-07N015) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Send Additional SAE Reporter Details to Safety
description: With this release, reporter email address and telephone values are now included when transferring SAE reporter contact information to Safety Vaults through the Safety-EDC Connection. This feature maps to the "Safety Integrations: Reporter details with new source, email and phone" (26R1-07M001) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Support Case Product Type Changes
description: This feature supports the changing of a Product Type dynamically when a product from EDC is changed to match products of different types.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Improved User Error Messages
description: User Exception Items (UEI) related to the Safety-EDC Connection include Study details and support LongText failures.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Automated Follow-up Management
description: Vault updates unpromoted Inbox Items to Superseded state upon receipt of a follow-up Inbox Item for the same event.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: User-Friendly Error Messages
description: The Add Relevant Subject Information dialog displays an error message when users do not have Create permission for the underlying object.

feature: eCOA-Clinical Operations Connection: Study Design Specification
description: When a customer has both Veeva eCOA and Veeva Clinical Operations, the Study Design Specification document that is generated by Veeva eCOA can be automatically filed into the eTMF of a connected Study as a representation of the study build. Document is automatically update each time a new collection is approved.

feature: Medical-CRM Connection: Country Integration
description: The new CRM Country Integration optimizes the standard Vault-to-Vault connection between Vault CRM and Medical Vaults. By making Medical Vaults "country-aware", this integration ensures that document updates only trigger notifications to the specific CRM Vaults associated with those countries to ensure data relevancy across your Vault environment. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Medical-CRM Connection: CLM Integration
description: The CLM Integration streamlines the management and distribution of digital content by synchronizing Medical Vault documents with Vault CRM. This integration automates the creation and updating of Multichannel Presentations and metadata, ensuring that field representatives always have access to the latest approved materials. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

application: MedComms, MedInquiry, RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: RIM-Medical Connection: Product Data Transfer
description: This feature allows the transfer of product data between RIM and Medical to have a single source of truth. RIM is the source for product, indication, and local product data.

feature: RIM-Medical Connection: Document Exchange
description: When configured, documents that reach their Steady State in RIM are created as CrossLinks in Medical. Subsequent updates to the Steady State document will be reflected on the CrossLink.

feature: PromoMats-CRM Connection: Country Integration
description: The new CRM Country Integration optimizes the standard Vault-to-Vault connection between Vault CRM and PromoMats Vaults. By making PromoMats Vaults "country-aware", this integration ensures that document updates only trigger notifications to the specific CRM Vaults associated with those countries to ensure data relevancy across your Vault environment. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: PromoMats-CRM Connection: CLM Integration
description: The CLM Integration streamlines the management and distribution of digital content by synchronizing PromoMats Vault documents with Vault CRM. This integration automates the creation and updating of Multichannel Presentations and metadata, ensuring that field representatives always have access to the latest approved materials. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: RIM-PromoMats Connection: AdPromo Submission Performance Improvements
description: The RIM-PromoMats AdPromo Submission feature is refactored and its complex CrossLink Post Processing is broken down into smaller, trackable jobs for improved error handling and faster performance.

feature: Quality-RIM Connection: Ensure QMS RCI & RAI Update Correctly
description: Quality-RIM ECC integration has been enhanced to ensure the QMS Regulatory Change Item records are updated when the corresponding RIM Change Item records are modified by either a user or system.

feature: Quality-Safety Connection: User Exception Item Enhancement
description: This enhancement improves the user exception item, adding the Safety Case ID to the UEI Item Data field.

feature: Quality-RIM Connection: Material Change Object Type on Regulatory Change Item
description: This feature contains the data model changes needed specifically for the Regulatory Change Item QMS object and serves as a precursor to expanding the enhanced change control integration to support changes at the Material level.

application: QMS, RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Quality-RIM Connection: Materials Product Data
description: This feature enhances the existing Quality-RIM Connection's Product Data feature to include the Materials Data needed for Enhanced Change Control. This include Packaging, Containers, Active Substances, Inactive Ingredients, and related object relationships.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive, Safety
feature: Safety-RIM Connection: Updated Product Dose Form Syncing
description: This feature supports tagging a single Product’s dosage forms as either the global preferred term or a country-specific exception and introduces the Product Manufactured Dosage Form object to Safety Vaults, which supports tracking multiple dosage forms for a single Product.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive, Safety
feature: Safety-RIM Connection: Co-Packaged Product Constituents
description: The Safety-RIM Product Data Connection now supports the automatic transfer and alignment of co-packaged products, with Vault creating Safety Combination Products from the RIM Packaging object.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive, Safety
feature: Safety-RIM Connection: Create Product Substances
description: With this feature, following substance information transferred through the Safety-RIM Product Data Connection, Vault now updates all Products in a Product Family with the Product Family Substance details received from RIM.

feature: RIM-Clinical Operations Connection: Update to CrossLink Trigger Logic
description: RIM source documents in the Steady State now trigger the RIM-Clinical Operations Connection and create new CrossLinks in Veeva Clinical.

feature: Veeva Safety: Integration Stats for Safety Connections
description: With this release, Safety leverages a new platform framework to surface Integration Statistics directly within Vault.

feature: Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection: SCORM File Transfer
description: The Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection transfers functional SCORM files from Clinical Operations to Study Training.

feature: Remove Reliance on Risk Library for Study Specific Risk Assessments
description: Users can now conduct Study Risk Assessments in CTMS without relying on the Risk, Critical Process, or Risk Mitigation libraries to develop study-specific risks and considerations.

feature: Critical to Quality (CtQ) Factors Support for RBQM
description: Users can now track and manage CtQ factor in Study Risk Assessments, link CtQ to Critical Processes and Data for full traceability, and automate setup via the updated Generate Risk Assessment action, which pulls CTQ factors from Risk templates or existing Study Risk Assessments.

feature: Additive SDV Supported in Monitoring Event Subject Visit Seeding Logic
description: The Proactively Seed Monitored Enrollment & Seed Monitored enrollment action supports seeding Additive SDV data into Monitored Visits. The logic for seeding Subject Visits includes checking if Additive SDV has been performed.

feature: Monitoring Event Question Status Badges
description: Monitoring Event Question Status Badges support CRAs in identifying outstanding required questions in Question Sections while a Monitoring Event is in progress.

feature: CTMS Transfer: Study Site Addresses
description: CTMS Transfer includes Study Site Addresses so that Sponsors can manage drug shipping addresses from CROs to drive drug shipment.

feature: Monitoring Event Seeding Respects Previous Monitoring Event of Same Content Type
description: The Monitoring Event Seeding actions respect the previous Monitoring Event of the same Content type.

feature: Monitoring Event Follow Up Item Seeding Logic Updates
description: The Seed Monitoring Follow-Up Items action on Monitoring Events now considers the Open Date on Follow Up Item's when seeding closed Follow Up Items into Monitoring Events.

feature: Protocol Deviation Subject Visit Context Improvement
description: A new Visit lookup field on Issue records displays user-friendly Subject Visit Definitions instead of system record names.

feature: Move CTN Setting Back to CTMS Settings
description: Admins can now enable the CTN Setting in the CTMS section of the Admin Settings page.

feature: Added More Standard Fields for Study Phase
description: Vault now includes additional standard values as inactive options in the Study Phase picklist. Admins must activate these values to enable triggers, prepopulation, and rules functionality for Disclosures. In addition, Expanded Access has been added as an inactive option to the Study Design Type picklist.

application: CTMS, Disclosures, Payments, Site Connect, Study Startup, eTMF
feature: Support Localized Number Formatting for App Pages
description: This feature ensures that numbers, currencies, and percentages are displayed and edited using the appropriate format of a user's locale, including the correct decimal and grouping separators.

application: CTMS, Site Connect, Study Startup, eTMF
feature: Prevent Creation of New Adobe Formatted Outputs
description: All new formatted output templates now leverage the Word functionality and no new Adobe templates can be created. Existing Adobe templates can continue to be edited.

application: CTMS, Site Connect, Study Startup, eTMF
feature: EDL Override Support for Site Connect
description: EDL Override templates update Site Connect fields on Expected Documents, such as Send using Site Connect, Auto-request from Site, and Sponsor/CRO Comments. This enables country-specific tailoring of Site Connect processes.

feature: New Standard Milestone Types: First IP Received, Operational Closeouts & Sample Testing
description: This feature introduces seven new standard values to the Milestone Type picklist: IP Received at Site, Country Operational Closeout, Study Operational Closeout, First Sample Received, First Sample Tested, Last Sample Received, and Last Sample Tested.

feature: Study Milestones in Process Monitor
description: Users can visualize Study, Study Country, and Study Site progression in Process Monitor using Milestones. Users can select new standard processes to measure and visualize study progression based on the Milestone Actual Finish Dates.

feature: Block Milestone Rollup Dates
description: Admins can now use the Block Rollup Dates multi-select picklist on Template Milestone and Milestone objects. This allows Admins to block specific Baseline or Planned dates from rolling up, providing more granular control over rollup functionality.

feature: Early-Finish Offsets
description: In Vaults with finish to finish dependency and date offsets enabled, the system now pulls in downstream dates when an upstream date is earlier, enabling more accurate trial planning.

feature: Milestone Document Hardening
description: The previous five minute delay has been reduced for Milestone Document Creation ensuring more accurate, real-time information.

feature: Sticky Header Support for List View of Milestones
description: Users now experience sticky header and freeze column capabilities when interacting with Milestone records in list view in Vault.

feature: Print Disclosures & Save to Library
description: Admins can now configure formatted outputs for a Disclosure record, allowing users to download a PDF or printable version, or automatically save the file to Vault. This is available for EU and US Registrations and Results.

feature: Validate Action on US Registrations Using API
description: Admins can now configure the Validate action for US Registrations in all Lifecycle States. This allows users to view validation errors directly on Disclosure records, replacing the existing CSV report method.

feature: Disclosures: Site List Enhancements
description: Vault now bypasses validation for US Registration Site Lists when the associated Study Type is Observational or Expanded Access. Vault can now also trigger disclosures for Expanded Access studies.

feature: Disclosures US Results: Add Notes & NA Explanations
description: Users editing US Results can now mark a number field as NA and provide an explanation. Users can now also provide units, and add notes (comments) to the Participant Flow Milestone table.

feature: Disclosures US Results: Outcome Measure Enhancements
description: Users editing US Results can now define different arms and units per outcome measure, or select Results Not Ready and add an Anticipated Date. Users can now re-order Outcome Measures.

feature: Disclosures Person & Organization Search & Fill
description: Users can now use a global directory search component to populate Organization and Contact information fields on US and EU Disclosure forms.

feature: TMF Quality Review
