description: Vault now provides the framework for users to implement a periodic TMF QC process to ensure content is inspection ready.

feature: Prevent Modifications on Archive Snapshot Documents
description: Users cannot unarchive or edit snapshots that Vault created as part of the study archival process.

feature: Global Directory to OpenData Clinical Matching
description: Vault can now automatically generate Data Change Requests (DCRs) to streamline matching Investigator and Institution/Site records to OpenData Clinical. Using a new DCR Type, matching requests are routed to Veeva, and once matched, OpenData IDs return to the Vault to be applied to records.

feature: Display Preferred Affiliation in OpenData Clinical Details
description: Users can now designate a preferred or primary Contact Information for an OpenData Clinical Investigator. The preferred contact details appear in the Investigator OpenData Clinical Details section.

feature: Local Language Name & Address Details in OpenData Clinical
description: OpenData Clinical now delivers and controls Local Language fields for applicable Investigators and Sites. This update adds new fields, updates delivered records, and enhances Data Change Request functionality to support local language field change requests.

feature: Support for Investigators Without Site Affiliations
description: Vault now supports the inclusion of OpenData Clinical investigator records without confirmed site affiliations.

feature: Primary Country for OpenData Clinical Investigators
description: OpenData Clinical now delivers and populates the Primary Country field on an Investigator based on their primary site affiliation.

feature: Set OpenData ID in Record View Mode
description: For Investigator or Institution records that are not mapped to OpenData Clinical, users with appropriate permissions can now select the Set OpenData ID action directly from the record's View mode. Previously, the record had to be in Edit mode to select Set OpenData ID.

feature: Prior Contact Information Relationship Optimization
description: This feature ensures data consistency for Vaults with OpenData Clinical enabled during the transition to a new relationship between Prior Contact Information records and Contact Information records.

feature: OpenData Clinical Investigator & Site Search Improvements
description: Improved search capabilities now provide a more streamlined experience when browsing OpenData Clinical Investigators and Sites. Searched terms now deliver narrower results and optimized record ordering when searching by name and city.

feature: Fee Schedule Template Builder
description: This Payments functionality allows users to build Fee Schedules from underlying costs. Visit costs can be constructed from Procedures, as well as defining other cost elements.

feature: Fee Schedule Builder: Site Level
description: This Payments functionality allow users to building Fee Schedules from underlying costs. Users can construct Visit costs from Procedures, as well as define other cost elements.

feature: Fee Schedule Templates: Cost Automation
description: The system populates Unit Cost, and Upper Limit values in the Fee Schedule Template Builder from matching Procedure Reference Costs and Site Fee Reference Costs when building country-level templates.

feature: Payments: Site Contract Tracking
description: Users can manage and track Site Clinical Trial Agreements (CTA) between sites and sponsors by directly linking Contract records with the corresponding documents and Site Fee Schedules.

feature: Generate Payable Items Supports Multi-Record Workflow
description: The Generate Payable Items action can now be initiated in a multi-record workflow.

feature: Payments: Alternate Currency Rounding
description: Payments rounds calculated overhead, holdback, and tax amounts values based on the currency's minor units (decimal places) for currencies other than JPY and KWD.

feature: Tax Rates: Calculating Tax Rate Total Value
description: Payments users utilizing the Tax Rate object have the Total value updated automatically if they update the component tax fields of the Tax Rate object. Additionally, all Tax Rate percentage fields support values of four decimal points.

feature: Document Action Filtering
description: This feature enables Admins to configure the available Site Connect document action that a user can select when exchanging documents.

feature: Download Acknowledgment Details
description: Using the acknowledgment details on the Distribution Task, site users can now download the acknowledgment information for all Safety Distributions.

feature: Study Plan in Production
description: This feature introduces a Study Site Plan which provides a collaborative workspace within Vault that allows Sponsors/CROs and Sites to establish, align on, and measure against standardized metrics and milestones.

feature: Secure Payments Documents
description: This feature secures the four payments document types ensuring that only site users with the "Manage Site Reimbursement" responsibility are able to view those documents.

feature: Optional Safety Distribution Acknowledgment
description: With this feature, Admins can waive acknowledgment for specific Safety Distributions for a given country.

feature: Prevent Document Reconciliation on Non-Connected Sites
description: The Document Reconciliation job does not run on sites that are not actively connected to SiteVault.

feature: Daily Document Exchange Emails
description: This feature introduces a daily summary email for document exchange notifications, including recall notifications. Site users with the Manage Essential Documents responsibility now receive one daily email notification per sponsor/CRO they work with.

feature: Site Connect UI Enhancements
description: This enhancement updates the hover text visible on the site record when a site is connected to SiteVault within the Sponsor/CRO view. Additionally, the search bar in Site Home has been optimized for small browser windows.

feature: Download Document Enhancements
description: When downloading Safety Documents, this feature ensures that the download file name is consistant between authenticated document links and email links.

feature: Update Email Details after Document View
description: This enhancement updates the Email Details field when the email status on the Distribution Task Recipient record is marked as viewed.

feature: Milestone Study Country & Site Hardening
description: In Vaults with the Milestone Study Country and Milestone Study Site feature enabled, the system now automatically connects a central application milestone to site level approvals through a finish to finish dependency. The feature also ensures when duplicate milestones exist, only milestone items for the specified milestone are created or removed.

feature: Milestone Planning View Enhancements
description: In Vaults with the Milestone Planning View enabled, the page now supports projections and a timeline redraw before saving, along with user experience enhancements. These UX enhancements include additional filtering, page zooming, and icon indications for related milestone features like roll-up dependencies and Site Connect's Study Plan.

feature: Include Current Day in the Study Document Audit Export
description: Vault now includes audit entries for the current day when users export the full Study Document Audit Trail and includes today in the date selection.

feature: Replace User Association
description: The Replace User action on the Person object re-associates Users with their target Person record, eliminating manual work to merge duplicate users.

feature: Study Training Matrix Snapshot
description: Vault automatically generates an uneditable Training Matrix Snapshot PDF each time a Training Admin publishes the Study Training Matrix.

feature: Study Training Matrix Extract & Load
description: Training Admins can export a Training Matrix to a formatted Excel file to add or remove Learner Roles or Training Requirements and update checkbox mappings in a familiar grid interface, then import the file back to a draft matrix to apply changes in bulk.

feature: Update Training Assignments Job Performance Improvements
description: Performance improvements to the Update Training Assignments job reduce logging and loops to increase processing speed.

feature: My Study Team: Individual Learner Page View
description: Clicking a Learner's card on the My Study Team page displays a new page with a comprehensive view of the Learner’s open, completed, and all Training Assignments.

feature: Study Training Matrix Builder Edit Menu Change
description: The Study Training Matrix Builder's Actions menu is updated to relocate the Edit and Delete buttons.

feature: PromoMats: CLM Slide Comparison User Interface
description: As a part of the CLM Publishing update, Vault automatically identifies revisions in a new side-by-side comparison view when a new version is uploaded. This user interface allows users to quickly approve the new version or make any necessary modifications before the presentation is synchronized in Vault CRM.

feature: PromoMats: CLM Publishing
description: This feature provides a new method of CLM Publishing to Vault CRM to support the content supply chain.

feature: Rights Manager
description: This feature enables PromoMats users to manage and understand content rights by treating License and Consent Files as standard documents with standard lifecycles.

feature: Claims: New References Section
description: A new References section replaces the legacy References section in the Claims layout and provides additional details for each Reference, including the anchor title and the lifecycle state and document type of the document. It also enables key functionality such as editable columns and commenting.

feature: Claims: Entry Criteria to Validate References Are in Steady State
description: This feature introduces an entry criteria that users can apply to the Text Asset Lifecycle to validate that a Claim's associated Reference documents are all in a steady state.

feature: Claims: Remove Auto-Link on Initial Upload Flag
description: This feature removes the existing Auto-Link on Initial Upload Admin checkbox as it has been replaced by the Text Asset Auto-Linking Settings page.

feature: Claims: Auto-Linking in Readiness Panel
description: The Auto-Linking status is available in the app-specific Document Readiness Panel.

feature: MLR: Reviewer Queue
description: A view called Reviewer Queue is now available on the Home tab. Reviewer Queue auto-prioritizes tasks to provide a more guided experience for Reviewers.

feature: Metrics in Portals
description: This feature surfaces high-level CLM engagement metrics directly in Portals to help teams understand how approved content is being used. Metrics are read-only, time-bounded, and intended for quick assessment for guiding reuse decisions.

feature: Claims: Deep Delete
description: This feature improves the administration of Text Asset records by updating the existing deletion rules for Text Assets. Deleting the parent Text Asset record now results in the deletion of standard child records, in a single action.

feature: Claims: Text Asset Auto-Linking Settings Enhancements
description: This feature extends the existing Auto-Linking Lifecycle States settings to also trigger Auto-Linking automatically when a document transitions into a configured state.

feature: MLR: Improved Similarity Scores
description: This feature improves how similarity scores are calculated, leading to more predictable and reproducible scores.

feature: MLR: Document Compare
description: Content Similarity Document Compare highlights the differences between two documents in the document viewer when the Content Similarity score meets a certain threshold.

feature: eCTD: Auto-On Redline Annotations
description: eCTD Compliance Packages with the Include Linked References setting set to Yes are generated with redline annotations, and the Add Annotations from Vault Links Application setting has been removed.

feature: Claims Agent
description: Claims Agent identifies promotional claims in documents, contextually matching to existing claim records, and creates new claim records for any variations detected. This significantly reduces the effort to annotate claims, and automatically manages the variability of core claims.

feature: Quick Check Agent & Content Agent Enhancements
description: The Quick Check Agent now returns more precise findings with fewer false positives, presented as observations rather than verdicts. The Content Agent provides more reliable answers to regulatory questions, returning decisions to the reviewer. Both agents now respond in the reviewer's language. *Auto-on in Vaults configured for Veeva AI.

feature: Retains Testing
description: Retains Testing supports testing of samples from a specific production batch that are stored for later analysis and used to investigate potential future issues.

feature: Reduced Testing
description: Reduced Testing allows application of a reduced set of Tests and Criteria to some Material batches rather than performing full testing on every incoming lot. Vault automates the selection of the appropriate testing plan based on pre-defined schedules, supplier qualification statuses, and the history of processed batches.

feature: Calculated Result Can Use Input Attributes
description: This feature allows a Test Definition to reference attribute values assigned to an Input at test evaluation and inject those values into formulas. For example, an HPLC assay calculation for a Result can now automatically pull the Standard Concentration attribute from the selected reagent lot record, eliminating manual transcription from a CoA.

feature: Calculated Result Can Use Input Amount
description: This feature allows Test Definitions to reference Inputs at Test evaluation and inject the Input's amount into formulas.

feature: Spec Data Builder: Formatting Options Now Editable
description: In the Spec Data Builder, the Result Format section on the Criteria card is now interactive, allowing admins to view and update the formatting options directly. While Notation defaults to Standard if unspecified, the other fields can now be left blank. Admins can also choose to populate specific valid combinations.

feature: Spec Data Builder: Option to Edit Fields on Sample Action
description: For Select Actions, the UI now includes an Edit Metadata button which opens the specific Action record in a new browser tab, allowing the user to quickly set metadata field values without cluttering the main Builder interface. Additionally, the Reported Name field is now visible and editable on the Test Action card within the Spec Data Builder.

feature: Apply Default Filter for Owning Site
description: This feature introduces automatic, default site-based filtering across LIMS-controlled screens based on a user's assigned organizational location.

feature: Test Definition: Formatting Options Can Be Optional
description: Previously, LIMS enforced Precision Type and Precision Number as required fields via standard validation rules. This feature allows Admins to inactivate these rules and thus save a Result or Variation Result without applying formatting rules.

feature: Test Execution: Display Spec Criteria
description: This feature allows Design Data Admins to display detailed product specification descriptions to Lab Analysts directly within the Test Execution and Sample Results Entry (SRE) UI.

feature: Design Data Builder: Chart Definitions
description: Spec Data Builder now allows Design Data Admins to configure various chart types, including control charts and regression analysis, directly through a centralized interface. Previously, this option was not possible through the Design Data Builder UI.

feature: Upper Level of Quantification (ULOQ)
description: This feature expands on LOD & LOQ with an Upper Level of Quantification (ULOQ). While LOD & LOQ cover the smaller range of possible measurement values, ULOQ provides the means to change how measurements above acceptable ranges are reported, displayed, and calculated.

feature: Stability Study: Create Copy of Sample Plan & Spec Data
description: The Generate Lab Study and Generate Lab Study Timepoint actions now have a new option: Create Copy of Sample Plan and Spec Data. When selected, a new copy of the Sample Plan and Spec Data is used for each Timepoint.

feature: Stability Study Builder
description: The Stability Study Builder introduces a purpose-built, top-down user experience for authoring, editing, and managing Stability Protocols and Study Designs.

feature: Non-Routine & Ad Hoc Sample Testing
description: Analysts can now perform Tests outside the scope of Batch Release and Stability Studies. They can create Non-Routine Spec Data for business processes such as cleaning or method validation as well as define Ad Hoc Tests for more freeform supplementary testing, and also initiate Non-Routine and Ad Hoc Testing by creating a Request record.

feature: Ad Hoc Criteria
description: Ad Hoc Criteria allow users to assign temporary, batch-specific acceptance criteria to unplanned Tests without modifying standard Spec Data. This enables pass/fail evaluation and COA reporting for one-off investigations or client-provided Test requests at runtime.

feature: Lab Test & Sample Field Updates
description: This update adds five standard fields to the Spec Data Sample Action object and introduces a lifecycle to the Lab Consumable Family object. Additionally, the Minimum, Maximum, and Decimal fields are now editable on the Lab Test Definition Input, Lab Test Definition Variation Input, and Lab Test Input objects.

feature: Test Execution: Optional Expected Amount
description: If Expected Amount is left blank in a Test Definition, it does not appear as Required in the Test Definition Preview.

feature: Assets & Consumables Standardization
description: This feature standardizes common Asset and Consumable data model components in Veeva LIMS by introducing standard objects, fields, lifecycles, and workflows.

feature: Test Definition Input & Test Input: Amount Field Update
description: Users can now edit Expected Amount and Amount decimal places on Lab Test Definition Input and Lab Test Input Object.

feature: Lab Consumable Family Object Lifecycle
description: This feature adds a standard lifecycle to the Lab Consumable Family object.

feature: Stability Study: Date/Time Fields for Pull Window
description: The following Date/Time fields are available on the Study Timepoint and Lab Sample objects: Earliest Pull Date/Time, Latest Pull Date/Time, Scheduled Start Date/Time (Study Timepoint object only). Additionally, the Hours and Minutes values are now available on the Unit picklist.

feature: Stability Study Field Update
description: The "User must always enter a value (required)" setting is now editable on the Time Stored and Time Stored Units fields on the Lab Study Design Timepoint and Lab Study Timepoint objects.

feature: Additional LOD Picklist Value
description: The No More Than picklist value is now available as an entry option and formatted value for the LOD Entry Option picklist.

feature: Test Definition & Spec Data: Updated Formatting Options Validation Method
description: The following valid states for formatting options on a Result or Criteria are now available for triggers and Change Analysis checks:  Rounding Rule, Precision, Precision Type, and Precision Rule all have data OR Rounding Rule and Precision Rule have data OR Precision and Precision Type are both blank or both populated.

feature: Open Documents in New Tab
description: Documents in Test Execution and Test Definition Builder can be popped out and viewed in a separate browser tab.

feature: Spec Execution: Initiated Date & Time
description: Spec Execution records now include a new field that tracks the date and time when the execution was initiated.

feature: Test Execution: Updated Exception Icon Hover Display
description: The existing Criteria icon hover tooltip has been redesigned to prevent text from clipping off the screen. The new tooltip shows a maximum of three criteria, truncates descriptions on the third line, and includes a new View Details link that opens a dialog containing the full text for all applicable Criteria.

feature: Reduced Testing: Obsolete Field & Object Inactivation
description: Vault now inactivates obsolete fields and objects replaced by the new Reduced Testing feature. This includes the Reduced Testing Frequency, Reduced Testing Interval, Include in Reduced Testing, and Full Testing fields, as well as the Material Supplier object.

feature: Print Label: Label Definition is Searchable
description: Users can now further filter the list of Label Definitions on Print Label actions. Previously, the field was a dropdown with no search capabilities.

feature: Stability Spec Execution: No Notification for Missing Batch
description: When a Stability Spec Execution is initiated, LIMS does not send a notification that the batch is missing.

feature: Show Input Name in Test Execution
description: In Test Execution, the configured Input name is now be displayed to the user. Previously, the Input's Family Name was displayed.

feature: Stability T0 Import: Default Sample Type to Release
description: In the T0 import dialog, the Sample Type column filter is now automatically set to Release.

feature: Scientific Statements: Entry Criteria to Validate References Are in Steady State
description: This feature introduces an entry criteria that can be applied to the Scientific Statement Lifecycle to validate that a Scientific Statement's associated Reference documents are all in steady state.

feature: Scientific Statements: Auto-Linking in Readiness Panel
description: The Auto-Linking status is available in the app-specific Document Readiness Panel.

feature: References in SCP UI
description: References for Scientific Statements can be managed directly from the Scientific Communication Platform (SCP) UI. The new dialog allows users to add or remove references and anchors for each Scientific Statement.

feature: Medical: Metrics in Portals
description: This feature surfaces high-level CLM engagement and Portal usage metrics directly in Portals to help teams understand how approved content is being used. Metrics are read-only, time-bounded, and intended for quick assessment for guiding reuse decisions.

feature: Scientific Statements: Deep Delete
description: This feature improves the administration of Scientific Statement records by updating the existing deletion rules for Scientific Statements. Deleting the parent Scientific Statement record now results in the deletion of standard child records, in a single action.

feature: Scientific Statements: Extend Scope of Auto-Approve Statements
description: The existing Auto-Approve Statements document entry action is updated to allow configuration on non-steady document states and expand the eligible states for Statements to include those assigned to the Initial State state type.

feature: Enable Scientific Communication Platform UI in All MedComms Vaults
description: The Scientific Communication Platform (SCP) UI is enabled automatically for all MedComms Vaults. The Enable Communication Platform UI Application setting has been removed.

feature: Medical: Rights Manager
description: This feature enables Medical users to manage and understand content rights by treating License and Consent Files as standard documents with standard lifecycles.

feature: Case Management UI: Timeline Panel
description: The new Case Management User Interface includes a timeline panel to display inbound and outbound interactions alongside the Case and Case-related records.

feature: New Case Management User Interface
description: The new Case Management User Interface allows users to view and manage Case and Case-related records on one page.

feature: Create Inbound Interactions from Ingested Emails
description: A new object is added to MedInquiry called Inbound Interaction, with object types for Email, Phone, and Chat. When emails are ingested into MedInquiry, an Inbound Interaction object of type Email is created.

feature: Update Component Security on Name Field on User Role Setup (Case) Object
description: The User Role Setup object now supports system-managed naming for the Name field. Record names can be configured to be automatically generated using a standardized sequence (for example, URS-MI-######).

feature: Editable Standard Formatted Output Templates
description: This release includes a Platform enhancement that allows the Label, Output Format, and template file to be editable for standard Formatted Output templates, which were previously not editable. In MedInquiry, this applies to the Case Report for Attachment (case_report_for_attachment__v) template.

feature: Enhanced Logging for MedInquiry Email Intake
description: Admins are notified immediately when a Medical Inquiry email fails to ingest.

feature: Add/Remove Responses Dialog Enhancements
description: The Add/Remove Responses dialog allows users to see Case Responses that are not in the Ready for Fulfillment state.

feature: MedInquiry: Case Processing Agent
description: To help automate Cases processing, the Case Processing Agent in the Case Management UI extracts information from Inbound Interactions and automatically creates Case Request, Adverse Event, and Product Quality Complaint records.

feature: Medical Product Agent
description: The Medical Product Agent infers the product details from unstructured text and provides the best matched records for the Product data model (Family, Form, Variant, and so on).

feature: Medical: CLM Slide Comparison User Interface
description: As a part of the CLM Publishing update, Vault automatically identifies revisions in a new side-by-side comparison view when a new version is uploaded. This user interface allows users to quickly approve the new version or make any necessary modifications before the presentation is synchronized in Vault CRM.

feature: Medical: CLM Publishing
description: This feature provides a new method of CLM Publishing to Vault CRM to support the content supply chain.

feature: New Application: Publications
description: Publications, part of the Vault Medical suite, is an application used to plan, author, review, approve, and submit scientific literature to journals and congresses. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Enforce Atomic Security in Audit Logs
description: When a user is restricted from seeing certain fields by Atomic Security, updates to these fields are hidden when the user views an individual object record audit trail. This enhancement does not impact Admin audit logs. *Auto-on for users with field restrictions by Atomic Security with access to view audit trails on object records.

feature: Notifications: Remove Multiple Email Addresses from Suppression List
description: Admins can now remove multiple email addresses from the suppression list in bulk.

feature: Responsive UI
description: The Vault user interface now automatically adjusts according to a user's available browser width, including collapsing sidebars to maximize space and adjusting field layouts to reduce horizontal scrolling. Users now also have an option to manually collapse sidebars. Additionally, Date/Time fields have a Now link to ease data entry.

feature: Fast Search
description: When users click into the search bar on a Document tab, the documents shown in the dropdown for quick access now load faster and provide more relevant documents to users.

feature: Copy Link Keyboard Shortcut
description: Users can now copy the link to a document or record using a standard keyboard shortcut.

feature: Timeout Improvements
description: Users now re-authenticate to Vault in a new window after being logged out due to inactivity, maintaining the page they were actively working on. When working in multiple Vaults on the same domain in different browser tabs or windows, activity in any Vault prevents timeout in all tabs or windows. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Add API Name to Document Type Details Object
description: A new field Document Type Name (document_type_name__v) field has been added to the Document Type Details (doc_type_detail__v) object so the public API name of the document type is more easily accessible.

feature: Collaborative Authoring Logs for OAuth Errors
description: The Microsoft Request ID is now included in Integration Status error messages displayed on the Admin > Settings > Checkout Settings page.

feature: Preview for Overlay & Signature Page Templates
description: Users can now preview edits to overlay and signature page templates before saving the template.

feature: Launch Collaborative Authoring from Link
description: Admins can now configure templates to include links that launch or join collaborative authoring sessions directly from email notifications. This enhancement applies to notifications used in workflows that have the "Use workflow single document" box checked.

feature: Document Inbox Enhancements: Edit Document Type
description: Users can now save a document type classification for Incomplete documents in the Document Inbox without providing all the required document field information. Documents still need to be completed with all the required field values to be fully usable in the Library.

feature: Improved Document Viewer
description: A new and improved document viewer is now available, which includes a simplified user experience with a streamlined document viewer toolbar, improved full screen viewing mode, split screen viewing mode, one-click version compare with AI Summary (for customers who have licensed Vault AI), and expanded zoom controls.

feature: EDLs: Consistent Hierarchy Viewer
description: The Hierarchy Viewer now has a consistent experience for EDLs, EDL Items, EDL Templates, and EDL Item Templates.

feature: Collaborative Authoring: Increase Participant Limit for Automatic Mentioning
description: Users can now add 100 participants when starting a collaborative authoring session with a workflow action, and all participants are granted Write permission to the document. *Auto-on for Vaults configured to use automatic mentioning via workflows.

feature: Dynamic Styling for Claim-Based Link Annotations
description: Claim-based link annotations now display unique styling to reflect how the annotation was created, as well as the lifecycle state of the associated Claim record used in its creation. *Auto-on in Vaults with auto-claims linking enabled. Other Vaults require configuration.

feature: Make a Copy: Exclude Inactive Record Values
description: When using Make a Copy on a document, inactive object record values in an object reference field are no longer copied to the new document.

feature: Layout Profiles Supported in Action Triggers
description: Admins can now evaluate layout profiles in a condition and use update record actions to set a layout profile.

feature: Record Migration Mode for Delete Operations
description: Vault now supports record migration mode for delete operations, including the No Triggers option. This feature is supported for both Vault API and Vault Loader.

feature: Control Binding for Object Fields
description: Admins can now configure object fields to be bound to a control. In the past, only layouts supported configuration of controls. Vault always displays a field with control binding using that control in detail pages, list pages, and related object sections.

feature: Bitmask Field
description: This feature introduces a Bitmask field type for objects, enabling apps to securely filter records efficiently without performance degradations at high volumes. Bitmask fields can be created by Veeva only and support a new bitwise operator in VQL.

feature: Checklists: Dynamic Questions
description: Admins can now create a pool of dynamic questions for each section in a Checklist Design. From this question pool, only a random subset of these dynamic questions is created in the instantiated checklist.

feature: Layout Profile: Summary Dialog for Adding & Removing Users
description: When adding or removing users from a Layout Profile, Vault now shows a summary dialog if any users were skipped. If all users were successfully added or removed, Vault continues to show a banner instead.

feature: Layout Rules: Automatic Controlled Field Management
description: Layout rules now automatically add controlled fields when their controlling field is hidden, and controlling fields when their controlled field is displayed as required. Auto-added fields are locked with a tooltip naming the dependency.

feature: Document Fields in Object Formula Fields
description: Object formula field expressions now support document fields.

feature: Word Formatted Output: Support for GetRelatedRecords Formula
description: Word Formatted Output now supports the GetRelatedRecords() formula to simplify creation of templates. This is most useful for showing a row or table only if a related record exists.

feature: Copy Link for Records
description: Vault now supports the Copy Link action for object records, allowing users to copy a clean and shortened URL for better sharing. The copied link automatically redirects users to the record detail page when pasted into a browser. This new action supports new shortcut keys.

feature: Record Migration Mode Inheritance
description: When records are created, updated, or deleted in migration mode, related records changed in the same transaction by Record Triggers inherit many of the same migration mode behaviors. This inheritance is unchanged, and the audit trail for the related records now appends "in migration mode" in the event description.

feature: Download as PDF: Deduplicated Records in Related Join Object Sections
description: When using the Download as PDF functionality on object records, the generated PDF now consolidates duplicate records in the same manner as the Vault UI.

feature: Improved Localization for Number Fields
description: Vault now follows the International Components for Unicode (ICU) locale format for number fields. This feature ensures that numbers, currencies, and percentages are displayed and edited using the appropriate format of a user's locale, including the correct decimal separators and digit groupings.

feature: Where Used Object Action
description: The Where Used object action shows where a given object record is used across other objects and documents.

feature: File Count Validation for Record Attachments
description: Vault now informs users that they cannot drag and drop more than 100 files if they attempt to do so in a record detail page. Attempts to do this result in an error that none of the files have been uploaded.

feature: Time Picker: Clear Invalid Input
description: The time picker in Vault UI now discards incomplete input or invalid values entered by the user. Previously, the time picker silently defaulted to the last known valid value when it could not interpret the user input, leading to confusing behaviors.

feature: Report Usage
description: A Report Usage object is now available, allowing users to create reports on report runs.

feature: Exclude Inactive Users in Report Filters
description: Reports can now exclude inactive users from being available in filter and prompt dropdowns, either on a per-report basis, or for all reports.

feature: Enhanced Create Report Page
description: The Create Report page has been improved to allow users to search available report types, see existing reports using report types, and see report type definitions.

feature: Support Multi-Object Reference Fields in Document Report Formulas
description: Reports now support using multi-value object reference fields as inputs to a Text function in a document report, which returns a list of object names separated by commas.

feature: Process Monitor: Drill Down
description: Process Monitor now provides an option to explore specific records or documents that are included in a process directly in the Process View itself.

feature: Enhanced Aggregate Formulas
description: A number of enhancements are introduced to aggregate functions in report formulas, including filtering within SumRows(), choosing at what level aggregates should display, supporting 15 aggregate functions in a single formula field, and expanding field type support. Additionally, aggregate functions can now be used in Matrix reports.

feature: Enhanced Expand All
description: The Expand All option is now available for users to expand all groups in reports with more than 2,000 records.

feature: Support Workflow & Task Owner in Report Formula Fields
description: Users can now add Workflow Owner and Task Owner fields in multi-pass reports for both documents and object workflow reports.

feature: Add Description to Report Formula Fields
description: Users can now add descriptions to report formula fields, which are displayed as tooltips on the report formula field column headers in reports.

feature: Show Report Formula Fields as a Percentage
description: Users can now configure report formula fields for numbers to display as percentages.

feature: Process Monitor: Saved Results
description: Process Views now run in the background and notify users when the run is complete. The data is cached on a Process View for 24 hours.

feature: Open Chart in New Tab
description: When viewing a dashboard, users can now right-click on charts to open the underlying report in a new browser tab.

feature: API Access Tokens
description: Users can now authenticate to the Vault API using long-lived tokens. This ability increases security and convenience.

feature: Query Profiler
description: Admins and developers can now monitor VQL query performance with the new query profiling tool. Query profiling allows Admins and developers to analyze and optimize their query execution.

feature: Packages Support for Record Attachments & Attachment Fields
description: Vault configuration migration packages now support exporting and importing record attachments and attachment field files.

feature: Migration Package Validation Enhancements
description: Migration package validation now validates SDK compile errors and sub-component dependencies, and prevents deployment if errors are detected. Previously, users had to read the log file to view errors.

feature: Relative Date Filters in Jobs
description: Admins can now use relative date functions that resolve to dates when scheduling jobs.

feature: Document Archive Job
description: A new Archive action is now available for archiving documents in Date-Based Document Operation job types. This option is available for document jobs in Vaults with document archiving enabled.

feature: Connection Authorization Enhancements
description: This feature enhances the Connection Authorization workflow, specifically focusing on the input methods for API Key and Client Secret Auth Types.

feature: Vault Loader Performance Enhancements
description: Loader jobs now leverage the distributed job framework, which leads to faster load times for Vault datasets.

feature: Direct Data API: Additional Document Metadata in Workflow Extracts
description: This feature adds existing document and version VQL fields in Workflow Item and Task Item extracts.

feature: Vault AI Enablement
description: Admins can now enable Vault AI in the Administration user interface. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Bring Your Own Model: Google Gemini Support
description: Vault AI includes support for custom LLM connections using Gemini 2.5 Pro and Flash models.

feature: Agent Configuration Enhancements
description: Agent Action configuration now includes support for Viewable Rendition, API access control, and Document version selection.

feature: Agent Workflow Task Completion
description: Vault AI provides the ability to assign workflow tasks to agent users for task completion.

feature: Vault AI Metadata
description: Vault AI Metadata describes Vault knowledge (objects and document types) for agents. Based on this knowledge, the agent can accurately interpret natural language instructions and execute them as application actions (for example, VQL queries) on physical components.

feature: JSON Response Tool Type
description: Vault AI agent tool configuration now supports a standard agent tool for generating a JSON output.

feature: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) for Actions
description: Vault AI now supports a new tool type that asks for user inputs in Vault AI Chat. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Document Version Compare Agent
description: Vault AI agents now support the Document Version Compare Agent, a platform-level agent that is designed to aid document comparison during version control. By comparing your current version against the previous major version, this agent provides a quick, high-level summary of key changes helping the user understand what to focus on.

feature: Query Agent
description: Vault AI now supports natural language capabilities to retrieve and analyze Vault data. The Query Agent utilizes Vault AI metadata and multiple tools, while interacting with users to better understand their needs. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Vault AI UI Minor Update
description: The Vault user interface now refers to Vault AI instead of Veeva AI.

feature: VeevaID Contextual Help for Personal Detail Updates
description: When VeevaID users update their personal details in the My Account tab, they are now required to provide acknowledgement that the changes they are making are correct.

feature: Qualification Check for Market-Ship Decisions
description: Admins can now configure Qualification checks for market-ship decisions.

feature: Configurable By Exception
description: Admins can configure what disposition decisions require a disposition to be reviewed by exception.

feature: Market Specific Document Check
description: Admins can now configure market specific document check requirements and item requirements.

feature: Disposition Plan Autonumber Title
description: Users can now use the Title field on the Disposition Autonumber object and can view the Title when populating the Parent Plan for a Disposition Plan.

feature: Disposition Creation Experience
description: When a user creates a disposition, they are taken to the newly created disposition with a banner displaying the status of Batch Disposition Item creation. When item creation is complete, the banner updates with a link to refresh the page and view the completed items.

feature: Collapse Disposition Header
description: Users can now open and close the Disposition details section on the Batch Disposition Execution Page.

application: Batch Release, HACCP, QMS, QualityDocs, Station Manager, Study Training, Surveillance, Training, Validation Management
feature: Display Application Configurations by Enabled Application
description: The links in the Application Configurations section on the Admin > Configuration page are now organized by application, and display according to the enabled applications in a Vault.

feature: HACCP Flow Diagram: Display Risk Category Field as Clickable Link
description: The Risk Category field in the Risk Assessment section of the Information panel now displays as a clickable link. Clicking the link opens the record in a small browser window.

feature: HACCP Flow Diagram: Intermediate State for Connections
description: Users are now prevented from making updates to a connection between two steps on the HACCP Flow Diagram while saving is in progress for any previous updates to that connection.

feature: HACCP Flow Diagram: Update to Label of Hazard Significance Filtering Option
description: In the Information panel, the label for the process hazard analysis filtering option under “Is Significant Hazard?” is now updated from “Insignificant” to "Non-significant".

feature: Reason for Change: Support for Test Plan & Effectiveness Check
description: Admins can now configure Vault to prompt users for a reason for change when modifying key fields on Test Plan and Effectiveness Check records.

feature: Qualification Support for LIMS & Batch Release
description: The data model is now enhanced to enable the use of qualification data for finished materials and testing decisions, providing foundational support for processes in LIMS and Batch Release.

feature: External Notifications: Complaint Enhancements
description: Admins can now configure External Notifications for Complaints and Quality Events (Complaint and Medtech Complaint object types) to use the new Complaint Contact object.

feature: Related Batch Application Section
description: Admins can now configure an application section that allows users to associate Batch records to a process record using pre-defined filters.

feature: Audit Room: Configurable Lifecycle States
description: Audit Room now supports modifying state labels and adding state lanes. Additionally, Admins can now configure custom lifecycle states on the Inspection Request Lifecycle and display them in the Audit Room.

feature: External Response Collaboration: Inspection Requests
description: External Response Collaboration now supports the Inspection Request object, allowing users to collaborate with external contacts on Inspection Request records.

feature: Audit Room: Expanded Inspection Request Card
description: Admins can now configure Inspection Request cards in the Audit Room to display additional key fields, allowing users to review critical information about requests.

feature: External Notifications: Preview Email
description: Admins can now configure the Send External Notification user action to display a preview of an email to users before sending.

feature: QRM: Create Risks from Existing Risk Assessment
description: Admins can now configure a new user action that allows users to create new Assessment Risks by copying data from existing Assessment Risk records.

feature: External Notifications: Support for Complaint Intake
description: External Notifications are now supported for the Complaint Intake object.

feature: Complaint Intake Follow-Up: Manual Processing
description: Users can now manage a manual Complaint Intake Follow-Up process with a new object and application sections.

feature: Complaint Contacts
description: Users can now manage information about contacts associated with a Complaint Intake with new objects, and display those contacts across associated Complaints with a new application section.

feature: Complaint Email Ingestion: Support for MedTech Complaint Intake Object Type
description: Complaint email ingestion now supports the MedTech Complaint Intake object type of the Complaint Intake object.

feature: External Notifications: Alternate Communication Languages
description: Admins can now configure External Notifications to send notifications in the  communication language specified on a Complaint Intake or Complaint record.

feature: External Notifications: Support for Email Document Attachments
description: Admins can now configure External Notifications to include documents as email attachments.

feature: QRM: Manage Related Documents in Risk Builder
description: Users can now add, modify, and view related documents for Assessment Risks from the Risk Builder interface.

feature: Audit Room: Multiple Scribe Notes
description: Audit Room now supports adding and accessing multiple Scribe Notes related to an Inspection, allowing teams to organize documentation by day, inspector, or scope.

feature: Display Record Count for QMS Sections
description: This feature adds record counts for the following QMS Sections: Action Steps, Record History, Reason for Change History, Related Event, Risk Builder, and Notification Recipients.

feature: External Collaboration Checklists: Display Follow-Up Interface on Completed Checklists
description: Users can now view follow-up questions and responses on completed Supplier Questionnaires.

feature: Promote to Complaint Enhancement: Ignore Inactive Fields
description: The Promote to Complaint action no longer considers inactive fields when attempting to copy values from source Complaint Intake and Reported Product fields to any generated Complaints.

feature: Create Related Record: Copy Custom Fields for Referenced Records
description: When copying referenced records with Create Related Record, the feature now copies populated custom field values from the source referenced record to the target referenced record, ensuring that existing data takes precedence over default values.

feature: Create Related Record: Validation Updates
description: Vault now prevents Admins from configuring system (__sys) objects as the source object in a Related Record Configuration. Additionally, the Create Related Record action now displays an error and does not create a related record if a configured source join object is inactive.

feature: Audit Room: Auto-Add Assignee to Fulfiller Role on Inspection Request
description: The Audit Room now supports automatically adding the user selected as the Assignee on an Inspection Request record to the Fulfiller role within that record’s Sharing Settings.

feature: Audit Room: Publish Inspection Request from Any Lifecycle State
description: Users can now publish Inspection Requests from any lifecycle state, removing the validation that required users to put an Inspection Request into the Fulfilled state prior to the Published state.

feature: Complaint Agent: Medtech Complaints
description: Users can now utilize Complaint Agent for Medtech Complaints to generate on-demand narrative summaries of investigations, and ask questions about the Complaint via the Vault AI Chat interface.

feature: Complaint Agent & Deviation Agent: User Experience Improvements
description: Users can now navigate away from records during Investigation and CAPA Plan narrative summary generation and review the generated summary upon return. This enhancement also improves the quality of the generated summaries, for example, removing references to owners. *Auto-on in Vaults configured for Vault AI.

feature: Cascade DCC Roles to Documents on Task Reassignment
description: Admins can now configure a workflow action to cascade document lifecycle role assignments down to the governed documents after tasks are reassigned in a Document Change Control (DCC) workflow.

feature: Document Change Control: Display Related Documents
description: Admins can now configure the Display Add Related Documents action in supported sections of the DCC setting, which enables allows users to add related documents to the Change Authorization, Documents to be made Effective with Workflows, and Documents to be made Obsolete with Workflows sections of a DCC.

feature: Periodic Review: Reassignment of Inactive Document Owner
description: Admins can now configure an action to reassign inactive owners on documents and periodic reviews, preventing periodic review jobs from failing.

feature: External Collaboration Enhancement: Data Model Update
description: The Display in Business Admin checkbox on the External Collaboration Reassign Tasks object configuration is now read-only and no longer editable.

feature: Document Change Control: Unlink Document Change Request & Periodic Review
description: Vault now automatically unlinks associated Document Change Request and Periodic Review records from a Document Change Control (DCC) record when the target documents are removed from the DCC.

feature: Document Change Request: Add Target Document Owner
description: Vault now automatically adds the Document Owner of the target document associated with a Document Change Request record to the Target Document Owner role in the Sharing Settings of the corresponding Document Change Request record.

feature: Quality Relationships Panel Enhancement: Support for Archived Documents
description: Vault now displays archived documents in the Document Relationships section of the Quality Relationships Panel. *Auto-on in Vaults configured for Document Archiving. Other Vaults require configuration.

feature: Process Navigator: Support Ten Dynamic Document Association Criteria Rules
description: Up to ten dynamic document association criteria rules can now be created for each process in Process Navigator.

feature: External Collaboration Enhancement: Display Veeva Quality Logo
description: Vault now displays the Veeva Quality logo on the steady state document that is sent to external collaborators via a secure public access link after the external collaboration has ended.

feature: Process Navigator Enhancement: Improve Object Reference Field Value Selection
description: Selecting object reference field values in the Process Navigator: Dynamic Association Criteria builder is now improved.

feature: Document Control Homepage Enhancement: Improve Object Reference Field Value Selection in Filter Criteria
description: Selecting object reference field values in the filter criteria of the Document Control Homepage is now improved.

feature: Process Navigator Enhancement: Support None Operator in Dynamic Document Associations
description: Users can now select values using the "Is none of the following" operator in Dynamic Document Association criteria rules in Process Navigator.

feature: QualityDocs & Station Manager Objects: Add Key Document Fields
description: Several QualityDocs and Station Manager objects now include standard, system-managed document fields, allowing users to view critical metadata directly on object records that reference a target document.

feature: Support Document Title in Station Manager
description: Station Manager now supports displaying the Document Title instead of the default Document Name in the Library View, Document View, and Document Information pages for both iOS and Android applications.

feature: Training & Study Training Enhancements
description: Updates were made to quiz icons shown to display correct and incorrect answers. The Training Requirement section of the Document Information Panel was updated to also include Training Requirement Impact Assessments.

feature: Curriculum Due Dates
description: Training Admins can set a Curriculum with Due Date fields, which Vault applies to all associated Training Requirements and resulting assignments. This feature is Auto-on with required configuration.

feature: Pre-Training Quiz
description: Learners can test out of training by passing a quiz before reviewing any Training Materials.

feature: Quiz Dynamic Sections
description: Training Admins can create a pool of questions from which Vault randomly selects a subset for each Learner attempt.

feature: Completion of E-Learning Completes Training Assignment
description: When a Learner completes an E-Learning (SCORM) course, Vault prompts them to populate their eSignature upon closing the SCORM player, then completes the assignment’s workflow task and marks the related Training Assignment as Complete.

feature: Optional Due Dates for Matrix Training
description: CONFIGURATION is needed for this feature to fully function. Training Admins can set Due Date fields within a Curriculum or Training Requirement such that any resulting assignments do not have a Due Date. This feature is Auto-on with required configuration.

feature: Curriculum Completion Percentage Update
description: The Curriculum Completion Status's Completion Percentage calculation has been updated to accurately calculate the completion percentage when a Learner has completed some Training Assignments for a Curriculum and the rest are canceled.

feature: VPS: Generate AER Snapshot
description: This feature generates the snapshot of the data used in the submission of AER to the health authorities. The UI uses this snapshot data once documents are generated *Auto-on in Vaults with the VPS: Generate Submission Documents action configured.

feature: VPS: Configurable Data Mapping
description: Admins can now configure and override the standard data mapping for health authority forms.

feature: VPS: Contact Information Improvements
description: Users can now easily manage and select contact information (address, phone, email, and so on) for health authority reports.

feature: VPS: Product Attributes Management
description: Users can now populate Product Attributes Master Data (Brand Name, Product Description, Registration Numbers, and so on) directly from the Adverse Event Report object if Regional Product Attributes feature is enabled.

feature: VPS: Concomitant Products & Related AER Improvements
description: This feature introduces the ability to add free text for section H10 (related adverse events) in eMDR and Concomitant Products on Complaint.

feature: Assign Training Requirement to Learner
description: CONFIGURATION is needed for this feature to fully function. A Training Admin can assign a Training Requirement directly to a Learner for integration into their Training Matrix.

feature: Copy Enhancements for Activities & Protocols
description: Admins can now configure the Enable Copy Enhancements for Activities and Protocol setting, which enhances the deep copy process to ensure large hierarchies of validation records are copied seamlessly and without system timeouts, and improves error handling.

feature: Populate Validation Viewer Role on Validation Management Records
description: Users assigned the Validation Viewer application role are now populated and visible in the Sharing Settings on Validation Management object records.

feature: Test Authoring Interface Experience Improvements
description: This feature optimizes loading and saving in the test authoring interface, increases in the number of standard and additional prompts shown horizontally based upon screen resolution to align with other application pages, and introduces active error handling for simple field validations (required, max length, and so on).

feature: Taiwan eCTD 3.2 (TW 2.1) DTD 2.0
description: RIM Publishing now supports publishing and validating Taiwan eCTD Submissions based on the version 2.0 DTD and validation criteria version 2.1

feature: Publishing Validation Results Help Field
description: Admins can now populate organization specific guidance on the Additional Instructions field available on Validation Criteria, which is displayed per rule on the Submission Validation Results. A Veeva Help Text field is now available and is populated with Veeva specific guidance per validation rule.

feature: Auto-Append STF
description: The XML Operation is now automatically set to Append for previously submitted STFs for a specific Study ID.

feature: Set Reference Leaf Updates for eCTD 4.0 Support
description: The user can now use the Set Reference Leaf operation which will use Submission Archive's new API and components to display already submitted content that can be selected via the Set Reference Leaf Operation.

feature: Automatic On-Demand Validation for Submission Validation Version Changes
description: Users can now update the Validation Criteria Version changes on a Publishing Active submission and the system performs validation against the entire submission.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: HAQ Response Automations: Default Fields on Response Document
description: When utilizing the Initiate Response guided user flow to generate a Health Authority Response, Vault automatically populates fields on the Response Document based on matching fields on the related Health Authority Response record.

feature: eCTD 4.0 Viewing: Stylized Submission Unit XML
description: The eCTD 4.0 submissionunit.xml now renders in a stylized, human-readable format serving as a navigable table of contents. The Submission Administrative Information section also displays this stylized envelope information, excluding navigable content. Users should use the Re-render Document action to update older renditions to this view.

feature: Submissions Archive Scalability Improvements
description: A simplified Export UI and optimized storage are now available. DAC security is unaffected. Exports now separate submission files from system-generated export summary, manifest, and warning CSV files.

feature: UDI Submissions to GUDID
description: Users can submit UDI data for medical devices to the US FDA's GUDID database.

feature: Link Packaging to MP-Registration Bulk Action
description: This feature updates the Manage Registered Details wizard to include the Link Packaging to Medicinal Product Registrations action. This allows for the automation of the action without the risk of duplicating records.

feature: Create Event Details: Improved Filtering
description: Users can define a Product Stage and use the values to filter the Create Event Details action. Additionally, the Clinical Study Product is extended to capture the Product Variant.

feature: Multi-Market IDMP Data Model & Aggregation Updates
description: Data model and aggregation logic has been updated to ensure users can efficiently manage IDMP data points that might be reported differently across markets because of differences in controlled vocabularies or other local variations in IDMP implementations.

feature: Enhanced IDMP Support for UDI-DI
description: This feature updates the Registrations data model, creating a more granular source for device identifiers used in IDMP. The IDMP data aggregation algorithm is updated to source data accordingly.

feature: Allow Disabling of Event Change Action Values
description: Admins can inactivate Event Change Action picklist values used in the Create & Manage Event Details wizard.

feature: Support for User Groups in Registration Verification Workflow
description: The Registration Verification workflow supports the "Use Vault user group as participants" configuration option.

feature: EUDAMED XSD Version 3.0.30 Support
description: UDI Submission generation supports and defaults to EUDAMED's latest XSD version 3.0.30, including a version-number-only change.

feature: Assess Local Activities Enhancements
description: Assess Local Activities can now be invoked from an Activity, and can show multiple Events and Activities. Users can save views and share saved views with other users.

feature: IDMP Output Record Purge
description: Vault deletes unnecessary IDMP output records following the successful generation of the FHIR message.

feature: Wizard Updates for Enhanced Handling of Local Differences
description: Registrations wizards have been updated to enhance handling of local differences, including updating Create Event Details to extend handling for special records as well as updates to Create Registrations & Manage Registered Details validation logic to filter out the relevant details on the Registrations.

feature: Create Related Records: High-Volume Data Support
description: The CASRO process (Create Related Records action, initiated from an Event) is converted into a job to support ten times the payload size.

feature: EUDAMED UDI Submission Generation Restricted to Supported Languages
description: When generating EUDAMED UDI Submissions, text properties are only included for valid supported languages. Any entries for unsupported languages are automatically excluded.

feature: Active Dossier Population for Activities with No Submission
description: This feature enables active dossier population from global content plan dispatch for activities that do not require a submission, and therefore the dispatch does not result in creating or updating submission content plans but does generate active dossier records.

application: RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Active Dossier: Improved Uniqueness Key Calculation
description: Vault's auto-generation of the Active Dossier Item Detail Uniqueness Key value is optimized to prevent collisions and data inaccuracy during Active Dossier population.

application: RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive
feature: Extract Proposed Active Dossier Relationships for Registrations: Enablement Update
description: The bulk action to extract the proposed Active Dossier Item Detail Registrations and related relationships from Vault can now be executed without requiring the Active Dossier Registration Tracking application setting to be on. This allows Admins to complete migration before enabling the feature for all users.

feature: Copy Into Global Content Plans
description: Currently, users can drag and drop sections into a GCP with certain limitations. This feature addresses many of those limitations by supporting matching/creation of Event relationships and ability to match/create Document Sets as part of the copy.

feature: GCP Dispatch to Exclude Empty CP Sections
description: Use of Document Set Content Plan relationship at the section level has been deprecated. Users can now populate Document Sets at the Content Plan Item level, then Vault excludes empty Content Plan sections when dispatching to an individual market.

feature: Bulk Export Scalability Improvement
description: Vault supports bulk export of submissions via the Perform Bulk Actions menu on the All Submissions and Applications tabs. *Auto-on for standard Submission and Application object types (excluding Global). Custom Object Types require configuration.

feature: Empty Section Indicator Scalability Improvement
description: The "Enable identifying empty sections in the Viewer" application setting now uses a new system-managed object, Application Metadata, to facilitate processing. The Empty Section Indicator is maintained if your Application is in the Active status.

feature: Active Dossier: Support for Tracking Vaccines & Injectables
description: This feature introduces an expansion of Active Dossier & Content Planning to support container-level tracking. A new Container field is added across RIM's Product relationships and Active Dossier to more efficiently manage vaccine and injectable documents.

feature: Active Dossier: Exclude Submission Country from Generation
description: A new field on Submission Country, Exclude from Active Dossier Generation, determines if the Country should be skipped when generating Active Dossier records. The Submission Country value can be defaulted based on the Application Country, and Procedure Type Country Constraints can be used to default values on the relevant Application Countries.

feature: Update Active Dossier from Country Decision Detail
description: Active Dossier Status updates can be triggered from an entry action on the Country Decision Detail lifecycle to allow for more granular updates to Active Dossier Item Details on a per-Country basis.

feature: Active Dossier: Enhanced Metadata Export
description: The existing Export Excel Tree with All Descendants action in Active Dossier Viewer is updated to respect the saved filters set in the Viewer during extraction.

feature: Active Dossier: Country Status Icon Improvements
description: New icons are introduced to the Active Dossier Viewer to represent Pending Current, Pending Superseded, and Pending Deprecation.

feature: Automatically Run Early Notification Rules on Case Promotion
description: In Vaults with early notification rules configured, the rules now automatically execute upon Case promotion.

feature: Local Case Resync
description: Users can now manually sync a Foreign Localized Case with its associated global Case to update existing records and fields or generate missing child and grandchild records with the latest data.

feature: FDA MedWatch 3500A: September 2025 Version
description: Veeva Safety can now generate the version of the FDA MedWatch 3500A form released in September 2025.

feature: Device Agency for EU Countries
description: Admins can now link a secondary, device-specific agency to a country.

feature: Exclude Reporter Information by Destination on CIOMS I Forms
description: Admins can now configure their Vault to exclude reporter information when sending CIOMS I forms to certain partners.

feature: Interval Tabulations for DSUR
description: Users can now generate an Interval Tabulation of SAEs and an Interval Tabulation of SARs with their DSUR.

feature: Allow Marketing to Investigational (Same Agency) Reporting Scenario
description: For products that are on both postmarket studies and clinical trials, Admins can now configure reporting rules for the scenario when a single agency requires submissions to both premarket and postmarket centers for the same event.

feature: Case Validation: Masked and Blinded Data
description: Vault now validates Case data that is masked, blinded, or undergoes any data transformation during Transmission generation.

feature: Web Intake Forms
description: Admins can now configure customized web-based intake forms to collect structured adverse event report data directly from reporters.

feature: Transmission Profile Creation Limit Removed
description: Vault no longer limits Gateway Profile creation during Transmission Profile creation.

feature: WHODrug Company Product Autocoding
description: Veeva Safety now autocodes Company Products during Case processing.

feature: Configurable Event Reported Verbatim on Import
description: Admins can now configure Transmission Profiles to determine how Vault maps data when the E.i.1.1a and E.i.1.1b data elements are blank on E2B(R3) and JSON imported files.

feature: Japan Rules-Based Narratives
description: Rules-based narratives now support generating narratives in Japanese for submission to the PMDA.

feature: PMDA Regulatory Comments Assistance
description: Vault now populates the reason for an expectedness evaluation in the new Expectedness Details field on Japan Localized Case Assessments, and populates a Localized Event (LLT), based on the global Event (LLT), on Japan Localized Case Adverse Events.

feature: Partially Completed Follow-up Questionnaires
description: Admins can now configure time-based automatic submission of partially completed online questionnaires.

feature: Vault No Longer Creates Gateway Profiles
description: When Admins create an AS2 Gateway type Transmission Profile for use with an AS2 Connection, Vault no longer creates a corresponding Gateway Profile.

feature: eMDR Device Form Validations
description: Veeva Safety now performs Case Validations for Electronic Medical Device Reporting (eMDR) device forms.

feature: MIR Device Form Validations
description: Veeva Safety now performs Case Validations for Manufacturer Incident Report (MIR) device forms.

feature: Remove Blind Protection for Investigator Causality
description: For Vaults using the Isolate Blinded Clinical Trial Information feature, investigator causality entered in Case Assessment Results is no longer treated as blind-sensitive. This means that updates to the blinded record now sync to the unblinded record, and vice-versa. Sponsor causality continues to be treated as blind-sensitive.

feature: Aggregate Support of New Study Types
description: Users can now run aggregate reports that automatically include the new Study types of Patient Support Program (4), Market Research Program (5), and Organised Data Collection System with source data from a digital platform (6).

feature: PMDA: Combination Product Registration Variant Matching
description: For Cases with Combination Products, the Retrieve Case Product Registration action now filters registrations based on Product Variants.

feature: Japan Reporting: Cross Reporting Registration Improvements
description: In Vaults configured for Substance matching during cross reporting, when generating Case Product Registrations on cases for Japan, Vault now excludes Combination Product Registrations.

feature: Blind Isolation: Simplified Japan Registration Unblinding
description: The Retrieve Case Product Registrations action now takes into consideration unblinded products and creates a single Japan Registration.

feature: FDA FAERS E2B(R3): Replace Unsupported Characters
description: On FDA FAERS E2B(R3) files, Vault now replaces unsupported characters with valid ones.

feature: Process eMDR ACKs
description: Veeva Safety now supports the acknowledgment package provided by the FDA for eMDR (Electronic Medical Device Reporting) submissions.

feature: Ignore Non-Active Studies During Reporting Rules Evaluation
description: When evaluating regulatory obligations during safety reporting, Vault now ignores Study Registrations in the New lifecycle state, in addition to the Inactive and Deprecated lifecycle states.

feature: FDA Reporting: Unique Device Identifiers Update
description: When generating FDA eMDR and FDA MedWatch 3500A (September 2025 version) forms, Vault now concatenates the Unique Identifier and Unique Production Identifier values on the Case Product to populate the D4 field.

feature: FDA FAERS E2B(R3) Primary IND Selection
description: Using the new FDA Primary IND setting on Transmission Studies, Admins can now configure the most relevant Study Registrations for cross reporting to the FDA.

feature: FDA Summary Type Reporting Rules Automation
description: For Cases that specify an FDA Summary Type, Vault now restricts rule evaluation and Early Notifications to the FDA Agency ruleset and suppresses general distribution rules.

feature: FDA Reporting: Support for Individual Study Device Submissions
description: When a study device is specified on a Transmission using the FDA MedWatch 3500A (August 2024 Version) form, Vault now populates only that device in sections D, G, and H of the form.

feature: Study Content Protection Reevaluation
description: If a case’s safety parameters change after transmission generation, running the Evaluate Regulatory Obligations action now includes updating the Study Content Protection setting.

feature: FDA Reporting: NullFlavor Export Updates
description: When certain patient and reporter identifiers are blank on a Case, Vault now populates nullFavors on FDA E2B(R3) files in the FAERS and VAERS formats.

feature: Safety Rules Troubleshooting Tool for Localized Case
description: The Safety Rules Troubleshooting tool now executes for Localized Cases and PMDA-specific rule evaluations.

feature: MedDRA International Sort Order
description: Veeva Safety now supports the International Sort Order on SOC terms in the MedDRA dictionary.

feature: Japan Reporting: Improved Validations for Blinded Product Submissions
description: When reporting to the PMDA for blinded Case Products, Vault no longer validates that substance information is included.

feature: Validation Criteria: MFDS Validation Improvements for Device Products
description: Validations for submissions to Korea no longer require drug data points such as MPID or substance.

feature: NMPA Validation Criteria: Exclude External Products
description: Validations for submissions to China no longer require registration approval numbers for external products.

feature: Safety PBRER Case Listing for Summary Tabulation of ADR
description: Vault now generates a list of all cases used in the calculations for the PBRER Summary Tabulation of Adverse Drug Reactions from Postmarketing Sources.

feature: Responsive UI for Safety
description: Veeva Safety now supports a fully responsive UI for both desktop and mobile devices. Screens automatically adjust their content and presentation depending on the screen size, while maintaining usability, readability and accessibility.

feature: Validation Criteria: EMA Identifiable Patient Updates
description: When masking patient identifiers on EMA E2B(R3) files, Vault now supports MSK as a masking value.

feature: NMPA Validation Criteria: Localize G.K.2.2 and H.1 Validations
description: The NMPA validations for G.K.2.2 and H.1 now have specified criteria that properly aligns with Chinese business rule requirements.

feature: Validation Criteria: Inactivate NMPA.F.r.1-2
description: On submissions to China, Vault no longer requires the Test Date element for Test Results.

feature: View E2B Readable Renditions in Vault
description: E2B Readable Renditions now open in a Vault pop-up document viewer. This feature is Auto-on for users with the Edit Relationships permission. For any other user who needs to use E2B Readable Renditions, Admins must grant this permission.

feature: Validation Criteria: Use EVCTMPROD Destinations for EMA Validations
description: EVCTMPROD is now an acceptable destination for EMA Validations.

feature: Product Browser: Allow Multiple Trade Names
description: The Safety Product Browser now allows for multiple trade names per Registration. Additionally, a new UI improvement is added to wrap all trade names in tag format.

feature: Enhanced E2B Generation Warning Notifications
description: Notifications about unsupported units of measurement on regional E2B files now identify the correct regional transmission document type.

feature: Case Significance
description: For initial and follow-up Cases, Vault now maps the Inbox Item Significance to either the Significant or Non-Significant field on the Case.

feature: Invalid & Special Situation Case Promotion
description: Vault now automatically maps Special Situation and Invalid Reason data from Inbox Items to Cases during initial promotion.

feature: Medical Timeline: Sorting & Unknown Dates
description: Users can now sort information in the Medical Review Timeline chronologically or reverse-chronologically, view the section in a modeless pop-up window, and see dedicated visual indicators for unknown dates.

feature: Case Compare: MedDRA Preferred Term Matching
description: Admins can now configure Preferred Term-level matching for MedDRA coded case data during Case Follow-up and Case Version Compare.

feature: Unknown Formulation Product Verification
description: When a product with an unknown formulation is reported, Vault now performs verification checks against all Product Registrations within the Product Family.

feature: MedDRA Upversion for Business Administration
description: Hierarchical MedDRA terms on active Datasheets, Watchlists, MedDRA Queries, and Product-Event Combinations are now automatically updated during the dictionary upversion process.

feature: Clinical Trial Combination Products
description: Veeva Safety extends support of Combination Products to Study Products on clinical trial Studies. *Auto-on in Vaults with Study Products that include a Combination Product value.

feature: Improved Postmarket Combination Product Management
description: Veeva Safety introduces the Case Combination Product object for Combination Product coding support.

feature: Document Intake Panel: Support for Additional Fields
description: The Document Intake panel now supports more Inbox Item fields.

feature: Readability Updates to Rules Based Narratives Follow-up Summary
description: Rules based narrative follow-up Summary Statements now use more concise phrasing, are limited to Investigator or MAH assessments, and improve clarity when suspect Case Products are added or Cause of Death and Dechallenge information is changed.

feature: Inbox Item Data Archiving
description: Vault now archives Inbox Items that are inactive for 180 days following promotion.

feature: Email Addresses for Manufacturer Sites
description: The new Email Address field on the Site object type of the Organization object enables storing FDA device manufacturer information.

feature: Standard FDA eMDR Transmission Profile Document Type
description: The standard Transmission Profile for device submissions to the FDA now includes the FDA eMDR document type.
