feature: FDA E2B(R3) Relabeled to FDA FAERS E2B(R3)
description: This feature relabels the FDA E2B(R3) file to FDA FAERS E2B(R3). There are no changes to document export or data mapping.

feature: JSON Data Integrity
description: During JSON import, Vault now excludes unsupported field types including custom objects, system fields, non-Vault fields, and fields on the ignore list.

feature: Activate the Safety Monthly Maintenance Job
description: The Safety Monthly Maintenance Job is now active in all Vaults. In Vaults that already had this job active, there are no behavior changes.

feature: EVDAS Data Requests & Automated Processing
description: Safety Signal now automates the loading, cleaning, and linking of EVDAS eRMR data with line listing.

feature: Enhanced Logic Operators for Signal Alerts
description: Safety Signal now allows enhanced Signal Alert Rule logic with AND/OR operators.

feature: MedDRA Query Analysis for FAERS & VAERS
description: Safety Signal now supports MedDRA Query calculations on FAERS and VAERS data.

feature: Signal Calculation Configuration Summary
description: Users can now download a summary of Signal Calculation configuration data.

feature: Weekly Signal Review Scheduling
description: Signal Reporting Periods can now be created on a weekly schedule.

feature: Signal Detection Plans
description: Signal Detection Plans provide a structured data model with product risk tiers guiding the review frequencies, methodologies, and deadlines across products. Safety Topics track medical concerns and events of special interest directly in Vault. Automated execution is not supported in this release.

feature: Signal Review Scheduling
description: Safety Signal and SafetyDocs introduce automated creation of Signal Reporting Periods based on a predefined schedule for a Signal Product Profile.

feature: Workbench PMDA Postmarket Aggregate Reports
description: Users can now generate compliant PMDA periodic safety reports in Workbench for organizations with cases reportable to the PMDA. This includes J-PSR Form 3, J-PSR Form 4, and J-NUPR Line Listing, along with Open Case and Case Series listings.

feature: Workbench Pregnancy Annex 3 Report Set
description: Users can now generate Pregnancy Annex 3 tabulations and associated Case and Event line listings in Workbench, complying with EMA pregnancy exposure guidelines.

feature: Sticky Dashboard Totals
description: Workbench Dashboards now anchor total rows so they remain visible regardless of scrolling.

feature: Latest Case Version Support
description: Admins can now configure Safety Workbench views to let users filter report and dashboard data by either the latest version or all versions of a case.

feature: Save Report Sets to the Library
description: Users can now upload Workbench Report Sets directly to the Library as a single Document.

feature: Dashboard Analysis with View Parameters
description: Admins can now create Workbench dashboards using views that require SQL parameters.

feature: Advanced Logic for Report Set Filters
description: Users can now specify advanced logic between filters on a report set.

feature: MedDRA Query Scope Filtering
description: Users can now choose the Narrow option when filtering by SMQ or CMQ.

feature: Dashboards: Embedded User Guidance
description: Workbench now includes a new type of Component that displays static text, enabling Admins to add documentation or welcome pages.

feature: Custom Report Naming from Dashboards
description: When generating a Workbench Report from a Workbench Dashboard Component, Vault now prompts users to enter a custom name.

feature: Dashboards: Long Text Dialogs
description: Users can now click into a Text cell to open a dialog that displays the entire field.

feature: Paste Lists into Text Filters
description: Users can now paste rows of data from Excel or Google Sheets into Workbench text filters.

application: Safety, Safety Signal, Safety Workbench, SafetyDocs
feature: 26R2 Safety Suite Standardization
description: This release includes a number of standardizations across the Safety Suite, such as page layouts, and label updates.

feature: Safety Deletion Logs
description: Admins can now configure document deletion actions to capture a deletion reason and enforce a defined retention period.

feature: Specify Reply-to Value for PVA Distribution Emails
description: Custom reply-to values can be defined for emails sent related to PVA Obligation Activities.

feature: IMIC Literature Intake
description: Users can now import literature article list files from the International Medical Information Center (IMIC).

feature: Generate Draft PSMF PDF
description: Users can now generate a merged draft PDF at any time during the PSMF Binder workflow, with the option to exclude annex documents.

feature: PVA Effective Date Automation
description: Vault automatically transitions an approved PVA from a pending state to its effective steady state once the effective date is reached.

feature: PSMF Request Management
description: Users can now track, assign, and resolve PSMF-related requests from Health Authorities and partners.

feature: PVA Periodic Review
description: This feature supports scheduled PVA periodic reviews and task generation, with automated up-versioning based on review outcomes.

feature: Prevent Automatic PSMF Logbook Generation
description: Admins can now disable the automatic creation of Logbook Entries when PSMF documents are updated.

feature: Signal Individual Case Review for SafetyDocs
description: Safety and SafetyDocs users can now perform Individual Case Reviews.

feature: Specify Start Date for Multi-Agreement Activities
description: Event start dates can be set for PVA Multi-Agreement Activities to more accurately calculate Activity due dates.

feature: Prevent Lifecycle State Change When Error Occurs While Generating PSMF PDFs
description: Vault automatically reverts the lifecycle state change when Generate PSMF PDF errors occur.

feature: User License Warnings for SafetyDocs Documents
description: Users with invalid licenses receive a warning notification upon accessing  SafetyDocs document types.

feature: Automatic Inbox Item Creation for Adverse Event Report Documents
description: Safety Vaults using Vault AI can now automatically create Inbox Items following upload of a Case > Source > Adverse Event Report document type to the Library.

feature: Narrative Agent: Custom Instructions
description: The Narrative Agent now includes standard prompt updates and the ability to configure custom actions and supplemental instructions.

feature: Quality-RIM Connection: Enhanced Change Control for Materials
description: This feature enhances the existing Quality-RIM Connection by enabling change controls to be applied against the Material records, in addition to Products. Materials include Packaging, Actives Substances & Inactive Ingredients. This level of detail facilities Batch Release.

feature: New Clinical Operations-Vault CRM Connection
description: The Clinical Operations-Vault CRM Connection enables HCP related Activities and Interactions to be transferred between Clinical Operations and Vault CRM. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Improved Error Handling for Protocol Deviations
description: Vault generates detailed User Exception Items (UEI) specifically for individual Protocol Deviation records containing unmapped Category or Subcategory values.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Restricted Subject Visit Creation
description: This feature simplifies the creation logic for Unblinded Subject Visit Data via the Clinical Operations-EDC Connection. If Restricted data is present for the Event in EDC, an Unblinded Subject Visit Data record is created. This feature maps to the "Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Restricted Subject Visit Data Synchronization" (26R2-07X001) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Additive SDV
description: The Clinical Operations-EDC Connection includes summary Additive SDV information for relevant Subject Visits in the data transfer from EDC (CDMS) Vaults to CTMS Vaults. This feature maps to the "Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Additive SDV transferred to CTMS" (26R2-0EW030) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Query Metric for Site Connect Study Plan
description: The Clinical Operations-EDC Connection supports populating the Average Number of Days to Resolve Queries field for each site for the Site Connect Study Plan.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Limit Updates to Sites for Connected Studies
description: For studies that are connected to CTMS, sites cannot be created or deleted through Veeva EDC, and their connected fields cannot be edited. This feature maps to the "Site Management Updates for Clinical Operations - EDC Connected Studies" (26R2-088004) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Clinical Operations-EDC Connection: Support Repeating Item Groups on Procedures
description: Procedure configuration in EDC Studio has been rebranded from "Integration Configuration" to "Payable Activity Configuration". A new UI introduces flexible configuration options allowing Procedures to contain data from repeating item groups and configuration options to define repeating item groups as one or multiple CTMS Procedure records. This feature maps to the "Support Repeating Item Groups on Procedures" (26R2-085006) in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Apply Cause of Death Details Only to Death-Related SAEs
description: This connection is enhanced to support an optional configuration in EDC that applies Death information only to cases that are distinctly death Cases (for example, when the Seriousness is Death, or the Outcome is Fatal). This feature maps to the "Safety Integrations: In Case of Death Information Only for Fatal Events" (26R2-0OT017) feature in the CDMS RIA.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Transmission Profile per Connection
description: Admins can now configure a distinct Transmission Profile for each EDC Vault using the Safety-EDC Connection.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Optimized Data Exchange
description: The Safety-EDC Connection updates data exchange, including linking Cases marked for follow-up to new Inbox Items, retaining the system link (link__sys) across follow-ups, and displaying translated error messages for EDC-specific failures.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Retain Primary Designation for Multi-Event Cases
description: Changes to primary AE are now strictly a human response and are no longer updated automatically by the Safety-EDC Connection.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Respond to Form Sequence Number
description: Form sequence number is now included in Case Adverse Events as a new field to indicate which EDC AE form creates the Safety AE. This is primarily to distinguish the same Event Reported, but different instances, such as if the patient has two migraine cases.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Combine Reporter & Sender Comments for Multi-Event Follow-Up Cases
description: To ensure multi-event cases are properly supported, the Safety-EDC connection now concatenates Reporter Comments on receipt of subsequent Follow-ups. Comments are not concatenated on Merge or Create follow-up actions, only on subsequent multi-event follow-ups.

feature: Safety-EDC Connection: Prioritize Actions Taken for Multi-Event Cases
description: When promoting Cases with multiple Adverse Events for the same Product, Vault now prioritizes the most severe Action Taken values (for example, Drug Withdrawn).

feature: Medical-CRM Connection: CLM Content Metrics
description: This feature automatically pulls CLM statistics from CRM-connected Vaults into the Medical Vault via a standard Vault to Vault connection. Users can now view these statistics for medical content. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Medical-CRM Connection: Document Transfer
description: This feature allows the transfer of approved documents to Vault CRM. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Medical-CRM Connection: Approved Email
description: This feature transfers steady state Email Templates and Fragments from Medical Vaults to Vault CRM. Document relationships are retained during the transfer. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Medical-CRM Connection: Populate Inquiry’s Preferred Contact Information on Case
description: This feature populates the new Preferred Contact Information field on the Case record in MedInquiry with the Person Information record created from the contact information specified on the Vault CRM Medical Inquiry. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: PromoMats-CRM Connection: CLM Content Metrics
description: This feature automatically pulls CLM statistics from CRM-connected Vaults into the PromoMats Vault via a standard Vault to Vault connection. Users can now view these statistics for commercial content. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: PromoMats-CRM Connection: Document Transfer
description: This feature allows the transfer of approved documents to Vault CRM. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: PromoMats-CRM Connection: Approved Email
description: This feature transfers steady state Email Templates and Fragments from PromoMats Vaults to Vault CRM. Document relationships are retained during the transfer. This feature may not be validated in prerelease Vaults.

feature: Quality-RIM Connection: Enhanced Change Control Integration Deleted RCI Enhancement
description: The Enhanced Change Control integration between Veeva Quality and Veeva RIM is now enhanced to ensure the system does not attempt to recreate Regulatory Change Items that were previously deleted from a Quality Vault.

feature: Quality-Safety Connection: Promotion Status
description: This feature enhances the existing Quality-Safety connection to share the status of the respective record transferred via the integration, such as the ability to indicate if an Inbox Item has been promoted to a Case, or if a complaint intake created via a Safety Case has been promoted to a Complaint.

feature: Quality-RIM Connection: Document Creation Triggers Outbound Job
description: The Quality-RIM connection now triggers the Document Integration when any document or document version is created directly in its steady state, creating the CrossLink in the target Vault.

application: RIM Publishing, RIM Registrations, RIM Submissions, RIM Submissions Archive, Safety
feature: Safety-RIM Connection: Data Transfer Enhancements
description: Data model alignments across Veeva Safety and Veeva RIM support greater data transfer, including multi-trade names and product variant substance information.

feature: RIM-Clinical Operations Connection: RIM Connection Stats
description: RIM Admins and users have visibility into the daily number of automated transactions completed by the RIM-Clinical Operations Connection via the new Connection Stats object.

feature: RIM-Clinical Operations Connection: Submission Tracking Enhancements
description: The connection supports tracking for withdrawn and implicitly approved applications, as well as enhanced support for resubmissions.

application: Safety, Safety Signal, Safety Workbench, SafetyDocs
feature: Safety-RIM Connection: New IDMP MPID Field Mapping
description: The Safety-RIM connection now sends the RIM IDMP MPID value to the dedicated Safety IDMP MPID field.

feature: Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection: Geographic Assignment Rollout
description: Vault creates a unique Training Requirement for every version of a connected Clinical Operations document, allowing Training Admins to manage each version independently and release them for individual regions or countries as appropriate. This feature is Auto-on with required configuration.

feature: Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection: Support for Cross-Domain Users
description: The Study Training-Clinical Operations Connection can transfer Cross-Domain users across these Vaults.
